papers.title: Competing Chern states revealed by quasiparticle charging in moiré rhombohedral graphene
papers.abstract: Moiré materials realize a versatile platform for exploring the physics of fractional Chern insulators (FCIs). The recently observed evolution from FCIs to an extended quantum anomalous Hall background upon lowering the electronic temperature in moiré rhombohedral graphene (mRG)8 raises a fundamental question: Is it caused by a failure to equilibrate the edge states of an FCI or by a genuine phase transition in the bulk from an FCI to a generalized anomalous Hall crystal? Here we address this question by probing quasiparticle charging in a mesoscopic mRG antidot device and by bulk resistance measurements, both of which are bulk-sensitive and free from complications from edge states. Tunneling to the mRG antidot reveals quasiparticles carrying one electron charge for both Chern states at filling factors ν=1 and 2/3 at low temperatures. Temperature dependence measurements of the bulk resistance near ν=2/3 further suggest a thermodynamic phase transition from an FCI to a generalized anomalous Hall crystal at temperatures below about 150mK. The results clearly exclude the edge state equilibration scenario and favor the phase transition scenario. Our work establishes mesoscopic probes as a powerful approach to uncover competing ground states in moiré materials and provides a basis for probing fractionalized excitations in FCIs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“probing quasiparticle charging in a mesoscopic mRG antidot device”、“bulk resistance measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：莫尔菱方石墨烯（moiré rhombohedral graphene, mRG）中的分数量子反常霍尔绝缘体（FCI）与广义反常霍尔晶体之间的竞争相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过探测准粒子充电和体电阻测量，排除了边缘态平衡导致FCI演化的可能性，证实了在约150 mK以下存在从FCI到广义反常霍尔晶体的热力学相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过探测准粒子充电和体电阻测量，排除了边缘态平衡导致FCI演化的可能性，证实了在约150 mK以下存在从FCI到广义反常霍尔晶体的热力学相变。；创新点：采用对边缘态不敏感的体敏感探测手段（介观反点隧穿和体电阻测量），直接区分了边缘态平衡与体相变两种竞争机制，并首次在实验上揭示了FCI到广义反常霍尔晶体的热力学相变。
papers.method_zh: 介观mRG反点器件中的隧穿测量（探测准粒子电荷）以及体电阻温度依赖测量。

papers.title: Quantum-Geometric Design of Lattice Generalized Landau Levels
papers.abstract: We design lattice models with tailored quantum geometry, including generalized Landau levels (LLs) satisfying the integrated trace condition and higher-Chern bands with ideal quantum geometry. Our models with $N=2$, $3$, and $4$ sublattices include a generalized Haldane model ($N=2$ honeycomb lattice model) with Gaussian-decaying hoppings realizable in twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$, and $N \geq 3$ models with exponentially decaying hoppings. Exact diagonalization reveals fractional Chern insulators in the generalized zeroth LL bands of all three models, a Moore-Read state in the generalized first LL band of the $N=4$ model, and various interaction-driven topological phases$\unicode{x2013}$including integer and fractional anomalous Hall crystals and a multicomponent Halperin state$\unicode{x2013}$in the ideal higher-Chern band of the $N=3$ model. Informed by quantum geometry, our work provides a pathway for lattice realizations of Landau-level and beyond-Landau-level physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：design lattice models, exact diagonalization, 理论模型构建与数值计算）；研究对象：具有定制量子几何性质的晶格模型，包括广义朗道能级（LLs）和理想量子几何的高陈数能带，具体涉及N=2（广义Haldane模型，可在扭曲双层MoTe₂中实现）、N=3和N=4子晶格模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在广义零级朗道能带中发现了分数量子陈绝缘体（三个模型均实现），在N=4模型的一级广义朗道能带中发现了Moore-Read态，在N=3模型的理想高陈数能带中发现了多种相互作用驱动的拓扑相（包括整数和分数量子反常霍尔晶体、多组分Halperin态）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在广义零级朗道能带中发现了分数量子陈绝缘体（三个模型均实现），在N=4模型的一级广义朗道能带中发现了Moore-Read态，在N=3模型的理想高陈数能带中发现了多种相互作用驱动的拓扑相（包括整数和分数量子反常霍尔晶体、多组分Halperin态）。；创新点：基于量子几何原理，系统设计了可精确实现广义朗道能级（满足积分迹条件）和理想量子几何高陈数能带的晶格模型，为在晶格体系中实现朗道能级及超越朗道能级的物理提供了可操作的路径。
papers.method_zh: 通过设计具有特定量子几何的晶格模型（包括高斯衰减跃迁和指数衰减跃迁），采用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）方法研究相互作用效应。

papers.title: Complex polar superstructure controlled thermal conductivity in ferroelectric PbTiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices
papers.abstract: Integrating epitaxial thin films of ferroelectric PbTiO3 and paraelectric SrTiO3 into artificially layered periodic superlattices provides a unique platform for tuning strain, depolarization, and interfacial/surface energies, thereby accessing a rich phase diagram of topological polar structures (skyrmions, vortices, merons, or sinusoidal waves) and superstructures (polar supercrystals). Here we show that the 3D arrangement of polar vortices in a supercrystal suppresses thermal conductivity (k) of PTO/STO superlattices (SLs). The temperature dependence of k reflects the evolution of the polar superstructure, as determined by X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy. The comparison with other SLs suggests that the 3D arrangement is crucial for controlling thermal conductivity beyond the usual interfacial scattering. Moreover, we observed an unexpected reduction in thermal conductivity with increasing superlattice thickness, a phenomenon reminiscent of phonon-wave Anderson localization. Our results show that complex polar superstructures can be useful active elements for modulating heat transport in technologies where control over heat dissipation is critical.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：X-ray diffraction, transmission electron microscopy, 温度依赖性测量。；研究对象：铁电PbTiO3/顺电SrTiO3人工周期性超晶格中的复杂极性超结构（极性超晶体），及其对热导率的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 极性超晶体中涡旋的三维排列可显著抑制超晶格的热导率，且热导率随超晶格厚度增加出现反常降低，类似声子波安德森局域化现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：极性超晶体中涡旋的三维排列可显著抑制超晶格的热导率，且热导率随超晶格厚度增加出现反常降低，类似声子波安德森局域化现象。；创新点：揭示了极性超结构的三维排列对热导率的控制作用超越了传统界面散射机制，并观察到厚度增加导致热导率反常降低的新现象。摘要未突出说明与已有极性拓扑结构热输运研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延生长超晶格样品；X射线衍射和透射电子显微镜表征极性超结构演化；变温热导率测量。

papers.title: Magnetophonon Resistance Oscillations in Structures with a GaAs Quantum Well and Barriers of AlAs/GaAs$\langleδ$-Si$\rangle$ Superlattices
papers.abstract: Magnetophonon resistance oscillations (MPR) associated with the resonant scattering of electrons by optical phonons at temperatures of 77-240 K, as well as resonant scattering of electrons by acoustic phonons (PIRO) at temperatures of 10-25 K, were investigated in the same samples featuring a GaAs quantum well and AlAs/GaAs superlattice barriers doped with Si. The study of MPR demonstrated that resonant electron scattering occurs on bulk longitudinal optical phonons and does not depend on the dimensionality of the system or inter-subband transitions in systems with two subbands of size quantization. However, the amplitude of the oscillation with number $N=1$ in two-dimensional structures depends on the interplay of scattering mechanisms, which, in turn, is influenced by the structure of the system. As for PIRO, in samples with two size quantization subbands, resonant electron scattering by longitudinal acoustic phonons is observed against the background of inter-subband transitions (MISO), leading to their interference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigated”（研究）、“study demonstrated”（研究表明）、“observed”（观察到）等实验研究关键词，且涉及温度范围（77-240 K, 10-25 K）和具体样品结构。；研究对象：具有GaAs量子阱和AlAs/GaAs⟨δ-Si⟩超晶格势垒的异质结构中的磁声子电阻振荡（MPR）和声子诱导电阻振荡（PIRO）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁声子电阻振荡源于电子与体纵光学声子的共振散射，且不依赖于系统维度或子带间跃迁；但在二维结构中，N=1振荡幅度受散射机制间相互作用影响。在具有两个尺寸量子化子带的样品中，电子与纵声学声子的共振散射与子带间跃迁（MISO）发生干涉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁声子电阻振荡源于电子与体纵光学声子的共振散射，且不依赖于系统维度或子带间跃迁；但在二维结构中，N=1振荡幅度受散射机制间相互作用影响。在具有两个尺寸量子化子带的样品中，电子与纵声学声子的共振散射与子带间跃迁（MISO）发生干涉。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过测量不同温度下（77-240 K和10-25 K）的电阻振荡，分别研究电子与光学声子和声学声子的共振散射行为。样品采用分子束外延（MBE）技术生长，包含GaAs量子阱和AlAs/GaAs超晶格势垒，势垒中掺入δ-Si层。

papers.title: Microwave Studies of Single Crystal TeO2 at Cryogenic Temperatures
papers.abstract: We use whispering-gallery-mode analysis to characterise the microwave dielectric properties of single-crystal TeO$_2$ at cryogenic temperatures and compare its loss performance with other low-loss dielectric materials. Finite-element modelling is combined with measurements at room temperature, 4 K, and 20 mK to develop accurate cryogenic simulations and extract the anisotropic dielectric permittivities, giving $\varepsilon_\parallel=25.75\pm0.08$ and $\varepsilon_\perp=20.90\pm0.07$. Loss measurements reveal quality factors as high as $9\times10^6$ and minimum loss tangents approaching $3\times10^{-8}$, placing TeO$_2$ among promising low-loss dielectrics for cryogenic microwave applications. Electron-spin-resonance spectroscopy further indicates a clean spin environment, while identifying distinct spin systems consistent with the known properties of the crystal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：whispering-gallery-mode analysis、measurements、finite-element modelling、electron-spin-resonance spectroscopy。；研究对象：单晶二氧化碲（TeO₂）在低温下的微波介电特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单晶TeO₂在低温下具有极高的品质因子（高达9×10⁶）和极低的损耗角正切（接近3×10⁻⁸），是一种有前景的低温微波低损耗介电材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单晶TeO₂在低温下具有极高的品质因子（高达9×10⁶）和极低的损耗角正切（接近3×10⁻⁸），是一种有前景的低温微波低损耗介电材料。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 回音壁模式分析、有限元建模（结合室温、4 K和20 mK下的测量）、电子自旋共振谱。

papers.title: Best Practices for First-Principles Modeling of Amorphous Oxide Semiconductors: A Statistical Framework and Application to Zn-Sn-O
papers.abstract: Ternary and quaternary amorphous oxide semiconductors have many properties that make them promising candidates for use in electronic applications like display, memory, and back end of line logic. However, finding the right material for a given application and optimizing its properties, deposition, and integration, requires a thorough understanding of the physics and chemistry at play. When properly carried out, first principles computations can play a crucial role in enhancing this understanding. In this work, we highlight several pitfalls often observed in research applying these computations, with the Zn-Sn-O system as an example. We show that a proper understanding of the fundamental differences between the physics of the crystalline and amorphous or disordered phases is crucial, as is a proper statistical sampling of structural models. For the Zn-Sn-O system we conclude that from a performance point of view, mobility and initial threshold voltage, it is a promising material class. However, our computed results show that a similar sensitivity to hydrogen induced doping may be present as in IGZO.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first principles computations”（第一性原理计算）、“statistical sampling of structural models”（结构模型的统计采样）。；研究对象：非晶氧化物半导体，具体为Zn-Sn-O（ZTO）体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Zn-Sn-O体系在迁移率和初始阈值电压方面是一种有前景的材料类别，但其对氢诱导掺杂的敏感性与IGZO类似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Zn-Sn-O体系在迁移率和初始阈值电压方面是一种有前景的材料类别，但其对氢诱导掺杂的敏感性与IGZO类似。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first principles computations），并强调了对非晶/无序相与晶相物理差异的正确理解，以及对结构模型进行恰当的统计采样。

papers.title: Physical aging of glasses of an organic semiconductor
papers.abstract: All glasses, including organic semiconductor glasses, are non-equilibrium materials whose properties will change with time. This physical aging process is poorly understood for organic semiconductors, hindering the rational design of highly durable devices. In this study, we investigated the volume and enthalpy recovery processes in both thin films and bulk glasses of N,N'-Bis(3-methylphenyl)-N,N'-diphenylbenzidine (TPD). Our results revealed that volume recovery kinetics exhibit negligible dependence on film thickness for liquid-cooled TPD films between 400 nm and 100 nm. Additionally, the volume recovery process in TPD films was strongly coupled to the enthalpy recovery observed in bulk TPD glasses during annealing near the glass transition temperature. Remarkably, TPD films prepared by physical vapor deposition at room temperature demonstrated exceptional resistance to physical aging, with an aging rate approximately one order of magnitude lower than that of their liquid-cooled counterparts. These results not only enhance our understanding of the non-equilibrium dynamics in amorphous systems but also offer valuable insights for the design of next-generation organic devices with significantly improved stability and durability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“investigated the volume and enthalpy recovery processes”（研究了体积和焓恢复过程），并涉及薄膜和块体玻璃的制备与测量。；研究对象：有机半导体玻璃材料N,N'-Bis(3-methylphenyl)-N,N'-diphenylbenzidine (TPD)的物理老化（physical aging）过程，具体包括体积恢复和焓恢复动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液态冷却的TPD薄膜（厚度100-400 nm）的体积恢复动力学对膜厚依赖性可忽略；室温物理气相沉积制备的TPD薄膜老化速率比液态冷却薄膜低约一个数量级，表现出优异的抗老化性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液态冷却的TPD薄膜（厚度100-400 nm）的体积恢复动力学对膜厚依赖性可忽略；室温物理气相沉积制备的TPD薄膜老化速率比液态冷却薄膜低约一个数量级，表现出优异的抗老化性能。；创新点：首次系统揭示了有机半导体TPD玻璃中体积恢复与焓恢复过程的强耦合关系，并发现室温物理气相沉积可显著抑制物理老化（老化速率降低约一个数量级），为提升有机器件稳定性提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：体积恢复动力学测量（薄膜样品）、焓恢复测量（块体玻璃样品），以及物理气相沉积（PVD）制备薄膜。退火温度控制在玻璃化转变温度附近。

papers.title: Valley Hall viscosity in the integer quantum Hall phases of (2+1)D Dirac materials
papers.abstract: We calculate the valley-resolved Hall viscosity for Lorentz-invariant integer quantum Hall phases in Semenoff-semiconducting graphene-like systems at zero temperature. The Kubo formalism based discussion reported in Phys. Rev. B 100, 115421 (2019) revealed the divergence of single valley viscous Hall contributions for this case with only a valley-summed Hall viscosity being finite and therefore well-defined. Our approach to the Hall viscosity calculation is based on an equivalent Green function formulation within Wigner-Weyl calculus. We find that the previously identified divergence seems to be regularized to a finite value in a proper representation of the valley-resolved Hall viscosity in terms of energy eigenfunctions and eigenvalues. Together with the local Hall conductivity and its first nonlocal correction, reported as well in Phys. Rev. B 100, 115421 (2019), we extend the empirical relativistic Hoyos-Son formula to individual valleys. Both the original Hoyos-Son formula for Galilean invariant fluids and its relativistic extension to Dirac materials are found to be structurally identical for integer quantum Hall phases and expressible in terms of local electric and viscous Hall responses. In addition we evaluate the valley(-difference) Hall viscosity for biased Bernal bilayer graphene in the chiral fermion low energy approximation. Prospects of measuring valley Hall viscosity in nonlocal transport for mono- and bilayer graphene- and group-VI TMD-based devices are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Kubo formalism”、“Green function formulation”、“Wigner-Weyl calculus”等理论计算方法，且未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是（2+1）维狄拉克材料（如Semenoff半导体型类石墨烯体系）中的整数量子霍尔相，以及偏置Bernal双层石墨烯在低能手征费米子近似下的谷霍尔粘度。物理现象为谷分辨的霍尔粘度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，先前报道中单谷粘性霍尔贡献的发散性，在基于能量本征函数和本征值的适当表示下可被正则化为有限值；同时，论文将经验性的相对论Hoyos-Son公式推广到单个谷，并发现该公式在伽利略不变流体和狄拉克材料中结构相同，均可由局域电响应和粘性霍尔响应表达。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，先前报道中单谷粘性霍尔贡献的发散性，在基于能量本征函数和本征值的适当表示下可被正则化为有限值；同时，论文将经验性的相对论Hoyos-Son公式推广到单个谷，并发现该公式在伽利略不变流体和狄拉克材料中结构相同，均可由局域电响应和粘性霍尔响应表达。；创新点：将原本仅适用于谷求和霍尔粘度的Hoyos-Son公式推广到单个谷，并证明其在整数量子霍尔相中与原始公式结构一致；同时解决了单谷霍尔粘度计算中出现的发散问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于Wigner-Weyl微积分框架的等效格林函数方法计算谷分辨霍尔粘度，并与Phys. Rev. B 100, 115421 (2019)中基于Kubo形式论的结果进行对比。对双层石墨烯则采用手征费米子低能近似。

papers.title: Stochastic dynamics of particles in correlated fields
papers.abstract: The effective dynamics of a colloidal particle immersed in a complex medium at equilibrium is usually described in terms of a linear overdamped Langevin equation, possibly with memory. However, numerical simulations and experiments have shown that this linear model fails, suggesting that the effective dynamics of the probe is actually nonlinear. Focusing on the case in which the medium is described by a fluctuating and correlated Gaussian field, linearly coupled to the colloid, we derive this effective dynamics and discuss its various consequences, including those on the stochastic thermodynamics of a driven particle. When the field is generated by the particle itself, with negligible fluctuations, the resulting self-chemotactic dynamics turns out to display anomalous diffusion and run-and-tumble motion in low spatial dimension, which we characterise analytically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive（推导）、analytically（解析分析）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：浸没在复杂平衡介质中的胶体粒子的有效动力学，特别是介质由涨落且相关的标量高斯场描述的情况；以及粒子自身产生场时的自趋化动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 线性过阻尼朗之万方程无法描述胶体粒子在复杂介质中的有效动力学，实际动力学是非线性的；当粒子自身产生场且涨落可忽略时，在低空间维度下会出现反常扩散和“跑-停”运动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：线性过阻尼朗之万方程无法描述胶体粒子在复杂介质中的有效动力学，实际动力学是非线性的；当粒子自身产生场且涨落可忽略时，在低空间维度下会出现反常扩散和“跑-停”运动。；创新点：揭示了在平衡复杂介质中，胶体粒子有效动力学的非线性本质，并解析表征了自趋化情形下低维空间中的反常扩散与“跑-停”运动。摘要未突出说明与已有非线性模型的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从介质由涨落相关高斯场描述、并与胶体线性耦合的模型出发，推导出粒子的有效非线性动力学方程；对自趋化情形进行解析表征。

papers.title: Short Peptide Tails Modulate DNA Association and Condensation by PAMAM Dendrimers
papers.abstract: Poly(amidoamine) (PAMAM) dendrimers are promising candidates for nucleic acid delivery; however, biocompatibility and transfection efficiency remain a challenge. Here, we investigated how the composition of short peptide tails conjugated to generation 2 PAMAM (G2) dendrimers influence DNA association and condensation across a range of pH values. Using a combination of potentiometric titrations, DNA precipitation assays, and coarse-grained molecular simulations with charge regulation, we show that the ionization of G2 dendrimers is strongly affected by both pH and proximity to DNA. Although charge regulation enhances dendrimer protonation and strengthens DNA association at low pH, DNA condensation by unmodified G2 remains largely insensitive to pH within the studied range. In contrast, conjugation of a single peptide tail introduces a pronounced pH dependence to DNA condensation. Histidine-containing conjugates exhibit the strongest response, with condensation efficiency decreasing markedly as the pH increases. Simulations reveal that the interaction strength between conjugates and DNA depends on both peptide composition and pH and that histidine-containing peptide tails become nearly neutral at physiological pH, contributing little to DNA binding. While single-conjugate simulations explain the trends in DNA association, they do not fully account for the observed condensation behavior, highlighting the importance of collective effects involving multiple conjugates. Overall, peptide conjugation transforms G2 PAMAM dendrimers from relatively pH-insensitive DNA condensing agents into pH-responsive DNA-binding systems. These findings provide molecular-level insight into the interplay between charge regulation, peptide composition, and DNA condensation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：potentiometric titrations（电位滴定）、DNA precipitation assays（DNA沉淀实验）、coarse-grained molecular simulations with charge regulation（带电荷调节的粗粒化分子模拟）。；研究对象：短肽尾修饰的G2代PAMAM树枝状大分子与DNA的相互作用及凝聚行为，重点研究pH值对结合与凝聚的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 短肽尾的引入使原本对pH不敏感的G2 PAMAM树枝状大分子转变为pH响应的DNA结合系统；含组氨酸的肽尾在生理pH下几乎呈电中性，对DNA结合贡献很小，但能显著改变DNA凝聚的pH依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：短肽尾的引入使原本对pH不敏感的G2 PAMAM树枝状大分子转变为pH响应的DNA结合系统；含组氨酸的肽尾在生理pH下几乎呈电中性，对DNA结合贡献很小，但能显著改变DNA凝聚的pH依赖性。；创新点：揭示了短肽尾组成与pH值协同调控PAMAM树枝状大分子与DNA结合及凝聚的分子机制，特别是电荷调节效应与多分子集体作用的重要性。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 电位滴定、DNA沉淀实验、带电荷调节的粗粒化分子模拟。

papers.title: Harnessing orbital Hall effect for energy-efficient magnetization switching in room-temperature van der Waals ferromagnet Fe3GaTe2
papers.abstract: 2D van der Waals (vdW) magnets provide new opportunities for spin-orbit torque magnetoresistive random-access memory (SOT-MRAM) due to their unique properties. Electrically manipulating the magnetization of vdW magnets is key to realizing 2D SOT-MRAM, whereas conventional spin Hall materials such as heavy metals and topological insulators suffer from limitations in torque efficiency and energy consumption. Although recent studies show that the orbital Hall conductivity in light metals greatly exceeds the spin Hall conductivity, direct experimental demonstrations that the orbital Hall effect (OHE) can induce more energy-efficient SOT switching than the spin Hall effect in vdW magnets remain scarce. Here, we utilize Cr as the orbital current source to efficiently manipulate the magnetization of the vdW ferromagnet Fe3GaTe2 at room temperature. In the Fe3GaTe2/Pt (1.5 nm)/Cr (4.5 nm) trilayer structure, the orbital current originating from Cr is converted into the spin current via Pt, which then exerts a torque on Fe3GaTe2. Compared with control samples using 6 nm Pt as the spin current source, the switching current density in OHE-based devices is reduced by 3.9 times, resulting in a 52% reduction in power consumption. This work presents the promising potential of harnessing orbital currents to realize energy-efficient 2D SOT-MRAM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了器件结构、实验对比（控制样品）、测量了开关电流密度和功耗降低比例等实验数据。；研究对象：二维范德华铁磁体Fe₃GaTe₂中的轨道霍尔效应（OHE）驱动的磁化翻转，具体体系为Fe₃GaTe₂/Pt(1.5 nm)/Cr(4.5 nm)三明治结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用轻金属Cr作为轨道电流源，在室温下通过轨道霍尔效应（OHE）实现了对二维范德华铁磁体Fe₃GaTe₂的磁化翻转，其开关电流密度比传统自旋霍尔效应（SHE）方案（使用6 nm Pt）降低3.9倍，功耗降低52%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用轻金属Cr作为轨道电流源，在室温下通过轨道霍尔效应（OHE）实现了对二维范德华铁磁体Fe₃GaTe₂的磁化翻转，其开关电流密度比传统自旋霍尔效应（SHE）方案（使用6 nm Pt）降低3.9倍，功耗降低52%。；创新点：首次在室温下实验证明，在二维范德华铁磁体中，利用轻金属Cr的轨道霍尔效应（OHE）可以实现比传统重金属Pt的自旋霍尔效应（SHE）更节能的磁化翻转，为低功耗二维SOT-MRAM提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 制备Fe₃GaTe₂/Pt/Cr三明治异质结，以Cr作为轨道电流源，Pt作为轨道-自旋转换层，通过电输运测量比较OHE器件与SHE控制样品的开关电流密度和功耗。

papers.title: Large-scale first-principle simulations of amorphous indium oxide
papers.abstract: Amorphous indium oxide (a-In$_2$O$_3$) is a high-electron-mobility semiconductor of central importance in thin-film transistors and a promising photoanode for solar-driven water oxidation. Despite sustained experimental and computational investigations, the structural motifs underlying its unusual transport properties and the existence of O-O peroxide-like bonds within its network have remained unresolved. Here we develop a MACE-based machine-learned interatomic potential trained on first-principles molecular dynamics trajectories and use it to generate and analyze amorphous structures containing up to 5120 atoms, two orders of magnitude larger than those adopted in typical ab initio studies. We find X-ray structure factors in excellent quantitative agreement with experiment and we confirm that In$_2$O$_3$ is a poor glass former, with the likely presence of quasi-crystalline regions in amorphous samples. Our large-scale structural analysis reveals extended chains of edge-sharing InO$_k$ polyhedra providing a concrete structural basis for the high electron mobility of a-In$_2$O$_3$. Our results strongly support the formation of O-O peroxide-like bonds in the amorphous network, with a mean length of 1.5 Å. We show that these bonds introduce localized in-gap states near the conduction band minimum, acting as a source of intrinsic n-type self-doping and enhancing sub-gap optical absorption. These effects are detectable via a distinct Raman feature near 850 cm$^{-1}$ that is absent in the IR spectrum. Overall, our results establish a comprehensive structure-property picture of a-In$_2$O$_3$, provide directly testable experimental predictions, and suggest that controlled amorphization is a viable strategy for improving the photoelectrochemical activity of a-In$_2$O$_3$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principle simulations（第一性原理模拟）、machine-learned interatomic potential（机器学习原子间势）、molecular dynamics trajectories（分子动力学轨迹）。；研究对象：非晶氧化铟（a-In₂O₃），一种高电子迁移率半导体，用于薄膜晶体管和光电阳极。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了a-In₂O₃中由边共享InOₖ多面体组成的扩展链，为其高电子迁移率提供了结构基础；确认了O-O过氧化物键的存在，这些键在导带底附近引入局域隙内态，导致本征n型自掺杂并增强亚带隙光吸收。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了a-In₂O₃中由边共享InOₖ多面体组成的扩展链，为其高电子迁移率提供了结构基础；确认了O-O过氧化物键的存在，这些键在导带底附近引入局域隙内态，导致本征n型自掺杂并增强亚带隙光吸收。；创新点：1. 实现了对a-In₂O₃的超大规模（5120原子）第一性原理精度模拟，克服了传统从头算的尺寸限制。2. 首次通过大规模结构分析，明确将边共享InOₖ多面体链与高迁移率联系起来。3. 强有力地支持了O-O过氧化物键的存在，并阐明了其作为本征n型掺杂源和亚带隙吸收增强机制的作用，同时给出了可实验验证的拉曼特征（~850 cm⁻¹）。
papers.method_zh: 基于MACE架构的机器学习原子间势，该势函数通过第一性原理分子动力学轨迹训练得到。利用该势函数生成并分析了包含多达5120个原子的非晶结构（比典型从头算研究大两个数量级），并计算了X射线结构因子、电子结构和拉曼光谱。

papers.title: Accurate Self-Attention Wavefunctions at Large Scale
papers.abstract: Self-attention neural networks provide powerful variational wavefunctions that surpass the expressivity of traditional variational ansatze. This expressivity, however, comes with increased computational complexity, raising a pressing question about scalability -- can such wavefunctions retain their accuracy at large system sizes? We apply self-attention wavefunctions to the two-dimensional homogeneous electron gas for up to N=169 particles, obtaining energies systematically lower than state-of-the-art DMC. Direct access to the ground state wavefunction further lets us recover the full collective-mode dispersion of the liquid phase, from the small-q plasmon branch to a roton-like minimum near q=2k_F. Observables at N=91 and N=169 are in near-perfect agreement, indicating convergence to the thermodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“variational wavefunctions”、“DMC”、“ground state wavefunction”、“thermodynamic limit”。；研究对象：二维均匀电子气（two-dimensional homogeneous electron gas），系统尺寸最大至N=169个粒子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自注意力波函数在多达169个粒子的二维均匀电子气中，获得了比当前最先进的扩散蒙特卡洛（DMC）方法更低的能量，并成功恢复了液相中从等离子体支到近q=2k_F处类旋子极小值的完整集体模色散关系。N=91和N=169的观测值几乎完全一致，表明已收敛到热力学极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自注意力波函数在多达169个粒子的二维均匀电子气中，获得了比当前最先进的扩散蒙特卡洛（DMC）方法更低的能量，并成功恢复了液相中从等离子体支到近q=2k_F处类旋子极小值的完整集体模色散关系。N=91和N=169的观测值几乎完全一致，表明已收敛到热力学极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用自注意力神经网络（self-attention neural networks）作为变分波函数，对二维均匀电子气进行变分蒙特卡洛计算。

papers.title: An Efficient Method for Gibbs Free Energy Evaluation under Volume Compression
papers.abstract: Accurate evaluation of Gibbs free energies is essential for constructing pressure-temperature phase diagrams. Conventional methods based on the quasi-harmonic approximation (QHA) require phonon spectra at many volume points and are therefore expensive in general. Here we develop an efficient method based on the interpolation of a few ab initio data points for Gibbs free energy evaluation under volume compression. Phonon spectra are calculated only at selected volumes. An effective Gruneisen parameter derived from the zero-point energy (ZPE) reconstructs the static-ZPE branch, while piecewise mode-resolved Gruneisen slopes reconstruct the finite-temperature vibrational branches on the target volume grids. The method is validated against QHA benchmarks for diamond (C), Al, Si, Ge, rutile TiO2, beta-PtO2, and Ta2O5 polymorphs. For simple benchmark systems (C, Al, Si, Ge, rutile TiO2, and beta-PtO2), the Gibbs free energy mean absolute errors (MAEs) relative to the QHA benchmarks remain below 0.53 meV/atom, with a six-system average of 0.148 meV/atom, while the number of explicit phonon volume points is reduced from about 20-21 to 3 in the lowest-cost implementation. For the more complex Ta2O5 polymorphs, the reconstructed free energies reproduce the main phase-stability topology despite larger phase-dependent errors. With reference to the QHA workflows, the interpolation method in this work achieves speedups of 5.911-9.023 times and remains reliable for moderate compression ranges where phonon frequencies vary smoothly with volume.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：ab initio data points、phonon spectra、Gibbs free energy evaluation、interpolation method、QHA benchmarks。；研究对象：固体材料在体积压缩下的吉布斯自由能评估方法，具体验证材料包括金刚石（C）、铝（Al）、硅（Si）、锗（Ge）、金红石型TiO₂、β-PtO₂以及Ta₂O₅多晶型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于少量从头算数据点插值的吉布斯自由能高效计算方法，在中等压缩范围内，该方法与准谐近似（QHA）基准相比，吉布斯自由能平均绝对误差低于0.53 meV/atom（六种简单体系平均0.148 meV/atom），同时将显式声子体积点从约20-21个减少至最低3个，计算速度提升5.9-9.0倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于少量从头算数据点插值的吉布斯自由能高效计算方法，在中等压缩范围内，该方法与准谐近似（QHA）基准相比，吉布斯自由能平均绝对误差低于0.53 meV/atom（六种简单体系平均0.148 meV/atom），同时将显式声子体积点从约20-21个减少至最低3个，计算速度提升5.9-9.0倍。；创新点：通过引入基于零点能的有效Grüneisen参数和分段模式分辨的Grüneisen斜率，实现了仅用极少数显式声子体积点即可高精度重构吉布斯自由能，大幅降低了传统QHA方法的计算成本。
papers.method_zh: 基于插值法的吉布斯自由能计算框架：仅在选定的体积点计算声子谱；利用从零点能（ZPE）导出的有效Grüneisen参数重构静态-ZPE分支，利用分段模式分辨的Grüneisen斜率重构目标体积网格上的有限温度振动分支。验证手段为与准谐近似（QHA）基准进行对比。

papers.title: Barnett effect generated by a rotating electric field in a ferromagnetic film
papers.abstract: We investigate the space-time evolution of the magnetization induced in a 2D ferromagnetic island by a short pulse of a rotating electric field. The field generates elastic twists that act on the magnetization via the Barnett effect: magnetization by rotation. Analytical studies are conducted within classical electrodynamics of continuous media and continuous elastic theory, while numerical studies are performed using discretized Landau-Lifshitz spin dynamics on the atomic lattice. The effect is studied for typical parameters of magnetic oxides at various field frequencies and amplitudes, and for various strengths of magnetic anisotropy, exchange, and damping. The possibility of reversing the island magnetization with an electric-field pulse is demonstrated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Analytical studies are conducted within classical electrodynamics... and continuous elastic theory”以及“numerical studies are performed using discretized Landau-Lifshitz spin dynamics”。；研究对象：二维铁磁岛（2D ferromagnetic island）在旋转电场脉冲作用下由Barnett效应（旋转磁化）诱导的磁化时空演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过旋转电场产生的弹性扭转，利用Barnett效应可以在铁磁薄膜中诱导磁化，并演示了用电场脉冲翻转铁磁岛磁化的可能性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过旋转电场产生的弹性扭转，利用Barnett效应可以在铁磁薄膜中诱导磁化，并演示了用电场脉冲翻转铁磁岛磁化的可能性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：连续介质经典电动力学与连续弹性理论；数值方法：基于原子晶格离散化的Landau-Lifshitz自旋动力学模拟。

papers.title: Universality of Measurement-Induced Criticality under Symmetry-Breaking Measurements
papers.abstract: We study the critical properties of random quantum circuits with a $U(1)$ symmetry subject to local projective measurements that explicitly break this symmetry. We find that, at the measurement-induced phase transition, symmetry-breaking measurements act as a relevant perturbation at large scales, leading to the same universal critical properties as the corresponding monitored random circuit with non-symmetric unitary dynamics. In particular, we consider monitored $U(1)$-symmetric Haar-random circuits in the limit of large local Hilbert-space dimension, where the trajectory-averaged entanglement entropy can be exactly obtained in terms of a classical statistical mechanics model. In this model, the charge associated with the conservation law follows a symmetric simple exclusion process, in which symmetry-breaking measurements correspond to disordered defects that create and destroy charges. We prove that the charge correlation length remains finite for any measurement rate, ruling out a charge-sharpening transition, in contrast to the case of symmetry-preserving measurements. We further support our predictions at finite local Hilbert-space dimension through numerical finite-size scaling analyses of the entanglement transition in monitored $U(1)$-symmetric Haar and stabilizer random circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“exactly obtained in terms of a classical statistical mechanics model”“prove”“numerical finite-size scaling analyses”。；研究对象：具有U(1)对称性的随机量子电路在对称性破缺投影测量下的测量诱导相变临界性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对称性破缺测量在测量诱导相变中作为相关扰动，导致与具有非对称幺正动力学的受监测随机电路相同的普适临界性质；同时，电荷关联长度在任何测量率下均保持有限，排除了电荷锐化相变的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对称性破缺测量在测量诱导相变中作为相关扰动，导致与具有非对称幺正动力学的受监测随机电路相同的普适临界性质；同时，电荷关联长度在任何测量率下均保持有限，排除了电荷锐化相变的存在。；创新点：揭示了对称性破缺测量在测量诱导相变中作为相关扰动的普适性，并严格证明其不会引发电荷锐化相变（与对称性保持测量情形形成对比）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用大局部希尔伯特空间维度极限下的经典统计力学模型精确求解轨迹平均纠缠熵；结合对称简单排斥过程描述电荷动力学；在有限局部希尔伯特空间维度下，对受监测U(1)对称Haar随机电路和稳定子随机电路进行有限尺寸标度数值分析。

papers.title: Vortex Dynamics in Magic-Angle Twisted Graphene
papers.abstract: We use a gate-defined Josephson junction (JJ) device made from twisted-layer graphene for studying vortex dynamics in two dimensions. The JJ sensor signals the presence of individual vortices in the superconducting leads nearby the junction through shifts in the Fraunhofer interference pattern of the magnetic-field-dependent critical current $I_c(B)$ across the junction. Rapid vortex fluctuations manifest as telegraph-type noise in time traces of the junction voltage $V(t)$. Measurements of $I_c(B)$ and $V(t)$ are interpreted in terms of multi-vortex processes where fast vortex fluctuations in the leads are modulated by quasi-stationary vortices trapped in the leads. The different timescales associated with these processes allow for their disentangling and quantitative analysis. Tracking the temperature dependence of the vortex-dynamical rates between $T = 7$ mK and $T = 120$ mK, we find that the creep type vortex motion is thermally activated above $T \approx 100$ mK, while the saturation of rates below $T \approx 80$ mK is suggestive of a sharp transition to macroscopic quantum tunneling of vortices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用“gate-defined Josephson junction (JJ) device”（栅极定义约瑟夫森结器件）进行测量，并分析了“time traces of the junction voltage”（结电压的时间轨迹）等实验数据。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（Magic-Angle Twisted Graphene）中的涡旋动力学（Vortex Dynamics）。具体研究的是该体系中超导铅（leads）内单个涡旋的运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量约瑟夫森结的临界电流和电压噪声，发现涡旋运动在约100 mK以上是热激活的蠕变行为，而在约80 mK以下速率饱和，暗示存在向宏观量子隧穿（Macroscopic Quantum Tunneling）的尖锐转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量约瑟夫森结的临界电流和电压噪声，发现涡旋运动在约100 mK以上是热激活的蠕变行为，而在约80 mK以下速率饱和，暗示存在向宏观量子隧穿（Macroscopic Quantum Tunneling）的尖锐转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用栅极定义的约瑟夫森结器件，通过测量随磁场变化的临界电流 \(I_c(B)\) 的夫琅禾费干涉图样来探测单个涡旋，并通过测量结电压 \(V(t)\) 的时间轨迹来捕捉快速涡旋涨落（电报噪声）。分析中利用多涡旋过程模型，区分了快速涨落和准静态涡旋的不同时间尺度。

papers.title: Holographic Theory of Mixed-Dimensional Statistics and Conservation-Encoding Hopping-Operator Algebras
papers.abstract: We develop a general framework for the statistics of mixed-dimensional excitations subject to intertwined conservation laws, extending the familiar Fermi statistics with conserved particle number. We define statistics microscopically through a \emph{hopping-operator algebra}: a local operator subalgebra (LOsA) generated by operators that locally move or deform excitations while preserving the conservation law. Nontrivial statistics arise when this subalgebra is nontrivial. We first focus on LOsAs that encode \emph{pointed} conservation laws. These give rise to invertible excitations, whose fusion rules are exactly those of the symmetry defects of a higher group $\cG$. For such $\cG$-conserved excitations in $d$-dimensional space, we show that the corresponding LOsA -- and hence the statistics it defines -- is classified by a cohomology class $[ω] \in H^{d+2}(B\cG;\R/\Z)$, where changing $[ω]$ by a coboundary corresponds merely to a rephasing of the local operators. We further provide a holographic realization: excitations with this prescribed conservation law and statistics live on the boundary of a $\cG$ higher-group gauge theory in $(d+1)$-dimensional space, twisted by $[ω]$. More generally, non-pointed conservation laws and the associated statistics of non-invertible excitations are defined by a pair: a LOsA together with its excitation-complex representation. This is equivalent to the pair consisting of a LOsA and its Hilbert-space representation, which is the data defining a generalized symmetry. Consequently, non-pointed conservation laws and their statistics in $d$-dimensional space are classified by fusion $d$-categories, just as generalized symmetries are. The higher-group results above are the fully-pointed special cases of this more general classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a general framework、define microscopically、classified by a cohomology class、holographic realization。；研究对象：混合维度激发（mixed-dimensional excitations）的统计性质，特别是受纠缠守恒律（intertwined conservation laws）约束的激发，以及与之相关的跳跃算符代数（hopping-operator algebras）和广义对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了混合维度激发统计性质的一般理论框架：对于点状守恒律，激发统计由上同调类 \([ω] \in H^{d+2}(B\cG;\R/\Z)\) 分类，并可通过边界上的高群规范理论全息实现；对于非点状守恒律，统计性质由融合 d-范畴分类，与广义对称性的分类一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了混合维度激发统计性质的一般理论框架：对于点状守恒律，激发统计由上同调类 \([ω] \in H^{d+2}(B\cG;\R/\Z)\) 分类，并可通过边界上的高群规范理论全息实现；对于非点状守恒律，统计性质由融合 d-范畴分类，与广义对称性的分类一致。；创新点：将混合维度激发的统计性质与广义对称性（fusion d-categories）的分类统一起来，并给出了点状守恒律情形下由上同调类分类的完整结果及其全息实现。摘要未突出说明与具体材料或实验的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架基于跳跃算符代数（hopping-operator algebra, LOsA），即由局域移动或形变激发且保持守恒律的算符生成的子代数。通过分析该子代数的非平凡性定义统计性质，并利用上同调分类和全息对偶（高群规范理论）进行刻画。

papers.title: Curvature-Controlled Topological Magnon Phases in a Folded Kagome Lattice
papers.abstract: We show that geometric curvature, encoded in the folding angle between two corner-sharing triangles on a kagome lattice, provides a continuous tuning knob for topological magnon phase. Starting from an extended spin Hamiltonian with exchange, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, and a higher-order bow-tie coupling of scalar chiralities, we derive the chirality-mediated hopping amplitude, which depends on the folding and spin canting of the bow-tie triangles. At small folding and canting angles, the bow-tie coupling surpasses DM, establishing a curvature-dominated regime. These results establish curvature as an intrinsic geometric control parameter for topological magnonics and reveal a direct analogy with chirality-induced spin selectivity in molecular systems, pointing to a unified mechanism for chirality driven transport across scales. The mechanism is particularly relevant for chiral crystals where the DM interaction is weak or forbidden by symmetry, as in systems with a six-fold screw axis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We show、derive、establish（理论推导与论证）。；研究对象：折叠Kagome晶格中的拓扑磁振子相，具体研究几何曲率（折叠角）对拓扑磁振子相的控制作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Kagome晶格中两个共角三角形之间的折叠角可作为连续调控拓扑磁振子相的几何参数；在小折叠角和倾斜角下，蝶结耦合（bow-tie coupling）超过Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用，形成曲率主导的拓扑相区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Kagome晶格中两个共角三角形之间的折叠角可作为连续调控拓扑磁振子相的几何参数；在小折叠角和倾斜角下，蝶结耦合（bow-tie coupling）超过Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用，形成曲率主导的拓扑相区。；创新点：首次提出几何曲率（而非传统DM相互作用）可作为拓扑磁振子学的内在几何控制参数，并揭示了与分子系统中手性诱导自旋选择性的直接类比，指向跨尺度的手性驱动输运统一机制。该机制尤其适用于DM相互作用弱或被对称性禁止的手性晶体（如六重螺旋轴体系）。
papers.method_zh: 基于包含交换作用、DM相互作用以及标量手性的高阶蝶结耦合的扩展自旋哈密顿量，推导了依赖于折叠角和自旋倾斜的手性介导跳跃振幅，并分析了不同参数区域的拓扑相图。

papers.title: Heterostructuring as Gateway to Electron Doping of Nickelate Superconductors
papers.abstract: Despite enormous expenditures in the research field, the electron-doped side of nickelate superconductors remains uncharted territory. Substituting the trivalent rare-earth cations by a tetravalent one hitherto failed. Here, we demonstrate by first-principles calculations a disorder-free route to electron dope Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates. When intercalating wide-band-gap insulating layers such as La$X$O$_3$ ($X$=Al, Ga, Sc) into La$_2$NiO$_4$, the extra (LaO)$^+$ layers act as electron donors, releasing carriers into the Ni-3$d$ orbitals. This electron doping puts La$_2$NiO$_4$:La$_2$AlO$_4$ naturally in the optimal region for $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave superconductivity with T$_c$ exceeding 50 K. The same concept also allows us to electron dope La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, the superconductor in the limelight.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：镍酸盐超导体中的电子掺杂，具体为Ruddlesden-Popper型镍氧化物（如La₂NiO₄和La₃Ni₂O₇）的异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在La₂NiO₄中插入宽带隙绝缘层（如LaAlO₃、LaGaO₃、LaScO₃），额外的(LaO)⁺层可作为电子给体，向Ni-3d轨道注入载流子，实现无无序的电子掺杂，并使La₂NiO₄:La₂AlO₄自然进入d_{x²-y²}波超导的最优掺杂区域，预测超导转变温度Tc超过50 K。该方案同样适用于电子掺杂当前备受关注的La₃Ni₂O₇超导体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在La₂NiO₄中插入宽带隙绝缘层（如LaAlO₃、LaGaO₃、LaScO₃），额外的(LaO)⁺层可作为电子给体，向Ni-3d轨道注入载流子，实现无无序的电子掺杂，并使La₂NiO₄:La₂AlO₄自然进入d_{x²-y²}波超导的最优掺杂区域，预测超导转变温度Tc超过50 K。该方案同样适用于电子掺杂当前备受关注的La₃Ni₂O₇超导体。；创新点：提出了一种通过异质结构实现镍酸盐电子掺杂的无无序（disorder-free）新路径，解决了长期以来用四价稀土阳离子替代三价稀土阳离子进行电子掺杂失败的问题。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体为基于密度泛函理论的计算方法（摘要未明确说明是否使用DFT+U等具体修正，但属于第一性原理计算范畴）。

papers.title: The Radial Distribution Functions of Nanofluids: Molecular Dynamics Simulations
papers.abstract: Nanofluids, which are composed of insoluble, stable, and well-dispersed solid particles of nanoscale and/or subnanometer sizes suspended in a base liquid, are the next generation of liquids of today. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the one dimensional and three dimensional angle dependent radial distribution functions RDF and ARDF of polymeric nanofluids made up of nonrigid (soft) nanoparticles and a polymer melt (base fluid) using the molecular dynamics simulation approach and to search the shape stabilities by using these results. For this purpose, we use the nanoparticles of three different sizes: 28, 42, and 56 particles. We research them both within the base fluid and without this polymeric medium for instability analysis. We found that the nanoparticles with 28 atoms show the shape instability inside the base fluid when we increase the system temperature from T=1.2 to T=1.8 and hence, the structure of two concentric spherical shell of the nanoparticle breaks down and as a result the empty vacuum between these inner and the outer shells disappears. In contrast to this findings, the nanoparticles with 42 and 56 atoms show the shape stability inside the base fluid by preserving their concentric shell structures when we rise the system temperature and decrease the affinity between the nanoparticles and the base liquid medium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Molecular Dynamics Simulations（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：纳米流体，具体为由非刚性（软）纳米颗粒与聚合物熔体（基液）组成的聚合物纳米流体，以及其中纳米颗粒的径向分布函数（RDF）和角度依赖径向分布函数（ARDF）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在基液中，由28个原子组成的纳米颗粒在温度升高时（T=1.2至T=1.8）出现形状不稳定性，其双层同心球壳结构被破坏；而由42和56个原子组成的纳米颗粒在相同条件下能保持结构稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在基液中，由28个原子组成的纳米颗粒在温度升高时（T=1.2至T=1.8）出现形状不稳定性，其双层同心球壳结构被破坏；而由42和56个原子组成的纳米颗粒在相同条件下能保持结构稳定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（Molecular Dynamics simulation approach），用于计算一维和三维角度依赖的径向分布函数（RDF和ARDF），并分析纳米颗粒的形状稳定性。

papers.title: A crystal-field route to THz-driven magnetization
papers.abstract: Light carries angular momentum, but the microscopic pathways that transform it into magnetization remain elusive. Here we establish that crystal-field excitations, historically viewed primarily as equilibrium spectroscopic fingerprints of localized 4$f$ electrons, constitute an active microscopic route through which circularly-polarized terahertz (THz) light creates magnetic polarization. Using wavelength-selective ultrafast Faraday spectroscopy on the paramagnetic insulator CeF$_3$, we show that resonant excitation of localized 4$f$ crystal-field transitions generates a helicity-dependent magnetization that survives for up to about 100 ps. Most strikingly, while the optical helicity is held fixed, the THz-driven response reverses sign as the excitation wavelength is tuned across the crystal-field resonance. The resulting dispersive spectral response follows the crystal-field excitation spectrum rather than that of optical phonons, and is captured by resonant electronic theory of the inverse Faraday effect. Our results identify crystal-field excitations as a previously unrecognized dynamical reservoir for optical angular momentum and broaden the microscopic pathways through which THz light can create and manipulate magnetic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：ultrafast Faraday spectroscopy、wavelength-selective、resonant excitation。；研究对象：顺磁绝缘体CeF₃中局域4f电子的晶场激发，以及圆偏振太赫兹光通过晶场跃迁产生磁极化的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶场激发是圆偏振太赫兹光产生磁极化的主动微观途径，且该磁化响应随激发波长调谐穿过晶场共振时发生符号反转，其色散谱响应遵循晶场激发谱而非光学声子谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶场激发是圆偏振太赫兹光产生磁极化的主动微观途径，且该磁化响应随激发波长调谐穿过晶场共振时发生符号反转，其色散谱响应遵循晶场激发谱而非光学声子谱。；创新点：首次识别出晶场激发作为光学角动量的动态储存库，揭示了局域4f电子的晶场跃迁是太赫兹光产生和操控磁化状态的未被认识的新微观途径，而非仅作为平衡态光谱指纹。
papers.method_zh: 波长选择性超快法拉第光谱学（wavelength-selective ultrafast Faraday spectroscopy），用于探测CeF₃中晶场跃迁的共振激发及其诱导的磁化动力学。

papers.title: PhononScore: a phonon-aware scoring function for dynamical stability
papers.abstract: In recent years, crystal generation models have enabled the design of massive numbers of candidate materials. However, the lack of dynamical stability among generated structures has become a major bottleneck preventing their translation into practical materials discovery. To address this challenge, we propose PhononScore, a phonon-aware scoring function for crystal generation. Unlike computationally expensive explicit phonon calculations, PhononScore predicts a unified stability score from crystal structures, enabling ranking of candidate materials dynamical stability with second-level computational cost. We construct a multi-fidelity phonon dataset containing 157,463 crystal structures. On the PhononBench benchmark, PhononScore improves the average dynamical stability rate of candidate pools generated by nine crystal generation models from 30.7% to 83.7%, achieving a 2.72-fold enrichment of stable structures, while the average stability rate of the Top-10 candidates reaches 97.5%. On a high-fidelity DFT-PBE phonon benchmark, the DFT-finetuned PhononScore-DFT increases the Top-100 stability rate to 93.0% and achieves 5-6-fold enrichment of dynamically stable structures under an extremely imbalanced hard-screening scenario. As a materials-screening tool analogous to scoring functions in drug discovery, PhononScore can serve directly as a dynamical-stability feedback signal for crystal generation, active learning, and reinforcement learning, enabling second-level stability-aware reranking without explicit phonon calculations and providing a unified and efficient dynamical stability evaluator for high-throughput materials discovery, active learning, reinforcement learning, and closed-loop inverse design. The online PhononScore platform is available at: http://phononbench.cn/phononscore/
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：crystal generation models, scoring function, phonon dataset, DFT-finetuned。；研究对象：晶体材料的动力学稳定性（dynamical stability），具体针对由晶体生成模型产生的大量候选材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PhononScore 评分函数能够以秒级计算成本预测晶体结构的动力学稳定性，将九个晶体生成模型候选池的平均动力学稳定率从30.7%提升至83.7%，Top-10候选的平均稳定率达到97.5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PhononScore 评分函数能够以秒级计算成本预测晶体结构的动力学稳定性，将九个晶体生成模型候选池的平均动力学稳定率从30.7%提升至83.7%，Top-10候选的平均稳定率达到97.5%。；创新点：提出了一种类似药物发现中评分函数的材料筛选工具，能够在不进行显式声子计算的情况下，为晶体生成、主动学习和强化学习提供秒级的动力学稳定性反馈信号，实现了对候选材料动力学稳定性的高效排序与富集。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个包含157,463个晶体结构的多保真度声子数据集，基于此训练了一个声子感知的评分函数（PhononScore）。在DFT-PBE高保真度基准上，进一步微调得到PhononScore-DFT模型。方法不依赖显式声子计算，而是直接从晶体结构预测统一稳定性分数。

papers.title: Exciton valley depolarization in monolayer MoS2: non-Markovian quantum dynamics, intervalley scattering, and the breakdown of the Dyakonov-Perel mechanism
papers.abstract: In monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides, exciton valley relaxation is typically attributed to the Dyakonov-Perel (DP) mechanism, where frequent intravalley scattering with phonons or defects suppresses the intervalley exchange-induced precession and the role of intervalley scattering is considered secondary. Employing a first-principles nonequilibrium exciton Green's function (NEGF) approach with the generalized Kadanoff-Baym ansatz (GKBA), which treats exchange-driven precession and exciton-phonon scattering on an equal footing across the full Brillouin zone, we demonstrate that even in the small momentum regime most favorable to DP physics, realistic exciton-phonon scattering is too weak to induce the motional narrowing that defines the DP regime. Upon accounting for excitons across the entire Brillouin zone, large momentum intervalley scattering becomes the dominant pathway for valley relaxation, shortening the depolarization by a factor of 3-4 relative to intravalley-only models. We find that valley depolarization and decoherence time are approximately 50 fs at 300 K and lengthen to 130 fs at 10 K. By comparing our results with a Lindblad-type collision framework, we explicitly demonstrate the role of non-Markovian effects and reveal that the Markovian Lindblad framework is highly basis dependent. In the valley-pseudospin basis underlying prior analyses, the Lindblad approach artificially amplifies scattering-induced equilibration, biasing the dynamics toward a DP interpretation. Our study provides a comprehensive picture of valley relaxation, and establishes the exciton density matrix approach derived from NEGF+GKBA as a powerful tool for investigating ultrafast exciton dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：采用第一性原理非平衡激子格林函数（NEGF）方法结合广义Kadanoff-Baym ansatz（GKBA）进行理论计算，并与Lindblad型碰撞框架对比。；研究对象：单层MoS₂中的激子谷极化弛豫动力学，具体涉及谷间散射、非马尔可夫量子效应以及Dyakonov-Perel（DP）机制的适用性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单层MoS₂中，激子-声子散射太弱，无法在DP机制所依赖的小动量区域实现运动窄化；相反，大动量谷间散射成为谷弛豫的主要通道，使退极化时间相比仅考虑谷内散射的模型缩短3-4倍。在300 K和10 K下，谷退极化与退相干时间分别约为50 fs和130 fs。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单层MoS₂中，激子-声子散射太弱，无法在DP机制所依赖的小动量区域实现运动窄化；相反，大动量谷间散射成为谷弛豫的主要通道，使退极化时间相比仅考虑谷内散射的模型缩短3-4倍。在300 K和10 K下，谷退极化与退相干时间分别约为50 fs和130 fs。；创新点：首次在全布里渊区范围内，基于第一性原理同时处理激子交换相互作用与激子-声子散射，明确揭示了DP机制在单层MoS₂中的失效，并指出马尔可夫Lindblad框架在谷赝自旋基下会人为放大散射诱导的平衡化，从而偏向DP解释。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理非平衡激子格林函数（NEGF）方法，结合广义Kadanoff-Baym ansatz（GKBA），在全布里渊区中平等处理交换驱动进动与激子-声子散射。同时与Lindblad型碰撞框架进行对比，以揭示非马尔可夫效应。

papers.title: The charge density fluctuations and the Shrinking Fermi Liquid scenario for strange metallicity in cuprates
papers.abstract: We interpret the strange metal (SM) properties of slightly overdoped cuprates in terms of the recently proposed Shrinking Fermi Liquid theory. This is based on the pervading presence in the cuprate phase diagram of charge density fluctuations (CDF), which have been identified and characterized in RIXS. These fluctuations are abundant and have a low energy due to the proximity of the charge density wave quantum critical point hidden under the superconducting dome of cuprates, but have a short range and non-critical character with a finite energy M/γ~10 meV as measured above Tc. Here M~ ξ^-2 is determined by the short correlation length ξ, while γencodes the Landau damping ruling the lifetime of the charge fluctuations. Besides these low energy CDF, cuprates also display phonons and a broad continuum of particle-hole excitations, mostly due to spin paramagnons arising from their strongly correlated character. With these experimentally characterized ingredients we show that above Tc the SM properties in transport are well described in terms of fermionic Landau quasiparticles scattering with CDF and phonons. The optical properties can instead be interpreted by the combined effect of low energy CDF determining the temperature dependence, and of the paramagnon continuum determining a linear in frequency scattering rate. Remarkably, the combined effect of these simple ingredients also induces ω/T scaling properties for frequencies larger than M/γ. When superconductivity is suppressed by strong magnetic fields the SM properties extend down to a few Kelvin. By assuming that the CDF dissipation parameter γgrows logarithmically by lowering T, we account for all anomalous transport and thermodynamic properties of cuprates (specific heat, Seebeck, heat transport, resistivity, and magnetoresistance) thereby providing a consistent scenario for the SM phase of cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：interpret、theory、scenario、account for。；研究对象：铜氧化物超导体在轻微过掺杂区域的奇异金属相（strange metal phase），具体涉及电荷密度涨落（CDF）、声子、自旋顺磁子（paramagnon）等元激发及其对输运和光学性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“收缩费米液体”（Shrinking Fermi Liquid）理论，通过费米子朗道准粒子与电荷密度涨落及声子的散射，成功解释了铜氧化物奇异金属相在输运和光学性质上的反常行为，并引入对数增长的耗散参数以统一描述低温下的热力学和输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“收缩费米液体”（Shrinking Fermi Liquid）理论，通过费米子朗道准粒子与电荷密度涨落及声子的散射，成功解释了铜氧化物奇异金属相在输运和光学性质上的反常行为，并引入对数增长的耗散参数以统一描述低温下的热力学和输运性质。；创新点：将实验观测到的短程、非临界、有限能量的电荷密度涨落作为核心散射机制，结合声子和自旋顺磁子，系统解释了奇异金属相的输运、光学、热力学及ω/T标度行为，并通过对数增长的耗散参数统一描述强磁场下低温性质。
papers.method_zh: 基于实验表征的电荷密度涨落（RIXS测量）、声子和自旋顺磁子连续谱，采用收缩费米液体理论框架，结合朗道阻尼、准粒子散射率计算，并引入对数温度依赖的耗散参数γ进行理论建模。

papers.title: Layer-resolved Electronic Structure and Correlation of Low-$n$ Square-planar Nickelates: A DFT+DMFT Prediction of Superconducting Candidates
papers.abstract: Multi-layer square-planar nickelates provide a rare platform in which the nominal Ni valence, dimensionality, and layer-resolved electronic structure can be tuned within the same structural family. Recent experiments have found superconductivity in $n=4$--8 $R_{n+1}Ni_nO_{2n+2}$ compounds, with the highest $T_c$ near $n=6$, whereas the more heavily hole-doped $n=3$ member remains nonsuperconducting. Here we propose spacer-layer Cl doping as a route to convert low-$n$ nickelates into superconducting candidates. Compared with changing the layer number $n$, Cl substitution on the spacer-layer oxygen sites offers a chemically natural way to continuously tune the Ni valence while leaving the NiO$_2$ planes largely intact; the lower-$n$ compounds may also be more accessible for synthesis. Using density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory, we show that electron-compensated $n=2$ and $n=3$ La-based nickelates, targeted to the nominal Ni valence of superconducting $n=6$, develop Ni-$d$ correlations comparable to those of superconducting higher-$n$ compounds while preserving the characteristic low-energy Ni-$d$ electronic structure. These results suggest spacer-layer Cl doping as a promising strategy for designing low-$n$ square-planar nickelate superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用密度泛函理论（DFT）结合动力学平均场理论（DMFT）进行计算预测。；研究对象：低层数（low-$n$）的方形平面镍酸盐（square-planar nickelates），具体为$n=2$和$n=3$的La基$R_{n+1}Ni_nO_{2n+2}$化合物，并探索通过间隔层Cl掺杂调控其电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过间隔层Cl掺杂将低$n$镍酸盐的Ni价态调控至与超导$n=6$化合物相同的名义价态后，其Ni-$d$电子关联强度和低能电子结构与超导的高$n$化合物相当，表明Cl掺杂是设计低$n$方形平面镍酸盐超导体的可行策略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过间隔层Cl掺杂将低$n$镍酸盐的Ni价态调控至与超导$n=6$化合物相同的名义价态后，其Ni-$d$电子关联强度和低能电子结构与超导的高$n$化合物相当，表明Cl掺杂是设计低$n$方形平面镍酸盐超导体的可行策略。；创新点：提出通过间隔层氧位点上的Cl替代掺杂（而非改变层数$n$）来连续调控Ni价态，从而将原本非超导的低$n$镍酸盐转化为超导候选材料。该方法在化学上更自然，且低$n$化合物可能更易合成。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）结合动力学平均场理论（DMFT）。

papers.title: Charge carrier flow through trimmed graphene nanoribbon junctions
papers.abstract: As Moore's law approaches its fundamental limits, the development of nanoelectronic devices using low-dimension materials has become a promising avenue for further miniaturization and performance improvements. Among the various novel materials, graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) have emerged as particularly attractive candidates due to their unique electronic properties, opening up a whole new nanoelectronics paradigm consisting of circuits made entirely of graphene. However, due to the technical constraints that naturally arise when working on a two-dimensional plane, the design of efficient nanoelectronic components with a minimal spatial footprint remains a significant challenge. In particular, connecting various components can be a real architectural challenge, comparable to that of the first printed circuit boards. This paper investigates strategies for designing optimal-sized nanoribbon junctions which allow connecting GNRs at an angle, by trimming the junction edge while maintaining favorable electronic properties. Specifically, we show that the probability density current at the tip of junctions is negligible, implying that a selection of atoms can safely be removed without significantly altering the conductance. More generally, we demonstrate that larger trimmings have impacts on the conductance channels, resulting in a conductance that is mainly dictated by the ratio of armchair and zigzag edges. Finally, we propose a simple model relating this ratio to the conductance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：investigates strategies for designing、show that、demonstrate、propose a simple model。；研究对象：石墨烯纳米带（GNRs）的转角结（junctions），具体研究通过修剪（trimming）结边缘来优化连接角度的纳米带结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结尖端的概率密度电流可忽略，因此可安全移除部分原子而不显著改变电导；更大范围的修剪会影响导电通道，电导主要由扶手椅型与锯齿型边缘的比例决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结尖端的概率密度电流可忽略，因此可安全移除部分原子而不显著改变电导；更大范围的修剪会影响导电通道，电导主要由扶手椅型与锯齿型边缘的比例决定。；创新点：提出了通过修剪边缘来设计最小化空间占用的石墨烯纳米带转角结的策略，并揭示了边缘类型比例对电导的主导作用。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于概率密度电流分析，通过修剪纳米带结边缘进行结构设计，并建立了一个将边缘比例与电导关联的简单模型。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如DFT、紧束缚模型等）。

papers.title: Influence of electronic correlations on disorder-induced loop currents in high-Tc superconductors
papers.abstract: Time-reversal symmetry breaking in superconducting systems can manifest itself in the form of currents which are induced by inhomogeneities in the charge and order parameter distribution. With regard to cuprates such states have been theoretically studied in the overdoped region of the phase diagram where the inhomogeneities are related to out-of plane dopants. In this paper we will extend previous work by including local correlations within the unrestricted Gutzwiller approximation in order to study its impact on the induced loop currents. In addition, we investigate the effect of next-nearest neighbor hopping which extends the TRSB phase towards half-filling. We find that in general correlations lead to a suppression of loop currents, however, the Gutzwiller approach can sustain such states to larger values of the local on-site repulsion as compared to the Hartree-Fock approximation. Our investigations allow for an estimation of the local magnetic moment emerging from impurity-induced loop currents for cuprate superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretically studied、Gutzwiller approximation、Hartree-Fock approximation）；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体中由无序诱导的环流（loop currents）及其与电子关联的相互作用，具体关注过掺杂区域中由面外掺杂剂引起的电荷与序参量不均匀性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子关联总体上抑制了无序诱导的环流，但Gutzwiller近似相比Hartree-Fock近似能维持这类态到更大的局域在位排斥强度；次近邻跳跃可将时间反演对称破缺相扩展至接近半填充。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子关联总体上抑制了无序诱导的环流，但Gutzwiller近似相比Hartree-Fock近似能维持这类态到更大的局域在位排斥强度；次近邻跳跃可将时间反演对称破缺相扩展至接近半填充。；创新点：在先前仅考虑过掺杂区无序诱导环流的工作基础上，首次系统研究了局域电子关联（通过Gutzwiller近似）对环流的影响，并揭示了次近邻跳跃对时间反演对称破缺相边界的扩展作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用无约束Gutzwiller近似（unrestricted Gutzwiller approximation）引入局域电子关联，并与Hartree-Fock近似进行对比；同时考虑了次近邻跳跃（next-nearest neighbor hopping）的影响。

papers.title: Quantum weight and low-loss EELS signatures of Wannier quantum geometry in black phosphorus
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry is now experimentally accessible in crystalline solids, with black phosphorus providing a key platform through polarization-resolved angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. We develop a first-principles framework that connects the momentum-resolved quantum metric of black phosphorus to a complementary bulk observable: the direction-resolved quantum weight measurable through low-loss electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS). A 32-band DFT--Wannier Hamiltonian is used to compute both single-band and occupied-manifold geometric quantities from analytic momentum derivatives. We show that the raw single-band quantum metric of the top valence band is not globally meaningful in the conventional cell because folding degeneracies and intra-valence near degeneracies produce true isolated-band singularities; masked maps and occupied-manifold projectors are therefore essential. Because semilocal PBE produces near-gap semimetallic pockets and spurious subgap interpolation features, we introduce an experimentally motivated restricted quantum weight $K_{ii}(ω_c)$, which obeys the corresponding restricted Souza--Wilkens--Martin sum rule and is the appropriate quantity for low-loss EELS once the zero-loss region is excluded. The restricted in-plane quantum weight is nearly isotropic, $K_{zz}/K_{xx}=0.972\pm0.005$ (armchair/zigzag), despite the strong band-mass anisotropy and armchair-only absorption onset of black phosphorus. Orbital-resolved Hubbard--Hartree corrections leave the absolute quantum weights rigid at the sub-percent level while producing a small but resolved armchair-directed drift of $K_{zz}/K_{xx}$, approximately $+0.46\%$ per eV of $U$. These results identify low-loss EELS spectral moments as a practical probe of integrated quantum geometry in an anisotropic layered material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：first-principles framework、DFT–Wannier Hamiltonian、analytic momentum derivatives、sum rule。；研究对象：黑磷（black phosphorus）中的量子几何（quantum geometry），具体为动量分辨的量子度量（quantum metric）及其与低损耗电子能量损失谱（low-loss EELS）可测量的方向分辨量子权重（direction-resolved quantum weight）之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 黑磷的面内受限量子权重（restricted in-plane quantum weight）几乎是各向同性的（\(K_{zz}/K_{xx}=0.972\pm0.005\)），尽管其能带质量具有强各向异性且吸收边仅沿armchair方向。轨道分辨的Hubbard–Hartree修正对绝对量子权重影响极小（亚百分比级），但会引入微小但可分辨的armchair方向漂移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：黑磷的面内受限量子权重（restricted in-plane quantum weight）几乎是各向同性的（\(K_{zz}/K_{xx}=0.972\pm0.005\)），尽管其能带质量具有强各向异性且吸收边仅沿armchair方向。轨道分辨的Hubbard–Hartree修正对绝对量子权重影响极小（亚百分比级），但会引入微小但可分辨的armchair方向漂移。；创新点：建立了从动量分辨量子度量到方向分辨量子权重的第一性原理框架，并指出低损耗EELS谱矩可作为各向异性层状材料中积分量子几何的实用探针。摘要未突出说明与已有量子几何实验（如偏振分辨ARPES）相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 基于32能带DFT–Wannier哈密顿量，通过解析动量导数计算单带和占据流形（occupied-manifold）的几何量。采用半局域PBE泛函，并引入实验动机的受限量子权重 \(K_{ii}(\omega_c)\) 及其对应的受限Souza–Wilkens–Martin求和规则，以排除零损失区域和修正PBE产生的近隙半金属口袋及虚假子隙插值特征。还使用了轨道分辨的Hubbard–Hartree修正（\(U\) 参数）。

papers.title: Theoretical exploration of Be Ag(II) F phases and their magnetic properties using learning algorithms
papers.abstract: The search for novel silver(II) fluorides is driven by their potential as electronic and magnetic analogues to high temperature cuprate(II) superconductor precursors. Here, we explore the previously uncharted Be Ag(II) F chemical space using global structure prediction algorithms combined with first principles calculations. Focusing on the AgBeF4 stoichiometry, we identify the five lowest enthalpy polymorphs crystallizing in the C2, P minus 1, and P 21/c space groups. All polymorphs show an antiferromagnetic ground state, with AgBeF4_4 and AgBeF4_5 exhibiting unprecedented strong superexchange interactions of J equal circa to minus 460meV and J equal circa to minus 359meV respectively. Those high J values are due to the presence of either [Ag2F7] for AgBeF4_4, or related infinite [AgF2/2+2/1]2 minus chains for AgBeF4_5. Although the phases are found to be metastable with respect to binary difluorides, the thermodynamic analysis suggests that they could be targeted via synthetic routes employing fluorine radicals, with reaction enthalpies reaching minus 370 kJ/mol.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：global structure prediction algorithms、first principles calculations、learning algorithms。；研究对象：Be-Ag(II)-F 化学空间中的新型银(II)氟化物，具体聚焦于 AgBeF4 化学计量比的多晶型物及其磁性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 AgBeF4 化学计量比下，发现了五种最低焓的多晶型物，均具有反铁磁基态；其中两种多晶型物（AgBeF4_4 和 AgBeF4_5）表现出前所未有的强超交换相互作用（J 分别约为 -460 meV 和 -359 meV），源于独特的 [Ag2F7] 或无限 [AgF2/2+2/1]²⁻ 链结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 AgBeF4 化学计量比下，发现了五种最低焓的多晶型物，均具有反铁磁基态；其中两种多晶型物（AgBeF4_4 和 AgBeF4_5）表现出前所未有的强超交换相互作用（J 分别约为 -460 meV 和 -359 meV），源于独特的 [Ag2F7] 或无限 [AgF2/2+2/1]²⁻ 链结构。；创新点：首次探索了此前未被研究的 Be-Ag(II)-F 化学空间，并发现了具有极强超交换相互作用的亚稳态相，为合成新型银(II)氟化物提供了理论指导。摘要未突出说明与已有 cuprate 类似物在具体结构或磁性上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 全局结构预测算法结合第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），并进行了热力学分析。

papers.title: Polycrystalline ferroelectric croconic acid for multisource environmental energy harvesting
papers.abstract: The development of organic ferroelectric materials through scalable and simplified fabrication routes remains a major challenge for next-generation energy-harvesting technologies. Here, polycrystalline croconic acid (CA) thin films are fabricated by vacuum sublimation onto Ar plasma-treated flexible substrates and stabilized by in situ encapsulation with an adamantane-based remote plasma polymer. This solvent-free strategy effectively suppresses surface degradation under ambient conditions, providing long-term stability. Piezoresponse force microscopy confirms robust ferroelectricity with an oblique polarization orientation, well-defined domains, and low nanoscale coercive fields. The films were integrated into multilayer piezoelectric and pyroelectric devices. The piezoelectric performance strongly depends on film thickness, while embedding the CA layer between dielectric polymeric films significantly improves the macroscopic response, reaching power densities of up to 37 microW m-2 for ca. 2 micrometer CA films. Despite the common assumption that high crystallinity is required to sustain ferro-, piezo-, and pyroelectricity, these polycrystalline CA films exhibit remarkable RT pyroelectricity, a property not previously demonstrated in CA-based devices. A pyroelectric coefficient of ca. 10 microC m-2 K-1 highlights a functional response comparable to that of well-established organic and inorganic pyroelectric materials, demonstrating the potential of CA thin films for thermal energy harvesting. Beyond their functional performance, the proposed low-T fabrication route combines deposition and encapsulation in a single in situ process, simplifying device fabrication. Its compatibility with scalable vacuum technologies, flexible substrates, and further process optimization makes this approach highly promising for developing low-cost, lead-free, multisource energy-harvesting systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：fabricated、Piezoresponse force microscopy、integrated into multilayer piezoelectric and pyroelectric devices。；研究对象：多晶克罗康酸（croconic acid, CA）薄膜，及其在压电和热释电多源环境能量收集中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过真空升华和原位封装制备的多晶CA薄膜，在室温下表现出显著的热释电性（此前未在CA基器件中报道），其热释电系数约10 μC m⁻² K⁻¹，可与成熟的有机/无机热释电材料媲美；同时，压电性能在约2 μm厚薄膜中达到37 μW m⁻²的功率密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过真空升华和原位封装制备的多晶CA薄膜，在室温下表现出显著的热释电性（此前未在CA基器件中报道），其热释电系数约10 μC m⁻² K⁻¹，可与成熟的有机/无机热释电材料媲美；同时，压电性能在约2 μm厚薄膜中达到37 μW m⁻²的功率密度。；创新点：首次在多晶CA薄膜中实现室温热释电性，打破了“高结晶度是维持铁电/压电/热释电性必要条件”的常见假设；提出一种无溶剂、低温、可规模化、集沉积与封装于一体的原位制备工艺，兼容柔性基底，为低成本无铅多源能量收集系统提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 真空升华沉积（vacuum sublimation）制备薄膜；Ar等离子体处理柔性基底；金刚烷基远程等离子体聚合物原位封装；压电力显微镜（PFM）表征铁电性；多层压电/热释电器件集成与性能测试。

papers.title: Bright and Dark Excitons in CrSBr: Local Ligand-Field Character and Band-Coherent Optical Selection Rules
papers.abstract: Magnetic van der Waals semiconductors such as CrSBr host an intricate exciton landscape whose physical interpretation has converged only recently. A many-body Feynman diagrammatic approach based on quasiparticle self-consistent GW with electron-hole ladder vertex corrections to the screened Coulomb interaction has established the electronic band gap, excitonic orbital character, real-space extent, binding energies, and bosonic-coupling signatures of the bright XA exciton near 1.34 eV and the higher XB manifold near 1.8 eV. These results agree well with ARPES and magneto-optical experiments and supersede the early Rydberg-like assignment of the excitons. What has remained unresolved is why these intense bright excitons coexist, within a few tens of meV, with companion states that are several orders of magnitude darker despite drawing from essentially the same single-particle transition manifold. Here we show that brightness is a band-coherent property of the excitonic eigenfunctions: bright and dark partners are sublattice-symmetric and sublattice-antisymmetric superpositions of the same ligand-field-like Bloch transitions across the two Cr atoms of the orthorhombic primitive cell. The commonly used Frenkel and Wannier-Mott labels describe what an exciton is made of, but brightness requires a symmetry-adapted interference rule between transition dipoles. Disentangling this bare excitonic structure is a prerequisite for interpreting the optical response of CrSBr once magnon, phonon, and photon couplings are included.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“many-body Feynman diagrammatic approach”、“quasiparticle self-consistent GW”、“electron-hole ladder vertex corrections”。；研究对象：磁性范德华半导体CrSBr中的激子，特别是亮激子（bright excitons）与暗激子（dark excitons）的共存机制及其光学选择定则。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 亮激子与暗激子本质上是同一套配位场类布洛赫跃迁在正交晶胞两个Cr原子上形成的子晶格对称与反对称叠加态；激子的亮度并非由激子的组成（如弗伦克尔或瓦尼尔-莫特类型）决定，而是由跃迁偶极矩之间的对称性适配干涉规则决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：亮激子与暗激子本质上是同一套配位场类布洛赫跃迁在正交晶胞两个Cr原子上形成的子晶格对称与反对称叠加态；激子的亮度并非由激子的组成（如弗伦克尔或瓦尼尔-莫特类型）决定，而是由跃迁偶极矩之间的对称性适配干涉规则决定。；创新点：首次指出激子的亮度是一种“能带相干性”属性，并建立了基于子晶格对称性的光学选择定则，从而解释了为何能量相近的激子态亮度相差数个数量级，超越了早期将激子简单归为类里德伯系列的认知。
papers.method_zh: 基于准粒子自洽GW方法，并加入电子-空穴梯图顶点修正（ladder vertex corrections）来修正屏蔽库仑相互作用，从而计算电子能隙、激子轨道特征、实空间延展、结合能及玻色子耦合特征。

papers.title: Signature in sound-mode of the exciton bilayer two-dimensional superfluid transition
papers.abstract: Obtaining definitive evidence of exciton superfluidity in electron-hole bilayers in zero magnetic field remains a major longstanding challenge since the condensate is electrically neutral, making its phase coherence difficult to detect directly. We show that the Anderson-Bogoliubov sound velocity provides a dynamical signature of exciton superfluidity. Across the BCS-BEC crossover, the velocity is known to discontinuously drop to zero at the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition. The magnitude of the drop has a strong density dependence. We compute this behavior, with the inclusion of finite-temperature screening, and determine the BKT transition using a renormalization-group approach. We further identify a temperature window which is experimentally accessible, where vortex-antivortex excitations strongly renormalize both the sound velocity and the transition temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show that、compute、determine、renormalization-group approach）；研究对象：电子-空穴双层体系中的激子超流相变，具体关注零磁场下激子超流体的声速模式及其在BKT相变中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 安德森-博戈留波夫声速在BCS-BEC渡越过程中，于BKT相变处不连续地降为零，且该下降幅度具有强密度依赖性；涡旋-反涡旋激发会显著重整化声速和相变温度，并存在一个实验可观测的温度窗口。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：安德森-博戈留波夫声速在BCS-BEC渡越过程中，于BKT相变处不连续地降为零，且该下降幅度具有强密度依赖性；涡旋-反涡旋激发会显著重整化声速和相变温度，并存在一个实验可观测的温度窗口。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限温度屏蔽效应下的理论计算，结合重整化群方法确定BKT相变温度，并分析涡旋-反涡旋激发对声速的重整化。

papers.title: Bond, orbital and spin order in d4/d6/d7 perovskite oxides: successes and limitations of foundation interatomic potentials
papers.abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are rapidly replacing density-functional theory (DFT) for modeling structure and nuclear dynamics, making their fidelity in strongly correlated systems an urgent question. We test three foundation potentials on the low-temperature order of three correlated, isostructural ABO3 perovskite oxides: LaMnO3 (d4), LaCoO3 (d6), and NdNiO3 (d7). We run molecular dynamics for 1 ns on 80- and 160-atom supercells from 50 to 300 K with no system-specific training. These oxides expose three distinct classes of low-temperature order that define a hierarchy of difficulty for the potentials. The scalar class, represented by NdNiO3, has a simple geometric fingerprint and is captured. The vector class, represented by LaMnO3, requires identifying which Cartesian axis carries the long bond at each site, and is captured in magnitude but not in symmetry. The on-site class, represented by the low-spin to high-spin crossover in LaCoO3, is a purely local multiplet population shift with no spatial order parameter and remains inaccessible to present-day MLIPs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials、molecular dynamics、density-functional theory）；研究对象：三种强关联ABO₃钙钛矿氧化物：LaMnO₃ (d⁴)、LaCoO₃ (d⁶) 和 NdNiO₃ (d⁷) 的低温有序态（键序、轨道序、自旋序）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有基础机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）能成功描述具有简单几何指纹的标量类有序（如NdNiO₃），能捕捉矢量类有序（如LaMnO₃）的幅度但无法正确描述其对称性，而完全无法处理局域位点类有序（如LaCoO₃中的自旋态交叉）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有基础机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）能成功描述具有简单几何指纹的标量类有序（如NdNiO₃），能捕捉矢量类有序（如LaMnO₃）的幅度但无法正确描述其对称性，而完全无法处理局域位点类有序（如LaCoO₃中的自旋态交叉）。；创新点：系统评估了当前最先进的基础MLIPs在强关联钙钛矿氧化物中处理不同层级低温有序（标量、矢量、位点类）的能力与局限性，揭示了其无法描述局域多重组态跃迁这一根本性缺陷。
papers.method_zh: 使用三种基础MLIPs（未指定具体模型名称），对80原子和160原子超胞进行1纳秒分子动力学模拟，温度范围50–300 K，未进行任何系统特异性训练。

papers.title: Rotation Sensing via Josephson-frequency Splitting in a Toroidal Superfluid
papers.abstract: We show that a toroidal superfluid interrupted by $n$ tunneling barriers realizes a compact Josephson gyroscope with an $n$-enhanced response to rotation. In the small-amplitude regime, we derive analytically the normal mode spectrum of the coupled population-phase oscillations. In the absence of rotation, pairs of modes are degenerate: a finite angular velocity $Ω$ lifts this degeneracy through a Doppler shift, producing a frequency splitting that grows linearly with both $Ω$ and $n$. Full numerical simulations confirm this prediction and reveal long-lived two-frequency beatings, in sharp contrast with the monochromatic Josephson oscillations of the nonrotating system. These beatings provide a direct rotation signal with estimation uncertainty scaling as $ΔΩ\sim n^{-3/2}$, while remaining robust against imperfections and dynamical excitations. These results identify multi-junction toroidal superfluids as scalable, micrometer-size rotation sensors compatible with current experimental platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive analytically”“full numerical simulations confirm”。；研究对象：环形超流体中由多个隧道势垒构成的约瑟夫森陀螺仪，具体研究其旋转感应特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在环形超流体中插入n个隧道势垒可实现n倍增强的旋转响应，通过约瑟夫森频率分裂产生可直接测量的双频拍频信号，旋转角速度的估计不确定度标度为ΔΩ ~ n^{-3/2}。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在环形超流体中插入n个隧道势垒可实现n倍增强的旋转响应，通过约瑟夫森频率分裂产生可直接测量的双频拍频信号，旋转角速度的估计不确定度标度为ΔΩ ~ n^{-3/2}。；创新点：提出多隧道势垒环形超流体作为可扩展的微米尺寸旋转传感器，利用n个势垒实现旋转响应的线性增强，并给出频率分裂与旋转角速度及势垒数目的定量关系。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导小振幅模式下耦合的粒子数-相位振荡的简正模谱；通过全数值模拟验证解析预测，并分析双频拍频的寿命及对缺陷和动力学激发的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Interplay between Electronic Structure, Chemical Bonding, and Lattice Symmetry in Bismuth Vanadate
papers.abstract: Bismuth vanadate (BiVO$_4$) is a prototypical oxide photocatalyst that occurs in both tetragonal and monoclinic scheelite phases with markedly different photocatalytic and photoelectrochemical activities. Accurately identifying the monoclinic phase as the ground state and explaining the origin of its symmetry-breaking distortion are unusually challenging from a theoretical perspective, with various levels of theory and associated physical interpretations for this behaviour reported in the literature. Here, we resolve these discrepancies by systematically assessing the role of exact exchange with and without spin-orbit coupling, demonstrating that an accurate treatment of electronic localization is essential to stabilize the monoclinic scheelite structure. Using this framework, we compute the electronic band structure through dense sampling of the Brillouin zone and show that the band edges in monoclinic and tetragonal BiVO$_4$ lie far from conventional high-symmetry paths, leading to substantial differences in band gaps and carrier effective masses. Choosing the exchange-correlation functional that best reproduces the crystal structure leads to excellent predictions of the band gap once excitonic and thermal effects are taken into account. In addition, we show that the monoclinic distortion is driven by charge transfer between non-equivalent oxygen sites, which breaks the lattice symmetry and is suppressed by self-interaction errors when using semi-local DFT. These results establish a direct connection between the exchange-correlation functional, electronic localization, chemical bonding, and structural stability in BiVO$_4$, providing a foundation for robust ab initio descriptions of phase stability and optoelectronic properties in such complex oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“theoretically”“DFT”“exchange-correlation functional”“ab initio descriptions”等关键词，主要基于密度泛函理论（DFT）进行计算分析。；研究对象：钒酸铋（BiVO₄）的四方相与单斜相白钨矿结构，重点研究其电子结构、化学键合与晶格对称性之间的相互作用，以及单斜相作为基态的稳定性起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确处理电子局域化（通过精确交换与自旋-轨道耦合）是稳定单斜白钨矿结构的关键；单斜畸变由不等价氧位点之间的电荷转移驱动，该电荷转移破坏了晶格对称性，而半局域DFT中的自相互作用误差会抑制这一过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确处理电子局域化（通过精确交换与自旋-轨道耦合）是稳定单斜白钨矿结构的关键；单斜畸变由不等价氧位点之间的电荷转移驱动，该电荷转移破坏了晶格对称性，而半局域DFT中的自相互作用误差会抑制这一过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT），系统评估了含与不含自旋-轨道耦合的精确交换作用；通过密集布里渊区采样计算电子能带结构；选择能最佳复现晶体结构的交换关联泛函，并考虑激子效应和热效应来预测带隙。

papers.title: Magnetic control of Goos-Hänchen shifts and group delay time in monolayer WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: We study the influence of an external magnetic field on the Goos-Hänchen (GH) shift and the group delay time (GDT) in monolayer WSe$_2$ in the presence of a magnetic barrier. The transport properties of Dirac-like carriers are obtained by solving the effective low-energy Hamiltonian and evaluating the corresponding transmission amplitudes. The GH shift and the GDT are subsequently extracted from the phase of the transmission coefficient. We systematically analyze their dependence on the magnetic field strength, incident energy, angle of incidence, and barrier width, with particular emphasis on the spin and valley degrees of freedom associated with the $K$ and $K'$ valleys. Our results show that the magnetic barrier strongly modulates both the GH shift and the GDT, leading to oscillatory behavior and pronounced spin-valley-dependent transport characteristics. Remarkably, the magnetic field enables selective control of the lateral shift and traversal time of carriers for each spin and valley channel, allowing for tunable spatial and temporal separation of electronic wave packets. This provides a mechanism for manipulating fermionic trajectories after transmission through the barrier in a highly controllable manner. Such tunability opens promising avenues for designing nanoscale devices based on spin and valley filtering, as well as for potential applications in information storage and processing within spintronic and valleytronic platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：求解有效低能哈密顿量、计算透射振幅、从透射系数相位提取物理量。；研究对象：单层WSe₂中在外加磁场与磁势垒作用下的Goos-Hänchen位移和群延迟时间，重点关注自旋与谷自由度（K和K'谷）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁势垒可强烈调控GH位移和群延迟时间，产生振荡行为及显著的自旋-谷依赖输运特性，从而实现载流子横向位移和穿越时间的自旋与谷通道选择性控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁势垒可强烈调控GH位移和群延迟时间，产生振荡行为及显著的自旋-谷依赖输运特性，从而实现载流子横向位移和穿越时间的自旋与谷通道选择性控制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解有效低能哈密顿量得到狄拉克型载流子的输运性质，计算透射振幅，并从透射系数的相位中提取GH位移和群延迟时间。

papers.title: Anomalous Reflection of Caustic Spin-Wave Beams in a Magnonic Waveguide
papers.abstract: Reflection of waves at interfaces is conventionally governed by Snell's law, which follows from conservation of momentum parallel to the interface. Here we show experimentally that caustic spin-wave beams in anisotropic media obey a fundamentally different reflection mechanism. Applying time-resolved Kerr microscopy to a yttrium iron garnet waveguide, we observe that reflected beams are selected by transitions between caustic points on the anisotropic iso-frequency contour rather than by momentum conservation. As a consequence, the reflected carrier wave vector and wavefront orientation exhibit trends opposite to those predicted by Snell's law. By tuning the magnitude and orientation of an external magnetic field, we continuously control the resulting reflection process and beam routing. Our results establish caustic-point transitions as a distinct reflection law for anisotropic wave beams and provide a route towards reconfigurable magnonic beam steering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally show”、“Applying time-resolved Kerr microscopy”、“we observe”等关键词。；研究对象：各向异性介质中的焦散自旋波束（caustic spin-wave beams）在磁性波导（yttrium iron garnet waveguide，钇铁石榴石波导）中的反射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 焦散自旋波束的反射不遵循传统斯涅尔定律（动量守恒），而是由各向异性等频轮廓上的焦散点跃迁（caustic-point transitions）决定，导致反射载波波矢和波前取向与斯涅尔定律预测相反。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：焦散自旋波束的反射不遵循传统斯涅尔定律（动量守恒），而是由各向异性等频轮廓上的焦散点跃迁（caustic-point transitions）决定，导致反射载波波矢和波前取向与斯涅尔定律预测相反。；创新点：首次实验证明各向异性介质中焦散波束的反射由焦散点跃迁主导，而非动量守恒，并提出这一机制可作为各向异性波束的独特反射定律，为可重构磁子束操控提供新途径。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨克尔显微镜（time-resolved Kerr microscopy），通过外加磁场的大小和方向调控反射过程。

papers.title: Interplay of Quasiperiodic Criticality and the Non-Hermitian Skin Effect
papers.abstract: Quasiperiodic lattices can host critical eigenstates, whereas nonreciprocal hopping in non-Hermitian lattices can induce non-Hermitian skin effect. In this work, we investigate localization phenomena in a Hatano--Nelson model with quasiperiodically modulated hopping amplitudes, where nonreciprocity arises from unequal modulation strengths of the right and left hoppings. Using a non-unitary gauge transformation, we map the non-Hermitian system into a Hermitian quasiperiodic system and obtain an exact analytical expression for the Lyapunov exponent in the thermodynamic limit. Under periodic boundary conditions, inverse participation ratios and finite-size scaling analysis are used to identify the quasiperiodic critical regimes.
