The comparison shows that parameter regimes hosting quasiperiodic critical states under periodic boundary conditions can exhibit the non-Hermitian skin effect under open boundary conditions. Furthermore, the non-Hermitian skin effect associated with quasiperiodic critical regimes is also observed in representative long-range hopping models and multiband extensions. Our results provide an analytically controlled perspective on how quasiperiodicity, modulated nonreciprocity, and boundary conditions jointly shape the non-Hermitian skin effect in critical regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-unitary gauge transformation、Lyapunov exponent、finite-size scaling analysis。；研究对象：准周期非厄米晶格中的局域化现象，具体为具有准周期调制跃迁振幅的Hatano-Nelson模型，以及非厄米趋肤效应与准周期临界性的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在周期边界条件下呈现准周期临界态的参数区域，在开放边界条件下可以表现出非厄米趋肤效应；准周期临界区相关的非厄米趋肤效应也在长程跳跃模型和多带扩展中被观察到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在周期边界条件下呈现准周期临界态的参数区域，在开放边界条件下可以表现出非厄米趋肤效应；准周期临界区相关的非厄米趋肤效应也在长程跳跃模型和多带扩展中被观察到。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过非幺正规范变换将非厄米系统映射为厄米准周期系统，在热力学极限下解析推导出Lyapunov指数；在周期边界条件下使用逆参与率和有限尺寸标度分析识别准周期临界区域。

papers.title: Emergent Topology from Nonlocal Electronic Correlations in One Dimension
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that electronic correlations in low-dimensional systems can induce topological phases starting from a topologically trivial noninteracting band structure. Using an advanced cluster-diagrammatic many-body approach applied to the one-dimensional extended Hubbard model, we show that tuning the nonlocal Coulomb interaction drives the emergence of bond-order-wave (BOW) and charge-density-wave (CDW) phases. Despite being interaction-driven and symmetry-broken, these states admit an effective low-energy single-particle description. In particular, the BOW phase maps onto an effective Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, while the CDW phase, with subleading bond-order correlations, corresponds to a Rice-Mele model. Both phases exhibit a nontrivial topological character, manifested by the presence of localized edge states. Our results establish a mechanism by which nonlocal electronic correlations generate emergent topology in correlated systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、using an advanced cluster-diagrammatic many-body approach、maps onto an effective model。；研究对象：一维扩展Hubbard模型中的非局域电子关联诱导的拓扑相，具体包括键序波（BOW）相和电荷密度波（CDW）相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节非局域库仑相互作用，可以从拓扑平庸的非相互作用能带出发，在相互作用驱动的对称破缺相（BOW和CDW）中诱导出非平庸拓扑性质，表现为局域边缘态的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节非局域库仑相互作用，可以从拓扑平庸的非相互作用能带出发，在相互作用驱动的对称破缺相（BOW和CDW）中诱导出非平庸拓扑性质，表现为局域边缘态的存在。；创新点：揭示了非局域电子关联作为产生涌现拓扑的新机制，即从拓扑平庸的能带结构出发，仅通过调控非局域相互作用即可实现拓扑相变。
papers.method_zh: 采用先进的团簇图解多体方法（cluster-diagrammatic many-body approach）对一维扩展Hubbard模型进行计算分析，并将BOW相映射为有效Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型，CDW相映射为Rice-Mele模型。

papers.title: Nonlocal Electrostatic Origin of Schottky-Barrier Variability in 2D Contacts
papers.abstract: Electrical contacts often limit the performance of atomically thin semiconductor devices. The Schottky barrier height (SBH) is conventionally treated as a local interface property, yet reported values for the same metal/2D-semiconductor contact vary by hundreds of meV. Here we show that, in top contacts, the effective SBH exhibits a pronounced nonlocal electrostatic dependence on defects near the contact edge, beyond the conventional local interface framework. A nonlocal electrostatic model, supported by density-functional-theory-based transport calculations for Ti--MoS$_2$ and Au--MoS$_2$, captures the large, metal-dependent variations in SBH as a function of defect position relative to the contact edge. These results provide a unified explanation for the longstanding variability in experimentally extracted SBHs and establish nonlocal electrostatics, mediated by edge-proximal defects, as a key mechanism governing carrier injection in 2D contacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“density-functional-theory-based transport calculations”（基于密度泛函理论的输运计算）和“nonlocal electrostatic model”（非局域静电模型）。；研究对象：二维半导体（如MoS₂）与金属（Ti、Au）接触中的肖特基势垒高度（SBH）变异性问题，特别是接触边缘附近缺陷对有效SBH的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在顶部接触中，有效肖特基势垒高度表现出对接触边缘附近缺陷的非局域静电依赖性，这解释了长期以来实验提取的SBH值存在数百毫电子伏特差异的原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在顶部接触中，有效肖特基势垒高度表现出对接触边缘附近缺陷的非局域静电依赖性，这解释了长期以来实验提取的SBH值存在数百毫电子伏特差异的原因。；创新点：突破了传统将SBH视为局部界面性质的框架，揭示了接触边缘附近的缺陷通过非局域静电机制主导载流子注入，为实验SBH的广泛变异性提供了统一解释。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的输运计算，结合非局域静电模型，对Ti-MoS₂和Au-MoS₂接触体系进行分析。

papers.title: Phase stability and ionic transport in post-spinel CaV$_2$O$_4$ cathode
papers.abstract: Calcium-ion batteries (CBs) represent an alternative to lithium-ion technology but their advancement is limited by the lack of high-performance intercalation cathodes. Identified via computational screening, post-spinel CaV$_2$O$_4$ has emerged as a promising candidate, though its practical application is hindered by limited electrochemical capacity. Hence, we investigate the thermodynamic and ionic transport characteristics of Ca$_x$V$_2$O$_4$ ($0 \leq x \leq 1$) in this work, by integrating the cluster expansion formalism with Monte Carlo simulations and density functional theory based calculations. We construct the temperature-composition phase diagram of Ca$_x$V$_2$O$_4$ revealing several stable phases ($α$ through $ζ$) that can appear during electrochemical operations at different voltages. Importantly, we observe the formation of the $\varepsilon$ phase at $x \sim 0.83$ across a 370-590~K temperature window via invariant reactions, which agrees with observations in the experimental voltage profiles. Further, migration barrier calculations confirm that Ca mobility is severely impeded within the $α$ ($x \sim 0$) and $γ$ ($x \sim 0.5$) phases. With the strong Ca-vacancy ordering contributing to the high barrier in $γ$ and the persistent two-phase region stretching across the $δ$ ($x \sim 0.67$) and the $γ$ phases, we expect the accessible electrochemical capacity in the CaV$_2$O$_4$ system to be kinetically limited to at most half the theoretical capacity at 298~K, in agreement with experiments. Strategies including cation doping and particle size reduction can be considered to flatten the potential energy landscape of $γ$ and improve Ca mobility. Our computational findings highlight the interplay between stability and transport and provide design strategies that can enable the practical use of CaV$_2$O$_4$ as a CB cathode.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：cluster expansion formalism、Monte Carlo simulations、density functional theory based calculations。；研究对象：后尖晶石结构CaV₂O₄作为钙离子电池正极材料，具体研究其在不同钙含量（CaₓV₂O₄，0≤x≤1）下的相稳定性与离子输运特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CaV₂O₄正极在室温下的可逆电化学容量受动力学限制，最多仅为理论容量的一半；主要原因是γ相（x~0.5）中强烈的钙-空位有序导致高迁移势垒，以及δ相与γ相之间存在的两相区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CaV₂O₄正极在室温下的可逆电化学容量受动力学限制，最多仅为理论容量的一半；主要原因是γ相（x~0.5）中强烈的钙-空位有序导致高迁移势垒，以及δ相与γ相之间存在的两相区。；创新点：通过计算揭示了CaₓV₂O₄体系中多个稳定相（α至ζ）在电化学操作中的出现顺序，并首次指出ε相（x~0.83）在370-590 K温度窗口内通过不变反应形成，与实验电压曲线吻合；同时明确了容量受限的微观机制（强Ca-空位有序与两相区），并提出了改善离子迁移的掺杂与粒径减小策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用团簇展开形式结合蒙特卡洛模拟与基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算，构建了温度-组分相图，并进行了迁移势垒计算。

papers.title: Viscoelasticity Enhances Contactless Adhesion of Soft Substrates
papers.abstract: Understanding adhesion is essential for describing stability, friction, and interfacial dynamics. Here, we investigate the adhesion force dynamics between a rigid sphere and a soft surface without direct contact, mediated by a viscous fluid. By combining controlled experiments, a first-principles visco-elastohydrodynamic theory, and numerical simulations, we demonstrate that viscoelastic relaxation fundamentally modifies elastohydrodynamic adhesion. Rather than simply dissipating energy, viscoelasticity causes the substrate to behave transiently as a stiffer solid, enhancing the maximum adhesive force, changing the early-time force growth for $t^{2/3}$ to $t^{1/3}$, shortening the interaction time, and giving rise to new scaling laws governed by the Deborah number. The two proposed dimensionless parameters, the softness parameter and the Deborah number, define a unified phase diagram connecting three distinct adhesion regimes: classical Reynolds lubrication, elastohydrodynamic adhesion, and the newly identified visco-elastohydrodynamic regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“结合受控实验、第一性原理粘弹流体动力学理论和数值模拟”。；研究对象：刚性球体与软基底之间通过粘性流体介导的非接触式粘附力动力学，具体涉及粘弹性对弹性流体动力学粘附的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 粘弹性松弛并非单纯耗散能量，而是使基底瞬态表现为更硬的固体，从而增强最大粘附力、改变早期力增长的时间标度（从t^(2/3)变为t^(1/3)）、缩短相互作用时间，并产生由Deborah数控制的新标度律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：粘弹性松弛并非单纯耗散能量，而是使基底瞬态表现为更硬的固体，从而增强最大粘附力、改变早期力增长的时间标度（从t^(2/3)变为t^(1/3)）、缩短相互作用时间，并产生由Deborah数控制的新标度律。；创新点：提出了两个无量纲参数（软度参数和Deborah数），构建了统一相图，将粘附分为三个不同区域：经典雷诺润滑区、弹性流体动力学粘附区，以及新发现的粘弹流体动力学区。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 受控实验（具体实验手段摘要未明确说明）；第一性原理粘弹流体动力学理论；数值模拟。

papers.title: Scalable Simulation of Strongly Correlated Electron-Phonon Systems via Non-Gaussian Matrix Product States
papers.abstract: We investigate strongly correlated electron-phonon (e-ph) systems via a non-Gaussian matrix product state method. By combining non-Gaussian states with matrix product states, our method efficiently characterizes the intractable entanglement between strongly correlated electrons and phononic modes of unbounded Hilbert space, enabling scalable simulations across broad parameter regimes. In one-dimensional generalized Hubbard--Holstein (HH) models, we identify a pronounced tendency toward phase separation (PS), an instability relevant to recent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy observations on doped cuprate chain. In two-dimensional HH models, we construct the phase diagram at half-filling featuring a metallic phase emerging from the competition between non-local phonon-mediated attraction and local Hubbard repulsion. Upon doping, we elucidate the role of soft phonons in stabilizing stripe phases. In the antiferromagnet, the stabilization of the fully filled stripe is attributed to a local retardation effect, wherein the charge order is pinned by phonons, leading to a diminished response to spin fluctuations. In the doped charge-density-wave regime, a novel bipolaronic stripe phase with an enlarged unit cell is stabilized via a non-local retardation effect, where long-range phonon-mediated interactions suppress PS. Our work establishes a systematic route to decoding the e-ph interplay that is crucial for superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“non-Gaussian matrix product state method”、“scalable simulations”、“construct the phase diagram”、“elucidate the role”。；研究对象：强关联电子-声子耦合系统，具体包括一维广义Hubbard-Holstein模型和二维Hubbard-Holstein模型，涉及相分离、条纹相、电荷密度波等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一维广义Hubbard-Holstein模型中发现了显著的相分离倾向；在二维半满模型中构建了相图，揭示了非局域声子介导吸引与局域Hubbard排斥竞争导致的金属相；掺杂后，软声子稳定了条纹相，并识别了两种不同的延迟效应机制（局域与非局域）分别稳定反铁磁和掺杂电荷密度波区域的条纹相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一维广义Hubbard-Holstein模型中发现了显著的相分离倾向；在二维半满模型中构建了相图，揭示了非局域声子介导吸引与局域Hubbard排斥竞争导致的金属相；掺杂后，软声子稳定了条纹相，并识别了两种不同的延迟效应机制（局域与非局域）分别稳定反铁磁和掺杂电荷密度波区域的条纹相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 非高斯矩阵乘积态方法。该方法将非高斯态与矩阵乘积态结合，有效表征强关联电子与无限希尔伯特空间声子模式之间难以处理的纠缠，从而实现对宽参数范围的可扩展模拟。

papers.title: Perpendicular magnetic anisotropy tuning of macrospin-to-vortex transitions in Co-based artificial spin-vortex ice
papers.abstract: We investigate the macrospin-to-vortex (MS-to-V) transition in Co-based artificial spin-vortex ice (ASVI) in the presence of perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) by spin-wave spectroscopy. Detailed micromagnetic simulations using mumax3 reveal that the PMA modifies the magnetic energy landscape and facilitates vortex formation, suggesting that PMA can enhance the transition probability. To seek experimental validation of this hypothesis, we prepared Ti (3 nm)/Co (10 nm)/Ti (3 nm)/Pt (2 nm) (TCT) and Ti (3 nm)/Co (10 nm)/Pt (2 nm) (TCP) multilayer stacks. Vibrating sample magnetometry measurements confirm that the TCP film exhibits a larger PMA than the TCT film. Using these stacks, we then investigate the MS-to-V transition probability in ASVIs and found that TCP ASVIs exhibit a higher transition probability than TCT ASVIs, in agreement with the simulation prediction. These findings identify PMA as an effective design parameter for controlling vortex formation in ASVIs and provide a promising route toward task-dependent tuning of fading-memory properties for physical reservoir computing based on artificial spin lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“micromagnetic simulations using mumax3”（计算模拟）和“Vibrating sample magnetometry measurements”（实验测量）。；研究对象：Co基人造自旋-涡旋冰（ASVI）中的宏观自旋到涡旋（MS-to-V）转变，以及垂直磁各向异性（PMA）对该转变的调控作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 垂直磁各向异性（PMA）能够改变磁能量景观并促进涡旋形成，从而增强宏观自旋到涡旋的转变概率；实验与模拟结果一致，证实PMA可作为控制ASVI中涡旋形成的有效设计参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：垂直磁各向异性（PMA）能够改变磁能量景观并促进涡旋形成，从而增强宏观自旋到涡旋的转变概率；实验与模拟结果一致，证实PMA可作为控制ASVI中涡旋形成的有效设计参数。；创新点：首次提出并验证了垂直磁各向异性（PMA）可作为人造自旋-涡旋冰（ASVI）中涡旋形成的关键调控参数，为基于人造自旋晶格的物理储层计算中记忆特性的任务依赖调谐提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 微磁学模拟（使用mumax3）和振动样品磁强计（VSM）测量；制备了Ti(3 nm)/Co(10 nm)/Ti(3 nm)/Pt(2 nm)（TCT）和Ti(3 nm)/Co(10 nm)/Pt(2 nm)（TCP）多层膜堆栈。

papers.title: Basin-volume distributions in monodisperse particle packings -- the soul of memory
papers.abstract: Mechanically stable packings of $N$ particles in $d$ dimensions lie at the minima of an $Nd$-dimensional potential energy landscape. Starting from random initial particle positions, the system can relax using gradient-based optimization until it arrives at one of the equilibrium states; all initial conditions that end at the same minimum belong to the same catchment basin. We measure the distribution of the catchment basin volumes for indistinguishable monodisperse soft spheres in both $d=2$ and $d=3$. Ordering the basins at each system size, $N$, according to their volume, $P_N(n)$, from the largest at $n=1$ to smaller at larger $n$, we find a very wide distribution of volumes which is similar in both dimensions: $P_N(n) \approx A_Nn^{-α}$ with $α\approx 1$ which, in our most favorable cases, extends over $7$ decades. We explore aspects of the connectivity of the basins, show that their structure is highly contorted, and demonstrate how these results may be used to understand the imprinting of memories in cyclic strain studies of solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“gradient-based optimization”（基于梯度的优化）、“measure the distribution”（测量分布）、“numerical simulation”特征明显。；研究对象：单分散软球颗粒堆积体系（monodisperse soft spheres）在二维（d=2）和三维（d=3）中的势能景观（potential energy landscape）及其集水盆地（catchment basin）体积分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单分散颗粒堆积的集水盆地体积分布呈现宽泛的幂律行为：\( P_N(n) \approx A_N n^{-\alpha} \)，其中指数 \(\alpha \approx 1\)，且该分布可在最有利情况下跨越7个数量级。此外，盆地结构高度扭曲，其连通性可用于理解固体循环应变研究中的记忆印刻（imprinting of memories）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单分散颗粒堆积的集水盆地体积分布呈现宽泛的幂律行为：\( P_N(n) \approx A_N n^{-\alpha} \)，其中指数 \(\alpha \approx 1\)，且该分布可在最有利情况下跨越7个数量级。此外，盆地结构高度扭曲，其连通性可用于理解固体循环应变研究中的记忆印刻（imprinting of memories）。；创新点：首次系统测量了单分散软球堆积中集水盆地体积的完整分布，并发现其在二维和三维中均呈现近似的幂律标度（\(\alpha \approx 1\)），且分布范围极宽（跨越7个数量级）。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 从随机初始粒子位置出发，采用基于梯度的优化方法（gradient-based optimization）使系统弛豫至势能最小值，从而定义并统计各集水盆地的体积分布。在d=2和d=3中分别进行数值测量，并按体积大小对盆地排序（n=1为最大盆地）。

papers.title: Helically Enhanced Chiroptical Response and Symmetry Breaking in Conjugated Polymers
papers.abstract: Chiral $π$-conjugated polymers are an attractive material platform for spin polarized carrier-transport and spectroscopy, but fundamental considerations for how torsional disorder influences the response properties of the material have not been considered. Here we combine atomistic electronic structure modeling with with experimental spectroscopic measurements to examine symmetry breaking in the prototypical $π$-conjugated polymer polyacetylene, (CH)$_x$. Chiral (CH)$_x$ oligomers are generated in distinct conformations which differ in their out-of-plane tonsorial ordering. We find that a \textit{helical }conformation introduces orders of magnitude enhanced chiroptical activity due to a solenoid effect. This effect is visualized by the Transition Chiral Tensor analysis which shows signatures of domain ordering which eliminates destructive interference between electric and magnetic contributions. These findings highlight the capability to develop a hierarchical interpretation relating local, fragment symmetry breaking to global, nonlocal interactions governing chiroptical response in emerging chiral materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。依据：摘要明确提到“combine atomistic electronic structure modeling with experimental spectroscopic measurements”。；研究对象：手性π共轭聚合物中的螺旋构象及其手性光学响应，具体以聚乙炔（polyacetylene, (CH)ₓ）为原型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 螺旋构象因螺线管效应（solenoid effect）可引入数量级增强的手性光学活性；该效应源于过渡手性张量分析揭示的畴序，消除了电与磁贡献之间的相消干涉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：螺旋构象因螺线管效应（solenoid effect）可引入数量级增强的手性光学活性；该效应源于过渡手性张量分析揭示的畴序，消除了电与磁贡献之间的相消干涉。；创新点：首次考虑了扭转无序（torsional disorder）对手性π共轭聚合物响应性质的影响，并揭示了螺旋构象通过畴序实现手性光学活性增强的物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 原子级电子结构建模（atomistic electronic structure modeling）结合实验光谱测量；采用过渡手性张量分析（Transition Chiral Tensor analysis）可视化手性响应机制。

papers.title: Active Particles Imprint Persistent Percolating Networks in Polymer Condensates
papers.abstract: Fluid condensates readily exchange components and reorganize, and in doing so typically erase structural history. Using simulations of sticker-spacer polymers in an active particle bath, we show that activity drives condensates from compact droplets into system-spanning percolated networks by enhancing interchain connectivity, suppressing intrachain collapse, and increasing topological constraints through interchain winding. The network persists after the active particles are removed, despite continued polymer exchange and contact turnover, revealing a fluid-like state with activity-induced topological imprinting. Hence, activity can write long-lived structural organization and memory into fluid condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“simulations”（模拟）、“sticker-spacer polymers”（贴纸-间隔聚合物模型）、“active particle bath”（活性粒子浴）。；研究对象：活性粒子浴驱动的聚合物凝聚体（polymer condensates），具体为贴纸-间隔聚合物（sticker-spacer polymers）在活性粒子浴中形成的网络结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性粒子浴通过增强链间连接、抑制链内塌缩以及增加链间缠绕带来的拓扑约束，将聚合物凝聚体从致密液滴转变为贯穿整个系统的逾渗网络；该网络在移除活性粒子后仍能持续存在，表明活性可以在流体凝聚体中写入持久的拓扑印记和结构记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性粒子浴通过增强链间连接、抑制链内塌缩以及增加链间缠绕带来的拓扑约束，将聚合物凝聚体从致密液滴转变为贯穿整个系统的逾渗网络；该网络在移除活性粒子后仍能持续存在，表明活性可以在流体凝聚体中写入持久的拓扑印记和结构记忆。；创新点：揭示了活性粒子浴能够通过拓扑印记（topological imprinting）在流体凝聚体中写入长寿命的结构组织和记忆，而传统流体凝聚体通常因快速交换和重组而擦除结构历史。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比或定量预测。
papers.method_zh: 采用贴纸-间隔聚合物模型进行计算机模拟，并引入活性粒子浴（active particle bath）来驱动体系演化。

papers.title: Interfacial chirality-induced magnetic-field-free switching with high energy efficiency in all-vdW heterostructures
papers.abstract: Chirality, a central concept across many scientific disciplines, continues to inspire the discovery of novel physical phenomena. In condensed matter physics, structural chirality - defined by the absence of mirror plane symmetries - has primarily been explored in bulk materials. However, new chiral phenomena can emerge uniquely at the interface, distinct from their bulk counterparts, when a chiral material forms a heterostructure. Here, we demonstrate that all van-der-Waals (vdW) heterostructure composed of the chiral Co1/3TaS2 and the achiral vdW ferromagnet Fe3GeTe2 exhibits two distinct and unconventional spin-orbit torques originating from the interfacial chirality. These torques enable magnetic-field-free switching of perpendicular magnetization with ultralow current density ~ 10^6 A/cm^2 and minimal power dissipation < 10^15 W/m^3. Moreover, by replacing Fe3GeTe2 with a similar vdW ferromagnet, Fe3GaTe2, but of higher Curie temperature, we achieved the magnetic-field-free switching at room temperature in the Fe3GaTe2/Co1/3TaS2 vdW heterostructure. Our findings establish interfacial chirality as a powerful new handle for spintronic control, opening a new pathway to explore chirality-induced phenomena beyond the bulk symmetry constraints - and paving the way toward highly efficient, low-power spintronic devices based on all-vdW heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”、“achieved”等实验性动词，并给出了具体的电流密度和功率耗散数值。；研究对象：全范德华（all-vdW）异质结构，具体为手性材料Co1/3TaS2与非手性范德华铁磁体Fe3GeTe2（或Fe3GaTe2）构成的异质结，研究界面手性诱导的自旋轨道矩及无外磁场磁化翻转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面手性在全范德华异质结中产生了两种非常规的自旋轨道矩，实现了无外磁场下的垂直磁化翻转，且具有超低电流密度（~10^6 A/cm²）和极低功耗（<10^15 W/m³）；通过替换更高居里温度的铁磁体Fe3GaTe2，在室温下实现了无场翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面手性在全范德华异质结中产生了两种非常规的自旋轨道矩，实现了无外磁场下的垂直磁化翻转，且具有超低电流密度（~10^6 A/cm²）和极低功耗（<10^15 W/m³）；通过替换更高居里温度的铁磁体Fe3GaTe2，在室温下实现了无场翻转。；创新点：首次在界面（而非体材料）中利用结构手性产生非常规自旋轨道矩，并实现高效、低功耗的无外磁场磁化翻转，突破了体材料对称性约束，为基于全范德华异质结的自旋电子学器件开辟了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 制备全范德华异质结（手性Co1/3TaS2与铁磁体Fe3GeTe2或Fe3GaTe2），通过电输运测量表征自旋轨道矩，并直接测量无外磁场下的磁化翻转行为。

papers.title: Observation of giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching in superconductor-ferromagnet hybrids
papers.abstract: Magneto-thermal switch is a crucial thermal component which enables heat transfer control by the application of an external magnetic field. Recently, a nonvolatile behavior in magneto-thermal conductivity at zero magnetic field was observed in type-II and phase-separated superconductors owing to magnetic flux pinning nature, leading to an energy-efficient thermal control technology. However, the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching ratio has been much lower than the volatile one in conventional materials. Here, we demonstrate a giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching in ferromagnetic Fe-superconducting Pb hybrids. The dispersion of pure Fe particles realizes increased electron and decreased phonon contributions in the thermal conductivity, which enhances the magneto-thermal switching ratio at the superconducting-to-normal conducting phase transition. Furthermore, in concert with trapped magnetic flux by supercurrent, ferromagnetic moment of Fe breaks the superconductivity of Pb matrix at zero magnetic field, enabling a significantly large nonvolatility even with a slight amount of Fe inclusions. Consequently, the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching ratio reaches 719% in maximum at the Fe ratio of 8.7 vol%, which is more than twice the previous record value observed in Pb-Sn composites and the volatile one in pure Pb. This work broadens the exploration space and strategy for giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、observation、experimental手段（dispersion of pure Fe particles等）。；研究对象：铁磁Fe-超导Pb混合体系（ferromagnetic Fe-superconducting Pb hybrids），具体研究其非易失性磁热开关效应（nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Fe体积分数为8.7%的Fe-Pb混合体系中，实现了高达719%的非易失性磁热开关比，是此前Pb-Sn复合材料记录值的两倍以上，也超过了纯Pb的易失性开关比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Fe体积分数为8.7%的Fe-Pb混合体系中，实现了高达719%的非易失性磁热开关比，是此前Pb-Sn复合材料记录值的两倍以上，也超过了纯Pb的易失性开关比。；创新点：首次在超导-铁磁混合体系中实现巨大非易失性磁热开关效应，利用Fe颗粒分散同时增强电子热导贡献和抑制声子热导贡献，并结合铁磁矩在零场下破坏超导性，显著提升了非易失性开关比。
papers.method_zh: 通过将纯Fe颗粒分散在超导Pb基体中制备混合样品，测量热导率随磁场的变化，利用超导-正常态相变及Fe铁磁矩与超导电流的协同作用实现非易失性热开关。

papers.title: A Generalized Mechanical Model for the Cycle Rank Dependence of Stretch at Break in Phantom Chain Star Polymer Networks
papers.abstract: A simple mechanical model was recently proposed to explain the universality of stretch at break (λ_b) as a function of cycle-rank density (ξ) in phantom-chain network simulations [J Non-Newtonian Fluid Mech., 349, 105620 (2026)]. Here, that model is reformulated as a series of the bottleneck strand and the surrounding network, yielding λ_b-1=(λ_bs-1)[1+ν_h/(1+cξ)]. In this formula, λ_bsis the stretch at break of the bottleneck strand, ν_h is the number of stiff units in series along the rupture path, and c is a geometric constant for the parallel redundancy of the medium. Since c and ν_hare difficult to separate over the examined range of ξ, c is fixed, and λ_bs and ν_hare treated as fitting parameters. The formula is applied to phantom-chain simulations of networks with various conditions. In all cases, it reasonably captures the data, and the two parameters represent network characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mechanical model, reformulated, fitting parameters）；研究对象：星形聚合物网络的断裂拉伸比（stretch at break）与循环秩密度（cycle-rank density）之间的依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个广义力学模型，将断裂拉伸比表示为瓶颈链段拉伸比、沿断裂路径串联的刚性单元数以及介质并联冗余度的函数，该模型能合理拟合不同条件下的幻影链网络模拟数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个广义力学模型，将断裂拉伸比表示为瓶颈链段拉伸比、沿断裂路径串联的刚性单元数以及介质并联冗余度的函数，该模型能合理拟合不同条件下的幻影链网络模拟数据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于瓶颈链段与周围网络的串联-并联力学模型，推导出解析公式 λ_b-1=(λ_bs-1)[1+ν_h/(1+cξ)]，并通过固定几何常数c、将λ_bs和ν_h作为拟合参数，应用于幻影链网络模拟数据的分析。

papers.title: Equilibrium in a Reaction Network of Assemblies
papers.abstract: We study a mean-field reaction network whose species are assemblies built from identical atoms by reversible coagulation and fragmentation. Each assembly is an ordered binary tree, so the number of species of a given length grows combinatorially, as the Catalan numbers. The model nonetheless admits an explicit equilibrium and tractable stochastic dynamics. A finite volume $V$ sets a crossover length $l_c \sim \ln V$ that splits the equilibrium into two sectors. Below $l_c$ each assembly occurs in many copies and the rank-frequency distribution is Zipf-like; above $l_c$ individual species are rare and fluctuation-dominated. The statistical weight of the rare sector decays slowly with volume, controlling the finite-size scaling of diversity, Shannon entropy, and other assembly-weighted observables. The equilibrium also admits a transparent grand-canonical description in terms of a bond energy and an atomic chemical potential. Together these results make the model a controlled neutral baseline against which selection and driving in richer assembly networks can be measured.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mean-field reaction network、explicit equilibrium、grand-canonical description。；研究对象：由可逆凝聚与碎裂反应构成的组装体反应网络，其中每个组装体为有序二叉树结构，物种数量随长度呈卡特兰数增长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型存在显式平衡态，且有限体积V引入一个交叉长度l_c ~ ln V，将平衡态分为两个区域：低于l_c时物种出现多个副本且服从Zipf分布，高于l_c时物种稀有且受涨落主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型存在显式平衡态，且有限体积V引入一个交叉长度l_c ~ ln V，将平衡态分为两个区域：低于l_c时物种出现多个副本且服从Zipf分布，高于l_c时物种稀有且受涨落主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 平均场反应网络理论、显式平衡态解析、随机动力学分析、有限体积标度分析、巨正则系综描述（引入键能和原子化学势）。

papers.title: Tunable Emergent Gauge Fields from Skyrmions in a Quasicrystalline Lattice
papers.abstract: We study magnetic skyrmions in a two-dimensional quasicrystalline lattice using a classical Heisenberg model with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and an external magnetic field. The competition between the skyrmion-skyrmion repulsion and an emergent quasiperiodic pinning landscape gives rise to a sequence of distinct skyrmion lattice configurations as a function of field. The resulting hierarchy of quasiperiodic pinning potentials, characterized by closely spaced quasi-degenerate minima, enables a quasi-continuous suppression of the skyrmion density as the saturation field is approached, in sharp contrast to the strongly first-order collapse of skyrmion crystals on periodic lattices. This provides a direct mechanism for controlling the topological charge and, consequently, the emergent gauge field for itinerant electrons. As a consequence, the Hall conductivity can be strongly modified with small changes in the magnetic field and driven smoothly to zero near saturation. This field-controlled tunability, rooted in the underlying multistability, identifies quasicrystalline magnets as a platform for tunable topological textures, with potential applications in magnetic memory and magnetoelectronic response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用“经典海森堡模型”进行“研究”，并分析了由此产生的物理后果，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：二维准晶格中的磁性斯格明子（magnetic skyrmions）。具体体系为具有Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和外磁场的经典海森堡模型所描述的准晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准晶格中准周期钉扎势与斯格明子间排斥作用的竞争，导致斯格明子密度随外磁场增加而准连续地降低，从而实现对拓扑电荷及由此产生的涌现规范场的平滑调控，这与周期晶格中斯格明子晶格的一阶相变式坍塌形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准晶格中准周期钉扎势与斯格明子间排斥作用的竞争，导致斯格明子密度随外磁场增加而准连续地降低，从而实现对拓扑电荷及由此产生的涌现规范场的平滑调控，这与周期晶格中斯格明子晶格的一阶相变式坍塌形成鲜明对比。；创新点：揭示了准晶格中由于准周期钉扎势导致的准简并极小值能级，使得斯格明子密度可被准连续地抑制，从而提供了一种通过磁场连续调控拓扑电荷和涌现规范场的直接机制。这为可调拓扑纹理及潜在应用提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析。具体使用了包含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和外磁场的经典海森堡模型，对二维准晶格中的斯格明子行为进行了数值研究。

papers.title: Gate induced strain on a two-dimensional hole gas in silicon
papers.abstract: We show the effect of gate-induced strain on the valence band of a silicon (Si) metal oxide semiconductor (MOS) confined two-dimensional hole gas (2DHG). Increasing aluminum gate thickness, and thereby the strain in the channel, results in the onset of a second subband contributing to Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations. Temperature-dependent magnetotransport measurements reveal distinct cyclotron masses of $m_c^*=(0.36\pm0.04)m_0$ and $m_c^*=(0.49\pm0.02)m_0$. The measured cyclotron masses differ from those expected for an idealized heavy-hole (HH)/light-hole (LH) picture, reflecting the combined influence of quantum confinement, strain, and HH-LH mixing on the valence band.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations、magnetotransport measurements、cyclotron masses。；研究对象：硅金属氧化物半导体（Si MOS）中受限的二维空穴气（2DHG），具体研究栅极诱导的应变对其价带的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增加铝栅极厚度会增强沟道应变，导致第二个子带开始贡献Shubnikov-de Haas振荡；测得的回旋质量（0.36m₀和0.49m₀）偏离理想重空穴/轻空穴图像，反映了量子限域、应变以及重空穴-轻空穴混合的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增加铝栅极厚度会增强沟道应变，导致第二个子带开始贡献Shubnikov-de Haas振荡；测得的回旋质量（0.36m₀和0.49m₀）偏离理想重空穴/轻空穴图像，反映了量子限域、应变以及重空穴-轻空穴混合的共同作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过改变铝栅极厚度引入应变，进行变温磁输运测量（Shubnikov-de Haas振荡），提取并分析不同子带的回旋质量。

papers.title: Liquid Crystal Ground States on Hyperbolic Cones
papers.abstract: We generalize the analytic theory and simulation models for liquid crystal ground states on conventional cones with positive apex Gaussian curvature and study liquid crystal ground states on hyperbolic cones with a delta function of negative apex Gaussian curvature. While both the local apex curvature on a conventional cone and a hyperbolic cone lead to a fixed unquantized pseudodefect in the conformal domain and behave like conventional disclinations with opposite topological charges, there are fundamental differences in the ground states as well, which can be viewed as a violation of charge conjugation symmetry in a liquid crystal phase. To illustrate the violated charge conjugation symmetry on curved surfaces, we study two simple examples: (a) $p$-atic liquid crystals on a hyperbolic cone with free boundary conditions at the cone base. (b) $p$-atic liquid crystals on a hyperbolic cone with tangential boundary conditions at the cone base. In the simple case of $p=1$ liquid crystals (a vector order parameter field) on a hyperbolic cone with tangential boundary conditions, the positive pseudocharge caused by the apex curvature can be stably bound with a topological charge of the same sign despite their repulsive interaction, in sharp contrast to the charge conjugated situation associated with conventional cones.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：generalize the analytic theory, simulation models, study liquid crystal ground states）；研究对象：双曲锥面上的液晶基态，特别是具有负高斯曲率δ函数奇点的双曲锥面，以及p-atic液晶（包括矢量序参量场）在该曲面上的构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双曲锥面上的液晶基态表现出对电荷共轭对称性的破坏：在锥底切向边界条件下，由顶点曲率引起的正赝电荷可以与同号拓扑电荷稳定结合，这与常规锥面上电荷共轭情形截然不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双曲锥面上的液晶基态表现出对电荷共轭对称性的破坏：在锥底切向边界条件下，由顶点曲率引起的正赝电荷可以与同号拓扑电荷稳定结合，这与常规锥面上电荷共轭情形截然不同。；创新点：首次系统研究了具有负高斯曲率奇点的双曲锥面上的液晶基态，揭示了与常规锥面（正曲率）在电荷共轭对称性上的根本差异，并给出了赝电荷与拓扑电荷同号稳定结合的实例。
papers.method_zh: 推广了常规锥面（正高斯曲率）液晶基态的分析理论与模拟模型，具体研究了两种边界条件（自由边界条件与切向边界条件）下p-atic液晶在双曲锥面上的基态行为，并分析了p=1（矢量序参量）的特殊情况。

papers.title: Understanding quorum sensing self-organization: Clustering and defect-induced ordering of diffusing particles
papers.abstract: Quorum sensing (QS) is known in biology as a form of intercellular communication mediated by signaling molecules called autoinducers. The QS protocol governs the transition from individual to collective cell behavior once a critical population density is reached. Using numerical simulations, we investigate how defects influence the QS transition and the structural organization of the resulting colonies. Our model system consists of a mixture of slow ("cold") and fast ("hot") diffusing colloidal particles that obey the QS protocol, together with defect particles characterized by a constant diffusivity. A striking reentrant solidification of QS particles, characterized by long-range order, is induced by hot defects, whereas cold defects give rise to amorphous structures with only short-range order. These findings deepen our understanding of the QS interaction and provide a mechanism to control the degree of organization in QS systems, with potential applications in robotics, social sciences, and medicine -- for instance, in overcoming antimicrobial resistance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerical simulations（数值模拟）。；研究对象：群体感应（Quorum sensing, QS）自组织过程，具体为受缺陷影响的扩散粒子（冷/热胶体粒子与缺陷粒子）的聚类与结构有序化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热缺陷可诱导群体感应粒子出现具有长程有序的再入式固化，而冷缺陷则导致仅具有短程有序的非晶结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热缺陷可诱导群体感应粒子出现具有长程有序的再入式固化，而冷缺陷则导致仅具有短程有序的非晶结构。；创新点：揭示了缺陷（热缺陷与冷缺陷）对群体感应转变及最终菌落结构组织的不同调控作用，为控制群体感应系统的有序度提供了新机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值模拟，构建由慢扩散（“冷”）和快扩散（“热”）胶体粒子组成的混合模型系统，粒子遵循群体感应协议，并引入具有恒定扩散率的缺陷粒子。

papers.title: Bulk Boundary Condition for Surface Calculations in Density Functional Theory
papers.abstract: We present a bulk boundary condition formalism for surface calculations in Kohn--Sham density functional theory. The approach exploits the nearsightedness of electronic interactions in real space to restrict the calculation to a localized surface region. Within this region, the electron density is evaluated by leveraging the decay of the density matrix, with bulk values imposed on the density and electrostatic potential in the interior, and the electrostatic potential solved subject to bulk boundary conditions. The energy and atomic forces are computed using density-matrix-based expressions. Through representative calculations of surface and adsorption energies, we demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed formalism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Kohn–Sham density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、formalism（形式理论）、surface calculations（表面计算）。；研究对象：表面体系，具体包括表面能及吸附能的计算。摘要未明确说明具体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于体相边界条件的表面计算形式，通过利用电子相互作用的近程性（nearsightedness）和密度矩阵的衰减特性，在仅计算局部表面区域的情况下，准确高效地获得表面和吸附能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于体相边界条件的表面计算形式，通过利用电子相互作用的近程性（nearsightedness）和密度矩阵的衰减特性，在仅计算局部表面区域的情况下，准确高效地获得表面和吸附能。；创新点：提出了一种新的体相边界条件形式，使得表面DFT计算可以严格限制在局部区域，同时保持精度，避免了传统方法中对整个体相区域进行自洽计算的需求。
papers.method_zh: 基于Kohn–Sham密度泛函理论（DFT）的体相边界条件形式。具体包括：在实空间中将计算限制在局部表面区域，利用密度矩阵的衰减性评估电子密度，在内部区域施加体相密度和静电势的边界条件，并使用基于密度矩阵的表达式计算能量和原子受力。

papers.title: Directed assembly of tetrahedral patchy particles
papers.abstract: Colloidal particles with prescribed valency such as the tetrahedral patchy particles have long been seen as a viable route to technologically relevant open lattice structures on the scale of hundreds of nanometers. However, conceptual limitations and resulting competing local bonding configurations often lead to mixed lattice phases. Here, we present a DNA-origami enabled approach to controlling the attachment of tetrapod building blocks in predictable ways. By varying the relative strength of two designed binding configurations we are able to direct the assembly of tetrapod particles into diamond cubic, twinned diamonds, stacking-disordered mixtures, hexagonal diamonds, and sII clathrates. Under specific conditions, the diamond structures are interpenetrated by additional networks, resulting in triple cubic and triple hexagonal diamond structures. The 440 nm large unit cell of the clathrates shifts structural reflections into the visible range, giving these rationally designed, self-assembled crystals structural color.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present a DNA-origami enabled approach”，属于实验方法。；研究对象：四面体补丁胶体粒子（tetrahedral patchy particles）的自组装行为，具体研究其形成金刚石立方、孪晶金刚石、堆垛无序混合物、六方金刚石及sII笼形物等开放晶格结构的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过DNA折纸技术调控两种设计结合构型的相对强度，可以定向引导四面体粒子组装成多种晶格相，包括金刚石立方、孪晶金刚石、六方金刚石及sII笼形物；在特定条件下，金刚石结构会被额外网络穿插，形成三重立方和六重六方金刚石结构。sII笼形物的大晶胞（440 nm）可将结构反射移至可见光范围，产生结构色。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过DNA折纸技术调控两种设计结合构型的相对强度，可以定向引导四面体粒子组装成多种晶格相，包括金刚石立方、孪晶金刚石、六方金刚石及sII笼形物；在特定条件下，金刚石结构会被额外网络穿插，形成三重立方和六重六方金刚石结构。sII笼形物的大晶胞（440 nm）可将结构反射移至可见光范围，产生结构色。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: DNA折纸技术（DNA-origami enabled approach），通过设计两种结合构型并调控其相对强度，实现四面体粒子的可控组装。

papers.title: Quantum Dot Moiré from Crossed MoS2 Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: Twisted atomically thin layers have attracted much attention for Moiré potential and correlated quantum phenomena. However, existing Moiré superlattices have largely been limited to extensive wavefunction without lateral confinement. Here we introduce a new platform where 1D nanoribbons of 2D MoS2 grown by vapor deposition can be easily superposed at various angles from stacking and transferring, to form Moiré quantum dots at their intersections with unique exciton physics. Angle-dependent Moiré intersections show enhanced exciton emission at commensurate angle 22 deg, which demonstrates faster relaxation at the cryogenic temperature. A size-dependent study further exhibits a reduced exciton energy and soften out-of-plane interlayer coupling for smaller Moiré areas. Our results reveal exciton physics turnability via precise overlapping of 1D nanoribbons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“vapor deposition”“stacking and transferring”“cryogenic temperature”等实验手段，以及“exciton emission”“relaxation”等实验观测结果。；研究对象：由气相沉积生长的MoS₂一维纳米带交叉堆叠形成的量子点莫尔超晶格，以及其中独特的激子物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交叉MoS₂纳米带的莫尔交点处，当交叉角为22°时激子发射增强，且低温下弛豫更快；较小的莫尔区域导致激子能量降低和面外层间耦合软化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交叉MoS₂纳米带的莫尔交点处，当交叉角为22°时激子发射增强，且低温下弛豫更快；较小的莫尔区域导致激子能量降低和面外层间耦合软化。；创新点：首次将一维纳米带交叉堆叠作为构建莫尔量子点的新平台，实现了对激子物理的横向限域调控，突破了传统二维莫尔超晶格缺乏侧向限域的局限。
papers.method_zh: 采用气相沉积法生长MoS₂一维纳米带，通过堆叠和转移技术以不同角度叠加纳米带形成莫尔交点；利用低温光学测量（如激子发射光谱）研究角度依赖和尺寸依赖的激子行为。

papers.title: Perturbations in the spin-orbital liquid (the Yao-Lee model)
papers.abstract: I investigate the stability of the spin-orbital liquid described by the Yao-Lee model in the presence of multiple perturbations that naturally arise in a recently proposed microscopic realization. While most perturbations are irrelevant and do not qualitatively alter the exact solvability, we find that the Kitaev interaction plays a special role: it couples to the $ \mathbb{Z}_2 $ gauge field and renders the visons mobile.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate”、“stability”、“exact solvability”、“couples to the gauge field”，属于解析理论分析。；研究对象：Yao-Lee模型所描述的自旋-轨道液体（spin-orbital liquid）及其在多种微扰下的稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 大多数微扰不会改变Yao-Lee模型的可精确求解性质，但Kitaev相互作用会耦合到Z₂规范场，使原本局域的vison（涡旋激发）变得可移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：大多数微扰不会改变Yao-Lee模型的可精确求解性质，但Kitaev相互作用会耦合到Z₂规范场，使原本局域的vison（涡旋激发）变得可移动。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析微扰理论分析，具体考察了在近期提出的微观实现中自然出现的多种微扰对Yao-Lee模型的影响。

papers.title: Lecture notes on random matrix theory: the results, the applications, and the analytical tools
papers.abstract: Random matrix theory has established itself as a theoretical cornerstone of the mathematical sciences over the past century. It has undeniable utility in areas of research as diverse as nuclear physics, finance, ecology and disordered systems. The purpose of these notes is twofold. First, the most famous and widely used classic results are derived in a pedagogical manner, mostly using the comparatively elementary and transparent cavity method. The significance of each result is then demonstrated in the context of a particular application. There are also some select exercises at the end of each section. In the second part of these notes, a reference guide of analytical techniques for the random-matrix/disordered-systems practitioner is provided. Introducing the diagrammatic, replica, path-integral, and supersymmetric formalisms from first principles, we rederive some of the aforementioned classic results, particularly focussing on the simplest one -- the semicircle law. Innovations such as the population dynamics method and the tools of free probability theory are also included. We discuss the merits of each analytical approach, and we highlight the contexts in which each becomes particularly useful.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：讲义、推导、解析方法、形式主义）；研究对象：随机矩阵理论本身，及其在核物理、金融、生态学和无序系统等领域的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文旨在以教学方式推导随机矩阵理论中最著名和广泛使用的经典结果，并展示其在具体应用中的意义；同时，为随机矩阵/无序系统研究者提供一套解析技术的参考指南。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文旨在以教学方式推导随机矩阵理论中最著名和广泛使用的经典结果，并展示其在具体应用中的意义；同时，为随机矩阵/无序系统研究者提供一套解析技术的参考指南。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。本文的主要特点在于其双重目的：既作为教学讲义（包含习题），又作为解析技术的综合参考指南，特别是系统地比较了不同解析方法的优缺点及其适用场景。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用空穴法（cavity method）进行教学推导；在第二部分，从第一性原理引入并重新推导了图解方法、复制方法、路径积分和超对称形式主义，并介绍了群体动力学方法和自由概率论工具。

papers.title: Fluctuation theorems for autonomous work
papers.abstract: Classical fluctuation theorems for work have been obtained theoretically, and verified experimentally, within a non-autonomous framework in which work is performed on a system of interest, ${\cal S}$, by the external manipulation of a work parameter, such as a piston's position. Here we obtain fluctuation theorems within an autonomous framework in which ${\cal S}$ exchanges energy with a reversible work source, ${\cal R}$. The two subsystems, ${\cal R}$ and ${\cal S}$, interact with one another as they evolve under Hamiltonian or stochastic dynamics, without external intervention. In this setting, we must account for the back-action of ${\cal S}$ on ${\cal R}$, which is absent in the non-autonomous setting. We obtain autonomous versions of standard fluctuation theorems for work and entropy production. In each case, we argue, the autonomous fluctuation theorem reduces to its non-autonomous counterpart when ${\cal R}$'s inertia becomes infinitely large.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：fluctuation theorems、theoretically、Hamiltonian or stochastic dynamics、autonomous framework。；研究对象：自主做功系统中的涨落定理，具体涉及一个感兴趣系统（\({\cal S}\)）与一个可逆功源（\({\cal R}\)）之间的能量交换过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自主框架下（无外部干预），推导出了功和熵产生标准涨落定理的自主版本，并证明当可逆功源的惯性趋于无穷大时，自主涨落定理退化为非自主框架下的对应形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自主框架下（无外部干预），推导出了功和熵产生标准涨落定理的自主版本，并证明当可逆功源的惯性趋于无穷大时，自主涨落定理退化为非自主框架下的对应形式。；创新点：将传统非自主框架下的功涨落定理推广到自主框架，明确纳入了系统对功源的反作用效应，并建立了自主与非自主版本之间的极限对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用哈密顿动力学或随机动力学框架，对系统（\({\cal S}\)）与可逆功源（\({\cal R}\)）构成的复合体系进行理论分析，考虑了系统对功源的反作用（back-action）。

papers.title: Bogolyubov excitons as a microscopic origin of two-level systems
papers.abstract: Two-level systems (TLS) are a leading source of decoherence and dielectric loss in Josephson-junction qubits, yet their microscopic origin remains unresolved. We propose an intrinsic, purely electronic TLS candidate: subgap bound states of Bogolyubov quasiparticles. We show that, in a model of a conventional superconductor with electron-electron attraction in the $s$-wave channel and repulsion in higher-angular-momentum channels, the latter produce an effective attraction between Bogolyubov quasiparticles, forming bound states. These Bogolyubov excitons resemble Bardasis--Schrieffer excitons but are driven by repulsive interactions. Bulk Bogolyubov excitons are not easily detectable through single-particle tunneling or other conventional probes, but we show that surface excitons couple to an external electric field and behave as two-level systems. We examine an idealized model of a bulk superconductor proximity-coupled to a two-dimensional repulsive metal, which could represent an external metallic or semiconductor layer or an underscreened region of the superconductor. The two levels correspond to the absence and presence of a single exciton, which carries an electric dipole moment and exhibits an avoided crossing with a resonator, as observed for TLS. Because this mechanism requires no defects and cannot be eliminated by screening or annealing, it suggests that TLS-like excitations may be intrinsic to superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、show、examine、model。；研究对象：超导体中导致约瑟夫森结量子比特退相干和介电损耗的两能级系统（TLS）的微观起源，具体为Bogolyubov准粒子的亚能隙束缚态（Bogolyubov激子）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种纯电子的、内在的TLS候选机制：由超导体中高角动量通道的排斥相互作用诱导形成的Bogolyubov激子束缚态，其表面态可耦合外电场并表现为两能级系统，且该机制无需缺陷，无法通过屏蔽或退火消除。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种纯电子的、内在的TLS候选机制：由超导体中高角动量通道的排斥相互作用诱导形成的Bogolyubov激子束缚态，其表面态可耦合外电场并表现为两能级系统，且该机制无需缺陷，无法通过屏蔽或退火消除。；创新点：首次提出TLS的纯电子起源（Bogolyubov激子），区别于传统认为的缺陷或原子隧穿模型，且该机制是超导体的内在属性，不依赖于外部缺陷。
papers.method_zh: 基于常规超导体的理论模型，考虑s波通道的电子-电子吸引和高角动量通道的排斥相互作用，通过分析Bogolyubov准粒子间的有效吸引形成束缚态，并研究体态与表面态激子的性质，以及超导体与二维排斥性金属（或半导体层、欠屏蔽区域）近邻耦合的理想化模型。

papers.title: Parity Anomaly of Preformed Pairs Governs the Thermal Hall Effect above $T_c$
papers.abstract: A large negative thermal Hall signal has been reported across multiple cuprate families in the pseudogap phase where the superconducting order parameter has vanished, with a magnitude that no existing microscopic theory reproduces without free parameters. Competing proposals based on chiral phonons, spinons, or loop currents each require undetermined coupling constants and do not predict the temperature dependence in terms of an independently measured spectroscopic gap. We show that the parity anomaly of $(2+1)$-dimensional quantum field theory resolves this long-standing puzzle: the preformed-pair pseudogap $Δ_{\rm pg}(T)$ enters the parity-odd fermion determinant identically to a condensate mass, yielding the exact parameter-free formula $κ_{xy}/T = (π^2 k_B^2/6h)\,C\,\tanh[Δ_{\rm pg}(T)/(2k_BT)]$, where $C$ is the Chern number of the chiral pairing channel and $Δ_{\rm pg}(T)$ is directly measurable by ARPES or STM. Coleman-Hill non-renormalization protects the result against higher-loop corrections, and two independent numerical tests, Wilson-loop flux threading and DMRG on $p+ip$ cylinders, confirm the anomaly correlation length to $0.2\%$ accuracy with no power-law finite-size corrections. The theory predicts thermal Hall onset at $T^*$ rather than $T_c$, provides a falsifiable logarithmic-derivative test against ARPES data, and yields a concrete quantitative target for magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：quantum field theory, parity anomaly, parameter-free formula, Coleman-Hill non-renormalization, DMRG数值检验）；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体赝能隙相中高于超导转变温度（$T_c$）的热霍尔效应（thermal Hall effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预形成对的赝能隙$\Delta_{\rm pg}(T)$通过$(2+1)$维量子场论的奇偶反常（parity anomaly）进入费米子行列式，从而产生无自由参数的热霍尔电导率公式，解释了赝能隙相中观测到的大负热霍尔信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预形成对的赝能隙$\Delta_{\rm pg}(T)$通过$(2+1)$维量子场论的奇偶反常（parity anomaly）进入费米子行列式，从而产生无自由参数的热霍尔电导率公式，解释了赝能隙相中观测到的大负热霍尔信号。；创新点：首次将预形成对的赝能隙与奇偶反常直接关联，推导出无自由参数的热霍尔电导率公式，且该结果受Coleman-Hill定理保护不受高阶圈图修正，并提供了可被实验证伪的对数导数检验方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为$(2+1)$维量子场论中的奇偶反常与Coleman-Hill非重整化定理；数值检验包括Wilson-loop磁通穿线（Wilson-loop flux threading）和$p+ip$圆柱上的密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算；实验可测参数$\Delta_{\rm pg}(T)$来自ARPES或STM。

papers.title: Electron-Phonon Functional Renormalization Group of Fermi Liquid Instabilities
papers.abstract: We formulate a functional renormalization group (FRG) ansatz for correlated electron models that incorporates electronic interactions as well as electron-phonon coupling (EPC) stemming from dispersive phonon bands. Particularizing to the RG flow of the electron-electron interaction vertex, we treat phonon- and electron-mediated Fermi liquid instabilities on equal footing as we analyze tentative electronic order parameters related to charge, spin, nematicity, and superconducting pairing. We illustrate the approach at the example of Peierls-type transitions we find for the Hubbard model on the square lattice coupled to acoustic phonon bands. Our method allows to incorporate full electronic and phononic ab initio input, and thus lends itself to the analysis of electronic order from intertwined electronic interactions and EPC at a microscopically most substantiated level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional renormalization group (FRG) ansatz, formulate, analyze。；研究对象：关联电子模型中的费米液体不稳定性，具体包括电子-电子相互作用以及由色散声子带产生的电子-声子耦合（EPC），并以耦合了声子带的方形晶格Hubbard模型中的Peierls型相变为例进行说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将电子-声子耦合纳入功能重整化群（FRG）框架，可以在同一层面上处理由声子介导和电子介导的费米液体不稳定性，并分析电荷、自旋、向列性和超导配对等候选电子有序参量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将电子-声子耦合纳入功能重整化群（FRG）框架，可以在同一层面上处理由声子介导和电子介导的费米液体不稳定性，并分析电荷、自旋、向列性和超导配对等候选电子有序参量。；创新点：该方法能够将完整的电子和声子第一性原理输入纳入FRG框架，从而在微观上最扎实的层面上分析由电子相互作用与电子-声子耦合交织所导致的电子有序。摘要未突出说明与以往FRG处理EPC工作的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 功能重整化群（FRG）方法，特别针对电子-电子相互作用顶点的RG流进行分析，同时处理电子相互作用和来自色散声子带的电子-声子耦合。

papers.title: Monte-Carlo solution of the Kondo model
papers.abstract: The Kondo model is a paradigmatic quantum impurity problem realized in a wide variety of experimental platforms and central to the study of strongly correlated electrons. We introduce a discrete model that exactly reproduces the multichannel Kondo model and demonstrate that it can be simulated efficiently. Using cluster Monte Carlo algorithms, we completely eliminate critical slowing down, providing direct access to universal crossover functions and transport properties across a broad range of parameters. Remarkably, the same model captures both the weak- and strong-coupling regimes, unifying descriptions traditionally derived in complementary limits and revealing their common origin. Our method naturally accommodates large channel numbers, anisotropy, interacting one-dimensional leads, and channel asymmetry, yielding predictions for transport properties in charge-Kondo devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Monte-Carlo solution”、“cluster Monte Carlo algorithms”、“simulated efficiently”。；研究对象：Kondo模型（Kondo model），特别是多通道Kondo模型（multichannel Kondo model），以及其在电荷-Kondo器件（charge-Kondo devices）中的输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种离散模型可精确再现多通道Kondo模型，并通过团簇蒙特卡洛算法完全消除临界慢化，从而在弱耦合与强耦合区域统一描述该模型的普适交叉函数和输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种离散模型可精确再现多通道Kondo模型，并通过团簇蒙特卡洛算法完全消除临界慢化，从而在弱耦合与强耦合区域统一描述该模型的普适交叉函数和输运性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用团簇蒙特卡洛算法（cluster Monte Carlo algorithms）对离散化Kondo模型进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Anisotropic vacancy-induced magnetization textures in altermagnets
papers.abstract: We study magnetic textures induced by vacancies in altermagnets using microscopic simulations and low-energy field theory. We show that a vacancy generically produces a real-space anisotropic distortion of the magnetic order, whose structure encodes the symmetry of the underlying altermagnetic state. This impurity response offers a direct route to detecting altermagnetic order with locally resolved probes. We demonstrate this for both classical altermagnets, where vacancies generate anisotropic magnetization textures in a transverse magnetic field, and quantum models, where fluctuations induce longitudinal power-law decaying magnetic distortions even at zero field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：microscopic simulations, low-energy field theory）；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）中由空位（vacancy）诱导的磁化织构（magnetization textures）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空位会在交变磁体中产生实空间各向异性的磁序畸变，其结构编码了底层交变磁态对称性；该杂质响应可直接用于通过局域探针检测交变磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空位会在交变磁体中产生实空间各向异性的磁序畸变，其结构编码了底层交变磁态对称性；该杂质响应可直接用于通过局域探针检测交变磁序。；创新点：揭示了空位诱导磁化织构的各向异性特征与交变磁体对称性之间的直接关联，并提出了利用局域探针检测交变磁序的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 微观模拟（microscopic simulations）与低能场论（low-energy field theory）

papers.title: Seven- and eight-loop critical exponents of the three-dimensional Ising model
papers.abstract: We determine the critical exponents $η$, $ν$, and the correction-to-scaling exponent $ω$ of the three-dimensional Ising universality class by resumming the recently computed seven- and eight-loop renormalization-group series in the $ε=4-d$ expansion (O.~Schnetz, \textit{Phys. Rev. D} \textbf{97}, 085018 (2018); O.~Schnetz, \textit{Phys. Rev. D} \textbf{107}, 036002 (2023)). The resummation combines conformal mapping with a homographic transformation, while the resummation parameters are optimized according to two complementary criteria. This approach yields precise estimates of the critical exponents together with quantitative uncertainty estimates. We find that the error bar on $η$ decreases rapidly with increasing loop order, whereas this is the case neither for $ν$ nor for $ω$. Unexpectedly, although the estimated values are accurate in absolute terms, their slow convergence with the loop order leads to a slight but systematic tension with the conformal bootstrap estimates that are currently considered as the benchmark. We discuss several possible origins of this behavior and its implications for high-order resummations of perturbative renormalization-group series.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization-group series（重整化群级数）、resummation（重求和）、critical exponents（临界指数）。；研究对象：三维伊辛模型（three-dimensional Ising model）的临界指数，具体包括η、ν和修正标度指数ω。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过七圈和八圈ε展开的重整化群级数重求和，得到了三维伊辛普适类的临界指数精确估计，但发现其收敛速度较慢，与当前作为基准的共形自举（conformal bootstrap）估计值存在轻微但系统的偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过七圈和八圈ε展开的重整化群级数重求和，得到了三维伊辛普适类的临界指数精确估计，但发现其收敛速度较慢，与当前作为基准的共形自举（conformal bootstrap）估计值存在轻微但系统的偏差。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用共形映射（conformal mapping）结合同调变换（homographic transformation）对七圈和八圈ε=4-d展开的重整化群级数进行重求和，并根据两个互补准则优化重求和参数，同时给出定量不确定度估计。

papers.title: Axion-Induced Casimir Interaction Between Graphene Plates
papers.abstract: Axion dark matter may induce observable electromagnetic effects in resonant cavity systems and potentially lead to modifications of the Casimir interaction. In this context, graphene represents an attractive platform owing to its tunable electromagnetic properties, and the fact that its electromagnetic response can be modelled microscopically from first principles within quantum field theory. The electromagnetic response induced by axion dark matter is investigated in a planar cavity consisting of parallel graphene interfaces in the presence of a homogeneous external magnetic field, incorporating finite temperature, chemical potential and dissipation through the graphene conductivity. Closed analytical expressions are obtained for the induced electric field and the resulting pressure. The pressure exhibits resonant enhancement at a series of plate separations satisfying $d_n=(2πn-φ(r))/m_a$, where $m_a$ is the axion mass and the phase $φ(r)$ is determined by the reflection coefficient $r$, which depends on the graphene conductivity evaluated at $ω=m_a$. The resonant structure is strongly influenced by the graphene chemical potential and damping parameter. In particular, increased doping, for example via a gate voltage, sharpens the resonances and amplifies the axion-induced signal. By comparing the resonantly enhanced signal with the conventional Casimir background, the parametric regimes in which the effect could become experimentally relevant are identified, with the strongest sensitivity obtained for highly doped low-dissipation graphene configurations operated near resonance. These results demonstrate that graphene-based Casimir-type configurations may provide a sensitive framework for probing axion-induced electromagnetic phenomena and highlight the interplay between axion electrodynamics, cavity resonances, and material properties in low-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“modelled microscopically from first principles within quantum field theory”、“Closed analytical expressions are obtained”等关键词，表明主要工作是理论建模和解析推导。；研究对象：由平行石墨烯平板构成的平面腔体，以及在其中由轴子暗物质诱导的卡西米尔相互作用。具体物理现象是轴子暗物质在外部磁场下，通过石墨烯的电磁响应，在平板间产生诱导电场和压力（即轴子诱导的卡西米尔力）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 轴子暗物质可以在石墨烯平板间诱导出共振增强的压力，该压力在特定的板间距处达到峰值，且共振结构强烈依赖于石墨烯的化学势和阻尼参数。通过高掺杂、低耗散的石墨烯配置，可以显著放大轴子诱导的信号，使其在实验上可能被探测到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：轴子暗物质可以在石墨烯平板间诱导出共振增强的压力，该压力在特定的板间距处达到峰值，且共振结构强烈依赖于石墨烯的化学势和阻尼参数。通过高掺杂、低耗散的石墨烯配置，可以显著放大轴子诱导的信号，使其在实验上可能被探测到。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于：1）将轴子电动力学与石墨烯的可调谐电磁特性相结合，研究其在卡西米尔型腔体中的效应；2）获得了轴子诱导压力的解析表达式，并系统分析了共振增强的条件；3）指出了通过调控石墨烯参数（如掺杂和耗散）来增强轴子信号的可能性，为实验探测提供了具体参数窗口。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子场论框架，从第一性原理出发对石墨烯的电磁响应进行微观建模。在存在均匀外磁场、有限温度、化学势和耗散的情况下，通过石墨烯电导率，解析推导了平行石墨烯界面构成的平面腔体中，由轴子暗物质诱导的电场和压力的闭合解析表达式。

papers.title: Second-harmonic signal in electric-field-modulated EPR spectra of Fe3 spin triangles
papers.abstract: We present electric-field-modulated electron paramagnetic resonance (EFM-EPR) measurements on centrosymmetric single crystals of the molecular spin triangle $\mathrm{[{Fe_3}O({O_2}CPh){_6}(py){_3}]ClO{_4}{\cdot}py}$ ($\bf{Fe_3}$). We provide the first observation of second harmonic EFM-EPR signal in polynuclear magnetic molecules. This signal is simulated and explained in terms of an electric-field induced modulation of the isotropic exchange in the molecule, and of their symmetry lowering resulting from a Jahn-Teller effect. Additionally, an unexpected first harmonic EFM-EPR signal is observed. Various plausible symmetry-breaking mechanisms are discussed in an attempt to explain this feature, whose observation is unexpected in a nominally centrosymmetric crystal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：measurements、present、observed、simulated）；研究对象：中心对称分子自旋三角形单晶 \(\mathrm{[{Fe_3}O({O_2}CPh){_6}(py){_3}]ClO{_4}{\cdot}py}\)（简称 \(\bf{Fe_3}\)）的电场调制电子顺磁共振（EFM-EPR）信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在多核磁性分子中观测到二次谐波EFM-EPR信号，该信号源于电场对各向同性交换作用的调制以及Jahn-Teller效应导致的对称性降低；同时意外观测到一次谐波EFM-EPR信号，其来源尚不明确。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在多核磁性分子中观测到二次谐波EFM-EPR信号，该信号源于电场对各向同性交换作用的调制以及Jahn-Teller效应导致的对称性降低；同时意外观测到一次谐波EFM-EPR信号，其来源尚不明确。；创新点：首次在多核分子磁体中观测到二次谐波EFM-EPR信号，并利用电场诱导的各向同性交换调制和Jahn-Teller对称性降低机制进行解释；此外，在名义上中心对称的晶体中意外发现一次谐波信号，并讨论了多种可能的对称性破缺机制。
papers.method_zh: 电场调制电子顺磁共振（EFM-EPR）实验测量，并结合信号模拟与理论解释。

papers.title: Universality and Dynamical Inequivalence in Isospectral Non-Hermitian Anderson Transitions
papers.abstract: The Hatano Nelson paradigm establishes that extensive bulk nonreciprocity can destabilize Anderson localization via an imaginary gauge flux. Here, we demonstrate that extensive nonreciprocity is not a necessary ingredient: a single non-Hermitian boundary bond in a disordered one-dimensional ring suffices to drive the localization-delocalization transition. More generally, we construct an exactly isospectral family of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that continuously interpolates between the uniform Hatano Nelson model and the single-bond limit. We show that the universal critical behavior encompassing spectral, eigenstate, and topological diagnostics is gauge invariant and governed solely by the total imaginary gauge flux, regardless of its spatial distribution. Remarkably, despite sharing identical spectra and critical exponents, different configurations within this isospectral family exhibit qualitatively distinct quantum dynamics, establishing a fundamental separation between static and dynamical universality in non-Hermitian systems. Specifically, the single boundary realization features rapid operator scrambling, oscillatory wavepacket acceleration, and a double re-entrant steady state entanglement transition. Finally, we propose an experimentally feasible realization based on multi-terminal topological transport, providing a realistic route toward observing boundary induced non Hermitian criticality and its unconventional dynamical signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：construct、demonstrate、propose，无实验数据或数值模拟细节描述）；研究对象：非厄米安德森转变中的局域-退局域相变，具体研究无序一维环中单个非厄米边界键对相变的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现非互易性不必遍及整个体系：单个非厄米边界键即可驱动局域-退局域转变；构建了与均匀Hatano-Nelson模型等谱的哈密顿量族，证明临界行为仅由总虚规范通量决定，但不同构型具有截然不同的量子动力学，表明静态与动态普适性在非厄米系统中存在根本分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现非互易性不必遍及整个体系：单个非厄米边界键即可驱动局域-退局域转变；构建了与均匀Hatano-Nelson模型等谱的哈密顿量族，证明临界行为仅由总虚规范通量决定，但不同构型具有截然不同的量子动力学，表明静态与动态普适性在非厄米系统中存在根本分离。；创新点：揭示了非厄米系统中静态普适性与动态普适性的分离，即等谱且临界指数相同的不同构型可表现出定性不同的动力学行为；提出基于多端拓扑输运的实验实现方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造：通过构建等谱非厄米哈密顿量族，连续插值均匀Hatano-Nelson模型与单边界键极限；分析谱、本征态和拓扑诊断量的普适临界行为；研究动力学特征（算子 scrambling、波包振荡、稳态纠缠转变）。

papers.title: Folding-Driven Auxetic Weft Knit Textiles with Integrated Capacitive Sensing
papers.abstract: Machine knitting provides a scalable platform for manufacturing multifunctional textiles in which geometry, mechanics, and embedded functionality can be programmed at the stitch level. However, predictive design tools capable of linking knit architecture to large-deformation mechanical response remain limited. Here, we develop a reduced-order spring-network model that captures the relaxation, unfolding, and deformation of knitted fabrics composed of checkerboard arrangements of rib and garter patches. The model accurately predicts the corrugated relaxed configuration of the knits and the evolution of local deformations under tensile loading using only linear extensional and torsional springs. Combining simulations with experiments, we show that the programmed unfolding of the corrugations generates tunable auxetic behavior, with both the magnitude of the negative Poisson's ratio and the strain at which it occurs governed by the unit-cell geometry. We further integrate capacitive strain sensing directly during fabrication through partial plating of conductive yarns, eliminating post-processing. The resulting knitted capacitors exhibit programmable tradeoffs between strain sensitivity and sensing range, enabling either highly sensitive sensors over narrow deformation windows or lower-sensitivity sensors capable of measuring larger strains. Together, our modeling framework and fabrication strategy provide a route toward the rational design of mechanically programmable, sensorized knits with tailored shape-morphing and sensing functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及了“开发了一个降阶弹簧网络模型”（计算/理论）和“结合模拟与实验”、“集成电容式应变传感”（实验）。；研究对象：具有可调负泊松比（拉胀）行为的机织针织纺织品，以及集成在该纺织品中的电容式应变传感器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过编程针织结构中波纹的展开，可以实现可调的拉胀行为，其负泊松比的大小和出现的应变范围由单元几何形状控制。同时，在制造过程中直接集成导电纱线，可以制备出具有可编程灵敏度与传感范围权衡的电容式应变传感器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过编程针织结构中波纹的展开，可以实现可调的拉胀行为，其负泊松比的大小和出现的应变范围由单元几何形状控制。同时，在制造过程中直接集成导电纱线，可以制备出具有可编程灵敏度与传感范围权衡的电容式应变传感器。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1. 理论/计算：开发了一个降阶弹簧网络模型，仅使用线性拉伸和扭转弹簧来捕捉针织物的松弛、展开和大变形力学响应。2. 实验：通过机织针织技术制备由罗纹和吊针补丁组成的棋盘格织物；采用部分镀覆导电纱线的方法，在制造过程中直接集成电容式应变传感。

papers.title: Irreducible Geometry of Higher-Order Correlator Families
papers.abstract: Programmable quantum simulators are beginning to access correlators of increasing complexity, ranging from four-point out-of-time-ordered correlators to even higher-order many-body correlators. The theoretical framework for interpreting such data, however, remains comparatively underdeveloped. Although a variety of higher-order correlators can be constructed straightforwardly, their physical meaning is often difficult to infer. A further complication is that different correlators are generally not independent: some may be mutually redundant, while others may encode genuinely distinct information. These features make it necessary to analyze correlators not as isolated quantities, but as a structured family. In this work, we develop a geometric framework for the collective analysis of higher-order correlator families. By representing correlators as inner products between operator words, we recast each family as a geometry in operator space. The key idea is to introduce conditioning subspaces that separate this geometry into reducible information, already explained by a chosen resolved sector, and irreducible information, encoded in the residual correlator geometry. Focusing on the latter component, we define irreducible volume profiles that quantify how broadly the unexplained part of a correlator family spreads over independent geometric directions. This perspective leads to several complementary forms of conditioning. Canonical conditioning optimally explains a correlator family. Targeted conditioning fixes the resolved sector to isolate a chosen physical feature. Krylov and cross conditioning extend the framework from a single correlator family to comparisons among correlator geometries. Our framework reveals irreducible structures hidden at the level of individual correlator values and establishes correlator geometry as a higher-level description of quantum many-body dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a geometric framework”、“theoretical framework”、“recast each family as a geometry”等关键词，旨在建立新的理论分析框架，而非进行实验或数值计算。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是量子多体系统中的高阶关联子（higher-order correlators）家族。具体涉及从四点非时序关联子到更高阶的多体关联子，以及它们之间的几何结构关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，高阶关联子家族并非孤立存在，而是构成一个具有内在几何结构的整体。通过引入“条件化子空间”（conditioning subspaces），可以将关联子家族分解为“可约信息”（由已解析的扇区解释）和“不可约信息”（残差关联子几何），并定义了“不可约体积轮廓”（irreducible volume profiles）来量化后者在独立几何方向上的分布广度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，高阶关联子家族并非孤立存在，而是构成一个具有内在几何结构的整体。通过引入“条件化子空间”（conditioning subspaces），可以将关联子家族分解为“可约信息”（由已解析的扇区解释）和“不可约信息”（残差关联子几何），并定义了“不可约体积轮廓”（irreducible volume profiles）来量化后者在独立几何方向上的分布广度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比，但核心创新在于：1）将高阶关联子家族作为一个整体结构进行集体分析，而非孤立地看待单个关联子；2）引入“条件化子空间”的概念，将关联子信息区分为可约与不可约部分，并定义了“不可约体积轮廓”这一新物理量；3）建立了关联子几何作为量子多体动力学高层描述的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 论文采用纯理论几何框架。核心方法是将关联子表示为算符词（operator words）之间的内积，从而将每个关联子家族重新诠释为算符空间中的一种几何结构。通过引入条件化子空间，实现了对关联子几何的分解，并提出了规范条件化（canonical conditioning）、目标条件化（targeted conditioning）、Krylov条件化和交叉条件化（cross conditioning）等多种互补的分析形式。

papers.title: Approaching Carnot Efficiency at Finite Power in an Experimentally Feasible Quantum Heat Engine
papers.abstract: Whether a heat engine can approach Carnot efficiency while maintaining finite power is a fundamental question in finite-time thermodynamics. For classical Markovian heat engines with local interactions, the power-efficiency trade-off forbids an asymptotic approach to Carnot efficiency at finite power. In quantum systems, by contrast, degeneracy, symmetry, and collective jumps have been theoretically predicted to enable such an asymptotic attainment by enhancing activity. It has remained open, however, whether this mechanism can be realized in an experimentally implementable heat engine. In this Letter, we propose a superconducting-circuit heat engine that emulates the collective enhancement, thereby enabling an asymptotic approach to Carnot efficiency at finite power. This result demonstrates that, in an implementable model, such an enhanced dissipative mechanism circumvents the power-efficiency trade-off of classical Markovian engines. Our work connects abstract bounds in finite-time thermodynamics to a concrete circuit-QED platform and suggests a route toward quantum-device design based on collectively enhanced dissipative processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretically predicted, propose, demonstrates, abstract bounds in finite-time thermodynamics）；研究对象：基于超导电路的量子热机，具体研究其在有限功率下逼近卡诺效率的可行性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种实验上可实现的超导电路热机，通过集体增强耗散机制，能够在有限功率下渐近逼近卡诺效率，从而规避经典马尔可夫热机中功率-效率的权衡限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种实验上可实现的超导电路热机，通过集体增强耗散机制，能够在有限功率下渐近逼近卡诺效率，从而规避经典马尔可夫热机中功率-效率的权衡限制。；创新点：首次在实验可实现的模型中证明，集体增强耗散机制能够使量子热机在有限功率下渐近逼近卡诺效率，将有限时间热力学的抽象界限与具体电路QED平台联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与电路量子电动力学（circuit-QED）平台设计，通过模拟集体量子跃迁（collective jumps）实现耗散增强。

papers.title: Absence of quantum advantage for approximate spin glass optimization
papers.abstract: We perform a semiclassical, large-spin S, analysis of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) on the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) model, using the truncated Wigner approximation. Fixing the QAOA angles to their previously determined optimal S=1/2 values, we observe a non-monotonic dependence of the final energy on the spin. At small S the semiclassics is dominated by noise, while the large-S limit is constrained by the exponential growth of the initial fluctuations. For a depth-p QAOA one achieves the optimal balance at S of order p, resulting in a convergence of the final energy to the Parisi value like log(p)/p. We find that the semiclassics slightly outperforms the true spin-1/2 QAOA, and thus suggest they both converge to the Parisi value in the same way. Finally, removing all the initial noise, and re-optimizing the parameters to account for that change, results in superior performance with 1/p convergence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：semiclassical analysis、large-spin S、truncated Wigner approximation。；研究对象：Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) 模型上的量子近似优化算法（QAOA），具体研究自旋玻璃优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SK模型上，深度为p的QAOA的最终能量随自旋大小S呈非单调变化，最优平衡点在S~p量级，最终能量以log(p)/p的速率收敛到Parisi值；半经典近似略优于真实自旋1/2的QAOA，两者收敛方式相同；去除初始噪声并重新优化参数后，可实现1/p的更快收敛。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SK模型上，深度为p的QAOA的最终能量随自旋大小S呈非单调变化，最优平衡点在S~p量级，最终能量以log(p)/p的速率收敛到Parisi值；半经典近似略优于真实自旋1/2的QAOA，两者收敛方式相同；去除初始噪声并重新优化参数后，可实现1/p的更快收敛。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用截断维格纳近似（truncated Wigner approximation）对QAOA进行半经典大自旋S分析，固定QAOA角度为先前确定的S=1/2最优值，研究最终能量对自旋大小的依赖关系。

papers.title: Twofold universality of large-$N$ melonic random tensors
papers.abstract: We construct a measure that exhibits two aspects of a new type of universality and dramatically simplifies the integration of tensors $T_{a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_D} \in \mathbb{C}$ ($a_1,\ldots,a_D=1,\ldots,N$) at large $N$. In contrast to matrix integration, in which matrix traces canonically yield the integrand, tensors need additional information (equivalent to a $D$-coloured graph $B$) to contract their indices and form a tensor trace $B(T)$. We show that, whenever each $B_1,\ldots, B_n$ can be obtained by a recursive construction known as melonicity, then the leading order in $N$ of the integral of $ {B_1}(T) {B_2}(T) \cdots {B_n}(T) $ is independent of the -- often intricate -- combinatorics of the traces $B_i$, but also, to our surprise, independent of $D$ as far as $D\geq 3$. Instead, at large $N$, these integrals are some functions (indexed by $n$) of the number of vertices $2p_i$ of $B_i$ which we call melonic polynomials. Melonic traces cumulants with respect to any ('interacting') measure \[ \exp\Big\{-N^{D-1} \sum_{i=1}^m g_i {B_i}(T)\Big\} \mathrm{d}μ_0(T) \quad (g_1,\ldots,g_m \in \mathbb{R}, \mathrm{d}μ_0(T) =\text{the tensor Gaussian}) \] with each $B_i$ melonic, can be computed with our universal measure that replaces each $B_i$ by a canonical trace depending only on $p_i$. We prove that any two melonic tensor models are indistinguishable at large-$N$, independently of the number of tensor indices (first universality aspect), and of the fine-grainedness of their interactions (second universality), being a sufficient condition that the couplings (the parameters $g_i$ above) agree and their respective traces are monomials with the same degree in $T$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：构造测度、大N展开、张量积分、解析计算。；研究对象：大N极限下的随机张量模型，具体为具有melon（甜瓜）结构的D指标复张量 \( T_{a_1,\ldots,a_D} \) 的积分与关联函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大N极限下，任意melon张量模型的积分行为表现出双重普适性：一方面与张量指标数D（D≥3）无关，另一方面与melon迹的具体组合结构无关，仅依赖于每个melon迹的顶点数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大N极限下，任意melon张量模型的积分行为表现出双重普适性：一方面与张量指标数D（D≥3）无关，另一方面与melon迹的具体组合结构无关，仅依赖于每个melon迹的顶点数。；创新点：首次揭示了大N极限下melon张量模型的双重普适性：一是对张量指标维数D（D≥3）的普适性，二是对相互作用精细结构的普适性（只要相互作用是melon迹且耦合常数匹配）。该普适性使得不同melon张量模型在大N下不可区分。
papers.method_zh: 通过构造一种新的普适测度，将原本复杂的melon张量迹的积分简化为仅依赖于顶点数的规范迹的积分。利用melon迹的递归构造性质（melon性）进行大N展开，并计算了在含相互作用项（任意melon迹作为相互作用）的测度下的melon迹累积量。

papers.title: Temperature Beyond Equilibrium in Isolated Quantum Many-Body Systems and Their Subsystems
papers.abstract: Temperature is one of the central concepts of thermodynamics, yet its meaning away from equilibrium remains elusive. This problem is particularly acute in isolated quantum many-body systems: their states evolve unitarily, need not be close to equilibrium, and can retain energy coherence, a feature with no classical thermodynamic analogue. A non-stationary quantum state contains two kinds of energy fluctuations. One is associated with energy populations and has the usual thermodynamic interpretation; the other arises from coherence between energy sectors and drives time dependence. We propose that temperature, also out of equilibrium, locates the state within the family of regular states compatible with its energy-coherence structure. This leads to a natural definition of temperature for regular nonequilibrium states. The resulting inverse temperature is not generally the derivative of thermodynamic entropy with respect to energy. Indeed the principle of maximum entropy does not extend in its usual form; it is replaced by a principle of minimum discrimination information. We also develop the corresponding theory for subsystems, where temperature cannot in general be inferred from the reduced state alone. Instead, it is determined by the induced local thermodynamic structure, with boundary ambiguities removed in the thermodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论温度概念在非平衡量子多体系统中的理论定义，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：孤立量子多体系统及其子系统在非平衡态下的温度定义问题，特别关注能量相干性带来的时间依赖行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出非平衡态温度可通过与系统能量-相干结构兼容的“正则态族”来定位，从而给出非平衡正则态的自然温度定义；子系统温度不能仅由约化态推断，而需通过局域热力学结构确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出非平衡态温度可通过与系统能量-相干结构兼容的“正则态族”来定位，从而给出非平衡正则态的自然温度定义；子系统温度不能仅由约化态推断，而需通过局域热力学结构确定。；创新点：将温度定义从平衡态推广至非平衡态，并明确区分能量布居涨落与相干涨落的不同热力学角色；指出最大熵原理在非平衡情形下被最小鉴别信息原理取代；揭示子系统温度不能由约化密度矩阵唯一确定，需依赖局域热力学结构。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于最小鉴别信息原理（而非最大熵原理）定义非平衡态温度；通过分析能量布居与能量相干两类涨落，构建与能量-相干结构兼容的正则态族；对子系统，引入局域热力学结构并在热力学极限下消除边界模糊性。

papers.title: Extracting conformal data from Loschmidt echoes after critical quenches
papers.abstract: Conformal field theory provides universal predictions for Loschmidt amplitudes following quenches from product states to critical Hamiltonians. Building on this observation, we develop a route to extracting conformal data from real-time dynamics without preparing critical low-energy states. After analytic continuation, the Loschmidt amplitude is described by a boundary-CFT partition function on a strip, whose transverse transfer matrix encodes both the boundary operator spectrum and the central charge. Local space-time perturbations of the amplitude are governed by equilibrium correlation functions, and therefore provide access to critical exponents. In parallel, generalized temporal entropies exhibit scaling with time analogous to the equilibrium scaling of spatial entanglement entropy. We show that the low-lying boundary spectrum can be reconstructed from the system-size dependence of finite-chain Loschmidt echoes, whose damped oscillations encode differences of boundary scaling dimensions. Finally, we propose a finite-size scaling protocol that can extract these quantities from simulations or experiments on state-of-the-art quantum platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“conformal field theory provides universal predictions”、“develop a route”、“propose a finite-size scaling protocol”，主要基于共形场论和解析延拓的理论推导，未涉及具体实验或数值计算。；研究对象：量子临界淬火后Loschmidt回波中的共形数据提取。具体体系为从乘积态淬火到临界哈密顿量的量子系统，以及边界共形场论描述的有限链系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析延拓，Loschmidt振幅可由条带上的边界共形场论配分函数描述，其横向转移矩阵编码边界算子谱和中心荷；有限链Loschmidt回波的阻尼振荡可重构低能边界谱，从而提取边界标度维数差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析延拓，Loschmidt振幅可由条带上的边界共形场论配分函数描述，其横向转移矩阵编码边界算子谱和中心荷；有限链Loschmidt回波的阻尼振荡可重构低能边界谱，从而提取边界标度维数差。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为共形场论（CFT）和边界共形场论（BCFT），具体包括：解析延拓将Loschmidt振幅映射为条带上的BCFT配分函数；利用平衡关联函数分析局域时空扰动；通过广义时间熵的时间标度类比空间纠缠熵的平衡标度；提出有限尺寸标度协议以从模拟或实验中提取共形数据。

papers.title: Symmetry as a route to generalized bosonic Kitaev chains
papers.abstract: The bosonic Kitaev chain (BKC) model is a deceptively simple looking quadratic pairing Hamiltonian. Despite being purely Hermitian, it exhibits a number of striking non-Hermitian topological phenomena, including skin effects. We show here how symmetries play a key role in this model, and how identifying these allows one to develop generalized BKC-like models. We emphasize the surprising fact that any quadratic bosonic pairing Hamiltonian with a sublattice (chiral) symmetry necessarily has a dynamical matrix with an effective time reversal symmetry. This symmetry is unrelated to physical time-reversal, but enables non-trivial topological invariants. We also discuss how this symmetry is unrelated to another key property of the BKC, the decoupling of quadrature dynamics. This feature can instead be connected to a distinct symmetry, namely an effective particle-hole symmetry of the dynamical matrix. We discuss non-trivial generalized BKC models that only keep one of these two effective symmetries intact. We also provide a classification of all translationally-invariant 1D pairing Hamiltonians, and show connections between the BKC and a well-studied non-Hermitian fermionic system, the symplectic Hatano-Nelson model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：model、Hamiltonian、symmetry、classification、topological invariants。；研究对象：玻色子Kitaev链（BKC）模型及其推广，具体研究具有配对相互作用的二次型玻色子哈密顿量中的对称性与拓扑现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任何具有子晶格（手征）对称性的二次型玻色子配对哈密顿量，其动力学矩阵必然具有一种有效的时间反演对称性，该对称性并非物理时间反演，但能导致非平庸拓扑不变量；BKC模型中正交动力学解耦特性则源于另一种独立的对称性——动力学矩阵的有效粒子-空穴对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任何具有子晶格（手征）对称性的二次型玻色子配对哈密顿量，其动力学矩阵必然具有一种有效的时间反演对称性，该对称性并非物理时间反演，但能导致非平庸拓扑不变量；BKC模型中正交动力学解耦特性则源于另一种独立的对称性——动力学矩阵的有效粒子-空穴对称性。；创新点：揭示了BKC模型中两种关键对称性（有效时间反演对称性与有效粒子-空穴对称性）的独立作用，并基于此构建了仅保留其中一种对称性的广义BKC模型；给出了所有一维平移不变配对哈密顿量的完整分类。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与对称性分类。具体包括：通过对称性分析揭示BKC模型中有效时间反演对称性与有效粒子-空穴对称性的起源；对所有一维平移不变配对哈密顿量进行完整分类；建立BKC模型与非厄米费米子系统（辛Hatano-Nelson模型）之间的联系。

papers.title: Triangulene-based diradicals as a blueprint for molecular quantum platforms with optical addressability and long spin coherence times
papers.abstract: The identification of molecules that combine long spin coherence times and efficient spin-optical interfaces, ideally at room temperature, is pivotal towards the development of molecular quantum technology. By means of advanced first-principles methods, we here unravel the electronic structure for triangulene (1), its aza-cation derivative (2), and the crystal of 2,6,10-tri-tert-butyl-4,8,12-trimesityl-triangulene (3), and show that these organic diradicals possess a triplet ground state well separated from the first singlet excited state approaching 0.5 eV, closely resembling solid-state defects like nitrogen vacancy centers. In addition, we compute spin decoherence times due to the interaction with phonons and surrounding nuclear spins, showing that a deuterated molecule of 3 in a nuclear spin-free environment would support $T_2 = 0.21$ ms at 10 K. Importantly, we show that the engineering of specific low-energy vibrations could significantly improve $T_2$ toward the limit imposed by the molecular core spin relaxation, here estimated to be as long as $T_1=27$ ms at 300 K for 2. Finally, we compute two-phonon contributions to inter-system crossing at 300 K for2 as a luminescent prototype, and find that it is highly spin-selective, supporting the possibility to engineer optical read out and spin initialization. These results advance a unified first-principles theoretical foundation of spin decoherence and spin-selective excited-state processes and point to novel chemical design strategies for optically addressable, highly coherent molecular qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles methods、compute、theoretical foundation）；研究对象：三角烯（triangulene）及其衍生物（aza-cation derivative、2,6,10-tri-tert-butyl-4,8,12-trimesityl-triangulene）等有机双自由基分子，作为分子量子平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 这些有机双自由基具有与固态缺陷（如氮空位中心）相似的三重态基态（与第一单重激发态能隙接近0.5 eV），且通过氘代和核自旋自由环境可实现T2=0.21 ms（10 K），并预测在300 K下自旋-晶格弛豫时间T1可达27 ms。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：这些有机双自由基具有与固态缺陷（如氮空位中心）相似的三重态基态（与第一单重激发态能隙接近0.5 eV），且通过氘代和核自旋自由环境可实现T2=0.21 ms（10 K），并预测在300 K下自旋-晶格弛豫时间T1可达27 ms。；创新点：建立了自旋退相干与自旋选择性激发态过程的统一第一性原理理论框架，并提出了面向光学可寻址、高相干分子量子比特的新型化学设计策略。
papers.method_zh: 高级第一性原理方法（advanced first-principles methods），包括计算电子结构、自旋退相干时间（声子与核自旋相互作用）、双声子贡献的系间穿越（intersystem crossing）过程。

papers.title: Operational meaning of Markov gap in tripartite entanglement of quantum dynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate how irreducible multipartite entanglement, a long-range correlation by nature, can emerge from short-range dynamics far from equilibrium. Focusing on the Markov gap as a probe of irreducible tripartite entanglement (IrTE) in free-fermion chains, we uncover qualitatively distinct dynamical behaviors: the Markov gap grows either quasi-linearly or in staircase-like jumps depending on the initial state.
