papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental gate pulsing method”、“demonstrated”、“measured”等实验性关键词。；研究对象：基于GaAs-AlGaAs二维电子气（2DEG）的栅控量子点（QD）体系，研究其热驱动电荷输运及局域热分布控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节量子点的隧穿速率，可以精确控制热电流的极性和大小，并在400 nm的间距上维持650 mK的温差，实现介观电路中的局域热分布调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节量子点的隧穿速率，可以精确控制热电流的极性和大小，并在400 nm的间距上维持650 mK的温差，实现介观电路中的局域热分布调控。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用栅控量子点结构，通过调节隧穿势垒的隧穿速率来控制热电流；引入一种实验性的栅极脉冲方法直接测量量子点两端的电子温差，无需理论拟合。

papers.title: Entanglement Asymmetry in Random Quantum Automata
papers.abstract: We investigate the subsystem entanglement asymmetry in random quantum automaton ensembles, which are generated by permuting the basis states in the Hilbert space and applying global phase shifts. We compute the ensemble average of the $U(1)$ subsystem asymmetry in different connectivity geometries, showing that the late-time limit of the ensemble associated to a 2-local circuit geometry coincides with the all-to-all ensemble average. By focusing on different subsystem sizes, we demonstrate that, similarly to Haar-random circuits, the system locally symmetrizes. However, in sharp contrast to the Haar-random setting, the scale at which symmetrization happens depends on the initial state, a phenomenon we associate with the interplay of conservation of the participation entropy and the uniform exploration of charge sectors. Additionally, we connect the growth of the subsystem asymmetry to the subsystem coherence and show that their growth is characterized by the same symmetrization scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、ensemble average、theoretical framework。；研究对象：随机量子自动机（random quantum automaton）中的子系统纠缠不对称性（subsystem entanglement asymmetry），具体涉及不同连接几何结构下的U(1)对称性破缺行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在2-局域电路几何对应的系综中，晚期时间极限与全连接系综平均一致；与Haar随机电路不同，对称化发生的尺度依赖于初始态，这一现象与参与熵守恒及电荷扇区的均匀探索有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在2-局域电路几何对应的系综中，晚期时间极限与全连接系综平均一致；与Haar随机电路不同，对称化发生的尺度依赖于初始态，这一现象与参与熵守恒及电荷扇区的均匀探索有关。；创新点：揭示了随机量子自动机中对称化尺度对初始态的依赖性，这一特性与Haar随机电路形成鲜明对比，并将子系统不对称性的增长与子系统相干性联系起来，指出两者由相同的对称化尺度表征。
papers.method_zh: 通过置换希尔伯特空间中的基态并施加全局相位偏移来生成随机量子自动机系综，计算不同连接几何下U(1)子系统不对称性的系综平均，并分析子系统大小对对称化行为的影响。

papers.title: Strain-tunable charge localization coupled to complex magnetic orders in EuAl$_4$
papers.abstract: Charge localization is particularly interesting when coupled to antiferromagnetic spin structures. Coupled spin-charge orders are well established in elemental chromium and correlated oxide superconductors, yet the interplay between charge order and more complex magnetic textures -- such as skyrmion lattices and chiral spin structures -- remains largely unexplored. Here we report a comprehensive study of how charge localization couples to the unusually rich sequence of magnetic phases in EuAl$_4$. Using x-ray diffraction under applied magnetic field and uniaxial pressure, we demonstrate a direct coupling between the charge and spin order parameters. In the absence of external stimuli, charge localization is markedly enhanced upon entering the magnetically ordered phases. Strikingly, this effect is highly susceptible to strain: uniaxial pressure applied along the charge-order propagation direction further enhances localization, whereas pressure applied perpendicular to it weakens it. Application of magnetic field reveals both competitive and possible collaborative interactions between spin and charge ordering.This flexible coupling between spin and charge ordering opens a new route to designing symmetry-breaking states. Chiral charge order may for example be patterned from spin structures with that symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“x-ray diffraction under applied magnetic field and uniaxial pressure”（X射线衍射、外加磁场、单轴压力）。；研究对象：EuAl₄ 单晶中电荷局域化与复杂磁有序（包括斯格明子晶格、手性自旋结构等）之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 EuAl₄ 中，电荷局域化与丰富的磁有序相之间存在直接耦合，且这种耦合对单轴应变高度敏感：沿电荷序传播方向施加压力会增强电荷局域化，而垂直方向施加压力则会削弱它。外加磁场则揭示了自旋与电荷序之间既存在竞争也可能存在协同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 EuAl₄ 中，电荷局域化与丰富的磁有序相之间存在直接耦合，且这种耦合对单轴应变高度敏感：沿电荷序传播方向施加压力会增强电荷局域化，而垂直方向施加压力则会削弱它。外加磁场则揭示了自旋与电荷序之间既存在竞争也可能存在协同作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用在外加磁场和单轴压力条件下的 X 射线衍射技术，通过测量电荷序参数与自旋序参数的变化，直接探测二者的耦合关系。

papers.title: Crossover and Changeover in Spin-1 Kitaev-$Γ$ Chain with Uniaxial Single-ion Anisotropy
papers.abstract: Recent advances in bond-directional spin chains have revealed extensive emergent phenomena and unconventional criticality. Here we investigate the spin-1 Kitaev-$Γ$ chain with uniaxial single-ion anisotropy (SIA) using large-scale density-matrix renormalization group calculations and bosonization analysis. Tuning the SIA strength reveals a crossover from the Kitaev phase to the large-$D$ phase, evidenced by the excitation gap changing from quadratic to linear, the coexistence and smooth evolution of spin-nematic and string order parameters, and the suppression of the double-peak specific heat. For negative SIA, we uncover a changeover from a first-order transition to a continuous one between the dimerized and Haldane phases. The continuous transition belongs to the \textrm{SU(2)$_2$} Wess-Zumino-Witten universality class with central charge $c=3/2$, a rare instance in a system without continuous symmetry. Our results establish the Kitaev-$Γ$ chain as a minimal platform for controlling crossover and changeover phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：density-matrix renormalization group calculations（DMRG计算）、bosonization analysis（玻色化分析）。；研究对象：自旋为1的Kitaev-Γ链，并考虑单轴单离子各向异性（SIA）的量子自旋系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节单轴单离子各向异性强度，系统从Kitaev相到大-D相存在交叉（crossover），表现为激发能隙从二次型变为线性、自旋向列序与弦序共存并平滑演化、比热双峰结构被抑制；在负SIA区域，系统从二聚化相与Haldane相之间的一级相变转变为连续相变，该连续相变属于SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Witten普适类，中心荷c=3/2。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节单轴单离子各向异性强度，系统从Kitaev相到大-D相存在交叉（crossover），表现为激发能隙从二次型变为线性、自旋向列序与弦序共存并平滑演化、比热双峰结构被抑制；在负SIA区域，系统从二聚化相与Haldane相之间的一级相变转变为连续相变，该连续相变属于SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Witten普适类，中心荷c=3/2。；创新点：首次在Kitaev-Γ链中通过单轴单离子各向异性实现了交叉（crossover）与转变（changeover）现象的可控调控，并在无连续对称性的系统中发现了罕见的SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Witten普适类连续相变。
papers.method_zh: 大规模密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）数值计算，结合玻色化（bosonization）理论分析。

papers.title: Nonlinear Dynamics of Hopfion for Frequency Multiplication
papers.abstract: Hopfions, associated with higher-dimensional topology through the Hopf fibration, exhibit {exotic} features like {complex knot} and improved stability compared to skyrmions, enhancing their appeal for innovative applications. In this paper, we study the nonlinear response of magnetic Hopfion to microwave fields. {We observe the emergence of higher-order harmonics of the driving microwave field as it interacts with the Hopfion}. By carefully selecting the {driving frequency, the corresponding harmonic can efficiently excite localized magnon state of a Hopfion. Our results demonstrate the promising potential of hopfions in nonlinear magnonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“研究非线性响应”“观察高阶谐波产生”，属于理论建模与数值模拟范畴。；研究对象：磁性Hopfion在微波场驱动下的非线性动力学行为，具体关注其频率倍增效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Hopfion在微波场驱动下会产生高阶谐波，通过选择合适的驱动频率，该谐波可高效激发Hopfion的局域磁振子态，展示了Hopfion在非线性磁子学中的应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Hopfion在微波场驱动下会产生高阶谐波，通过选择合适的驱动频率，该谐波可高效激发Hopfion的局域磁振子态，展示了Hopfion在非线性磁子学中的应用潜力。；创新点：首次揭示了磁性Hopfion在微波驱动下的非线性谐波产生机制，并利用该机制实现局域磁振子态的选择性激发，拓展了Hopfion在非线性磁子学中的功能。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如微磁学模拟、解析模型等），但涉及对微波场驱动下Hopfion非线性响应的研究。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian control of helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance
papers.abstract: We study non-Hermitian antiferromagnetic resonance in an antiferromagnetic insulator/nonmagnetic metal junction with sublattice-dependent damping and spin-orbit torque. By formulating the linearized Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation as a 2x2 non-Hermitian eigenvalue problem, we derive the complex resonance frequencies, the exceptional-point condition, and the stability-threshold condition. We show that the largest absorption response is maximized by approaching the stability threshold from the stable side. Near the threshold on the stable side, the absorption spectrum exhibits strong enhancement and linewidth narrowing, together with pronounced helicity dependence in the sub-THz regime that can be switched by reversing the spin-orbit torque. We also confirm by solving the full LLG dynamics that crossing the threshold leads to gain and self-oscillation. These results identify the stability threshold as the key control principle for enhancing absorption and achieving polarization selectivity in the sub-THz/THz regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：formulating、derive、eigenvalue problem、solving the full LLG dynamics）；研究对象：反铁磁绝缘体/非磁性金属异质结中的非厄米反铁磁共振现象，具体涉及子晶格依赖的阻尼和自旋轨道力矩。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过接近稳定性阈值（从稳定侧），可以最大化吸收响应，并实现亚THz波段强增强、线宽窄化以及可被自旋轨道力矩反转的螺旋度选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过接近稳定性阈值（从稳定侧），可以最大化吸收响应，并实现亚THz波段强增强、线宽窄化以及可被自旋轨道力矩反转的螺旋度选择性。；创新点：将稳定性阈值识别为增强吸收和实现亚THz/THz波段偏振选择性的关键控制原理，并揭示了非厄米性在反铁磁共振中的螺旋度调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性化的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG)方程，将其构建为2×2非厄米本征值问题，推导复共振频率、奇异点条件和稳定性阈值条件；并通过求解完整LLG动力学方程进行验证。

papers.title: Stress calculation in linear scaling DFT: convergence and dynamics
papers.abstract: We present the approach needed to calculate stress within density functional theory (DFT) using a localised orbital basis, both for exact diagonalisation and linear scaling approaches, and demonstrate our implementation within the large scale DFT code Conquest. For the linear scaling approach, we test the rate of convergence of stress with density matrix range, and compare it to the convergence of energy and forces for different materials with a range of band gaps. We show that excellent convergence is found for modest cutoffs, and show that large-scale isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics is stable and accurate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、linear scaling approaches、localised orbital basis、Conquest（DFT代码）。；研究对象：论文研究的是在局域轨道基组下，使用线性标度DFT方法计算应力的技术，并测试了该方法在不同带隙材料中的收敛性与动力学稳定性。摘要未明确指定具体材料名称。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在线性标度DFT中，应力随密度矩阵截断半径的收敛性良好，在适中的截断半径下即可达到与能量和力相当的收敛精度；基于此方法的大规模等温等压分子动力学模拟稳定且准确。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在线性标度DFT中，应力随密度矩阵截断半径的收敛性良好，在适中的截断半径下即可达到与能量和力相当的收敛精度；基于此方法的大规模等温等压分子动力学模拟稳定且准确。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用局域轨道基组的密度泛函理论（DFT），分别使用精确对角化方法和线性标度方法计算应力，并在大规模DFT代码Conquest中实现。通过改变密度矩阵截断半径测试应力的收敛速率，并与能量和力的收敛性进行对比。

papers.title: A Multi-Scale Machine Learning Framework for Coupled Chemical, Spin, and Structural Disorder in Alloys
papers.abstract: Understanding the thermodynamic properties of disordered magnetic alloys requires a unified treatment of configurational (chemical, spin, etc.) and structural degrees of freedom, which has remained beyond the scope of existing computational frameworks. Here we present a general framework that integrates machine learning models (such as graph neural networks and machine learning interatomic potentials) and statistical sampling methods (such as Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulations) to study the coupled chemical, spin, and structural disorder in alloys. We demonstrate the framework on body-centered-cubic Fe-Co alloys with interstitial carbon dopants, where the Fe-Co host exhibits intrinsic chemical and spin disorder, and the interstitial carbon introduces additional structural disorder through local lattice distortions, making the system a prototypical multi-disorder magnetic alloy. The framework predicts the order-to-disorder phase transition temperature and the melting temperature of Fe-Co alloy to be 1,000 K and 1,690 K, in excellent agreement with the experimentally measured values of 1,006 K and approximately 1,700 K, respectively. It also predicts the tetragonal-to-nearly-cubic structural transitions in Fe-Co-C alloy as temperature increases. These results establish the framework as a reliable tool for studying multi-disorder alloys, with applications to complex disordered systems such as high-entropy alloys, multiferroics, and spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning models、Monte Carlo、molecular dynamics simulations、framework。；研究对象：多无序磁性合金（以体心立方Fe-Co合金及含间隙碳原子的Fe-Co-C合金为例），具体研究其化学无序、自旋无序与结构无序的耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架成功预测了Fe-Co合金的有序-无序相变温度（1000 K）和熔化温度（1690 K），与实验值（1006 K和约1700 K）高度吻合；同时预测了Fe-Co-C合金随温度升高发生的四方相到近立方相的结构转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架成功预测了Fe-Co合金的有序-无序相变温度（1000 K）和熔化温度（1690 K），与实验值（1006 K和约1700 K）高度吻合；同时预测了Fe-Co-C合金随温度升高发生的四方相到近立方相的结构转变。；创新点：首次提出一个能够统一处理合金中化学、自旋和结构三种无序耦合问题的通用计算框架，突破了现有方法无法同时描述多种无序的局限。
papers.method_zh: 集成机器学习模型（如图神经网络、机器学习原子间势）与统计采样方法（如蒙特卡洛模拟、分子动力学模拟）的多尺度计算框架。

papers.title: Growth of (111)-textured SrTiO3 thin films on Pt(111)/Al2O3(1-102) substrates by rf magnetron sputter deposition
papers.abstract: SrTiO3 thin films, 20-30nm, with high quality crystal structure and low roughness can be used as growth templates for complex oxides or as the dielectric materials for capacitor structures. In this work, stoichiometric STO thin films were grown by radio frequency magnetron sputtering on Pt (111) templates grown on rAl2O3 substrates, and the effects of growth parameters as well as the underlying Pt templates structural properties on the quality of STO films were studied. A comparison between room temp grown Pt and Pt grown at elevated temps showed that the latter lead to highly ordered Pt and STO films with quasi 2D surface roughness. Xray diffraction showed that the STO thin films had (111) and (222) crystal orientation. A rocking curve full width at half maximum value of 0.2° was achieved, indicating that the STO films are high-quality. The STO films have a roughness less than 1 nm, as measured using atomic force microscopy, comparable to the underlying Pt templates roughness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了薄膜生长（rf magnetron sputter deposition）和表征（X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy）等实验过程。；研究对象：在Pt(111)/Al2O3(1-102)衬底上生长的SrTiO3（STO）薄膜，具体研究其(111)织构生长及晶体质量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过射频磁控溅射在高温生长的Pt(111)模板上制备的STO薄膜具有高度有序的(111)和(222)取向，摇摆曲线半高宽仅为0.2°，表面粗糙度小于1 nm，表明获得了高质量的单晶织构薄膜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过射频磁控溅射在高温生长的Pt(111)模板上制备的STO薄膜具有高度有序的(111)和(222)取向，摇摆曲线半高宽仅为0.2°，表面粗糙度小于1 nm，表明获得了高质量的单晶织构薄膜。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 射频磁控溅射（rf magnetron sputter deposition）生长STO薄膜；X射线衍射（XRD）分析晶体取向和摇摆曲线半高宽；原子力显微镜（AFM）测量表面粗糙度；对比室温与高温生长的Pt模板对STO薄膜质量的影响。

papers.title: Hyperuniform systems are maximally irreversible
papers.abstract: Hyperuniform systems, defined by the anomalous suppression of large-scale density fluctuations, are a paradigm of non-equilibrium self-assembly. While mechanisms underlying the self-assembly of hyperuniform states have been widely studied, the energetics of this process remain unexplored. This raises a fundamental question: what is the energetic cost of self-assembling a hyperuniform system? Here, we address this question across several noisy particle systems drawn from soft matter and machine learning, in which hyperuniformity can be induced by tuning noise correlations. Despite their distinct microscopic dynamics, we uncover a universal behavior across all systems: hyperuniform states are maximally irreversible, as quantified by the entropy production rate. Further, we develop a path integral formulation of the entropy production rate directly from the microscopic dynamics, which explains our observations. Our work establishes a direct link between emergent long-range structure and time irreversibility and opens a new avenue of probing the energetic cost of hyperuniform self-assembly, ubiquitous across physics, biology, and materials science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：path integral formulation、entropy production rate、noisy particle systems、machine learning）；研究对象：超均匀系统（hyperuniform systems）在非平衡自组装过程中的能量学，具体涉及软物质和机器学习中的噪声粒子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超均匀态在所有研究的系统中均表现出最大不可逆性，其熵产生率（entropy production rate）达到最大值，从而建立了长程结构与时间不可逆性之间的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超均匀态在所有研究的系统中均表现出最大不可逆性，其熵产生率（entropy production rate）达到最大值，从而建立了长程结构与时间不可逆性之间的直接联系。；创新点：首次揭示了超均匀自组装的能量代价（即最大不可逆性），并建立了超均匀性与时间不可逆性之间的普适性关联，为理解物理、生物学和材料科学中普遍存在的超均匀自组装提供了新的热力学视角。
papers.method_zh: 通过调节噪声相关性诱导超均匀性，利用熵产生率量化不可逆性，并发展了一种直接从微观动力学出发的路径积分（path integral）形式来推导熵产生率。

papers.title: Optimizing high-temperature electron mobility in single-crystal Bi$_2$O$_2$Se based on its unconventional dependence on concentration
papers.abstract: Quasi-2D Bi$_2$O$_2$Se is part of an intensive materials research effort aimed at finding new semiconductors that outperform silicon-based electronics in terms of speed and power consumption. This material exhibits exceptionally high carrier mobility at low temperatures but mediocre mobility at 300 K. Its high mobility is generally associated with its high permittivity ($\varepsilon_r$~500), which is also associated with metallicity persisting down to very low carrier concentrations. This material exhibits a counterintuitive increase in carrier mobility as the concentration increases. The connection between low both carrier concentration and mobility in Se-rich conditions, and both high carrier concentration and mobility in Se-poor conditions suggests that the increase is related to native defects. We demonstrate that these defects can alter the effective mass of charge carriers. Specifically, substitutional Se(Bi) defects, which appear under Se-rich conditions, destroy the Bi$_2$O$_2$ channel and compromise charge transport properties. These defects increase the effective mass of charge carriers transforming the original semiconductor into a semimetal and introducing holes into charge transport. Additionally, we show that single crystals are generally inhomogeneous, particularly those grown under Se-rich conditions. Unlike Se-poor conditions, Se-rich conditions induce a higher concentration of dislocations and extraneous phases. These findings suggest that the perfection of the Bi$_2$O$_2$ channel is crucial for mobility, particularly at room temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：single-crystal、carrier mobility、native defects、dislocations、extraneous phases）；研究对象：准二维半导体单晶Bi₂O₂Se，重点研究其高温（300 K）电子迁移率与载流子浓度的反常依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Bi₂O₂Se的载流子迁移率随浓度增加而反常增大，其根源在于Se-rich条件下形成的替位缺陷Se(Bi)会破坏Bi₂O₂通道、增大有效质量并引入空穴，而Se-poor条件下晶体更完美、通道更完整，从而获得更高迁移率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Bi₂O₂Se的载流子迁移率随浓度增加而反常增大，其根源在于Se-rich条件下形成的替位缺陷Se(Bi)会破坏Bi₂O₂通道、增大有效质量并引入空穴，而Se-poor条件下晶体更完美、通道更完整，从而获得更高迁移率。；创新点：揭示了Bi₂O₂Se中迁移率随浓度反常增大的微观机制——与Se(Bi)替位缺陷导致的能带结构变化（半导体→半金属转变）及晶体不均匀性（位错、杂相）直接相关，并指出Bi₂O₂通道的完整性是室温高迁移率的关键。
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长（Se-rich与Se-poor条件对比）、载流子浓度与迁移率测量、缺陷分析（有效质量变化、位错与杂相表征）。

papers.title: Quantitative DFT+DMFT description of spectra and transport in the moderately correlated metal SrVO$_3$
papers.abstract: A quantitative, material-specific account of spectral and transport properties remains a central challenge in the theory of strongly correlated materials. Combining density functional theory with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT) has proven to be a powerful approach for treating electron correlation effects and material specificity on an equal footing. Here, we examine the single-particle spectra and the dc and optical conductivity of SrVO$_3$, a prototypical, moderately correlated metal, within this framework. The degenerate $t_{2g}$ active space of SrVO$_3$, together with its well-established Fermi-liquid behavior, admits an effective-mass description governed by a single quasiparticle weight, yielding a nearly universal picture of the low-frequency, low-temperature regime. Employing a computationally efficient, real-frequency multi-orbital iterative perturbation theory (MO-IPT) impurity solver, we find reasonable agreement with experimental measurements of dc resistivity and optical conductivity across the entire experimentally relevant $(ω, T)$ range within a single, unified scheme. The agreement is shown to not depend on specific interaction parameters provided the quasiparticle weight is kept constant. These results indicate that, in SrVO$_3$, the $\mathbf{k}$-dependence of the self-energy may be weak, and vertex corrections may not dominate the dc and optical transport in this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT+DMFT、MO-IPT impurity solver、理论计算与实验对比）；研究对象：中度关联金属 SrVO₃ 的单粒子谱、直流电导率与光学电导率
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持准粒子权重不变的条件下，DFT+DMFT 结合 MO-IPT 杂质求解器可在统一框架下定量描述 SrVO₃ 在全部实验相关（ω, T）范围内的直流电阻率和光学电导率，且结果不依赖于具体相互作用参数；该材料中自能的 k 依赖性可能较弱，且顶点修正可能不主导直流与光学输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保持准粒子权重不变的条件下，DFT+DMFT 结合 MO-IPT 杂质求解器可在统一框架下定量描述 SrVO₃ 在全部实验相关（ω, T）范围内的直流电阻率和光学电导率，且结果不依赖于具体相互作用参数；该材料中自能的 k 依赖性可能较弱，且顶点修正可能不主导直流与光学输运。；创新点：摘要未突出说明
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT），采用实频多轨道迭代微扰论（MO-IPT）杂质求解器

papers.title: Force-Isosurface Simulations Probe the Limits of High-Resolution AFM on Three-Dimensional Molecules
papers.abstract: High-resolution atomic force microscopy has transformed molecular imaging by revealing intramolecular structure directly in real space. A major remaining challenge is to extend this capability from largely planar molecules to non-planar molecular systems, where the most important structural information may be distributed across different heights above the surface. Here we use probe-particle-model simulations to predict the constant-force contours expected above molecules with increasing structural complexity. By extracting force isosurfaces from simulated three-dimensional force fields, we compare the molecular information retained in constant-height and constant-force images. For tilted benzene and pyrrole, constant-force images preserve the molecular framework across a range of adsorption angles and allow the molecular orientation to be recovered quantitatively. For larger non-planar and three-dimensional systems, simulations identify characteristic force-isosurface contrast associated with adsorption geometry, lower-lying molecular structure and curved molecular surfaces. These results provide target contrasts for force isosurfaces that could be extracted from three-dimensional force-mapping experiments, evaluating the molecular information retained by ideal force-isosurface imaging across progressively non-planar systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：probe-particle-model simulations、simulated three-dimensional force fields、force isosurfaces。；研究对象：非平面分子体系（如倾斜苯、吡咯及更大三维分子）在高分辨率原子力显微镜（AFM）成像中的力等值面行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于非平面分子，恒力成像（force-isosurface）相比恒高成像能更完整地保留分子骨架信息，并允许定量恢复分子取向；模拟揭示了与吸附几何、低层分子结构及弯曲分子表面相关的特征力等值面对比度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于非平面分子，恒力成像（force-isosurface）相比恒高成像能更完整地保留分子骨架信息，并允许定量恢复分子取向；模拟揭示了与吸附几何、低层分子结构及弯曲分子表面相关的特征力等值面对比度。；创新点：系统评估了从三维力映射实验中提取的力等值面在逐步非平面分子体系中的理想成像能力，为高分辨率AFM从平面分子扩展到三维分子提供了目标对比度参考。
papers.method_zh: 采用探针-粒子模型模拟（probe-particle-model simulations），从模拟的三维力场中提取力等值面，对比恒高成像与恒力成像保留的分子信息。

papers.title: Competing ferroelectric and smectic order: modulated structures through molecular design
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the balance between polar and positional order can be systematically tuned through molecular engineering, providing direct control over the emergence of polar and modulated liquid-crystalline phases, allowing for versatile strategy for the design of functional ferroelectric soft materials. We show that polar orthogonal smectic phases (SmAF and SmAAF), promoted by the self-segregation of aromatic cores and sufficiently long terminal chains, are readily destabilized by strong longitudinal dipolar interactions that energetically penalize parallel alignment of molecular dipoles within a smectic layer. In contrast, the tilted ferroelectric SmCF phase is remarkably robust across the entire homologous series, indicating that molecular tilt efficiently relieves dipolar frustration within the smectic layers. We further demonstrate that the interplay between microsegregation and electrostatic interactions stabilizes the new modulated SmCM phase, characterized by incommensurate electron-density waves, particularly for compounds with short terminal chains. For longer homologs controlling the spatial distribution of fluorinated molecular fragments and terminal-chain length enabled the targeted formation of broken-layer-type modulated polar phases (2D or 3D).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论结合的文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“通过分子工程系统调控”、“设计功能铁电软材料”，并描述了不同分子结构（如末端链长、氟化片段分布）对相行为的影响，这通常涉及实验合成与表征；同时，摘要中关于“偶极相互作用”、“微相分离”等对相稳定性的解释，体现了理论分析。；研究对象：铁电液晶材料中的极性有序与位置有序（近晶相）之间的竞争关系，具体研究了通过分子设计调控产生的多种调制液晶相，包括正交极性近晶相（SmAF, SmAAF）、倾斜铁电近晶相（SmCF）以及一种新的调制近晶相（SmCM）和破层型调制极性相（2D或3D）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子工程（改变末端链长、氟化片段分布）可以系统调控极性有序与位置有序的平衡，从而直接控制极性及调制液晶相的出现。其中，倾斜铁电SmCF相在整个同系物中非常稳定，而强纵向偶极相互作用会破坏正交极性相，并稳定一种具有非公度电子密度波的新型调制SmCM相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子工程（改变末端链长、氟化片段分布）可以系统调控极性有序与位置有序的平衡，从而直接控制极性及调制液晶相的出现。其中，倾斜铁电SmCF相在整个同系物中非常稳定，而强纵向偶极相互作用会破坏正交极性相，并稳定一种具有非公度电子密度波的新型调制SmCM相。；创新点：揭示了通过分子设计（特别是末端链长和氟化片段分布）来精细调控铁电与近晶序竞争，从而定向设计新型极性调制液晶相（如SmCM相和破层型调制相）的通用策略。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 分子工程（化学合成与设计），具体手段包括：改变芳香核的自分离特性、调控末端链长度、控制氟化分子片段的空间分布。通过观察不同分子设计下液晶相的出现与转变，来研究分子结构与相行为的关系。摘要未提及具体的实验表征手段（如X射线衍射、介电谱等）或理论计算方法（如分子动力学模拟、密度泛函理论等）。

papers.title: Ab Initio Investigation of Pressure Effects in the Spin-Liquid Candidate Y-Kapellasite
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent experiments showing pressure-induced suppression of magnetic order and the emergence of a dynamical ground state in the anisotropic kagome antiferromagnet Y-kapellasite Y3Cu9(OH)19Cl8, we perform ab initio density functional theory (DFT)calculations to investigate the evolution of magnetic exchange interactions under hydrostatic pressure. We show that pressure efficiently tunes the magnetic Hamiltonian by altering the CuOCu bond geometry, thereby driving the system towards a spin-liquid regime. This evolution is governed by a nonlinear dependence of the dominant exchange coupling on the CuOCu bond angle. We further examine the influence of hydrogen positions and find that both the OH bond length and the hydrogen out-of-plane angle strongly affect the magnetic interactions. Our results provide a microscopic explanation for the experimentally observed pressure-induced enhancement of frustration and highlight the key role of hydrogen geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“ab initio density functional theory (DFT) calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是Y-kapellasite（Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈），一种各向异性kagome反铁磁体，以及其在静水压下的自旋液体候选态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力通过改变Cu-O-Cu键几何结构，非线性地调控主导磁交换耦合，从而将系统推向自旋液体区域；氢原子的位置（O-H键长和面外角）对磁相互作用有显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力通过改变Cu-O-Cu键几何结构，非线性地调控主导磁交换耦合，从而将系统推向自旋液体区域；氢原子的位置（O-H键长和面外角）对磁相互作用有显著影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，研究静水压下磁交换相互作用的演化。

papers.title: Machine Learning Materials Properties by Encoding Orbital-Projected Density of States
papers.abstract: Graph neural networks have become the dominant machine-learning architecture for predicting materials properties from crystal structures. Yet the initialization of atomic node features has received comparatively little attention, and conventional approaches rely on static elemental descriptors that carry no information about the quantum-mechanical electronic environment of each atom in its crystalline host. Here we show that augmenting atomic node representations with site-projected orbital density of states (pDOS) fingerprints, computed directly from density functional theory calculations, yields systematic and substantial improvements in predictive performance.These representations are fused with Pettifor elemental embeddings at each atomic site before message passing. For the superconducting critical temperature $T_c$ and the optical dielectric constant $ε_{\infty}$,the pDOS augmentation reduces prediction errors by 22.9% and 27.9%, respectively, relative to the elemental-descriptor baseline. These improvements are comparable to those achieved by doubling the training-set size. The gains are, however, contingent on training-set size. For the magnetic exchange energies of Heusler compounds, a substantially smaller dataset, the improvement is reduced,indicating that pDOS augmentation is most effective when the training data exceeds the length of the pDOS feature vector. We introduce an interpretable spectral attention-gating mechanism that reveals that the model autonomously learns to prioritize the orbital channels and energy windows most physically relevant to each target property. These results establish pDOS-augmented graph nodes as a broadly applicable strategy for infusing first-principles electronic-structure knowledge into graph networks, opening a practical route to high-accuracy property prediction in data-scarce regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：graph neural networks、density functional theory calculations、machine-learning architecture。；研究对象：晶体材料的物理性质预测，具体包括超导临界温度 \(T_c\)、光学介电常数 \(\varepsilon_{\infty}\) 以及 Heusler 化合物的磁交换能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将第一性原理计算得到的投影轨道态密度（pDOS）作为原子节点特征融入图神经网络，可显著提升材料性质预测精度，其效果相当于将训练集规模扩大一倍；模型通过可解释的谱注意力门控机制自动学习与目标性质最相关的轨道通道和能量窗口。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将第一性原理计算得到的投影轨道态密度（pDOS）作为原子节点特征融入图神经网络，可显著提升材料性质预测精度，其效果相当于将训练集规模扩大一倍；模型通过可解释的谱注意力门控机制自动学习与目标性质最相关的轨道通道和能量窗口。；创新点：首次系统性地将 site-projected orbital density of states（pDOS）作为原子节点特征引入图神经网络，替代传统静态元素描述符，并证明该方法在多种材料性质预测中带来显著且一致的精度提升。
papers.method_zh: 采用图神经网络（GNN）架构，在原子节点特征中融合 DFT 计算的 pDOS 指纹与 Pettifor 元素嵌入，通过消息传递进行性质预测；引入可解释的谱注意力门控机制分析模型学习到的物理相关性。

papers.title: Spin-polarized electron transport for the altermagnet CrSb
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate spin-polarized electron transport for the centrosymmetric altermagnet CrSb, which is known to reveal both altermagnetic and topological features. We demonstrate pronounced first-harmonic anomalous and second-harmonic non-linear Hall effects for a single-crystal CrSb flake with ferromagnetic nickel contacts, while both effects can not be seen for the reference samples with non-magnetic gold ones. For the anomalous Hall effect, we demonstrate bow-tie hysteresis loop in Hall voltage, which is usually ascribed to surface spin textures in magnetic materials. The slope of the Hall curve changes a sign for two orientations of the Hall-bar contact configuration for the same sample, i.e. for the same sign of the charge carriers. We interpret the observed sign inversion and bow-tie hysteresis as the joint effect of the alternating bulk spin splitting and spin-polarized topological surface states in CrSb. The pronounced non-linear Hall effect with hysteresis in magnetic field confirms finite Berry curvature dipole under injection of spin-polarized electrons, i.e. the topological features for the altermagnetic candidate CrSb.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally investigate”、“demonstrate”、“measurements”等关键词，涉及实际样品制备和电输运测量。；研究对象：研究的具体材料是中心对称的交变磁体（altermagnet）CrSb，以及其与铁磁性镍（Ni）接触形成的单晶薄片中的自旋极化电子输运现象，包括反常霍尔效应和非线性霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CrSb单晶薄片与铁磁性镍接触的器件中，观测到了显著的一次谐波反常霍尔效应和二次谐波非线性霍尔效应，并观察到反常霍尔电压的蝴蝶型磁滞回线和符号反转，这些现象被归因于体态交变自旋劈裂与自旋极化拓扑表面态的联合效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CrSb单晶薄片与铁磁性镍接触的器件中，观测到了显著的一次谐波反常霍尔效应和二次谐波非线性霍尔效应，并观察到反常霍尔电压的蝴蝶型磁滞回线和符号反转，这些现象被归因于体态交变自旋劈裂与自旋极化拓扑表面态的联合效应。；创新点：首次在交变磁体CrSb中通过自旋极化电子注入（铁磁接触）同时观测到反常霍尔效应的蝴蝶型磁滞回线和符号反转，并证实了有限贝里曲率偶极矩的存在，从而将交变磁性与拓扑表面态的自旋输运特征联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：制备单晶CrSb薄片，分别制作铁磁性镍（Ni）接触和非磁性金（Au）接触的霍尔棒器件；测量一次谐波反常霍尔效应和二次谐波非线性霍尔效应；通过改变霍尔棒接触构型（orientation）观察霍尔曲线斜率变化。

papers.title: Magnetotransport Properties of Iron-Based Ladder Compounds BaFe2S3 and BaFe2Se3 under High Pressure
papers.abstract: The magnetotransport properties of the iron-based ladder compounds BaFe2S3 and BaFe2Se3 under various pressures were investigated. BaFe2S3 had a T^2 dependence in electrical resistivity and a normal magnetoresistance near an insulator-metal transition. Therefore, it had Fermi-liquid-like properties in the normal phase. However, BaFe2Se3 had a T^3/2 dependence in electrical resistivity and a negative magnetoresistance. This suggested that BaFe2Se3 had non-Fermi-liquid properties near the insulator-metal transition. For both materials, the Hall resistivities indicated a hole-dominant magnetic field dependence. During a pressure-induced insulator-metal transition, BaFe2Se3 had a rapid decrease in electrical resistivity above 15 GPa attributed to an isomorphic structural transition previously reported in X-ray diffraction experiments. This transition had a strong impact on the electronic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了电输运测量（电阻率、磁电阻、霍尔电阻率）及高压实验，属于凝聚态物理实验研究。；研究对象：铁基梯状化合物 BaFe₂S₃ 和 BaFe₂Se₃ 在高压下的磁输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BaFe₂S₃ 在绝缘体-金属转变附近表现出费米液体行为（电阻率 T² 依赖、正常磁电阻），而 BaFe₂Se₃ 则表现出非费米液体行为（电阻率 T³/² 依赖、负磁电阻）。此外，BaFe₂Se₃ 在 15 GPa 以上电阻率急剧下降，归因于此前 X 射线衍射实验报道的同构结构相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BaFe₂S₃ 在绝缘体-金属转变附近表现出费米液体行为（电阻率 T² 依赖、正常磁电阻），而 BaFe₂Se₃ 则表现出非费米液体行为（电阻率 T³/² 依赖、负磁电阻）。此外，BaFe₂Se₃ 在 15 GPa 以上电阻率急剧下降，归因于此前 X 射线衍射实验报道的同构结构相变。；创新点：揭示了两种同类型铁基梯状化合物在高压绝缘体-金属转变附近截然不同的输运行为（费米液体 vs. 非费米液体），并指出 BaFe₂Se₃ 中同构结构相变对电子性质的强烈影响。
papers.method_zh: 高压电输运测量，包括电阻率、磁电阻和霍尔电阻率的测量，并结合此前 X 射线衍射实验的结构信息。

papers.title: Taming nonlinear energy diffusion: The case of time-crystal energy condensates
papers.abstract: We study a bulk-driven nonlinear variant of the Kipnis-Marchioro-Presutti model of stochastic energy diffusion in which local collisions are biased to induce a net energy flow, resembling the effect of an external field. Starting from the microscopic master equation, we derive the hydrodynamic description of the driven system via a local equilibrium approximation, obtaining explicit expressions for the energy current and the associated diffusivity and mobility transport coefficients, which are nonlinear functions of the local energy density. We test our findings in kinetic Monte Carlo simulations of the model and, as a proof of concept, we demonstrate the versatility of this driving mechanism to control nonlinear energy transport by inducing time-crystalline phases. In particular, we show that appropriately designed packing fields induce the spontaneous formation of traveling energy condensates, exhibiting robust long-range temporal order reminiscent of continuous time crystals. Our results provide a simple yet powerful framework to study bulk-driven nonlinear energy diffusion in stochastic many-body systems, offering a bridge between microscopic dynamics, macroscopic transport, and controlled spatiotemporal order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：推导了流体力学描述，并进行了动力学蒙特卡洛模拟验证。；研究对象：受体驱动非线性能量扩散模型，具体为Kipnis-Marchioro-Presutti（KMP）模型的非线性变体，以及其中形成的“时间晶体能量凝聚体”现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计合适的“打包场”（packing fields），可以在该随机多体系统中诱导出具有鲁棒长程时间序的行波能量凝聚体，类似于连续时间晶体的行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计合适的“打包场”（packing fields），可以在该随机多体系统中诱导出具有鲁棒长程时间序的行波能量凝聚体，类似于连续时间晶体的行为。；创新点：提出了一种简单而通用的驱动机制来控制非线性能量输运，并首次在该类随机能量扩散模型中实现了时间晶体相，建立了微观动力学、宏观输运与可控时空序之间的桥梁。
papers.method_zh: 从微观主方程出发，采用局域平衡近似推导了驱动系统的流体力学描述，得到了能量流、扩散率和迁移率等输运系数的显式表达式；并通过动力学蒙特卡洛模拟对理论结果进行了验证。

papers.title: Perspectives on inverse design for AI magnonics
papers.abstract: Inverse design - specifying a desired functionality and letting a computational algorithm find the optimal structure - has emerged as a powerful paradigm for magnonic device engineering. In this article, we survey the rapidly growing field of inverse-design magnonics, organising it along two axes: the design variables (topology, material parameters, and magnetic field landscape) and the algorithmic toolbox (gradient-free, gradient-based, and neural-network-based methods) together with the differentiable micromagnetic solvers that enable them. We then identify open frontiers that we consider most promising for the next phase of the field: sensitivity analysis and robust design to bridge the gap between simulation and experiment; input shaping and transducer optimisation; the incorporation of nonlinear spin-wave effects as an explicit design resource; spatially structured amplification; self-adapting media and machine-learning-based design; and the long-term vision of a universal, reconfigurable magnonic platform. We argue that magnonics and artificial intelligence are converging from two directions - machine-learning tools for designing magnonic devices, and magnonic devices as hardware for neuromorphic computation - and propose the term AI magnonics to describe this emerging paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述/展望文章。关键词：survey（综述）、perspectives（展望）、emerging paradigm（新兴范式）。；研究对象：磁子学器件（magnonic devices）的逆向设计，具体涉及拓扑结构、材料参数、磁场分布等设计变量，以及自旋波（spin-wave）的非线性效应、空间结构化放大、自适应介质等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁子学与人工智能正在双向融合：一方面利用机器学习工具设计磁子器件，另一方面磁子器件可作为神经形态计算的硬件平台，由此提出“AI磁子学”（AI magnonics）这一新兴范式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁子学与人工智能正在双向融合：一方面利用机器学习工具设计磁子器件，另一方面磁子器件可作为神经形态计算的硬件平台，由此提出“AI磁子学”（AI magnonics）这一新兴范式。；创新点：首次系统性地将逆向设计在磁子学中的应用按“设计变量”和“算法工具箱”两个维度进行组织，并前瞻性地提出了未来开放前沿（如鲁棒性设计、输入整形与换能器优化、非线性自旋波作为设计资源、自适应介质等），以及“AI磁子学”这一整合性概念。
papers.method_zh: 综述了逆向设计的方法工具箱，包括：无梯度方法、基于梯度的方法、基于神经网络的方法，以及可微分微磁学求解器（differentiable micromagnetic solvers）。摘要未提及具体实验或计算手段。

papers.title: Thermodynamic description of worldwide distribution of energy and carbon emission
papers.abstract: Based on public data, we analyze the distributions of energy and carbon emission over world countries on a scale of the last 40-50 years using their presentation via Lorenz and Pareto curves. These curves in rescaled format remain remarkably stable on this time period being characterized by high values of the Gini coefficient indicating a strong inequality of energy distribution. To explain these distributions, we introduce the ENergy Thermalization Hypothesis (ENTH) according to which these distributions result from the Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation of agents representing different countries. We show that this hypothesis provides an excellent description of Lorenz and Pareto curves obtained from data on the above time period. It also gives natural grounds for inequality relating it to the RJ condensation at low energy states. We additionally trace parallels with the wealth inequality in the world.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：ENergy Thermalization Hypothesis (ENTH)、Rayleigh-Jeans thermalization、理论模型描述。；研究对象：全球各国能源消耗与碳排放的分布规律，以及其与统计物理中热化过程的类比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全球能源与碳排放分布可用瑞利-金斯热化与凝聚过程精确描述，该机制自然解释了分布的高度不平等性（高基尼系数），并与财富不平等现象存在平行关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全球能源与碳排放分布可用瑞利-金斯热化与凝聚过程精确描述，该机制自然解释了分布的高度不平等性（高基尼系数），并与财富不平等现象存在平行关系。；创新点：将统计物理中的瑞利-金斯热化与凝聚机制引入社会经济系统，为全球能源与碳排放分布的不平等性提供了基于物理原理的定量解释，并建立了与财富不平等之间的理论联系。
papers.method_zh: 基于公开数据，利用洛伦兹曲线和帕累托曲线对过去40-50年全球各国能源与碳排放分布进行重标度分析；提出“能量热化假说”（ENTH），将各国视为“代理粒子”，用瑞利-金斯分布描述其能量态的热化与凝聚。

papers.title: Pressure-induced PT Symmetry Breaking in LaMnSi
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetotransport properties of the antiferromagnetic metal LaMnSi, in which the collinear magnetic order breaks both spatial inversion (P) and time-reversal (T) symmetry yet preserves their combined PT symmetry. High pressure is found to suppress this PT-symmetric antiferromagnetic phase, inducing a transition into a PT-broken state characterized by a large anomalous Hall effect. Based on symmetry analysis, we propose a candidate magnetic structure for the high-pressure phase. Subsequent band calculations for this structure reveal the emergence of band splitting and orbital-dependent spin polarization. Our results establish LaMnSi as an ideal platform for controlling PT symmetry breaking via external parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算分析）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“investigate the magnetotransport properties”（磁输运性质测量）、“High pressure is found to suppress”（高压实验发现），同时包含“band calculations”（能带计算）作为辅助手段。；研究对象：反铁磁金属LaMnSi，具体关注其共线磁有序破坏空间反演（P）和时间反演（T）对称性但保持联合PT对称性的相，以及高压诱导的PT对称性破缺相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高压可抑制LaMnSi的PT对称反铁磁相，诱导进入一个具有大反常霍尔效应的PT破缺态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高压可抑制LaMnSi的PT对称反铁磁相，诱导进入一个具有大反常霍尔效应的PT破缺态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高压下的磁输运性质测量；理论上基于对称性分析提出高压相候选磁结构，并进行能带计算以揭示能带劈裂和轨道依赖的自旋极化。

papers.title: Magnetocaloric properties of centered molecular quantum spin systems
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetocaloric properties of a class of centered magnetic molecules that are very similar in their magnetic properties. In particular, we study the magnetocaloric response of these molecules in the space of two exchange parameters and as function of the spin quantum numbers. Major figures of merit such as adiabatic temperature change and isothermal entropy change as well as theoretically achievable low temperatures show that overall ferromagnetic interactions are preferential as long as this does not lead to dipolar ordering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、study、theoretically achievable。；研究对象：一类中心型分子量子自旋系统（centered molecular quantum spin systems），具体为磁性性质非常相似的磁性分子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交换参数空间和自旋量子数变化下，只要不导致偶极有序，总体上的铁磁相互作用对磁热效应更有利，表现为更大的绝热温度变化、等温熵变以及理论上可达到的更低温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交换参数空间和自旋量子数变化下，只要不导致偶极有序，总体上的铁磁相互作用对磁热效应更有利，表现为更大的绝热温度变化、等温熵变以及理论上可达到的更低温度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，通过两个交换参数（exchange parameters）和自旋量子数（spin quantum numbers）的空间扫描，计算绝热温度变化、等温熵变等磁热性能指标。

papers.title: Electrical manipulation and detection of perpendicular altermagnetic order via proximitized Dirac semimetal
papers.abstract: Altermagnets, which combine antiferromagnetic-like magnetic compensation with ferromagnetic-like broken time-reversal symmetry, hold great promise for high-density and ultrafast spintronic applications. However, the detection and switching of perpendicular altermagnetic order are fundamentally constrained by magnetic symmetry, restricting both fundamental studies and practical implementation. We realize robust electrical reading and deterministic switching of perpendicular altermagnetic order by designing a Dirac semimetal/altermagnet heterostructure of PtTe2/CrSb. This engineered interface enables anomalous Hall readout via altermagnetic proximity effect and delivers efficient spin-orbit torque for manipulating the epitaxial perpendicular Neel vector in CrSb. These findings significantly broaden the functional scope of altermagnetic heterostructures and pave the way for highly scalable altermagnetic memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：realize、designing、enables、delivers。；研究对象：Dirac半金属/交变磁体异质结（PtTe₂/CrSb），具体研究垂直交变磁序的电学操控与探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计PtTe₂/CrSb异质结，实现了对CrSb中垂直交变磁序（Néel矢量）的鲁棒电学读取和确定性翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计PtTe₂/CrSb异质结，实现了对CrSb中垂直交变磁序（Néel矢量）的鲁棒电学读取和确定性翻转。；创新点：首次在垂直交变磁序体系中实现电学读取与确定性翻转，突破了磁对称性对垂直交变磁序探测与操控的根本限制，拓展了交变磁异质结的功能范围。
papers.method_zh: 利用交变磁邻近效应实现反常霍尔读出，并通过自旋轨道矩（spin-orbit torque）对CrSb外延垂直Néel矢量进行电学操控。具体异质结材料为PtTe₂（Dirac半金属）与CrSb（交变磁体）。

papers.title: A Topotactic Phase Transition in the Uranium Oxide System
papers.abstract: A topotactic phase transition involves the transformation of one crystalline solid to another, which may include the loss or gain of material, where the orientation of the parent crystal determines the orientation of the daughter. We set out an experimental approach, based on polyepitaxial thin film deposition, where the precise transformation mechanism in important physico-chemical processes can be revealed in brilliant detail. Here, we find a reversible topotactic transition from (001) cubic UO2 to a (130) orthorhombic U3O8 structure; a >35% expansion/contraction. This remarkable result solves a puzzle that has eluded researchers for decades, and presents a method for determining the mechanism of crystallographic transformation in many other compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：polyepitaxial thin film deposition（多晶外延薄膜沉积）、experimental approach。；研究对象：铀氧化物体系中的拓扑相变，具体涉及从立方相UO₂到正交相U₃O₈的结构转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种可逆的拓扑相变：从(001)取向的立方UO₂转变为(130)取向的正交U₃O₈结构，伴随超过35%的体积膨胀/收缩，解决了困扰研究者数十年的晶体学转变机制之谜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种可逆的拓扑相变：从(001)取向的立方UO₂转变为(130)取向的正交U₃O₈结构，伴随超过35%的体积膨胀/收缩，解决了困扰研究者数十年的晶体学转变机制之谜。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于多晶外延薄膜沉积的实验方法，通过精确控制薄膜取向来揭示相变机制。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization of Genetic Algorithm Hyperparameters in a Multi-Fidelity Framework for Efficient Lattice Material Design
papers.abstract: This study presents a multi-fidelity framework for the systematic optimization of genetic algorithm (GA) hyperparameters. The framework integrates three fidelity levels: high-fidelity Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) homogenization for validation, a medium-fidelity 3D convolutional neural network surrogate for rapid property evaluation, and a low-fidelity Gaussian process (GP) surrogate within a Bayesian optimization (BO) framework to guide the hyperparameter search. Various acquisition functions are evaluated, with logNEI achieving the best performance by effectively accounting for the noise inherent in GA evaluations. The proposed framework identifies hyperparameter configurations that enable a 25-generation GA run to achieve elastic modulus values comparable to those obtained in a full 75-generation optimization. Furthermore, introducing a penalized BO objective significantly reduces the number of required lattices with only minor decreases in absolute achieved elastic modulus, revealing a practical trade-off between performance and the number of structures that must be evaluated. High-fidelity FFT validation verifies the effectiveness of the surrogate-driven optimization strategy. The optimized hyperparameters allow for rapid convergence, eliminate the need for lattice mutation, and reduce the overall computational cost by 24% (from 225 to 171 hours) while preserving mechanical performance. These results demonstrate the potential of multi-fidelity optimization as an efficient and practical approach for GA hyperparameter tuning and future experimental lattice design studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：多保真度框架、遗传算法超参数优化、贝叶斯优化、FFT均匀化、卷积神经网络代理模型。；研究对象：晶格材料（lattice material）的设计与优化，具体涉及通过遗传算法和代理模型加速其力学性能（弹性模量）的优化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多保真度框架优化遗传算法超参数，可使仅运行25代的遗传算法达到原本75代优化才能获得的弹性模量值，同时将计算成本降低24%（从225小时降至171小时）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多保真度框架优化遗传算法超参数，可使仅运行25代的遗传算法达到原本75代优化才能获得的弹性模量值，同时将计算成本降低24%（从225小时降至171小时）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三保真度框架：高保真度使用快速傅里叶变换（FFT）均匀化方法进行验证；中保真度使用3D卷积神经网络（3D CNN）作为代理模型快速评估性能；低保真度使用高斯过程（GP）代理模型结合贝叶斯优化（BO）指导超参数搜索。其中采用logNEI采集函数处理遗传算法评估中的噪声，并引入惩罚项平衡性能与结构数量。

papers.title: Improving feature resolution and pore back effect in focused ion beam tomography of porous GaN thin films
papers.abstract: Porous gallium nitride (GaN) is a mesoporous crystalline material, typically in the form of a thin film on an unlike substrate, prepared by electrochemically etching conductive GaN. The use of porous GaN in electronics and optoelectronics is rapidly expanding, but is held back significantly by a lack of structural control and understanding of the principles of pore formation from underlying electrochemical mechanisms, where high-quality characterisation of pore morphology is essential to understanding these principles. Focused ion beam (FIB) tomography is an invaluable tool for such characterisation, but is hindered greatly by the pore back effect, where unwanted contrast appears in an image due to electrons scattering out from the back wall of a pore. No major attempts to formally quantify or assess the extent of the effect for different tomography experiments has been demonstrated. In this work, we demonstrate an advanced methodology for performing FIB tomography on porous GaN thin films, where the experiment is rotated to image pores perpendicular to the surface of the sample, and introduce new voxel intensity-based formalisms for assessing the impact of the pore back effect based on voxel intensities for individual features and the whole dataset. The new approach, which requires more complex preliminary setup, is found to significantly mitigate the pore back effect in porous GaN thin films with a range of pore morphologies without increasing the total experimental duration. The pore back effect can thus be quantified and mitigated in FIB tomography of porous GaN and similar mesoporous thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：FIB tomography、electrochemical etching、voxel intensity-based formalisms。；研究对象：多孔氮化镓（porous GaN）薄膜，一种介孔晶体薄膜材料，通过电化学刻蚀导电GaN制备。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将FIB断层扫描实验旋转至垂直于样品表面成像，并引入基于体素强度的新形式化方法，可显著减轻多孔GaN薄膜中的“孔隙背效应”（pore back effect），且不增加总实验时长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将FIB断层扫描实验旋转至垂直于样品表面成像，并引入基于体素强度的新形式化方法，可显著减轻多孔GaN薄膜中的“孔隙背效应”（pore back effect），且不增加总实验时长。；创新点：首次提出正式量化并评估不同断层扫描实验中孔隙背效应影响的方法，并展示了一种通过旋转实验几何来减轻该效应的先进实验方案。
papers.method_zh: 聚焦离子束（FIB）断层扫描技术；旋转实验几何以垂直于样品表面成像；基于体素强度（voxel intensity）的新形式化方法，用于评估单个特征及整个数据集的孔隙背效应影响。

papers.title: Critical SO(5) scaling of entanglement entropy at honeycomb lattice deconfined criticality
papers.abstract: The deconfined quantum critical point (DQCP) in square lattice S=1/2 quantum antiferromagnets has been extensively studied with a large body of evidence pointing to a weakly first-order transition scenario. Recent studies, which focused on entanglement at this nearly continuous DQCP in square lattice J-Q models, have observed conflicting bipartite entanglement entropy (EE) scaling behavior. One bipartition choice gave scaling coefficients in remarkable agreement with predictions from the unitary CFT corresponding to the putative DQCP. While another equally natural choice gave scaling coefficients in complete violation of unitary CFT that may be attributed to lack of scale invariance at the known weakly first-order behavior of the model. This motivates the exploration of DQCP behavior via entanglement measures in lattice models with distinct crystalline symmetries. Here we study a S=1/2 honeycomb model that hosts a nearly continuous transition between Néel and valence-bond-solid ground states relevant to probing DQCP. Using large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we compute the Rényi EE for a variety of bipartitions and test the CFT based description of the DQCP on the honeycomb lattice. For smooth bipartitions, we find no evidence of logarithmic corrections, in accordance with CFT, thereby essentially ruling out contributions from Goldstone modes. For subsystems with corners, CFT predicts universal logarithmic contributions, which we extract for corners with 60 and 120 degree angles and find close agreement with an emergent SO(5) CFT. While we observe scaling consistent with a critical system in the majority of cases, we also demonstrate an intriguing counterexample of the hexagon subsystem that exhibits a subtle period three oscillation. This results in three separate finite-size series, where the sign of the logarithmic term apparently changes depending on the series.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo simulations、Rényi entanglement entropy、CFT scaling。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格上S=1/2量子反铁磁体中的去禁闭量子临界点（DQCP），具体为Néel序与价键固体（VBS）基态之间的近连续相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于光滑边界划分，未发现对数修正，符合共形场论（CFT）预期，排除了Goldstone模贡献；对于含角子系统，提取的60°和120°角对数修正与涌现的SO(5) CFT预测吻合。但六边形子系统表现出微妙的三周期振荡，导致对数项符号随有限尺寸序列变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于光滑边界划分，未发现对数修正，符合共形场论（CFT）预期，排除了Goldstone模贡献；对于含角子系统，提取的60°和120°角对数修正与涌现的SO(5) CFT预测吻合。但六边形子系统表现出微妙的三周期振荡，导致对数项符号随有限尺寸序列变化。；创新点：首次在蜂窝晶格DQCP模型中系统研究纠缠熵标度行为，发现与正方晶格J-Q模型不同的标度特征（如六边形子系统的周期三振荡），并验证了SO(5) CFT对含角子系统的普适性预测。
papers.method_zh: 大规模量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）模拟，计算不同边界划分下的Rényi纠缠熵，并基于CFT标度理论分析对数修正项。

papers.title: Understanding surface potential dynamics of passivated perovskites via Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
papers.abstract: Molecular passivation has become central to reducing photovoltage losses in metal-halide perovskite solar cells, but its electronic action is still often inferred from device-level metrics rather than directly resolved at the nanoscale. Here, we use amplitude-modulated Kelvin probe force microscopy to examine how [3-(2-aminoethylamino)propyl]trimethoxysilane (AEAPTMS) modifies the surface potential and photovoltage dynamics of mixed-cation, mixed-halide perovskite thin films. AEAPTMS homogenises the dark contact potential difference (CPD), narrowing its distribution from ~45.7 to ~14.6 mV without obvious morphological changes. Under illumination, passivated films show a larger steady-state surface photovoltage (SPV) and faster stabilisation, with the SPV increasing from ~345 to ~417 mV and the stabilisation time constant decreasing from ~840 to ~470 s. Wavelength-dependent SPV further indicates reduced sub-bandgap electronic disorder. By separating grain-boundary and grain-interior contributions, we show that AEAPTMS suppresses grain-boundary potential barriers, linking amino-silane passivation to a more homogeneous and stable carrier landscape.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用振幅调制开尔文探针力显微镜（amplitude-modulated Kelvin probe force microscopy）进行直接测量，并分析表面电势和光电压动力学数据。；研究对象：混合阳离子、混合卤化物钙钛矿薄膜（mixed-cation, mixed-halide perovskite thin films），以及其经[3-(2-氨基乙基氨基)丙基]三甲氧基硅烷（AEAPTMS）分子钝化后的表面电势与光电压动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AEAPTMS钝化使钙钛矿薄膜的暗态接触电势差（CPD）分布从~45.7 mV收窄至~14.6 mV，同时稳态表面光电压（SPV）从~345 mV提升至~417 mV，稳定时间常数从~840 s缩短至~470 s，表明钝化抑制了晶界势垒，实现了更均匀、稳定的载流子分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AEAPTMS钝化使钙钛矿薄膜的暗态接触电势差（CPD）分布从~45.7 mV收窄至~14.6 mV，同时稳态表面光电压（SPV）从~345 mV提升至~417 mV，稳定时间常数从~840 s缩短至~470 s，表明钝化抑制了晶界势垒，实现了更均匀、稳定的载流子分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 振幅调制开尔文探针力显微镜（AM-KPFM），用于测量暗态接触电势差（CPD）、稳态表面光电压（SPV）及其动力学时间常数，并结合波长依赖的SPV分析亚带隙电子无序度，以及分离晶界与晶粒内部贡献。

papers.title: Terahertz Phase Inversion via Field-Free Spin-Orbit Torque Switching in an Antenna-Integrated Spintronic Heterostructure
papers.abstract: We demonstrate microsecond-timescale electrical control of the terahertz (THz) emission phase in broadband field-free spintronic THz emitters, enabling megahertz-rate phase inversion while overcoming the kilohertz limitations of conventional mechanical and field-driven approaches. Our device integrates an H-dipole antenna with a spintronic heterostructure exhibiting uniaxial magnetic anisotropy, enabling deterministic spin-orbit torque induced in-plane magnetization switching without external magnetic fields. The corresponding THz phase inversion is directly observed in the time domain signal, by applying $1\,μ\mathrm{s}$ electrical pulses on the bias striplines of the H-dipole. This field-free operation reduces system complexity while significantly extending modulation bandwidth. Our results establish electrically programmable spintronic THz emitters that could be used to develop a compact and scalable platform for integrated on-chip THz devices and ultrafast applications, including phase-sensitive spectroscopy and near-field imaging, where high-speed and precise control of THz waveforms is essential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“demonstrate”（展示）、“directly observed”（直接观测）、“applying electrical pulses”（施加电脉冲）等实验操作与观测行为。；研究对象：天线集成的自旋电子异质结构（antenna-integrated spintronic heterostructure），具体为具有单轴磁各向异性的薄膜体系，用于产生太赫兹辐射并实现相位控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过无外磁场的自旋轨道矩（SOT）实现微秒级电控磁化翻转，从而在宽带自旋太赫兹发射器中实现兆赫兹速率的太赫兹相位反转，克服了传统机械和场驱动方法千赫兹速率的限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过无外磁场的自旋轨道矩（SOT）实现微秒级电控磁化翻转，从而在宽带自旋太赫兹发射器中实现兆赫兹速率的太赫兹相位反转，克服了传统机械和场驱动方法千赫兹速率的限制。；创新点：实现了无外磁场（field-free）条件下的自旋轨道矩磁化翻转，并以此驱动太赫兹相位反转，大幅降低了系统复杂度并显著扩展了调制带宽，为片上集成太赫兹器件提供了紧凑、可扩展的电控方案。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：H-偶极天线与自旋电子异质结构集成；在偏置带状线上施加1微秒电脉冲；通过时域信号直接观测太赫兹相位反转。利用单轴磁各向异性实现无外磁场下的确定性面内磁化翻转。

papers.title: Nucleation and Enhancement of Superconductivity under Tip-Induced Strain Fields
papers.abstract: A metallic point contact formed on a non-superconducting or weakly superconducting material often nucleates or enhances superconductivity confined under the contact. However, no unified theoretical description of the phenomenon exists. We show that the spatially inhomogeneous, predominantly uniaxial nature of the stress field under a point contact is fundamental for such tip-induced and tip-enhanced superconductivity (TISC/TESC). We also show that the coupling of such a stress field to the electronic structure can be estimated through an experimentally measurable uniaxial coupling scale $C^{\mathrm{exp}}$. Combining Hertzian contact mechanics with a Ginzburg-Landau variational analysis, we derive a criterion for the nucleation of TISC/TESC and determine $C^{\mathrm{exp}}$ for twenty-one materials. For topological semimetals with ungapped band crossings, the framework explains observed critical temperatures with no free parameters and for all others, $C^{\mathrm{exp}}$ provides a direct experimental determination of the uniaxial strain sensitivity and a target scale for microscopic theories.The work predicts TISC in elemental Sb and Y with $T_c \approx 2.8$\,K and $T_c \approx 12$\,K respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretical description、Ginzburg-Landau variational analysis、Hertzian contact mechanics）；研究对象：针尖诱导/增强超导电性（TISC/TESC）现象，即在非超导或弱超导材料上形成金属点接触时，接触下方局域超导态的成核与增强。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 点接触下非均匀、以单轴为主的应力场是针尖诱导/增强超导电性的关键机制；通过可实验测量的单轴耦合标度 \(C^{\mathrm{exp}}\) 可估计该应力场与电子结构的耦合强度，并预言元素Sb和Y中分别存在 \(T_c \approx 2.8\,\mathrm{K}\) 和 \(T_c \approx 12\,\mathrm{K}\) 的针尖诱导超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：点接触下非均匀、以单轴为主的应力场是针尖诱导/增强超导电性的关键机制；通过可实验测量的单轴耦合标度 \(C^{\mathrm{exp}}\) 可估计该应力场与电子结构的耦合强度，并预言元素Sb和Y中分别存在 \(T_c \approx 2.8\,\mathrm{K}\) 和 \(T_c \approx 12\,\mathrm{K}\) 的针尖诱导超导电性。；创新点：首次为点接触下超导成核现象提供统一的理论描述，并引入可直接实验测量的单轴耦合标度 \(C^{\mathrm{exp}}\)，使理论预测无需自由参数即可解释拓扑半金属中的观测临界温度。
papers.method_zh: 结合赫兹接触力学与金兹堡-朗道变分分析，推导出TISC/TESC成核判据，并利用该框架对21种材料计算 \(C^{\mathrm{exp}}\)。

papers.title: Wall tension of a Bose-Einstein condensate: Effects of quantum fluctuations and finite-range interactions
papers.abstract: We investigate the effects of quantum fluctuations (QFs) and finite-range interatomic interactions on the ground state and wall tension of a Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) at zero temperature by means of modified Gross-Pitaevskii equations. The QFs are shown to stiffen the condensate near the hard wall, narrowing the density profile and raising the wall tension above its mean-field value by an amount proportional to square-root of the gas parameter. Finite-range corrections always reduces the wall tension relative to the QFs correction value regardless of the effective range. We find the ordering $γ_0 < γ_{\rm II} < γ_{\rm I}$ in the dilute regime and identify a crossover condition under which the two beyond-mean-field contributions mutually cancel. These results provide an experimentally accessible way for probing beyond-LHY physics through precision measurements of the wall tension in ultracold Bose gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：modified Gross-Pitaevskii equations、investigate、effects of quantum fluctuations and finite-range interactions。；研究对象：零温下玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的基态和壁张力（wall tension），特别关注量子涨落和有限程相互作用的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子涨落使凝聚体在硬壁附近变硬，密度分布变窄，壁张力高于平均场值，增加量与气体参数的平方根成正比；有限程修正总是降低壁张力，且在稀薄区域存在一个交叉条件，使两种超越平均场贡献相互抵消。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子涨落使凝聚体在硬壁附近变硬，密度分布变窄，壁张力高于平均场值，增加量与气体参数的平方根成正比；有限程修正总是降低壁张力，且在稀薄区域存在一个交叉条件，使两种超越平均场贡献相互抵消。；创新点：揭示了量子涨落与有限程相互作用对壁张力的竞争关系，并找到了两者相互抵消的交叉条件，为通过超冷玻色气体壁张力的精密测量探测超越Lee-Huang-Yang（LHY）物理提供了实验上可行的途径。
papers.method_zh: 通过修正的Gross-Pitaevskii方程（modified Gross-Pitaevskii equations）进行理论分析，分别考虑量子涨落和有限程相互作用对基态和壁张力的影响。

papers.title: Floquet-Weyl states at one-photon resonances in three-dimensional topological insulators
papers.abstract: Quantum materials exhibit exotic phases and electronic responses under irradiation by circularly polarized light, which breaks time-reversal symmetry and generates Floquet replica bands. Recently, Floquet topological states arising from direct resonances have attracted much attention, e.g., the emergence of Floquet-Weyl points at a one-photon resonance, rather than topological features within the modulated original bands via high-frequency expansion. In this study, we investigate the effects of a one-photon resonance in a representative three-dimensional topological insulator, Bi$_2$Se$_3$, applying Floquet theory under circularly polarized light. We find that four pairs of Floquet-Weyl points emerge in the intermediate-frequency regime, mediated by hybridization between the original and one-photon-resonant Floquet bands, preserving the threefold rotational symmetry of the crystalline structure. Our numerical calculations demonstrate that tuning the chemical potential via hole doping yields a large anomalous Hall conductivity, directly associated with these Floquet-Weyl points. This work provides a highly accessible route toward the experimental realization of one-photon-resonant Floquet-Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“应用Floquet理论”、“数值计算”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：三维拓扑绝缘体Bi₂Se₃在圆偏振光照射下的一光子共振效应，以及由此产生的Floquet-Weyl态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中间频率区域，Bi₂Se₃的原始能带与一光子共振Floquet复制带之间发生杂化，产生四对Floquet-Weyl点，且这些点保持晶体结构的三重旋转对称性。通过空穴掺杂调节化学势，可获得与这些Weyl点直接相关的大反常霍尔电导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中间频率区域，Bi₂Se₃的原始能带与一光子共振Floquet复制带之间发生杂化，产生四对Floquet-Weyl点，且这些点保持晶体结构的三重旋转对称性。通过空穴掺杂调节化学势，可获得与这些Weyl点直接相关的大反常霍尔电导。；创新点：区别于以往通过高频展开在调制原始能带中寻找拓扑特征，本工作直接研究一光子共振（而非高频近似）下Floquet-Weyl点的出现，并指出其可通过空穴掺杂实现可观测的大反常霍尔效应，为实验实现一光子共振Floquet-Weyl半金属提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用Floquet理论框架，对圆偏振光照射下的三维拓扑绝缘体Bi₂Se₃进行数值计算，分析一光子共振条件下的能带杂化与拓扑性质。

papers.title: Emergent superconductivity upon disordering a topological insulator
papers.abstract: We study the emergence of superconductivity in a quantum spin Hall insulator and identify a disorder-driven enhancement of pairing arising from quantum geometry. Using sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the attractive Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang (BHZ) Hubbard model, we obtain a quantum phase transition as a function of interaction strength for different impurity densities. In the clean limit, the system develops bulk superconductivity for Hubbard interaction $\vert U \vert$ above a finite critical strength. Interestingly, strong impurities significantly reduce such $\vert U \vert$ required for the onset of superconductivity. Our calculations indicate that Cooper pairing first nucleates in subgap ring states surrounding the impurities and then evolves into a globally coherent superconducting phase. Our results demonstrate that impurity-generated bound states can promote superconductivity in systems with strong quantum geometry. This mechanism is expected to be relevant in nearly flat-band systems like moiré materials where quantum geometry plays a dominant role.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations、quantum phase transition、calculations indicate）；研究对象：量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（具体为吸引型Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang Hubbard模型）中无序诱导的超导涌现现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强杂质能显著降低超导所需的临界Hubbard相互作用强度，超导配对首先在杂质周围的亚隙环态中成核，随后演变为全局相干超导相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强杂质能显著降低超导所需的临界Hubbard相互作用强度，超导配对首先在杂质周围的亚隙环态中成核，随后演变为全局相干超导相。；创新点：揭示了杂质生成的束缚态可在具有强量子几何的体系中促进超导性，并指出该机制在近平带系统（如莫尔材料）中具有普适性。
papers.method_zh: 采用无符号问题的量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究不同杂质密度下吸引型BHZ Hubbard模型的量子相变。

papers.title: Interplay of Umklapp scattering and Sb-Au hybridization in surface-reconstructed Sb/Au(111)
papers.abstract: Surface reconstructions induced by atomic adsorption can strongly reshape metallic surface states, providing a direct pathway to tune their electronic structure. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we investigate the electronic structure of Sb/Au(111) during the coverage-driven evolution from the clean Au(111) surface to the $(14\times14)$ and Rec$(3\times\sqrt{3})$ phases. In the Rec$(3\times\sqrt{3})$ phase, triangular Fermi pockets emerge at the Brillouin-zone boundary. Their momentum positions are consistent with a reciprocal-space folding construction, but their reduced size near the Fermi level indicates a modification of the Au-derived $sp$ dispersion. The substantial modifications of deeper Au $d$-derived bands observed in ARPES further indicate significant mixing between Sb $p$ orbitals and Au $d$ states. These results show that the electronic structure of Sb/Au(111) is governed by the interplay between reconstruction-induced Umklapp scattering and interfacial orbital hybridization, highlighting adsorbate-substrate hybridization as a key mechanism for tuning and engineering surface electronic structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用ARPES（角分辨光电子能谱）作为主要研究手段。；研究对象：Sb/Au(111)表面重构体系，具体研究从清洁Au(111)表面到(14×14)相和Rec(3×√3)相的覆盖度驱动演化过程中的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sb/Au(111)的电子结构由重构诱导的Umklapp散射与界面轨道杂化（Sb p轨道与Au d态混合）共同主导，其中吸附质-衬底杂化是调控表面电子结构的关键机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sb/Au(111)的电子结构由重构诱导的Umklapp散射与界面轨道杂化（Sb p轨道与Au d态混合）共同主导，其中吸附质-衬底杂化是调控表面电子结构的关键机制。；创新点：揭示了表面重构中Umklapp散射与界面轨道杂化两种机制的协同作用，并指出吸附质-衬底杂化是工程化表面电子结构的关键机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES），结合覆盖度依赖的样品制备（分子束外延或类似方法，摘要未明确说明具体生长手段）。

papers.title: Density-Induced Reentrant Coarsening in a Two-Temperature System
papers.abstract: Understanding how nonequilibrium driving modifies phase-separation kinetics remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that phase separation in a two-temperature system exhibits a striking density-induced reentrant coarsening behavior. Using Brownian dynamics simulations and a coarse-grained field-theoretic model, we find that the characteristic domain size grows as $L(t)\sim t^{1/z}$, displaying a reentrant sequence $(t^{1/3} \rightarrow t^{1/4}\rightarrow t^{1/3})$ with increasing density. While the low- and high-density regimes are governed by classical curvature-driven bulk diffusion, the intermediate-density regime exhibits anomalously slow growth. We show that this slowdown originates from a transport bottleneck arising from the interplay of particle diffusivity, particle availability, and attachment kinetics, which suppresses the effective mass flux between domains. Unlike equilibrium phase separation, where density primarily affects morphology and crossover scales, the two-temperature drive renders density a key control parameter for coarsening pathways. Our results uncover a nonequilibrium mechanism for anomalous domain growth in two-temperature systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：Brownian dynamics simulations、coarse-grained field-theoretic model。；研究对象：双温度系统中的相分离动力学，特别是密度诱导的再进入粗化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双温度系统中，相分离的畴尺寸生长呈现密度依赖的再进入序列：随密度增加，生长指数从1/3变为1/4再回到1/3。中间密度区的异常慢生长源于粒子扩散率、粒子可用性与附着动力学之间的相互作用导致的输运瓶颈。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双温度系统中，相分离的畴尺寸生长呈现密度依赖的再进入序列：随密度增加，生长指数从1/3变为1/4再回到1/3。中间密度区的异常慢生长源于粒子扩散率、粒子可用性与附着动力学之间的相互作用导致的输运瓶颈。；创新点：揭示了在双温度非平衡驱动下，密度成为控制粗化路径的关键参数，这与平衡相分离中密度主要影响形貌和交叉尺度不同，发现了一种新的非平衡异常畴生长机制。
papers.method_zh: 布朗动力学模拟和粗粒化场论模型。

papers.title: Unveiling Nanoscale Surface Damage Dynamics in Swift Heavy Ion Irradiated Gallium Nitride
papers.abstract: This work systematically unveils the nanoscale surface damage dynamics in gallium nitride by investigating the atomistic mechanisms of hillock formation. The results identify two distinct hillock morphologies dependent on electronic energy loss (Se) values. Bell-shaped hillocks form under 18.2 keV/nm Kr irradiation, whereas crater-rim hillocks with central holes emerge under 40.2 keV/nm Ta irradiation. Microstructural analysis reveals that Ga-rich hillocks are accompanied by the generation of metastable zincblende nanodomains. These nanodomains preferentially aggregate around the periphery or sidewalls of the hillocks and exhibit a high spatial correlation with screw dislocations. Further temperature-dependent studies indicate that elevated temperatures significantly enlarge the overall dimensions of the hillock structures without altering their fundamental morphologies. Notably, under Ta irradiation above 1200 K, the high temperatures drastically reduce the viscosity and surface tension of liquid gallium. This enhanced fluidity of the transient molten phase promotes the formation of penetrating nanochannels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“microstructural analysis”“temperature-dependent studies”等实验手段，以及具体辐照实验（Kr、Ta离子辐照）。；研究对象：氮化镓（GaN）在快重离子辐照下的纳米尺度表面损伤动力学，特别是hillock（小丘）结构的形成机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了两种依赖于电子能量损失（Se）值的不同hillock形貌：低Se（18.2 keV/nm Kr辐照）下形成钟形hillock，高Se（40.2 keV/nm Ta辐照）下形成带有中心孔的环形hillock。高温（>1200 K）下液态镓的流动性增强促进了穿透性纳米通道的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了两种依赖于电子能量损失（Se）值的不同hillock形貌：低Se（18.2 keV/nm Kr辐照）下形成钟形hillock，高Se（40.2 keV/nm Ta辐照）下形成带有中心孔的环形hillock。高温（>1200 K）下液态镓的流动性增强促进了穿透性纳米通道的形成。；创新点：首次系统揭示了GaN中hillock形貌随电子能量损失的依赖关系，并发现hillock中富镓区域伴随亚稳态闪锌矿纳米域生成，且这些纳米域与螺位错高度空间相关。高温下液态镓的流动性对纳米通道形成的促进作用也是新发现。
papers.method_zh: 采用快重离子辐照实验（Kr和Ta离子），结合微观结构分析（可能包括透射电子显微镜等，摘要未明确具体手段）以及变温实验（温度依赖性研究）。

papers.title: Ethaline deep eutectic solvent under nanoconfinement: Unveiling structural and dynamical changes
papers.abstract: Hybrid nanomaterials incorporating deep eutectic solvents (DES) in porous hosts or at solid interfaces are gaining increasing attention for their potential interest across a wide range of applications. Under these conditions, the performances of DESs may be influenced by interfacial effects and spatial restrictions. In this study, we examined the effects of nanoconfinement on both the structure and molecular dynamics of the prototypical DES ethaline (a mixture of choline chloride and ethylene glycol) when confined within the cylindrical mesopores of SBA-15 (Dp $\approx$ 8.1 nm) and MCM-41 (Dp $\approx$ 3.5 nm) silicas, using neutron diffraction and quasielastic neutron scattering. It demonstrates that ethaline remains structurally homogeneous under confinement, showing no evidence of core-shell segregation within the pore cross-section. The molecular dynamics of the confined ethaline preserve the key characteristics observed in its bulk state. Translational diffusion follows a jump-diffusion mechanism, with diffusion coefficients that remain remarkably close to the bulk values, showing only a modest reduction in MCM-41. A more pronounced increase in the residence time t0 between translational molecular jumps is observed. It corresponds to roughly a factor of 3-8 under confinement in SBA-15, and reaches up to a tenfold enhancement in MCM-41 relative to bulk. Similarly, the characteristic relaxation time, tL, associated with the localized in-cage motion of ethaline, increases by approximately 20% in SBA-15 and up to 50% in MCM-41. However, the molecular trajectories, modeled from the elastic incoherent structure factor, remain largely preserved under confinement, showing only a marginal reduction in intra-basin motional amplitudes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了中子衍射和准弹性中子散射实验手段。；研究对象：低共熔溶剂（DES）Ethaline（氯化胆碱与乙二醇的混合物）在纳米限域下的结构与分子动力学，具体限域介质为SBA-15（孔径约8.1 nm）和MCM-41（孔径约3.5 nm）介孔二氧化硅。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ethaline在纳米限域下保持结构均匀性，未出现核-壳分离；其分子动力学保留体相的关键特征，但分子跳跃的停留时间和局域笼内运动的弛豫时间显著增加，且孔径越小增强效应越明显。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ethaline在纳米限域下保持结构均匀性，未出现核-壳分离；其分子动力学保留体相的关键特征，但分子跳跃的停留时间和局域笼内运动的弛豫时间显著增加，且孔径越小增强效应越明显。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 中子衍射（Neutron diffraction）和准弹性中子散射（Quasielastic neutron scattering, QENS），并结合弹性非相干结构因子（EISF）建模分析分子轨迹。

papers.title: Phonon scattering mechanisms in WTe$_2$ observed by ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Revealing the mechanisms of phonon scattering is crucial for understanding material properties such as transport characteristics and optical responses. It can be discussed by measuring the temperature dependence of the phonon energy and lifetime. To gain insight into these mechanisms in Weyl semimetal T$_d$-WTe$_2$, we investigated coherent phonons using time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy in a wide temperature range from 4.6 to 300 K. The temperature dependence of the frequency and decay rate of the two high-frequency optical modes was described by the conventional anharmonic phonon-phonon scattering model. In contrast, the low-frequency mode at 2.4 THz exhibited anomalous behavior, which can be interpreted as the contribution of phonon-electron scattering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy”（时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱）作为主要实验手段。；研究对象：Weyl半金属T_d相WTe₂中的声子散射机制，特别是不同频率光学模的声子能量和寿命随温度的变化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高频光学模的频移和衰减率随温度变化符合常规的非谐声子-声子散射模型，而2.4 THz的低频模表现出反常行为，可归因于声子-电子散射的贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高频光学模的频移和衰减率随温度变化符合常规的非谐声子-声子散射模型，而2.4 THz的低频模表现出反常行为，可归因于声子-电子散射的贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用超快相干声子光谱学（ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy），具体为时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱，在4.6 K至300 K的宽温区内测量相干声子的频率和衰减率随温度的变化。

papers.title: A modified Moss rule highlights underexplored classes of high refractive index materials
papers.abstract: High refractive index dielectrics are central to photonic applications, yet the empirical Moss rule imposes a fundamental trade-off between refractive index and optical transparency. We introduce a modified Moss rule anchored to the optical absorption edge rather than the fundamental bandgap, capturing materials where various physical mechanisms suppress absorption well above the electronic gap. Screening the Materials Project database with this metric reveals recurring chemical compositions and structural prototypes in the materials with the most promising refractive index/transparency trade-offs. These materials include chalcopyrites, Zintl pnictides, and early transition metal multi-anion chalconitrides and oxychalcogenides compounds. Hybrid density functional theory calculations reveal that the chalconitride (Hf,Zr)2(S,Se)N2 family can achieve a combination of ultra-high refractive indices, low effective masses and transparency windows extending deep into the UV, surpassing state-of-the-art TiO2 and SiC. Our results establish (Hf,Zr)2(S,Se)N2 compounds as a unique and largely unexplored material family for next-generation photonic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：screening the Materials Project database、hybrid density functional theory calculations）；研究对象：高折射率介电材料，特别是(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂化合物家族，以及chalcopyrites、Zintl pnictides、早期过渡金属多阴离子chalconitrides和oxychalcogenides等材料类别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种修正的Moss规则，该规则以光学吸收边而非基本带隙为锚点，从而识别出折射率与透明度权衡更优的材料。其中(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂家族可实现超高折射率、低有效质量以及深紫外透明窗口，性能超越TiO₂和SiC。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种修正的Moss规则，该规则以光学吸收边而非基本带隙为锚点，从而识别出折射率与透明度权衡更优的材料。其中(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂家族可实现超高折射率、低有效质量以及深紫外透明窗口，性能超越TiO₂和SiC。；创新点：修正了传统Moss规则，使其适用于吸收机制高于电子带隙的材料，从而发现了一类此前未被充分探索的高折射率材料家族（(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂）。
papers.method_zh: 基于Materials Project数据库进行高通量筛选，采用修正的Moss规则作为筛选指标，并使用杂化密度泛函理论（hybrid DFT）进行电子结构和光学性质计算。

papers.title: Ab initio thermodynamic statistical modeling of the miscibility gap and the metal-insulator phase transition in SrTi$_{1-x}$V$_x$O$_{3}$
papers.abstract: The substitutional alloy SrTi$_{1-x}$V$_x$O$_3$ interpolates between the band insulator SrTiO$_3$ and the correlated metal SrVO$_3$, exhibiting a composition-driven metal--insulator transition whose origin combines Mott physics with local chemical disorder. Previous first-principles studies relied on individual supercells, which cannot capture the thermally disordered solid solution, since configurations of identical composition can display very different electronic properties. Here we treat the alloy within a generalized quasi-chemical approximation, a thermodynamically consistent statistical framework in which every property is obtained as an ensemble average over all symmetry-inequivalent clusters, weighted by occurrence probabilities that minimize the Gibbs mixing free energy. This provides a well-defined procedure to average over different supercells, and places the structural and electronic descriptions on an equal footing. From the mixing thermodynamics we obtain a miscibility gap with a critical temperature of 1443 K, consistent with experimental evidence. Combining the cluster ensemble with dynamical mean-field theory, we track the density of states at the Fermi level across the full composition range: whereas density-functional theory alone predicts a metal for all $x>0$, the correlated spectral function reproduces the transition, evolving from insulating below $x\approx0.3$ to metallic near $x=1$. Finally, classifying clusters as metallic or insulating and performing site percolation on a simple cubic lattice yields a sharp onset of system-spanning conduction near $x\approx0.4$. These results establish a thermodynamically consistent, configuration--averaged framework applicable to the broader class of correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：generalized quasi-chemical approximation, dynamical mean-field theory, 统计框架）；研究对象：SrTi₁₋ₓVₓO₃ 替代合金中的混溶隙（miscibility gap）和组分驱动的金属-绝缘体相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该合金在约 x≈0.3 以下为绝缘体，接近 x=1 时变为金属；混溶隙的临界温度为 1443 K，与实验一致；基于团簇的渗流分析表明，在 x≈0.4 附近出现系统范围的导电通路。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该合金在约 x≈0.3 以下为绝缘体，接近 x=1 时变为金属；混溶隙的临界温度为 1443 K，与实验一致；基于团簇的渗流分析表明，在 x≈0.4 附近出现系统范围的导电通路。；创新点：提出了一个热力学自洽的构型平均框架，将结构描述与电子描述置于同等地位，克服了以往基于单个超胞方法无法捕捉热无序固溶体不同构型电子性质差异的局限。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义准化学近似（generalized quasi-chemical approximation）进行热力学统计建模，结合动力学平均场理论（DMFT）计算关联谱函数，并在简单立方格点上进行位点渗流（site percolation）分析。

papers.title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Gradients Unlock Topological Dimensional Reduction in Magnetic Hopfions
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional magnetic solitons retain topological protection only while their spin field remains continuous. Here we show that chemical inhomogeneity can break this protection in a controlled way, converting a hopfion-like toroidal texture into an effectively two-dimensional skyrmion string. Tilt-dependent Lorentz transmission electron microscopy, electron energy-loss spectroscopy, and micromagnetic simulations of pristine, uniformly Y-doped, and nonuniformly Y-doped disordered TiO2 nanoparticles embedded in a FeCrNiMn host reveal two regimes. Uniform Y doping enriches Ti3+/oxygen-vacancy localization centers and stabilizes closed rings with Hopf invariant QH approximately 1. Nonuniform Y doping forms a Ti4+-rich, vacancy-depleted boundary that creates a sharp q=D/(2A) gradient and a weak-moment leakage channel. This coupled mismatch torque and continuity leakage split the ring, leaving a skyrmion-string remnant and a field-sensitive helicity texture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“Lorentz transmission electron microscopy, electron energy-loss spectroscopy”（实验手段）和“micromagnetic simulations”（计算模拟）。；研究对象：嵌入FeCrNiMn基体中的无序TiO₂纳米颗粒，具体研究其中均匀与非均匀Y掺杂对磁孤子（hopfion-like环状拓扑结构）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非均匀Y掺杂会在TiO₂纳米颗粒边界形成尖锐的q=D/(2A)梯度，产生弱磁矩泄漏通道，从而将具有Hopf不变量QH≈1的闭合环拓扑结构降维为二维skyrmion弦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非均匀Y掺杂会在TiO₂纳米颗粒边界形成尖锐的q=D/(2A)梯度，产生弱磁矩泄漏通道，从而将具有Hopf不变量QH≈1的闭合环拓扑结构降维为二维skyrmion弦。；创新点：首次通过化学非均匀性（Y掺杂梯度）可控地打破三维磁孤子的拓扑保护，实现从三维hopfion到二维skyrmion弦的拓扑维度约化。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 倾斜依赖洛伦兹透射电子显微镜（tilt-dependent Lorentz TEM）、电子能量损失谱（EELS）、微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulations）。

papers.title: A low-energy effective Hamiltonian for Landau quasiparticles: II Application to the contact Fermi gas
papers.abstract: This article follows up on arxiv:2511.15938, in which we developed a new renormalization scheme to construct a quantized theory of Fermi liquids. Here, we apply this formalism to a low-temperature atomic Fermi gas where the short-range interactions are fully parametrized by the s-wave scattering length $a$. We benchmark our renormalized theory by recovering known perturbative results on the static properties of the Fermi gas, such as the Lee-Huang-Yang expansion of the equation of state, the Galitskii expansion of the momentum distribution, and the Gor'kov- Melik Barkhudarov preexponential correction to the critical temperature. We then turn to the transport dynamics and demonstrate the presence of a preexponential correction to the speed of zero sound when including corrections of second order in $a$. Finally, we develop an efficient numerical method to solve the transport equation exactly, and we apply to study the crossover from the collisionless to the hydrodynamic regime in the density and polarisation response functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a new renormalization scheme”、“construct a quantized theory”、“develop an efficient numerical method”，属于理论推导与数值方法开发。；研究对象：低温原子费米气体，其中短程相互作用完全由s波散射长度a参数化。具体研究其静态性质（状态方程、动量分布、临界温度）和输运动力学（零声速、密度与极化响应函数）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在包含二阶a修正时，零声速存在指前修正；开发了精确求解输运方程的数值方法，并用于研究从无碰撞区到流体动力学区的交叉行为。
