papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在包含二阶a修正时，零声速存在指前修正；开发了精确求解输运方程的数值方法，并用于研究从无碰撞区到流体动力学区的交叉行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用新发展的重整化方案（基于arXiv:2511.15938）构建费米液体量子理论，通过恢复已知微扰结果（Lee-Huang-Yang展开、Galitskii展开、Gor'kov-Melik Barkhudarov修正）进行基准测试，并开发精确求解输运方程的数值方法。

papers.title: Minimizing propagated density errors of atomic core-electron for simultaneously accurate bandgaps and lattice constants in closed-shell Copper semiconductors
papers.abstract: Density functional theory struggles to accurately determine electron density of atoms, whose error is inevitably encoded into the pseudopotential and propagated into solid-state calculations. However, little is known about how this affects accuracy nor how to remedy it. In this work, through a systematic study of the effect of Cu atomic density on bandgap and lattice constants of over 50 Cu-containing simple closed-shell semiconductors, we find that core-electron density can drastically affect nuclear attraction to valence electrons and subsequent charge distribution and energy position of Cu 3$d$ electrons. The error can be eliminated at its source by employing modified Hartree-Fock pseudopotentials for Cu core while retaining (semi-)local functionals for valence electrons. This real-space partitioning approach leads to simultaneous high-accuracy in bandgap and lattice constants across the entire material class.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、pseudopotential（赝势）、Hartree-Fock（哈特里-福克）。；研究对象：含铜的闭壳层半导体（Cu-containing simple closed-shell semiconductors），具体研究其晶格常数和带隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过修正Cu原子芯电子的哈特里-福克赝势，同时保留价电子的（半）局域泛函，可以在整个材料类别中同时实现高精度的带隙和晶格常数，从而从源头消除芯电子密度误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过修正Cu原子芯电子的哈特里-福克赝势，同时保留价电子的（半）局域泛函，可以在整个材料类别中同时实现高精度的带隙和晶格常数，从而从源头消除芯电子密度误差。；创新点：揭示了芯电子密度误差如何影响价电子核吸引及Cu 3d电子的电荷分布与能量位置，并提出通过实空间分区（芯电子用HF赝势、价电子用半局域泛函）从源头消除该误差的方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）系统研究Cu原子密度对超过50种含铜闭壳层半导体的带隙和晶格常数的影响；使用修正的哈特里-福克赝势处理Cu芯电子，对价电子保留（半）局域泛函，实现实空间分区处理。

papers.title: Size focusing in core-shell precipitates: A phase-field study
papers.abstract: Due to their enhanced resistance to coarsening and/or creep, aluminium alloys with precipitates of two distinct phases in a core-shell morphology are of great contemporary interest. In this paper, we focus on the curious observation in two recent studies on Al-Sc-Li and Al-Yb-Li alloys that growth of the shell phase leads to a narrowing of the size distribution. We have studied this phenomenon, known as size focusing, using a theoretical framework (which extends Zener's theory of diffusional growth to a core-shell precipitate) and multi-precipitate simulations based on a phase field model. Our results yield key theoretical insights as well as conclusions with practical significance. (a) On the theoretical front, we show clearly that size focusing is a growth phenomenon: it ends when shell growth ends, and coarsening begins. (b) On the practical front, our results offer guidelines for designing alloys with narrower size distributions: size focusing is promoted in alloys with greater shell volume fractions and greater inter-precipitate spacing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“phase-field study”（相场研究）、“theoretical framework”（理论框架）、“multi-precipitate simulations”（多析出相模拟）。；研究对象：铝合金中核壳结构析出相（core-shell precipitates）的尺寸聚焦（size focusing）现象，具体涉及Al-Sc-Li和Al-Yb-Li合金体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尺寸聚焦是一种生长现象，当壳层生长结束时聚焦即停止，随后进入粗化阶段；壳层体积分数越大、析出相间距越大，越有利于实现更窄的尺寸分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尺寸聚焦是一种生长现象，当壳层生长结束时聚焦即停止，随后进入粗化阶段；壳层体积分数越大、析出相间距越大，越有利于实现更窄的尺寸分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用扩展的Zener扩散生长理论（将Zener理论推广至核壳析出相）以及基于相场模型的多析出相模拟。

papers.title: Surface-Reconstruction-Driven Insulating Behavior in Metallic Charge-Density-Wave 1T-TaSe$_{2}$
papers.abstract: Bulk 1T-TaSe$_2$ is metallic, yet its surface consistently exhibits an insulating gap -- a dichotomy long attributed to a surface Mott insulator driven by enhanced electron correlations. Here, using density functional theory calculations, we show that this insulating surface instead originates from a charge-density-wave (CDW) stacking reconstruction. Whereas the bulk stabilizes a single-layer CDW stacking that supports metallic transport, the surface energetically favors a bilayer stacking, in which interlayer hybridization of Ta $5d_{z^2}$ orbitals opens a $\sim$0.4 eV gap -- a band insulator requiring no on-site Coulomb repulsion. This reconstruction is the thermodynamic ground state for slab thicknesses from two to eight layers, and the calculated surface density of states quantitatively reproduces scanning tunneling spectra for both insulating and metallic domains. Our results establish CDW surface reconstruction, rather than Mott physics, as the mechanism governing the surface electronic structure of 1T-TaSe$_2$ and provide a unified explanation for the experimentally observed coexistence of metallic and insulating domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“using density functional theory calculations”（使用密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：1T-TaSe₂ 的表面电子结构，具体研究其表面绝缘性起源与电荷密度波（CDW）堆叠重构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1T-TaSe₂ 表面的绝缘能隙并非源于传统认为的 Mott 绝缘体机制，而是由表面电荷密度波堆叠重构（从单层堆叠转变为双层堆叠）所导致的能带绝缘体，该重构在2至8层厚度的薄片中均为热力学基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1T-TaSe₂ 表面的绝缘能隙并非源于传统认为的 Mott 绝缘体机制，而是由表面电荷密度波堆叠重构（从单层堆叠转变为双层堆叠）所导致的能带绝缘体，该重构在2至8层厚度的薄片中均为热力学基态。；创新点：推翻了长期以来将1T-TaSe₂表面绝缘行为归因于增强电子关联驱动的表面Mott绝缘体的观点，首次提出并证明了CDW表面重构（而非Mott物理）是控制其表面电子结构的关键机制，并统一解释了实验中金属性与绝缘性畴区共存的现象。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于分析不同堆叠方式下的电子结构、能带间隙及表面态密度，并与扫描隧道谱（STS）实验数据进行定量对比。

papers.title: AI2Pot: A scalable and unified framework for machine-learning interatomic potential development and large-scale molecular dynamic simulations
papers.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) bridge the accuracy of first-principles calculations and the efficiency required for large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. However, existing MLIP software remains fragmented across different model architectures, making it difficult to establish unified workflows that support flexible model development, efficient training, and scalable MD deployment. Here, we present AI2Pot, a scalable and unified MLIP framework that seamlessly integrates model training, evaluation, and large-scale MD simulations with PyTorch-compatible ecosystem. Instead of relying on generic automatic differentiation for expensive atomistic operators, AI2Pot re-engineers the core computations of Moment tensor potential (MTP) and Neuroevolution potential (NEP) for both training and inference using hand-crafted C++/CUDA code. These specialized operators constitute a unified computational backend shared by training and inference, improving training-inference consistency and reducing memory usage by avoiding large intermediate caches. As a result, AI2Pot enables fast inference for large-scale atomic systems containing millions of atoms on a single GPU, while retaining the flexibility of PyTorch for model construction, training, and evaluation. Trained models can be deployed in ASE and LAMMPS for MD simulations. Furthermore, AI2Pot provides a companion command-line toolkit (AI2Pot-cli) and Python APIs to facilitate practical MLIP workflows. By unifying high-performance atomistic computing with modern machine-learning ecosystems, AI2Pot offers an user-friendly end-to-end framework for the developing, training, and deploying MLIPs for large scale MD.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、molecular dynamics simulations、framework、training、inference。；研究对象：论文研究的是机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的开发与大规模分子动力学（MD）模拟的统一框架，不针对特定材料或物理现象，而是面向通用原子模拟体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了AI2Pot框架，通过重新设计MTP和NEP算子的手写C++/CUDA核心计算，实现了在单个GPU上对包含数百万原子的大规模体系进行快速推理，同时保持与PyTorch生态兼容的灵活模型开发与训练能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了AI2Pot框架，通过重新设计MTP和NEP算子的手写C++/CUDA核心计算，实现了在单个GPU上对包含数百万原子的大规模体系进行快速推理，同时保持与PyTorch生态兼容的灵活模型开发与训练能力。；创新点：通过手写高性能算子替代通用的自动微分，解决了现有MLIP软件在不同模型架构间碎片化的问题，实现了训练-推理一致性，并显著降低内存占用，从而在保持PyTorch灵活性的同时支持超大规模原子体系的快速推理。
papers.method_zh: 采用手写C++/CUDA代码重新实现MTP（矩张量势）和NEP（神经进化势）的核心算子，构建统一的训练与推理计算后端；基于PyTorch进行模型构建、训练与评估；支持在ASE和LAMMPS中部署训练好的模型进行MD模拟；提供命令行工具（AI2Pot-cli）和Python API。

papers.title: Anomalous Hall and Nernst effects driven by static and fluctuating spin chiralities on Kagome lattice
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the anomalous Hall and Nernst effects (AHE and ANE) in a two dimensional Kagome lattice to uncover the distinct roles of static and fluctuating scalar spin chi ralities. Employing Monte Carlo simulations incorporating with a tight binding Hamiltonian via the s-d exchange interaction, we explicitly evaluate the anomalous transport coefficients. A key finding is the systematic disentanglement of the macroscopic responses into an intrinsic contribu tion, governed by momentum space Berry curvature induced by static chirality, and an extrinsic skew scattering contribution driven by real space dynamical spin fluctuations. We demonstrate a pronounced mechanistic crossover: deep in magnetically ordered phases like the skyrmion crystal, the intrinsic Berry curvature dictates the transport behavior. However, approaching the magnetic order-disorder critical regime, strong thermal fluctuations disrupt static noncoplanar spin configu rations, drastically suppressing intrinsic responses. Here, dynamical chiral fluctuations emerge as the dominant driving force. By delineating the phase regimes governed by static versus fluctuating chiralities, this work elucidates the distinct microscopic mechanisms dictating anomalous transport in frustrated magnetic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“Monte Carlo simulations”、“tight binding Hamiltonian”。；研究对象：二维Kagome晶格中的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE），特别是静态与涨落标量自旋手性对这两种输运现象的驱动作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统区分了两种贡献：由静态手性诱导的动量空间贝里曲率产生的内禀贡献，以及由实空间动态自旋涨落驱动的外禀斜散射贡献。在磁有序相（如斯格明子晶体）中，内禀贝里曲率主导输运；而在磁有序-无序临界区，热涨落抑制静态非共面自旋构型，动态手性涨落成为主导驱动力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统区分了两种贡献：由静态手性诱导的动量空间贝里曲率产生的内禀贡献，以及由实空间动态自旋涨落驱动的外禀斜散射贡献。在磁有序相（如斯格明子晶体）中，内禀贝里曲率主导输运；而在磁有序-无序临界区，热涨落抑制静态非共面自旋构型，动态手性涨落成为主导驱动力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟，结合通过s-d交换相互作用耦合的紧束缚哈密顿量，显式计算反常输运系数。

papers.title: Visualizing modified spin-wave wavefronts near magnetic defects and domains using nitrogen-vacancy centers
papers.abstract: Direct, real-space imaging of spin-wave propagation and wavefronts in magnetic materials is crucial for advancing both fundamental understanding of spin dynamics and the development of functional devices. This, however, remains a significant challenge, especially in materials with complex magnetic characteristics at the nanoscale. Here, we employ scanning nitrogen-vacancy center spectroscopy to achieve visualization of spin waves in two archetypical magnetic films: yttrium-iron-garnet and lanthanum strontium manganese oxide. We reveal a wavelength-dependent spin-wave filtering effect near point-like magnetic scatterers and a modified spin wavefront in antiferromagnetically coupled stripe domains. The spin-wave characteristics are explained using micromagnetic simulations and analytical calculations. These findings point to possible fine control of spin-wave propagation near complex magnetic structures and extend the scope of spin-wave imaging based on nitrogen-vacancy centers beyond uniform magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning nitrogen-vacancy center spectroscopy、visualization、micromagnetic simulations）；研究对象：两种典型磁性薄膜中的自旋波传播与波前：钇铁石榴石（yttrium-iron-garnet）和镧锶锰氧化物（lanthanum strontium manganese oxide），以及点状磁散射体和反铁磁耦合条状畴附近的波前畸变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在点状磁散射体附近观察到波长依赖的自旋波滤波效应，在反铁磁耦合条状畴中观察到自旋波前被修改。这些效应表明可通过复杂磁结构精细调控自旋波传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在点状磁散射体附近观察到波长依赖的自旋波滤波效应，在反铁磁耦合条状畴中观察到自旋波前被修改。这些效应表明可通过复杂磁结构精细调控自旋波传播。；创新点：将基于氮-空位中心的自旋波成像从均匀磁体扩展到具有复杂磁结构的体系，并揭示了非均匀磁环境（如缺陷和畴壁）对自旋波波前的具体影响。
papers.method_zh: 扫描氮-空位中心光谱学（scanning nitrogen-vacancy center spectroscopy）进行实空间成像，辅以微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations）和解析计算（analytical calculations）解释自旋波特性。

papers.title: Negative and Zero Linear Compressibility in MCN (M = Ag, Au, Cu): A First-Principles Study
papers.abstract: Negative linear compressibility (NLC) is the counterintuitive phenomenon in which a crystallographic axis expands under hydrostatic pressure. A related phenomenon, zero linear compressibility (ZLC), occurs when an axis shows no length change under pressure. Both responses are rare and arise in materials with highly anisotropic mechanical properties. Motivated by recent reports of anomalous behavior in metal cyanides - including negative thermal expansion and NLC - we use first-principles calculations to investigate the potential of the MCN family (M = Ag, Au, Cu) to exhibit ZLC or NLC. Our simulations reveal three main findings. First, we predict the existence of previously unreported phases: the P6mm phase for AgCN and CuCN, and the R3m phase for AuCN. Second, all six members of the MCN family studied exhibit extreme elastic anisotropy, which indeed leads to ZLC or NLC in each case. Third, we identify a mechanism for these responses distinct from previously reported ones. The mechanism arises from the unique "bamboo forest" geometry of the material: weakly interacting rigid rods whose sparse packing allows pressure to be accommodated through changes in packing density rather than rod compression. This mechanism enables the anomalous response to persist over a wide pressure range, contrasting favorably with other materials that exhibit similar behavior. Our findings expand the relatively small family of materials known to exhibit ZLC or NLC and provide deeper insight into the microscopic origin of these unusual mechanical responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“simulations”（模拟）。；研究对象：MCN（M = Ag, Au, Cu）金属氰化物家族，具体研究其负线性压缩性（NLC）和零线性压缩性（ZLC）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测了MCN家族中AgCN和CuCN的P6mm相以及AuCN的R3m相，并发现所有六种MCN材料均表现出极端的弹性各向异性，从而在每种材料中均实现了ZLC或NLC。该异常响应的机制源于材料独特的“竹林”几何结构：弱相互作用的刚性棒通过改变堆积密度而非棒本身压缩来容纳压力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测了MCN家族中AgCN和CuCN的P6mm相以及AuCN的R3m相，并发现所有六种MCN材料均表现出极端的弹性各向异性，从而在每种材料中均实现了ZLC或NLC。该异常响应的机制源于材料独特的“竹林”几何结构：弱相互作用的刚性棒通过改变堆积密度而非棒本身压缩来容纳压力。；创新点：识别出一种与以往报道不同的、由“竹林”几何结构驱动的NLC/ZLC新机制，该机制使异常响应能在较宽的压力范围内持续存在。同时，预测了该材料家族中此前未报道的晶体相。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。

papers.title: Connecting Microseismicity to Lithology via a Model of Slip Avalanches
papers.abstract: Fluid injection into the earth's crust can induce small and frequent earthquakes in the subsurface. Predicting their sizes and temporal occurrences via statistical analysis is crucial for safe operations in unconventional oil and gas recovery, enhanced geothermal systems, and geologic carbon storage. Here we show that a simple micromechanical model of slip avalanches in slowly deforming solids predicts the slip statistics observed over drastically different spatial scales, namely meter-scale microseismic observations and nanometer- to micrometer-scale nanoindentation experiments can be described with this model. Microseismic catalogs extracted from high-pressure fluid injection operations into geological basins with various lithologies and nanoindentation experiments on shale across a wide range of temperatures and mineral compositions yield statistics consistent with model predictions. This universality across materials, temperatures, and scales is consistent with the prediction that the slip statistics result from only a few basic properties. Previously debated deviations of the statistics in layered sedimentary formations are explained by finite-size and stress-integrative effects resulting from mechanically weak bedding planes. The slip statistics therefore provide important information about the structure and scales of the bedding planes. Conversely, the basin structure can also be used to predict the probability distribution for the sizes of triggered microseismic events.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论模型+实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中提出了“滑移雪崩的微观力学模型”，并对比了“微震观测”和“纳米压痕实验”的统计数据。；研究对象：流体注入地壳诱发微地震的滑移统计行为，具体涉及不同岩性（lithology）的地质盆地和页岩（shale）的纳米压痕实验。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一个简单的滑移雪崩微观力学模型能够统一描述从纳米/微米尺度（纳米压痕）到米尺度（微地震）的滑移统计规律，且该统计规律仅由少数基本性质决定，具有跨材料、跨温度和跨尺度的普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一个简单的滑移雪崩微观力学模型能够统一描述从纳米/微米尺度（纳米压痕）到米尺度（微地震）的滑移统计规律，且该统计规律仅由少数基本性质决定，具有跨材料、跨温度和跨尺度的普适性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：该工作首次将微地震统计与纳米压痕实验的统计结果统一在同一理论框架下，并指出层状沉积岩中统计偏差源于弱层理面的有限尺寸和应力积分效应，从而建立了滑移统计与地质结构（层理面尺度）之间的双向预测关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为“缓慢变形固体中滑移雪崩的微观力学模型”；实验数据来自高压流体注入作业的微震目录（不同岩性盆地）以及不同温度和矿物成分下的页岩纳米压痕实验。

papers.title: Resonant-impurity scanning tunneling spectroscopy in altermagnets: dual Fano resonance and Landau-quantization-induced nodal spin contrast
papers.abstract: Using a Green's-function formalism, we study the spin-resolved local spectral function of a resonant impurity coupled to a two-dimensional $d$% -wave altermagnetic substrate. It is found that the interplay between direct tunneling from the impurity to the scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) tip and altermagnet-mediated tunneling gives rise to a dual Fano resonance in the absence of an external magnetic field. Moreover, the anisotropic spin-dependent oscillations of the local density of states and the corresponding Fano factors provide information on the altermagnetic splitting strength from complementary local and global perspectives. In addition, spin-selective tunneling can be achieved by tuning the Fermi energy and the tip position. In the presence of a strong magnetic field with Landau-level quantization, the dominant scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) signature appears as a spin-dependent nodal structure in real space: the nodal mismatch between opposite spin channels produces a large local spin contrast. These results establish resonant-impurity STM/STS as a phase-sensitive local probe of altermagnetic band anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用 Green's-function formalism（格林函数形式）进行理论计算，未提及实验数据或数值模拟。；研究对象：二维 d 波交变磁体（altermagnet）中与共振杂质（resonant impurity）耦合的局域谱函数，以及扫描隧道显微镜/谱（STM/STS）对其的探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无外磁场时，直接隧穿与交变磁体介导隧穿的干涉导致双 Fano 共振；在强磁场下，朗道能级量子化产生实空间自旋依赖的节点结构，导致大的局域自旋对比度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无外磁场时，直接隧穿与交变磁体介导隧穿的干涉导致双 Fano 共振；在强磁场下，朗道能级量子化产生实空间自旋依赖的节点结构，导致大的局域自旋对比度。；创新点：提出将共振杂质 STM/STS 作为交变磁体能带各向异性的相位敏感局域探针，揭示了双 Fano 共振和朗道量子化诱导的节点自旋对比度等新特征。
papers.method_zh: 基于格林函数形式（Green's-function formalism）计算自旋分辨的局域谱函数，分析共振杂质与二维 d 波交变磁体衬底的耦合效应。

papers.title: Thermoelectric and Magnetic Properties in Doped Fe$_2$VAl within a Bipolar Random Anderson Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermoelectric and magnetic properties of Si-substituted $n$-type and Ti-substituted $p$-type Heusler alloy Fe$_2$VAl using the bipolar random Anderson model, which has been introduced recently to study antisite-defect effects associated with the sign change of the Seebeck coefficient in thermally quenched Fe$_2$VAl. Based on the electronic states of both $n$-type and $p$-type compounds, with the rigid-band shift of the Fermi energy and a temperature-dependent scattering rate taken into account, we elucidate how antisite defects simultaneously influence thermoelectric transport and local magnetic moments. We find that the magnetic moments are enhanced in $n$-type Fe$_2$VAl, whereas they are suppressed in $p$-type Fe$_2$VAl compared with the undoped compound. These contrasting magnetic responses highlight the impact of antisite spin polarization on thermoelectric properties and demonstrate the crucial role of antisite defects in realizing magneto-thermoelectric functionalities in Heusler-type alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：bipolar random Anderson model（双极随机安德森模型）、rigid-band shift（刚带移动）、temperature-dependent scattering rate（温度依赖的散射率）。；研究对象：Si取代的n型与Ti取代的p型Heusler合金Fe₂VAl的热电与磁性质，以及其中的反位缺陷效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反位缺陷在n型Fe₂VAl中增强磁矩，在p型Fe₂VAl中抑制磁矩；这种相反的磁响应揭示了反位缺陷对热电性能的影响，并表明其在实现磁热电功能中的关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反位缺陷在n型Fe₂VAl中增强磁矩，在p型Fe₂VAl中抑制磁矩；这种相反的磁响应揭示了反位缺陷对热电性能的影响，并表明其在实现磁热电功能中的关键作用。；创新点：通过双极随机安德森模型系统阐明了反位缺陷如何同时影响热电输运和局域磁矩，并揭示了n型和p型掺杂下磁响应的相反趋势。
papers.method_zh: 采用双极随机安德森模型，结合费米能的刚带移动和温度依赖的散射率，基于n型和p型化合物的电子态进行计算分析。

papers.title: Disorder signatures in coherent electronic waveguides
papers.abstract: Microscopic disorder in a coherent conductor is encoded in the magnitude of the transmitted current and in the energy- and channel-resolved structure of the scattering response. We develop a conductance-balanced learning framework for identifying microscopic disorder mechanisms from coherent quantum-transport spectra. Using armchair graphene nanoribbons as controlled multichannel tight-binding waveguides, we generate ensembles in which distinct disorder classes occupy the same intervals of integrated transmission, removing the dominant shortcut associated with average conductance. Within this constrained setting, we compare scalar transmission spectra with transmission-eigenvalue spectra, and use supervised classification, scale-normalizing controls, plateau-resolved tests, and principal-component analysis to identify the spectral structures that remain informative. The learned distinctions persist after normalization of the conductance envelope and are strongest in multichannel energy windows, where mode mixing and channel redistribution shape the scattering response. Principal components provide interpretable transport coordinates whose loadings identify the energy and eigenchannel sectors responsible for the dominant spectral deformations. The results establish a controlled AI-assisted protocol for learning disorder signatures from nonlinear quantum-scattering data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“紧束缚模型”、“监督分类”、“主成分分析”等计算和数据分析方法，未提及具体实验操作。；研究对象：相干电子波导中的微观无序机制，具体以扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带作为多通道紧束缚波导模型系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在去除平均电导这一主导捷径后，通过电导平衡学习框架，发现传输本征值谱比标量传输谱包含更多关于无序类别的可区分信息，且这些信息在多通道能量窗口中最为显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在去除平均电导这一主导捷径后，通过电导平衡学习框架，发现传输本征值谱比标量传输谱包含更多关于无序类别的可区分信息，且这些信息在多通道能量窗口中最为显著。；创新点：提出了一种受控的、基于人工智能的协议，用于从非线性量子散射数据中学习无序特征。该方法通过“电导平衡”策略，强制不同无序类别具有相同的积分透射率，从而排除了平均电导这一简单区分标志，迫使模型学习更精细的谱结构特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用电导平衡学习框架，结合紧束缚模型生成不同无序类别的传输谱系综。使用监督分类、尺度归一化控制、平台分辨测试和主成分分析等机器学习与统计方法，对比分析标量传输谱与传输本征值谱。

papers.title: Large-scale pseudopotential density functional theory calculations using orthogonalized enriched finite element basis
papers.abstract: We present an efficient and scalable computational framework for pseudopotential Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT) calculations using an enriched finite element (EFE) basis. The EFE basis is formed by augmenting the classical finite element (CFE) basis with compact atom-centered functions, which we term enrichment functions. The key idea is to combine the completeness of a finite element basis with the efficiency of an atom-centered basis. We orthogonalize the enrichment functions with respect to the underlying CFE basis to simultaneously improve the conditioning of the EFE basis and the efficiency of evaluating the inverse of the overlap matrix. To efficiently solve the Kohn-Sham eigenvalue problem, we employ a residual-based Chebyshev subspace iteration approach that is tolerant to approximations in the evaluation of the inverse of the overlap matrix. We demonstrate the accuracy of the framework as compared to the widely available DFT packages. For benchmark non-periodic calculations, ranging up to 39,083 electrons, the EFE basis offers a $5-7\times$ reduction in degrees of freedom over the CFE basis. As a result of this, EFE achieves a $5-9\times$ reduction in computational cost over the CFE basis. The EFE basis also provides a $4-5\times$ reduction in the required memory compared to the CFE basis, thus allowing for optimal utilization of computational resources. Finally, we demonstrate that the EFE basis affords good parallel scalability. Overall, the EFE basis offers a systematically convergent, fast, scalable, resource-efficient basis for pseudopotential DFT calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：pseudopotential Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT) calculations、computational framework、enriched finite element (EFE) basis。；研究对象：论文研究的是用于凝聚态物理中密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的一种新型基组方法，而非特定材料或物理现象。研究对象是计算框架本身，即基于富集有限元（EFE）基组的赝势DFT计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 富集有限元（EFE）基组相比经典有限元（CFE）基组，在保持精度的同时，可将自由度数量减少5-7倍，计算成本降低5-9倍，内存需求减少4-5倍，并具有良好的并行可扩展性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：富集有限元（EFE）基组相比经典有限元（CFE）基组，在保持精度的同时，可将自由度数量减少5-7倍，计算成本降低5-9倍，内存需求减少4-5倍，并具有良好的并行可扩展性。；创新点：提出并实现了一种将有限元基组的完备性与原子中心基组的效率相结合的富集有限元（EFE）基组，并通过正交化策略解决了基组条件数问题，从而在保持系统收敛性的同时大幅降低了计算自由度和资源消耗。
papers.method_zh: 采用富集有限元（EFE）基组进行赝势Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（KS-DFT）计算。EFE基组通过在经典有限元（CFE）基组上添加紧凑的原子中心函数（富集函数）构成，并对富集函数相对于CFE基组进行正交化以改善基组条件数和重叠矩阵求逆效率。求解Kohn-Sham本征值问题时，使用了基于残差的Chebyshev子空间迭代方法，该方法对重叠矩阵求逆的近似具有容忍性。

papers.title: High-frequency nonlinear conductivity of a Wigner crystal
papers.abstract: Electrons trapped above the surface of superfluid helium are a disorder-free platform for investigating the formation and dynamics of low-dimensional Wigner crystals. A characteristic nonlinear transport feature of this electronic solid suspended above the helium surface is the Bragg-Cherenkov effect, in which the mobility of the smoothly moving crystal is limited by the coherent emission of helium surface waves (ripplons). The effect has been understood in the conventional Cherenkov setting in which the crystal moves at a constant speed. Here we report on transport measurements of electrons on helium confined in a microchannel geometry to investigate the non-equilibrium response of the Wigner solid when it is subjected to a high-frequency driving field. Surprisingly, the experiments reveal a strongly nonlinear transport response of the confined Wigner solid at frequencies nearly an order of magnitude larger than the ripplon frequencies contributing to the conventional Bragg-Cherenkov effect. We relate this observation to the coupling of the Wigner solid to ripplons with higher-order Bragg vectors, which gives rise to a dynamical friction that provides a mechanism for the observed high-frequency pinning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here we report on transport measurements”（我们报告了输运测量），并描述了实验发现。；研究对象：悬浮在超流氦表面的电子形成的维格纳晶体，特别是被限制在微通道几何结构中的维格纳固体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验发现，在远高于传统布拉格-切伦科夫效应中涉及的里普尔子频率（近一个数量级）的高频驱动下，受限的维格纳固体表现出强非线性输运响应。该现象被归因于维格纳固体与高阶布拉格矢量的里普尔子耦合，从而产生了一种高频钉扎机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验发现，在远高于传统布拉格-切伦科夫效应中涉及的里普尔子频率（近一个数量级）的高频驱动下，受限的维格纳固体表现出强非线性输运响应。该现象被归因于维格纳固体与高阶布拉格矢量的里普尔子耦合，从而产生了一种高频钉扎机制。；创新点：发现了维格纳晶体在远高于传统布拉格-切伦科夫效应特征频率下的强非线性输运行为，并提出了与高阶布拉格矢量里普尔子耦合相关的动态摩擦作为新的高频钉扎机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用了微通道几何结构来限制电子，并对电子进行高频驱动下的输运测量。

papers.title: A neural-network Maxwell's demon learns cold damping for work extraction
papers.abstract: We train a neural-network Maxwell's demon to extract work from a model of an underdamped micromechanical cantilever subject to thermal noise. The demon, which periodically adjusts the position of a harmonic trap, is trained to maximize the power extracted under steady-state operation. When the demon is given the cantilever position and trap position as inputs it learns a refined version of an existing hand-designed protocol, yielding a substantial improvement in performance. When the demon receives the oscillator velocity as input it discovers a qualitatively different strategy that extracts substantially more work, close to the theoretical power bound. Analysis of the protocol shows that it implements {\em cold damping}: the trap position is displaced approximately linearly with velocity, producing an effective increase of the oscillator's damping coefficient and a reduction of its effective temperature. Thus a neural-network Maxwell's demon rediscovers a well-known cooling strategy from optomechanics, revealing a simple physical mechanism underlying near-optimal work extraction from thermal fluctuations in an underdamped system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural-network Maxwell's demon（神经网络麦克斯韦妖）、training（训练）、analysis of the protocol（协议分析）。；研究对象：受热噪声驱动的欠阻尼微机械悬臂梁（underdamped micromechanical cantilever）模型，以及通过调节谐波陷阱位置从热涨落中提取功的物理过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 神经网络麦克斯韦妖在仅输入振荡器速度时，自主发现了“冷阻尼”（cold damping）策略——陷阱位移与速度近似线性相关，从而有效增加阻尼系数并降低系统有效温度，实现了接近理论极限的功提取。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：神经网络麦克斯韦妖在仅输入振荡器速度时，自主发现了“冷阻尼”（cold damping）策略——陷阱位移与速度近似线性相关，从而有效增加阻尼系数并降低系统有效温度，实现了接近理论极限的功提取。；创新点：神经网络自主重新发现了光力学中已知的冷阻尼冷却策略，揭示了在欠阻尼系统中实现近最优功提取的简单物理机制，且性能优于已有手工设计的协议。
papers.method_zh: 使用神经网络作为麦克斯韦妖，通过强化学习训练其周期性地调整谐波陷阱位置，以最大化稳态下的提取功率。输入变量包括悬臂梁位置、陷阱位置或振荡器速度，并对比不同输入下的性能。

papers.title: Synthesis of Bulk Superconducting LiNbO$_2$ Crystals through CaH$_2$ Reduction
papers.abstract: We have synthesized layered superconducting LiNbO$_2$ crystals through a bulk phase transformation from LiNbO$_3$ single crystals via CaH$_2$ reduction. As the Nb valence is reduced from 5+ to 3+, the material undergoes a structural transformation to the resulting product, LiNbO$_2$, which is accompanied by metallic behavior and a superconducting transition, Tc onset, as high as 14.4 K. Secondary ion mass spectroscopy (SIMS) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) show that the resulting phase is hole-doped through de-lithiation during the reduction. Magnetization and AC susceptibility measurements from a tunnel diode resonator confirm the bulk nature of superconductivity with a superconducting volume fraction of approximately 77% and an upper critical field approaching 26 T. Our study demonstrates extreme hydride reduction as an effective method to induce phase transformations with non-topotactic pathways and can be used to synthesize bulk materials with exotic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：合成（synthesized）、测量（magnetization, AC susceptibility）、二次离子质谱（SIMS）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）。；研究对象：层状超导材料LiNbO₂晶体，通过CaH₂还原法从LiNbO₃单晶转变而来。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过CaH₂还原实现了LiNbO₃到LiNbO₂的体相转变，所得LiNbO₂晶体表现出金属行为和超导电性，超导起始转变温度高达14.4 K，且超导体积分数约为77%，上临界场接近26 T，证实了体超导性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过CaH₂还原实现了LiNbO₃到LiNbO₂的体相转变，所得LiNbO₂晶体表现出金属行为和超导电性，超导起始转变温度高达14.4 K，且超导体积分数约为77%，上临界场接近26 T，证实了体超导性质。；创新点：展示了极端氢化物还原作为一种非拓扑转变路径，可有效诱导相变并合成具有奇异物性的体相材料。摘要未突出说明与已有LiNbO₂合成方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用CaH₂还原法对LiNbO₃单晶进行体相转变；使用二次离子质谱（SIMS）和X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析元素价态与掺杂；通过磁化强度测量和隧道二极管谐振器的交流磁化率测量表征超导特性。

papers.title: Microscopic Dynamical Entropy II: Statistical and Stochastic Thermodynamics of Hamiltonian Systems
papers.abstract: The Microscopic Dynamical Entropy (MDE) introduced in Ref. [1] describes irreversible relaxation of selected variables x within a finite closed Hamiltonian system of fixed total energy E. Here we extend the framework to arbitrary total-energy distributions and time-dependent Hamiltonians. This allows work interactions with external agents or protocols, crucial in stochastic and classical thermodynamics, and driven systems more generally, to be addressed directly. The central step is to reduce the full microscopic description in terms of selected variables x and unmonitored variables y to one in terms of the selected variables and the instantaneous total energy (x,E). The unmonitored degrees of freedom y in Y enter through their conditional phase-space volume (CPV) $Ω_Y(x,E,t)$. This construction allows work and heat to be defined directly for finite Hamiltonian composites, including cases where Y is so small that its temperature is not well defined. We demonstrate monotonic MDE growth, corresponding to the macroscopic second law, under mixing and time-scale separation even for driven systems with arbitrary energy distributions. At trajectory level, we derive detailed and integral fluctuation relations for the MDE, generalising standard large-bath results. We verify these numerically in a driven few-particle Hamiltonian system, showing the emergence of stochastic thermodynamics for collective coordinates, such as the centre-of-mass position, even in closed systems with only ten or twenty degrees of freedom. Physically, these fluctuation relations connect irreversibility to the change in the number of unmonitored microstates compatible with initial and final data for the observed coordinates. Together, our results provide a finite-system Hamiltonian foundation for the emergence of classical and stochastic thermodynamics and extend their applicability to surprisingly small heat baths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：extend the framework、derive fluctuation relations、numerically verify）；研究对象：有限封闭哈密顿系统中选定变量的不可逆弛豫，以及经典与随机热力学在有限小热浴中的涌现基础。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将微观描述约化为选定变量与瞬时总能量（x,E），可直接定义有限哈密顿复合体系中的功与热，并证明即使在驱动系统与任意能量分布下，微观动力学熵（MDE）仍满足单调增长（宏观第二定律）及轨迹层面的细致与积分涨落关系，从而为经典与随机热力学在仅含十到二十个自由度的封闭系统中涌现提供了哈密顿基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将微观描述约化为选定变量与瞬时总能量（x,E），可直接定义有限哈密顿复合体系中的功与热，并证明即使在驱动系统与任意能量分布下，微观动力学熵（MDE）仍满足单调增长（宏观第二定律）及轨迹层面的细致与积分涨落关系，从而为经典与随机热力学在仅含十到二十个自由度的封闭系统中涌现提供了哈密顿基础。；创新点：将先前针对固定总能量系统的微观动力学熵（MDE）框架推广到任意总能量分布与含时哈密顿量，从而直接处理功与热，并证明即使在热浴极小的系统中（温度定义不明确）涨落关系仍成立，扩展了随机热力学的适用范围。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于条件相空间体积（CPV）Ω_Y(x,E,t) 将全微观描述约化为（x,E）空间；推导了MDE的涨落关系；数值验证：在驱动少粒子哈密顿系统中模拟集体坐标（如质心位置）的随机热力学行为。

papers.title: Driven square lattice of quantum dots in a magnetic field coupled to a cylindrical FIR-photon cavity
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive computational study of driven quantum dot arrays in a square lattice configuration, subject to an external magnetic field and coupled to a cylindrical far-infrared photon cavity. The driving is introduced through a harmonic modulation of the full electron-photon interaction, therefore including both paramagnetic and diamagnetic contributions. The electron-electron Coulomb interactions are treated within density functional theory, while the electron-photon coupling is modeled using a many-body configuration interaction approach at each iteration of the density functional. By exploiting the unique properties of the cylindrical TE$_{011}$ cavity mode, we demonstrate selective enhancement of diamagnetic two-photon transitions. Our results reveal that the effectiveness of harmonic modulation of the electron-photon interaction is strongly dependent on both the driving frequency and the electron occupation number per dot. When the driving frequency approaches twice the cavity photon frequency, the system exhibits resonant behavior characterized by efficient photon pumping, occupation of higher-order photon replicas, and activation of collective radial Coulomb breathing modes. These findings establish a controllable mechanism for manipulating photon states in coupled quantum dot-cavity systems and provide insights into the interplay among harmonic modulation, photonic excitations, magnetic confinement, and many-body electron correlations in dimensionally reduced nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“computational study”、“density functional theory”、“many-body configuration interaction approach”。；研究对象：受驱动量子点阵列（方形晶格构型），置于外磁场中并与圆柱形远红外光子腔耦合的复合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过谐波调制电子-光子相互作用，可选择性增强抗磁双光子跃迁；当驱动频率接近两倍腔光子频率时，系统出现共振行为，表现为高效光子泵浦、高阶光子副本占据以及集体径向库仑呼吸模式的激活。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过谐波调制电子-光子相互作用，可选择性增强抗磁双光子跃迁；当驱动频率接近两倍腔光子频率时，系统出现共振行为，表现为高效光子泵浦、高阶光子副本占据以及集体径向库仑呼吸模式的激活。；创新点：利用圆柱形TE₀₁₁腔模的独特性质，实现了对抗磁双光子跃迁的选择性增强，并揭示了驱动频率与每个量子点电子占据数对谐波调制有效性的关键影响。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论处理电子-电子库仑相互作用，并在密度泛函的每次迭代中结合多体组态相互作用方法建模电子-光子耦合。驱动通过全电子-光子相互作用的谐波调制引入，同时包含顺磁和抗磁贡献。

papers.title: Evaporation-Driven Nanowire Self-Assembly in an Elongated Droplet
papers.abstract: Drying of nanowire-laden elongated droplets is a ubiquitous process in printed electronics fabrication, where the resulting deposition pattern critically determines device performance by controlling nanowire alignment, connectivity, and percolating charge-transport pathways. However, the physical understanding of evaporation-driven deposition is still largely derived from studies of spherical droplets on homogeneous substrates. This gap limits the ability to predict and control deposit morphology in realistic printing scenarios. Here, we use mesoscale lattice Boltzmann simulations to investigate the drying of nanowire-laden elongated droplets on wettability-patterned substrates, focusing on the effects of droplet geometry, nanowire interactions, and nanowire length. The elongated droplet geometry is found to intrinsically induce distinct axial and transverse inhomogeneities in the final deposit. Increasing the effective attraction between nanowires, which mimics changes in surface chemistry or solvent conditions, can improve electrical connectivity but also promotes clustering and local ordering, reducing structural uniformity. In contrast, increasing nanowire length yields a dual benefit by improving long-range connectivity while simultaneously enhancing deposit homogeneity. Our findings provide design guidance for balancing electrical transport and structural uniformity in evaporation-driven printed electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“mesoscale lattice Boltzmann simulations”（介观尺度格子玻尔兹曼模拟）。；研究对象：研究的具体物理现象是：在润湿性图案化基底上，含有纳米线的细长液滴在蒸发驱动下的自组装沉积过程。具体材料体系为纳米线悬浮液滴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细长液滴的几何形状会内在导致最终沉积物在轴向和横向上产生不均匀性。增加纳米线间的有效吸引力虽能改善电学连通性，但会促进团簇和局部有序化，降低结构均匀性；而增加纳米线长度则能同时改善长程连通性和沉积均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细长液滴的几何形状会内在导致最终沉积物在轴向和横向上产生不均匀性。增加纳米线间的有效吸引力虽能改善电学连通性，但会促进团簇和局部有序化，降低结构均匀性；而增加纳米线长度则能同时改善长程连通性和沉积均匀性。；创新点：该工作将蒸发驱动沉积的研究从传统的球形液滴/均匀基底拓展到更贴近实际印刷场景的细长液滴/图案化基底，系统研究了液滴几何形状、纳米线相互作用和纳米线长度对最终沉积形貌的影响，为平衡电学输运和结构均匀性提供了设计指导。
papers.method_zh: 介观尺度格子玻尔兹曼方法（Lattice Boltzmann Method, LBM）模拟。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Chiral Phonons in Altermagnets via Magnon-Phonon Coupling
papers.abstract: Chiral phonons are attractive for spintronics applications, however, their zero-field generation in conventional antiferromagnets is forbidden by combined parity and time-reversal ($\mathcal{PT}$) symmetry. Here we demonstrate the emergence of chiral phonons in $\mathcal{PT}$-breaking altermagnetic systems at zero field arising from relativistic magnon-phonon coupling. Focusing on the prototypical altermagnet CrSb, we utilize first-principles methods to calculate the hybridized magnon-polarons across the complete Brillouin zone. We show that this coupling imprints an altermagnetic $g$-wave symmetry directly onto the phonon angular momentum. Furthermore, we demonstrate anomalous spin and phonon angular momentum Nernst responses arising from finite Berry curvatures. These findings establish that chiral lattice dynamics can arise in compensated magnetic ground states without requiring external fields, positioning bulk altermagnets as material candidates for zero-field spin caloritronics and chiral phononics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：first-principles methods（第一性原理计算）、计算混合磁振子-极化子。；研究对象：研究在交变磁体（altermagnet）CrSb中，通过相对论性磁振子-声子耦合产生的宇称-时间反演对称性（\(\mathcal{PT}\)）破缺下的手性声子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零磁场下，交变磁体CrSb中相对论性磁振子-声子耦合能够产生手性声子，并将交变磁体的g波对称性直接印刻到声子角动量上；同时，有限贝里曲率导致了反常的自旋和声子角动量能斯特响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零磁场下，交变磁体CrSb中相对论性磁振子-声子耦合能够产生手性声子，并将交变磁体的g波对称性直接印刻到声子角动量上；同时，有限贝里曲率导致了反常的自旋和声子角动量能斯特响应。；创新点：首次在零磁场且无净磁矩的补偿磁基态（交变磁体）中，通过磁振子-声子耦合实现了手性声子的产生，为无需外场的自旋热电子学和手性声子学提供了候选材料。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理方法（first-principles methods）计算了整个布里渊区中杂化的磁振子-极化子（magnon-polarons）。

papers.title: Microscopic Dynamical Entropy I: Quantifying Hamiltonian Irreversibility in Large and Small Systems
papers.abstract: We introduce a Microscopic Dynamical Entropy (MDE) for Hamiltonian systems, defined with respect to a chosen partition of degrees of freedom into a system X and its environment Y. The construction is based on the conditional phase-space volume (CPV), or conditional Boltzmann entropy, associated with the unmonitored degrees of freedom Y. The MDE is a microscopically defined entropy functional of the marginal distribution $ρ_X(t)$, obtained by discarding conditional microscopic information associated with Y from the Gibbs entropy of the joint XY system, while retaining exact Hamiltonian dynamics. This construction clarifies the microscopic origin of thermal entropy. The dependence of MDE solely on $ρ_X(t)$ is consistent with the thermodynamic assumption that the entropy increment of a heat bath Y depends on its heat content and temperature, not on details of its probability distribution. Indeed, the MDE recovers dS = dQ/T connecting entropy increments to heat flow between system and environment. More generally, it provides a consistent description of irreversible relaxation under exact Hamiltonian dynamics, while permitting transient entropy decreases in small systems and in spin-echo type protocols. Under time-scale separation between X and Y, the MDE becomes strictly monotonic in time, recovering the familiar structure of irreversible thermodynamics. The MDE can foreshadow thermodynamics even in a small isolated Hamiltonian system, if X is a well chosen subset of its degrees of freedom. An example is the centre of mass of interacting particles confined to a box. Even for as few as N=10 particles, the MDE increases during relaxation towards a maximum at equilibrium, with increasing monotonicity at larger N. Taken together, our results show that the MDE offers a microscopic interpretation of nonequilibrium thermal entropy and its time dependence within exact Hamiltonian dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“introduce”“construction”“definition”等理论构建词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：哈密顿系统的不可逆性与热力学熵的微观起源。具体体系包括：将自由度划分为系统X与环境Y的哈密顿系统，以及小孤立系统（如N=10个粒子在盒子中运动的质心）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种微观动力学熵（MDE），它仅依赖于系统X的边缘分布ρ_X(t)，能在精确哈密顿动力学下描述不可逆弛豫，并恢复dS = dQ/T这一热力学关系，同时允许小系统或自旋回波协议中出现瞬态熵减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种微观动力学熵（MDE），它仅依赖于系统X的边缘分布ρ_X(t)，能在精确哈密顿动力学下描述不可逆弛豫，并恢复dS = dQ/T这一热力学关系，同时允许小系统或自旋回波协议中出现瞬态熵减。；创新点：首次在精确哈密顿动力学框架下，通过仅依赖系统边缘分布的方式定义微观熵，统一解释了热力学熵的微观起源、不可逆弛豫以及小系统中的熵减现象，并能在时间尺度分离下恢复不可逆热力学的单调熵增结构。
papers.method_zh: 基于条件相空间体积（CPV）或条件玻尔兹曼熵，从联合XY系统的吉布斯熵中丢弃与环境Y相关的条件微观信息，保留精确哈密顿动力学，构建MDE作为ρ_X(t)的熵泛函。

papers.title: Topological charge, helicity and vorticity conservation and the reverse spin-current model in the II-nd type multifferoics
papers.abstract: The topological charge and its density are related to the spin vorticity, while the spin vorticity is a part of full vorticity of the medium. The full vorticity is related to an integral of motion called the hydrodynamic helicity. Relation between two integrals of motion (the topological charge and the hydrodynamic helicity) is traced. The role of the spin-current model of the electric polarization formation due to the specific spin distribution in the helicity conservation is demonstrated. The reverse spin-current model is suggested to demonstrate the contribution of the polarization in the spin evolution equation, its importance for the helicity conservation is shown as well. Spin-field model of the electric polarization is the second model for the electric polarization (the deformation, firstly) formation due to the specific spin distribution, which appears from the same principles, but it has nonstationary origin. Moreover, the reverse spin-current model gives a mechanism for the spin structure formation due to the electric polarization in the system. It also appears as the requirement for the conservation of the helicity and the topological charge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论拓扑荷、螺旋度、涡度等概念之间的关系，提出“反向自旋流模型”等理论模型，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：II型多铁性材料中与自旋分布相关的电极化形成机制，以及拓扑荷、螺旋度、涡度守恒之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了拓扑荷与流体动力学螺旋度这两个运动积分之间的关联，并提出了“反向自旋流模型”，说明电极化如何反过来影响自旋演化方程，从而维持螺旋度和拓扑荷的守恒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了拓扑荷与流体动力学螺旋度这两个运动积分之间的关联，并提出了“反向自旋流模型”，说明电极化如何反过来影响自旋演化方程，从而维持螺旋度和拓扑荷的守恒。；创新点：提出了“反向自旋流模型”，该模型不仅展示了电极化对自旋结构形成的贡献，还将其作为螺旋度和拓扑荷守恒的必要条件。此外，摘要指出自旋-场模型（非定常起源）是除形变模型外第二种由特定自旋分布形成电极化的模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，包括拓扑荷密度与自旋涡度的关系、全涡度与螺旋度的积分守恒关系，以及自旋流模型和反向自旋流模型的构建。

papers.title: Majorana physics in a Luttinger liquid with attractive interactions
papers.abstract: Majorana zero modes are the hallmark of topological superconductivity. In one-dimensional systems, these zero modes are usually introduced in the context of gapped, mean-field models that do not conserve particle number, such as the Kitaev chain. By non-locally encoding a conventional fermion across spatially separated Majorana zero modes, these systems become inherently immune to local decoherence. In this work, we show that signatures of Majorana edge physics persist in a number-conserving, gapless Luttinger liquid of spinless fermions with short-range attractive interactions. We identify the two-point correlator as a sharp diagnostic, revealing an edge-to-edge revival whose sign depends on the fermion-number parity. This revival is robust in the thermodynamic limit, and persists in the excited states of the system and at different fillings. A simple particle-hole ansatz for the ground state of the system with an odd number of fermions captures the physics of the system for a wide range of interaction strengths, interpolating between the free-fermion limit and the strongly interacting Majorana regime. Finally, we propose a concrete protocol to realize this model with ultracold dipolar molecules or atoms in an optical lattice, and to detect the revival via beam-splitter interferometry, opening an experimental route to Majorana physics beyond the conventional gapped-superconductor paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：number-conserving, gapless Luttinger liquid, particle-hole ansatz, propose a concrete protocol）；研究对象：一维自旋less费米子构成的Luttinger液体，具有短程吸引相互作用，以及其中可能存在的马约拉纳边缘物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在粒子数守恒、无能隙的Luttinger液体中，马约拉纳边缘物理的迹象仍然存在：两点关联函数表现出边缘到边缘的复兴，其符号依赖于费米子数的奇偶性，且在热力学极限下稳健。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在粒子数守恒、无能隙的Luttinger液体中，马约拉纳边缘物理的迹象仍然存在：两点关联函数表现出边缘到边缘的复兴，其符号依赖于费米子数的奇偶性，且在热力学极限下稳健。；创新点：将马约拉纳零模从传统的能隙、平均场、粒子数不守恒模型（如Kitaev链）拓展到粒子数守恒、无能隙的Luttinger液体中，并提出了在超冷偶极分子或原子光晶格中实现该模型的具体实验方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：使用两点关联函数作为诊断工具；提出粒子-空穴变分波函数描述基态；通过束分束器干涉测量法提出实验探测方案。

papers.title: First-Principles Investigation of the Al-V Phase Diagram
papers.abstract: The Al-V alloy system contains a number of phases including several with complex structures and at least two exhibiting sites of partial occupation. Through electronic density functional theory-based total energy calculations combined with methods of statistical mechanics, we examine the relative stability of phases at finite temperatures. We construct composition-continuous free energy models for the V-rich solid solution and for one of the complex intermetallic phases. In the V-rich region, we identify three ground states that transform to the solid solution at elevated temperatures. We also suggest that \phase{Al}{V_3} takes the Al15 structure as an intermediate-temperature phase stabilized by anharmonic vibrational free energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：基于电子密度泛函理论（DFT）的总能量计算，并结合统计力学方法。；研究对象：Al-V合金体系的相图，特别是富V固溶体及复杂金属间化合物的相对稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在富V区域识别出三个基态，它们在高温下会转变为固溶体；提出AlV₃相可能以Al15结构作为中间温度相存在，该相由非简谐振动自由能稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在富V区域识别出三个基态，它们在高温下会转变为固溶体；提出AlV₃相可能以Al15结构作为中间温度相存在，该相由非简谐振动自由能稳定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于电子密度泛函理论（DFT）的总能量计算，结合统计力学方法，构建了富V固溶体及一种复杂金属间化合物的成分连续自由能模型。

papers.title: Spin-orbit magnetism in altermagnets
papers.abstract: The mechanism enabling antiferromagnets, including altermagnets, to exhibit a prominent anomalous Hall effect despite a vanishingly small net magnetization has long remained elusive. Here, by employing oriented spin group theory and spin-orbit-coupling tensor expansion, we systematically disentangle the perturbative behaviors of orbital and spin magnetizations with respect to spin-orbit coupling. Remarkably, we find that only if the opposite-spin sublattices are connected through a fourfold rotation, the orbital and spin magnetizations exhibit distinct perturbative orders. In these altermagnets, we further discover a coaxial Hall effect characterized by the induced spin and orbital magnetizations aligning parallel to the Néel vector, which we further demonstrate by first-principles calculations in the altermagnet KV$_{2}$Se$_{2}$O. This effect holds great promise for achieving deterministic switching of the Néel order under weak external fields. Our work provides a systematic symmetry approach to identify potential altermagnetic candidates combining a large anomalous Hall effect with minimal net magnetization, paving the way for high-performance, stray-field-free spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有第一性原理计算）。判断依据：采用群论和自旋-轨道耦合张量展开的理论框架，并结合第一性原理计算进行验证。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）中的自旋-轨道磁性，具体以KV₂Se₂O为例，研究其反常霍尔效应与轨道/自旋磁化的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 只有当相反自旋的子格通过四重旋转对称性连接时，轨道磁化和自旋磁化在自旋-轨道耦合下表现出不同的微扰阶数；在此类交变磁体中，存在一种共轴霍尔效应，即诱导的自旋和轨道磁化与奈尔矢量平行排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：只有当相反自旋的子格通过四重旋转对称性连接时，轨道磁化和自旋磁化在自旋-轨道耦合下表现出不同的微扰阶数；在此类交变磁体中，存在一种共轴霍尔效应，即诱导的自旋和轨道磁化与奈尔矢量平行排列。；创新点：首次系统区分了交变磁体中轨道磁化和自旋磁化在自旋-轨道耦合下的不同微扰行为，并发现了一种新的共轴霍尔效应，该效应有望在弱外场下实现奈尔序的确定性翻转。
papers.method_zh: 采用定向自旋群理论（oriented spin group theory）和自旋-轨道耦合张量展开（spin-orbit-coupling tensor expansion）进行对称性分析，并结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）在交变磁体KV₂Se₂O中进行验证。

papers.title: Physical exact conditions as regularizers for exchange-correlation in solids and surface chemistry
papers.abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) often is the method of choice for simulating the electronic properties of extended solids and surfaces from first principles due to a favorable compromise between accuracy and computational cost. In the field of heterogeneous catalysis, DFT is indispensable for deriving mechanistic insights and understanding trends in surface reactivity. The accuracy of DFT for surface reaction energetics depends strongly on the exchange-correlation (XC) approximation. We show here that optimization of such XC functionals for surface binding energies can lead to a worse description of surface reaction barriers, unless important physical exact conditions are fulfilled.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、exchange-correlation (XC) approximation、first principles。；研究对象：固体和表面化学中的电子性质，特别是异相催化中的表面反应能学（表面结合能、表面反应势垒）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 优化交换关联泛函以提高表面结合能的准确性，可能导致表面反应势垒的描述变差，除非该泛函满足重要的物理精确条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：优化交换关联泛函以提高表面结合能的准确性，可能导致表面反应势垒的描述变差，除非该泛函满足重要的物理精确条件。；创新点：揭示了在固体和表面化学中，仅以表面结合能为目标优化交换关联泛函会损害反应势垒的准确性，并强调满足物理精确条件是避免这一权衡的关键。摘要未突出说明具体采用了哪些泛函形式或测试体系。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）框架下的交换关联泛函优化与评估，重点考察泛函是否满足物理精确条件对表面反应能学的影响。

papers.title: Mesoscopic routers and single-pole double-throw switches for electronic heat
papers.abstract: The unavoidable dissipation of heat in electronic nanostructures is a crucial problem, specially when their operation requires low temperatures. It demands finding devices able to control and redirect the excess heat, ideally without perturbing the electrostatic environment. We propose three-terminal junctions working either as thermal routers or as thermal single-pole double-throw switches controlled by a single external knob. Two models are discussed based on resonant tunneling energy filters and different couplings to the heat source: (i) Phase-coherent contact via a scanning tip modulates the relative amount of the two output currents via position-dependent quantum interference; (ii) Coupling via a gate voltage tunable filter selectively switches one of the currents in the presence of dephasing. In the later case, we find that the heat flow using ideal filtering is bounded by fourth the open conductor current.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose（提出模型）、discuss（讨论模型）、based on（基于理论机制）。；研究对象：电子热输运的介观路由器与单刀双掷开关，具体为三端结（three-terminal junctions）结构，用于控制电子热流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单个外部控制旋钮，三端结可实现热路由器或热单刀双掷开关功能；在存在退相干的理想滤波情况下，热流受限于开路导体电流的四分之一。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单个外部控制旋钮，三端结可实现热路由器或热单刀双掷开关功能；在存在退相干的理想滤波情况下，热流受限于开路导体电流的四分之一。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于共振隧穿能量滤波器（resonant tunneling energy filters）的理论模型，讨论了两种耦合方式：（i）通过扫描探针实现相位相干接触，利用位置依赖的量子干涉调制两路输出电流的相对大小；（ii）通过栅压可调滤波器实现耦合，在退相干存在时选择性切换其中一路电流。

papers.title: Moiré Phonon Condensation in Magic-Angle Twisted Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Twisted bilayer graphene reconstructs from weak breathing corrugation to large common bending near the magic angle, but the origin of this collective crossover has remained unclear. Here we show that the crossover is a soft-mode condensation of layer-symmetric $A_1$ moiré flexural phonons: these modes soften on the breathing branch, lose stiffness near the magic angle, and freeze into the bending morphology. We call this mechanism Moiré Phonon Condensation (MPC). At $θ=1.08^\circ$, it is extremely surprising that displacements of all 11164 atoms in the moiré supercell, with a maximum atomic position shift of 2.30 Angstrom, is captured by only two $A_1$ phonon modes at more than $99.5\%$ spectral weight. A first-harmonic continuum theory identifies a dimensionless control parameter of the phenomenon, showing that as the twist approaches the magic angle, the growing moiré length scale amplifies a smooth stress-bending competition until the flexural stiffness changes sign. Mode-resolved tight-binding calculations further show that the condensed phonon coordinates are electronically active. This work identifies MPC as a twist-controlled structural order parameter for moiré reconstruction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“continuum theory”“mode-resolved tight-binding calculations”等理论建模与计算方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene）中的莫尔重构（moiré reconstruction）现象，具体为从弱呼吸型褶皱到大幅弯曲型形貌的集体转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该集体转变是一种层对称A₁莫尔弯曲声子的软模凝聚（Moiré Phonon Condensation, MPC）：这些声子在呼吸分支上软化，在魔角附近失去刚度，并冻结为弯曲形貌。在θ=1.08°时，莫尔超胞中全部11164个原子的位移（最大原子位移2.30 Å）可由仅两个A₁声子模式以超过99.5%的谱权重描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该集体转变是一种层对称A₁莫尔弯曲声子的软模凝聚（Moiré Phonon Condensation, MPC）：这些声子在呼吸分支上软化，在魔角附近失去刚度，并冻结为弯曲形貌。在θ=1.08°时，莫尔超胞中全部11164个原子的位移（最大原子位移2.30 Å）可由仅两个A₁声子模式以超过99.5%的谱权重描述。；创新点：首次将魔角附近莫尔重构的集体转变识别为一种由转角控制的声子软模凝聚，并揭示其结构序参量性质。摘要未突出说明与已有理论（如仅考虑静力学重构）的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 连续介质理论（first-harmonic continuum theory）提取无量纲控制参数；模式分辨的紧束缚计算（mode-resolved tight-binding calculations）分析凝聚声子坐标的电学活性。

papers.title: Fluctuation-Driven Enhancement of Spin-Orbit Torque near the Curie Temperature of Ultrathin Ferromagnets
papers.abstract: We investigate how magnetic fluctuations influence spin-orbit torque in ultrathin-film magnetic heterostructures whose Curie temperature $T_C$ is suppressed by confinement. Above $T_C$, the damping-like contribution to spin-orbit field is significantly enhanced while the field-like contribution is suppressed, with the two contributions exhibiting opposite field dependencies. We show that these behaviors are consistent with fluctuation driven mixing between the longitudinal and transverse interfacial spin conductances, which enhances absorption of transversely polarized spin current by the ferromagnet. This mechanism can be activated below $T_C$ by engineering the microscopic magnetic state and by harnessing spin current-generated short-wavelength magnons, suggesting a spintronic analog of heat-assisted magnetic recording.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate, show, consistent with, suggesting）；研究对象：超薄铁磁薄膜异质结中，由磁涨落驱动的自旋轨道转矩（spin-orbit torque）行为，特别是居里温度（\(T_C\)）附近的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在居里温度以上，阻尼类自旋轨道场显著增强，而场类自旋轨道场被抑制，两者表现出相反的场依赖性。这一行为源于磁涨落驱动的纵向与横向界面自旋电导的混合，增强了铁磁体对横向极化自旋流的吸收。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在居里温度以上，阻尼类自旋轨道场显著增强，而场类自旋轨道场被抑制，两者表现出相反的场依赖性。这一行为源于磁涨落驱动的纵向与横向界面自旋电导的混合，增强了铁磁体对横向极化自旋流的吸收。；创新点：揭示了磁涨落对自旋轨道转矩的调控作用，并提出该机制可在居里温度以下通过工程化微观磁态或利用自旋流产生的短波长磁子来激活，类似于自旋电子学中的热辅助磁记录。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于界面自旋电导的涨落驱动混合机制，并与自旋流吸收模型结合进行解释。

papers.title: Local Markov Order and Global Inference in Many-Body Dynamics
papers.abstract: We consider how the presence of conserved charges affects memory in a classical stochastic process, the symmetric exclusion process, with an observer constantly measuring a single site. We find that the observer's measurement record becomes Markovian (i.e., loses memory) on a timescale that depends on their knowledge of the global charge, namely the total particle number. In particular, when the global charge is unknown a priori, the observer's time series Markovianizes on a timescale constrained by their ability to learn it from their measurement record. Augmenting the observer's record with bulk measurements drives a charge-learnability transition between charge-fuzzy and -sharp phases. We show that the memory timescale tracks the learnability timescale, diverging in the fuzzy phase and remaining finite in the sharp phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“classical stochastic process”、“symmetric exclusion process”、“observer’s measurement record”、“Markovianizes”、“charge-learnability transition”。；研究对象：经典随机过程——对称排斥过程（symmetric exclusion process）中，由守恒荷（总粒子数）导致的记忆效应与全局推断问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 观测者的测量记录在全局电荷（总粒子数）未知时，其马尔可夫化（记忆丧失）的时间尺度受限于观测者从记录中学习到全局电荷的能力；通过引入体测量可驱动电荷可学习性相变，记忆时间尺度在“模糊相”发散，在“尖锐相”保持有限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：观测者的测量记录在全局电荷（总粒子数）未知时，其马尔可夫化（记忆丧失）的时间尺度受限于观测者从记录中学习到全局电荷的能力；通过引入体测量可驱动电荷可学习性相变，记忆时间尺度在“模糊相”发散，在“尖锐相”保持有限。；创新点：揭示了在经典多体动力学中，全局守恒量的未知性如何决定局部观测记忆时间尺度的物理机制，并首次提出“电荷可学习性相变”这一概念，将记忆时间尺度与信息学习动力学直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于对称排斥过程的随机动力学模型，结合观测者单点连续测量与全局电荷推断的信息论框架，分析测量记录的时间序列马尔可夫化条件及电荷可学习性相变。

papers.title: Origin of the reaction temperature in solid-state materials synthesis
papers.abstract: Temperature plays a crucial role in solid-state materials synthesis, but there is currently no mechanistic theory to explain or predict which temperature is best to conduct a solid-state reaction. Reactions between powder precursors are conventionally assumed to be slow diffusion-limited processes; however, recent in situ experiments show that solid-state reactions can complete in minutes above a critical onset temperature. Here, we present evidence that a transient liquid phase forms above the metastable eutectic temperature, and that this non-equilibrium liquid serves as a fast diffusion medium to intermix precursors and initiate a solid-state reaction. This thermodynamic principle is agnostic to the structure or chemistry of the reactants, and can be applied towards the synthesis and manufacturing of a wide range of complex materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mechanistic theory、thermodynamic principle、evidence）；研究对象：固态材料合成中的反应温度起源，具体涉及粉末前驱体之间的固态反应及瞬态液相的形成机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 固态反应在临界起始温度以上会形成瞬态液相（非平衡液体），该液相作为快速扩散介质促进前驱体混合并启动反应，从而解释了固态反应的最佳温度来源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：固态反应在临界起始温度以上会形成瞬态液相（非平衡液体），该液相作为快速扩散介质促进前驱体混合并启动反应，从而解释了固态反应的最佳温度来源。；创新点：提出一个与反应物结构或化学性质无关的热力学原理，用于解释和预测固态反应的最佳温度，突破了传统认为固态反应是缓慢扩散限制过程的假设。
papers.method_zh: 基于热力学原理分析，结合近期原位实验观察（如固态反应可在数分钟内完成）作为证据支撑，未使用具体计算或实验手段名称。

papers.title: BatteryMat: a hierarchical machine-learning and DFT framework for average-voltage screening of lithium-ion cathode materials
papers.abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) predicts cathode voltages accurately but does not scale to the combinatorial chemical spaces of modern materials databases, while pure machine-learning surrogates are fast but cannot guarantee thermodynamic consistency. We introduce BatteryMat, a three-tier framework that promotes single-pass average-voltage prediction with the Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network (ALIGNN) as the primary screening signal across JARVIS-DFT, then validates survivors with ALIGNN-FF force-field delithiation profiles and automated PBE+U or optB88-vdW+U supercell DFT. The exchange-correlation functional is selected automatically by spacegroup, and the lithium metal reference is recomputed in the same plane-wave basis as the cathode runs, removing a systematic offset of about 1 V present in tabulated values. Trained on 7,610 ALIGNN-FF delithiation voltages, the ALIGNN predictor reproduces the force-field labels with a mean absolute error of 0.17 V and a coefficient of determination of 0.94; this measures distillation fidelity to the force-field protocol, not agreement with DFT or experiment. On four commercial chemistries (LiFePO4, LiMnPO4, LiMn2O4, LiCoO2) the DFT tier reproduces the experimental average voltage to within 0.3 V and the theoretical volumetric capacity to within 5%; a fifth, non-stoichiometric layered entry is carried as an edge case. The pipeline prioritises, rather than generates, existing structures: it ranks the lithium-containing JARVIS-DFT pool into 71 candidates and a scan of about 4.49 million Alexandria structures into 213, all surrogate-level leads awaiting DFT validation rather than confirmed cathodes. BatteryMat is available at https://github.com/atomgptlab/batterymat with a demo at https://atomgpt.org/battery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning、DFT、force-field、screening。；研究对象：锂离子电池正极材料的平均电压筛选，具体涉及多种锂化合物（如LiFePO₄、LiMnPO₄、LiMn₂O₄、LiCoO₂）及非化学计量层状材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个三级分层框架BatteryMat，结合机器学习（ALIGNN）与DFT（PBE+U或optB88-vdW+U），能够高效筛选锂离子正极材料的平均电压，在四种商业化学体系中DFT层复现实验平均电压误差在0.3 V以内，理论体积容量误差在5%以内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个三级分层框架BatteryMat，结合机器学习（ALIGNN）与DFT（PBE+U或optB88-vdW+U），能够高效筛选锂离子正极材料的平均电压，在四种商业化学体系中DFT层复现实验平均电压误差在0.3 V以内，理论体积容量误差在5%以内。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三级框架：第一级用Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network (ALIGNN) 对JARVIS-DFT数据库进行快速筛选；第二级用ALIGNN-FF力场进行脱锂轮廓模拟；第三级用自动选择的PBE+U或optB88-vdW+U进行超胞DFT计算。锂金属参考电极在同一平面波基组下重新计算，以消除约1 V的系统偏移。

papers.title: Irregular Metamaterial Networks
papers.abstract: Metamaterials can achieve exceptional functionality through careful engineering of their mesoscale structure. Although appropriately introduced irregularities can be advantageous, current approaches largely conform to regular structures to preserve tractability. Here, we contend that network theory, enriched with geometry and physics, provides a natural framework for designing metamaterials with controlled irregularities at relevant scales, thereby enabling the discovery of new property-enhancing structures. We examine how this augmented network theory can facilitate the creation of irregular metamaterials with enhanced or novel properties and how metamaterial research, in turn, is opening new directions in network science. Supported by machine learning and advanced self-assembly, the emerging field of irregular metamaterial networks is poised to transform inverse design and scalable manufacturing of novel materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：network theory, machine learning, inverse design）；研究对象：非规则超材料网络（irregular metamaterial networks），即通过引入可控非规则性（irregularities）来设计具有增强或新颖性能的超材料结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结合几何与物理的网络理论为设计具有可控非规则性的超材料提供了自然框架，有望发现新的性能增强结构，并推动超材料逆向设计与可规模化制造。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结合几何与物理的网络理论为设计具有可控非规则性的超材料提供了自然框架，有望发现新的性能增强结构，并推动超材料逆向设计与可规模化制造。；创新点：提出将网络理论扩展至超材料设计，系统性地利用而非回避非规则性，从而开辟“非规则超材料网络”这一新兴方向，并指出超材料研究反过来可推动网络科学的新发展。
papers.method_zh: 网络理论（network theory）结合几何与物理分析，辅以机器学习（machine learning）和先进自组装（advanced self-assembly）方法。

papers.title: Semilocal exchange functionals from the exact-exchange condition for the hydrogen atom: Hydrogenic exactness and recovery of Rydberg-like bound states
papers.abstract: In semilocal density functionals the exchange potential decays too rapidly outside atoms and molecules and lacks the correct $-1/r$ tail; as a consequence, functionals from PBE to modern meta-GGAs such as SCAN support no bound Rydberg-like state of an atom. We revisit the gradient-corrected exchange functional that Gill and Pople (GP93) constructed to reproduce the exact exchange potential of the hydrogen atom, solve their equation as an inverse problem, and use the resulting enhancement factor -- the GP93 factor -- as a tail-generating ingredient of a switched semilocal functional. The GP93 factor is exact on the hydrogen $1s$ density and, by uniform coordinate scaling, on hydrogenic $1s$ ions, where it yields the eigenvalue $-Z^2/2$ exactly (hydrogenic exactness). Its large-gradient growth has the hydrogen-exact form $O[s(\ln s)^{2/3}]$, distinct from the $s\ln s$ form of Armiento and Kümmel. The factor is combined with a kinetic-energy-density indicator so that its divergent branch acts only in one-electron-like regions; the GP93 ingredient is nonempirical, while a few switching parameters are calibrated to balance tail recovery against self-consistent-field stability. The resulting functional produces Rydberg-like series of bound virtual Kohn--Sham states in systems whose outermost shell is a one-electron-like $s$ shell -- all-electron H and He, and Li, Na, and K with large-core pseudopotentials -- and moves the highest-occupied eigenvalue toward the experimental ionization energy. For $p$-shell atoms (Ne, Ar) the switch closes, so the domain of applicability is fixed by design. Fixed-density tests indicate that a reduced-Laplacian switch distinguishes atomic tails from covalent bond centers, and that a density-only kinetic-energy functional renders the entire switch orbital-independent, so that no generalized Kohn--Sham solver is required.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“semilocal density functionals”、“exchange functional”、“inverse problem”、“enhancement factor”、“fixed-density tests”等，属于密度泛函理论（DFT）的泛函构造与测试。；研究对象：论文研究的具体对象是原子（氢原子、氦原子、锂、钠、钾等）中的Rydberg-like束缚态，以及半局域交换泛函在原子外部的渐近行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过重新求解Gill和Pople（GP93）为氢原子精确交换势构造的梯度修正交换泛函，得到GP93增强因子，该因子在氢原子1s密度上精确，并能在类氢离子中精确给出本征值 \(-Z^2/2\)（氢原子精确性）。将其作为开关型半局域泛函的尾部生成成分，可以恢复原子中Rydberg-like束缚态系列，并将最高占据轨道本征值推向实验电离能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过重新求解Gill和Pople（GP93）为氢原子精确交换势构造的梯度修正交换泛函，得到GP93增强因子，该因子在氢原子1s密度上精确，并能在类氢离子中精确给出本征值 \(-Z^2/2\)（氢原子精确性）。将其作为开关型半局域泛函的尾部生成成分，可以恢复原子中Rydberg-like束缚态系列，并将最高占据轨道本征值推向实验电离能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用逆问题方法求解GP93方程，得到增强因子；将其与动能密度指示器结合，使发散分支仅在类单电子区域起作用；通过少量开关参数校准，平衡尾部恢复与自洽场稳定性。使用固定密度测试验证约化拉普拉斯开关和仅依赖密度的动能泛函的轨道无关性。

papers.title: DNA handles bias force-dependent looping times
papers.abstract: DNA loop formation is a key mechanism in gene regulation, and looping kinetics are sensitive to mechanical tension acting on the DNA. In both single-molecule experiments and biological settings, this tension is typically transmitted through DNA segments flanking the looping region, rather than acting directly at the looping sites. How this indirect force transmission affects the looping time has not been systematically investigated. Using molecular dynamics simulations of a wormlike chain, we show that such flanking segments significantly steepen the force dependence of the looping time, an effect that is insensitive to their length once it exceeds the persistence length, and vanishes when the junction to the looping region is made flexible. We develop an analytical framework that accounts for this effect through a force-dependent shift in the effective free energy landscape of the looping segment. In the limit of small forces, this shift reduces to a zero-force equilibrium average, after which the entire force dependence of the looping time follows analytically. Applying this framework using a coarse-grained DNA model that treats individual bases as rigid bodies, we obtain predictions in quantitative agreement with experimental looping data. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of force transmission has a significant and predictable effect on looping kinetics, with direct implications for the interpretation of tension-dependent looping in both single-molecule experiments and gene regulatory contexts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：使用了分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations）和解析框架（analytical framework），并基于粗粒化DNA模型（coarse-grained DNA model）进行预测。；研究对象：DNA环化动力学（DNA looping kinetics），具体研究机械张力通过DNA侧翼片段（flanking segments）间接传递时对环化时间（looping time）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 侧翼DNA片段会显著增强环化时间对力的依赖性，且当侧翼长度超过持久长度后该效应不再敏感；当环化区域与侧翼的连接点变得柔性时，该效应消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：侧翼DNA片段会显著增强环化时间对力的依赖性，且当侧翼长度超过持久长度后该效应不再敏感；当环化区域与侧翼的连接点变得柔性时，该效应消失。；创新点：系统揭示了力传递几何结构（而非仅力的大小）对DNA环化动力学的显著且可预测的影响，并建立了从零力平衡平均量出发解析推导整个力依赖关系的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用蠕虫链模型（wormlike chain）的分子动力学模拟，以及一个考虑力依赖有效自由能景观偏移的解析框架。进一步使用将单个碱基视为刚体的粗粒化DNA模型进行定量预测。

papers.title: Variational Learning with Sparse Long-range Entangling Gates
papers.abstract: The performance of variational quantum algorithms depends in general on the structure of the parametrized quantum circuit, but the most common ansätze are typically based on local couplings. Motivated by the extended connectivity available with neutral atoms and trapped ions, we examine when structured long-range connectivity provides a useful resource, focusing on sparse power-of-two (PWR2) coupling graphs. Using dynamical Lie-algebra analysis, approximate unitary-design diagnostics, and finite-depth measures of expressibility and entanglement, we examine how these geometries enlarge the accessible operator space. This enlarged space alone is not sufficient to ensure trainability of the parameterized circuit for given target problems, and we explore performance across example problems with and without long-range coupling, identifying where sparse coupling graphs are or are not likely to provide an advantage. We also introduce a variational scheme that maps hierarchical long-range Hamiltonians to geometrically local ones that can be optimized with short-range circuits. Together, these results identify circuit geometry and qubit reconfigurability as task-dependent resources for variational algorithms, relevant to ongoing developments in quantum hardware with long-range connectivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Dynamical Lie-algebra analysis”、“approximate unitary-design diagnostics”、“finite-depth measures”等理论分析工具，以及“variational scheme”等算法设计。；研究对象：变分量子算法（VQA）中参数化量子电路的几何结构，特别是稀疏长程纠缠门（如PWR2耦合图）对算法性能的影响。研究对象是抽象的量子电路模型，而非具体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稀疏的长程连接（如PWR2图）可以扩大变分电路可访问的算子空间，但这本身并不保证电路的可训练性。电路几何结构（长程vs短程）的优势是任务依赖的，并可通过映射方案将层级长程哈密顿量转化为可用短程电路优化的局域问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稀疏的长程连接（如PWR2图）可以扩大变分电路可访问的算子空间，但这本身并不保证电路的可训练性。电路几何结构（长程vs短程）的优势是任务依赖的，并可通过映射方案将层级长程哈密顿量转化为可用短程电路优化的局域问题。；创新点：系统性地研究了稀疏长程耦合图（PWR2）在变分量子算法中的资源角色，并提出了一个将层级长程问题映射到局域电路进行优化的具体方案，明确了电路几何结构是任务依赖的资源。
papers.method_zh: 1. 动力学李代数分析；2. 近似酉设计诊断；3. 有限深度下的表达能力和纠缠度量；4. 针对示例问题（有无长程耦合）的性能对比；5. 提出一种将层级长程哈密顿量映射为几何局域哈密顿量的变分方案。

papers.title: Spin Textures and Eigenstate Evolution of Isospectrally Patterned Lattices
papers.abstract: Isospectrally patterned lattices exhibit a composite band structure with a tunable ratio of localized versus delocalized eigenstates that is controlled by the underlying phase gradient. We show that the lattice Hamiltonian can be interpreted as that of a single spin exposed to a rotating magnetic field which is allowed to hop with a spin-flip across the lattice. In the low- and high-energy part of the band the localized states show an envelope of oscillatory character separated by quasi-nodes. Spin peaks occur at the locations of these quasi-nodes and provide a unique spin texture to the eigenstates which becomes increasingly complex with increasing degree of excitation. The crossover from localization to delocalization and vice versa leaves its fingerprints in the Fourier spectrum of the eigenstates: the original bimodal frequency distribution widens with increasing degree of excitation, moves across the spectral window and finally culminates in an extremely narrow frequency peak. In the course of this evolution the spin texture undergoes a rearrangement transition involving different characteristic (ir)regular patterns which we quantify by considering the total variation of the local spin fluctuations. Our results demonstrate the variety of the spectral properties of isospectrally patterned lattices which holds great prospect in particular when considering higher lattice or cell dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“lattice Hamiltonian can be interpreted as that of a single spin exposed to a rotating magnetic field”，并讨论能谱、本征态演化、傅里叶谱等理论分析，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：等谱图案化晶格（isospectrally patterned lattices）中的自旋织构与本征态演化，具体研究局域态与扩展态共存的可调能带结构及其自旋纹理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 等谱图案化晶格的本征态在低能和高能部分呈现振荡包络与准节点，自旋峰出现在准节点位置，形成独特的自旋织构；随着激发程度增加，本征态的傅里叶谱从双峰分布演变为极窄单峰，自旋织构经历重排转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：等谱图案化晶格的本征态在低能和高能部分呈现振荡包络与准节点，自旋峰出现在准节点位置，形成独特的自旋织构；随着激发程度增加，本征态的傅里叶谱从双峰分布演变为极窄单峰，自旋织构经历重排转变。；创新点：揭示了等谱图案化晶格中局域态与扩展态交叉演化过程中自旋织构的复杂重排行为，并首次通过傅里叶谱的演变和自旋涨落总变分定量刻画了从局域到退局域的指纹特征。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将晶格哈密顿量映射为在旋转磁场中自旋的跳跃模型（含自旋翻转项），通过分析本征态的傅里叶谱和局域自旋涨落的总变分来量化自旋织构的（非）规则模式。

papers.title: Bayesian Learning of Distance Metrics Beyond RMSD for Biomolecule Alignment, Clustering, and Domain Identification
papers.abstract: Root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) is the standard metric of structural comparison in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. In its conventional form, RMSD assigns equal weight to all atoms regardless of mobility. Hence, flexible loops and disordered regions can dominate a global RMSD, while the rigid functional core contributes negligibly to the overall metric. To address this issue, we introduce the Bayes-optimal RMSD (BRMSD), which optimizes per-atom weights jointly with structural averages by maximizing a Bayesian posterior. In a trade-off between low RMSD and weight uniformity, a position-fluctuation parameter $σ$ controls the transition from classical RMSD ($σ\to \infty$) to a progressive focus on a rigid core ($σ\to 0$). The BRMSD framework supports analysis modules for structural alignment, focused alignment onto a user-specified domain, trajectory smoothing, soft $K$-means conformational clustering, and rigid-domain identification. These modules are implemented in the open-source Python package BRMSD (https://github.com/bio-phys/BRMSD) and benchmarked on two MD systems, the endoplasmic reticulum translocon-associated protein SND3 and the phosphotransferase adenylate kinase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Bayesian learning、maximizing a Bayesian posterior、open-source Python package。；研究对象：生物分子动力学（MD）模拟中的结构比较与对齐问题，具体体系为内质网转位子相关蛋白SND3和磷酸转移酶腺苷酸激酶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出贝叶斯最优RMSD（BRMSD），通过优化每个原子的权重，解决了传统RMSD对柔性区域和刚性核心权重不均的问题，实现了对分子刚性核心的聚焦分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出贝叶斯最优RMSD（BRMSD），通过优化每个原子的权重，解决了传统RMSD对柔性区域和刚性核心权重不均的问题，实现了对分子刚性核心的聚焦分析。；创新点：将贝叶斯学习引入RMSD的原子权重优化，使得权重可随原子运动性自适应调整，从而在结构比较中自动突出刚性功能核心，抑制柔性区域的干扰。
papers.method_zh: 贝叶斯后验最大化方法，联合优化原子权重与结构平均；引入位置涨落参数σ控制从经典RMSD到刚性核心聚焦的过渡；开发了结构对齐、聚焦对齐、轨迹平滑、软K均值构象聚类和刚性域识别等分析模块，并在开源Python包BRMSD中实现。

papers.title: Rayleigh Bound States in the Continuum
papers.abstract: We predict a class of bound states in the continuum (BICs) in non-subwavelength periodic metasurfaces -- Rayleigh BICs -- that emerge precisely at Rayleigh anomalies, where diffraction channels open. In contrast to conventional symmetry-protected and accidental BICs, which are typically engineered in the subwavelength regime with only a few radiation channels, Rayleigh BICs remain nonradiating far beyond this limit, even when multiple diffraction channels are open. Their formation originates from the interplay between collective lattice resonances, Rayleigh anomalies, and anapole states of the constituent metaatoms. We show that Rayleigh BICs are characterized by an unusual cubic scaling of the quality factor in reciprocal space, ($Q \propto 1/k^3$), an asymptotic behavior that is not characteristic of either symmetry-protected or accidental BICs. Our results establish a constructive route for engineering nonradiating states in metasurfaces beyond the subwavelength regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“predict”（预测）、“show”（展示）、“establish”（建立），以及理论推导（如品质因子标度律 \( Q \propto 1/k^3 \)），未提及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：非亚波长周期性超表面中的连续谱束缚态（BIC），具体为一种新型的“瑞利BIC”，其出现在瑞利异常（衍射通道开启）处。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测了一类在非亚波长超表面中于瑞利异常处出现的连续谱束缚态（瑞利BIC），其品质因子在倒空间中呈现反常的立方标度（\( Q \propto 1/k^3 \)），且即使在多个衍射通道开启时仍保持非辐射特性，突破了传统BIC仅适用于亚波长体系的限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测了一类在非亚波长超表面中于瑞利异常处出现的连续谱束缚态（瑞利BIC），其品质因子在倒空间中呈现反常的立方标度（\( Q \propto 1/k^3 \)），且即使在多个衍射通道开启时仍保持非辐射特性，突破了传统BIC仅适用于亚波长体系的限制。；创新点：首次提出并系统描述了在非亚波长（即超表面周期大于工作波长）条件下，于瑞利异常处产生的BIC，其品质因子标度律（立方标度）与传统的对称保护型或偶然型BIC（通常为平方标度）截然不同，为非亚波长超表面中非辐射态的设计提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与推导。基于集体晶格共振、瑞利异常和组成超原子的环形偶极态（anapole states）之间的相互作用，建立了瑞利BIC的形成机制，并推导了其品质因子在倒空间中的渐近标度行为。

papers.title: Scalar-Wave Dispersion in Vectorial Photonic Crystals via Site-Adapted p Orbitals
papers.abstract: Electromagnetic waves are intrinsically vectorial and require description via polarization, unlike scalar fields such as acoustic pressure or electronic wavefunctions. In three dimensions, the transversality constraint further prevents any globally smooth transverse-polarization frame at the $Γ$ point, which would apparently rule out a simple scalar band structure for three-dimensional (3D) photonic crystals. We show here that site-adapted $p$-orbitals can realize scalar-wave dispersion: the induced band representation is isomorphic to the scalar elementary band representation up to a one-dimensional character twist, so the symmetry-enforced degeneracies and compatibility relations are the same. We demonstrate this mechanism experimentally in 3D photonic meta-crystals, where the local $p$-orbital axes adapt from site to site according to symmetry. In contrast to a fixed-polarization reduction (e.g., in 2D), our construction preserves site-polarization textures while simultaneously supporting a scalar network with one amplitude per site. Thus, it offers a pathway from vectorial photonic degrees of freedom to scalar band engineering, keeping polarization as an active design knob.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+实验混合类型。判断依据：摘要中既有理论分析（“We show here that site-adapted p-orbitals can realize scalar-wave dispersion”），又有实验验证（“We demonstrate this mechanism experimentally in 3D photonic meta-crystals”）。；研究对象：三维光子晶体中的电磁波色散行为，特别是通过位点适配p轨道实现标量波传播的机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过位点适配的p轨道，可以在三维光子晶体中实现标量波色散，其诱导的能带表示与标量基本能带表示同构（仅差一维特征标扭转），从而具有相同的对称性强制简并和相容性关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过位点适配的p轨道，可以在三维光子晶体中实现标量波色散，其诱导的能带表示与标量基本能带表示同构（仅差一维特征标扭转），从而具有相同的对称性强制简并和相容性关系。；创新点：与固定偏振简化（如二维情况）不同，该构造在保持位点偏振织构的同时，支持每个位点仅有一个振幅的标量网络，从而为从矢量光子自由度到标量能带工程提供了一条路径，并将偏振作为主动设计旋钮。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面采用能带表示理论分析（诱导能带表示与标量基本能带表示的对比）；实验方面在三维光子超晶体中构建位点适配p轨道结构，通过实验测量验证标量波色散特性。

papers.title: Interaction of vortex rings generated by two unsynchronised drop impacts
papers.abstract: A liquid drop falling into a deep pool can create a vortex ring at the right impact conditions. Such drop-formed vortex rings are of importance in nature and technology and the dynamics of rings created by single and synchronised double drop impacts have been extensively studied. In practice, two neighbouring drops rarely impact a liquid surface exactly at the same time, yet the interaction of two unsynchronised vortex rings have not been studied. Here, we have performed experiments with two water drops impacting a water pool at varying time differences $Δt$. By using particle image velocimetry, we have quantified the time-evolution of the resulting vortex rings. We find four distinct categories of vortex ring evolution depending on $Δt$. At $Δt<0.5$ ms, fully symmetric merging of the vortex rings occur. An unsynchronisation larger than this drastically influences the collision and merging, which either becomes asymmetric and incomplete ($0.5 < Δt<7$ ms) or does not happen at all ($Δt \geq 7$ ms). At $7 \leq Δt<80$ ms, the creation of the second vortex ring is impaired, whereas at $Δt\geq 80$ ms, the first impact no longer affects the formation of the second ring and eventually the two rings evolve without influencing each other. We show that these different regimes can be explained by the capillary waves created by the first droplet. Our results demonstrate the importance of the time difference between drop impacts in the creation and subsequent interaction of two adjacent drop-formed vortex rings, which is important for achieving uniform and controlled mixing in high-throughput applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experiments、particle image velocimetry、quantified。；研究对象：两个非同步液滴撞击水面后产生的涡环之间的相互作用，具体为不同时间差下涡环的演化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 根据两个液滴撞击时间差Δt的不同，涡环演化可分为四种截然不同的类型：完全对称合并（Δt<0.5 ms）、不对称不完全合并（0.5<Δt<7 ms）、第二个涡环生成受损（7≤Δt<80 ms）、以及两个涡环互不影响（Δt≥80 ms）。这些不同行为可由第一个液滴产生的毛细波解释。
