papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：根据两个液滴撞击时间差Δt的不同，涡环演化可分为四种截然不同的类型：完全对称合并（Δt<0.5 ms）、不对称不完全合并（0.5<Δt<7 ms）、第二个涡环生成受损（7≤Δt<80 ms）、以及两个涡环互不影响（Δt≥80 ms）。这些不同行为可由第一个液滴产生的毛细波解释。；创新点：首次系统研究了两个非同步液滴撞击产生的涡环之间的相互作用，揭示了时间差对涡环合并、生成及独立演化的决定性影响，并指出毛细波是导致不同演化模式的关键机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验采用两个水滴撞击水池，通过改变撞击时间差Δt，利用粒子图像测速技术（Particle Image Velocimetry）定量测量涡环的时间演化。

papers.title: Reconnection diagnostics for vortex tangles in Bose-condensed and superfluid dark matter halos
papers.abstract: Bose-Einstein-condensed (BEC) and superfluid dark-matter (SFDM) halos can contain coherent, wave-supported cores whose angular momentum is carried by quantized vortices. When vortices form a tangle, reconnections convert part of the vortex kinetic energy into dark phonons, density waves, Kelvin waves, and vortex loops, providing a microscopic channel by which SFDM vortex structure can affect halo-core evolution. We estimate the dynamical importance of this channel by combining the local Gross-Pitaevskii reconnection law with a halo-scale vortex-line density calibrated against Schrödinger-Poisson simulations. In the minimal model the released energy stays in the dark sector, and standard-model luminosity requires additional portal physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Gross-Pitaevskii reconnection law、Schrödinger-Poisson simulations、theoretical estimate）；研究对象：玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）和超流暗物质（SFDM）晕中的涡旋缠结，特别是涡旋重联过程对晕核演化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 涡旋缠结中的重联过程可将部分涡旋动能转化为暗声子、密度波、开尔文波和涡旋环，为超流暗物质涡旋结构影响晕核演化提供微观能量耗散通道；但在最小模型中，释放的能量仍留在暗物质扇区，不产生标准模型可观测的光度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：涡旋缠结中的重联过程可将部分涡旋动能转化为暗声子、密度波、开尔文波和涡旋环，为超流暗物质涡旋结构影响晕核演化提供微观能量耗散通道；但在最小模型中，释放的能量仍留在暗物质扇区，不产生标准模型可观测的光度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合局域Gross-Pitaevskii重联定律与基于薛定谔-泊松模拟标定的晕尺度涡旋线密度，对能量释放的动力学重要性进行理论估算。

papers.title: Spontaneous patterning of cell size on curved surfaces
papers.abstract: Tissue surfaces exhibit complex curvature during embryogenesis and oncogenesis. Evidence shows that cells can actively sense curvature to regulate behavior and fate, yet the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Here, we develop a vertex model for arbitrary curved surfaces and uncover spontaneous cell size patterning on ellipsoidal surfaces: cells in high-curvature regions are consistently larger than those in low-curvature regions. This non-uniformity arises from a mechanical competition encoded in Riemannian geometry: positive Gaussian curvature reduces the perimeter-to-area ratio of polygonal cells, relaxing cell-edge tension in high-curvature regions, which is compensated by area expansion to maintain global force balance. This area pattern is robust against variations in model parameters and matches observations in biological systems. The perimeter pattern, in contrast, is governed by competition between the intrinsic geometric tendency and the deformation required by force balance, and undergoes reversal beyond a critical shape index. Together, these findings establish self-organized spatial variations in cell size as a potential physical mechanism for curvature sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：vertex model, Riemannian geometry, mechanical competition）；研究对象：细胞在弯曲组织表面（如椭球面）上的自发尺寸图案化现象，具体研究细胞如何感知曲率并调控自身大小。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在椭球面上，细胞会自发形成尺寸图案：高曲率区域的细胞尺寸更大，低曲率区域的细胞尺寸更小。这种非均匀性源于黎曼几何编码的力学竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在椭球面上，细胞会自发形成尺寸图案：高曲率区域的细胞尺寸更大，低曲率区域的细胞尺寸更小。这种非均匀性源于黎曼几何编码的力学竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 开发了一个适用于任意弯曲表面的顶点模型（vertex model），并结合黎曼几何分析，通过计算细胞周长与面积比、边缘张力等力学量，研究曲率对细胞尺寸的影响。

papers.title: Radiation Damage Cascades in Fullerite Using Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract: Molecular dynamics is used to study radiation cascades in solid C60 under ambient conditions. Simulations are performed for Primary Knock-On Atom (PKA) energies from 0.1 to 1 keV, and cascades are sampled over many PKA directions to collect statistics. Energies and forces are described using the Environment Dependent Interaction Potential for carbon paired with the Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark potential for short-range interactions, and cascade behaviour is characterized by tracking kinetic energy, hybridization and bond connectivity as a function of time. Compared to most materials, fullerite exhibits an unusual radiation response due to weak thermal transfer between C60 molecules leading to a thermalization phase lasting hundreds of picoseconds. The cascades damage the C60 molecules and link them together, and a linear relation is found between the number of cross-linked molecules and the number of new sp3 atoms. The threshold displacement energy computed is 18 eV, in agreement with experiments
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Molecular dynamics（分子动力学）、simulations（模拟）。；研究对象：固体C60（富勒烯）在环境条件下的辐射损伤级联过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 富勒烯因C60分子间热传递弱，导致热化阶段持续数百皮秒；辐射级联会破坏C60分子并使其交联，且交联分子数与新生成的sp3碳原子数呈线性关系；计算得到的位移阈能为18 eV，与实验一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：富勒烯因C60分子间热传递弱，导致热化阶段持续数百皮秒；辐射级联会破坏C60分子并使其交联，且交联分子数与新生成的sp3碳原子数呈线性关系；计算得到的位移阈能为18 eV，与实验一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟，结合环境依赖相互作用势（EDIP）和Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark短程势描述碳原子间的能量与力；对初级撞击原子（PKA）能量从0.1到1 keV进行模拟，并对多个PKA方向采样以收集统计结果；通过追踪动能、杂化状态和键连通性随时间的变化来表征级联行为。

papers.title: Invariant Measures for Soliton Systems Generated by Mealy Automata
papers.abstract: We study invariant measures for soliton systems described by Mealy automata. Motivated by recently introduced soliton models associated with 2-letter, 3-state Mealy automata, we formulate the time evolution induced by Mealy automata on bi-infinite configuration spaces. We provide sufficient conditions for the invariance of Bernoulli product measures and derive a criterion for the invariance of two-sided space-homogeneous Markov distributions. We then apply these general results to three soliton models, which can be interpreted as variants of the box-ball system (BBS). For two of these models, BBS-S(2) and BBS-V(2), we prove that Bernoulli product measures are invariant. For the remaining model, BBS-C(2), we establish a more general result: the invariance of two-sided space-homogeneous Markov distributions, which include Bernoulli product measures as a special case. Furthermore, for all three models, we compute the phase shift associated with the interaction of two solitons, as well as the velocity of an isolated soliton. Although the latter has already been studied previously, both quantities constitute fundamental characteristics for understanding the generalized hydrodynamics of these systems. These results provide a foundation for the study of invariant measures, generalized Gibbs ensembles, and generalized hydrodynamic behavior in Mealy-automaton soliton systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论“formulate the time evolution”、“provide sufficient conditions”、“derive a criterion”等理论推导和条件分析，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：由Mealy自动机生成的孤子系统，特别是可解释为盒-球系统（BBS）变体的三种孤子模型（BBS-S(2)、BBS-V(2)、BBS-C(2)）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了对于BBS-S(2)和BBS-V(2)模型，伯努利乘积测度是守恒的；对于BBS-C(2)模型，更一般地证明了双侧空间齐次马尔可夫分布（包含伯努利乘积测度作为特例）的守恒性。此外，计算了所有三种模型中两个孤子相互作用时的相移以及孤立孤子的速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了对于BBS-S(2)和BBS-V(2)模型，伯努利乘积测度是守恒的；对于BBS-C(2)模型，更一般地证明了双侧空间齐次马尔可夫分布（包含伯努利乘积测度作为特例）的守恒性。此外，计算了所有三种模型中两个孤子相互作用时的相移以及孤立孤子的速度。；创新点：将Mealy自动机描述的孤子系统与守恒测度理论系统性地联系起来，为研究这类系统的广义吉布斯系综和广义流体动力学提供了基础。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于Mealy自动机在双无限位形空间上定义时间演化，推导伯努利乘积测度守恒的充分条件，以及双侧空间齐次马尔可夫分布守恒的判据，并将这些一般结果应用于具体孤子模型。

papers.title: Anyon-induced non-Hermitian topological phases
papers.abstract: We show that anyonic exchange statistics can activate non-Hermitian point-gap topology in models that are topologically trivial in its absence. The emergent topology oscillates more rapidly with the statistical phase as the anyon number increases, and exhibits a parity dependence on the particle number. A perturbative analysis reveals the mechanism: fractional statistics induces a mismatch between momentum terms that, combined with sublattice-dependent dissipation, produces particle-number-dependent non-reciprocity and complex spectral winding. As these effects rely on the formation and exchange of interaction-bound anyons, our results establish exchange statistics as a resource for enabling non-Hermitian topology under programmed dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、analysis、reveals、mechanism、establish。；研究对象：任意子（anyon）交换统计诱导的非厄米拓扑相，具体关注点-隙拓扑（point-gap topology）在非厄米系统中的激活与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任意子的分数化交换统计可以激活原本拓扑平庸模型中的非厄米点-隙拓扑，且该拓扑随统计相位振荡，振荡频率随任意子数目增加而加快，并表现出对粒子数奇偶性的依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任意子的分数化交换统计可以激活原本拓扑平庸模型中的非厄米点-隙拓扑，且该拓扑随统计相位振荡，振荡频率随任意子数目增加而加快，并表现出对粒子数奇偶性的依赖。；创新点：首次提出将任意子的交换统计作为资源，在程序化耗散（programmed dissipation）条件下实现非厄米拓扑相，揭示了统计相位与拓扑结构之间的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用微扰分析（perturbative analysis）揭示机制：分数统计导致动量项失配，结合子格依赖的耗散（sublattice-dependent dissipation），产生依赖于粒子数的非互易性（non-reciprocity）和复能谱缠绕（complex spectral winding）。

papers.title: Explaining the magnitude of Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity via electron-electron exchange
papers.abstract: Chiral molecular structure can couple to electron spin, leading to unexpected spin polarization effects. This Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity (CISS) was first reported for DNA molecules adsorbed on gold but its microscopic origin remains unclear. We demonstrated though simulation that the exchange arising from electron-electron Coulomb interactions within the self-consistent mean field (Hartree--Fock) approximation can yield significant ($\sim 2\%$) spin polarisation for $3$-methylcyclohexanone adsorbed on Cu(111) amplifying a much smaller ($\sim 0.0014\%$) initial bias, consistent with experiment. Symmetry considerations ensure the result is physically meaningful, while its ab-initio nature ensures all parameters are physically realistic. This amplification is connected to existing studies on spin-symmetry breaking in Hartree--Fock, providing a new pathway for understanding the magnitude of CISS as an emergent phenomenon of interacting electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：simulation、self-consistent mean field (Hartree--Fock) approximation、ab-initio）；研究对象：手性分子吸附体系：3-甲基环己酮（3-methylcyclohexanone）吸附在Cu(111)表面，以及其中由手性诱导的自旋选择性（CISS）效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过电子-电子库仑相互作用产生的交换作用（在自洽平均场Hartree-Fock近似下），可以将初始极小的自旋偏压（约0.0014%）放大至显著的约2%的自旋极化，从而解释CISS效应的量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过电子-电子库仑相互作用产生的交换作用（在自洽平均场Hartree-Fock近似下），可以将初始极小的自旋偏压（约0.0014%）放大至显著的约2%的自旋极化，从而解释CISS效应的量级。；创新点：将CISS效应的显著量级归因于电子-电子相互作用中的交换效应，并将其与Hartree-Fock中自旋对称性破缺的已有研究联系起来，为理解CISS作为相互作用电子涌现现象提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽平均场下的Hartree-Fock近似，通过第一性原理（ab-initio）模拟计算电子-电子交换相互作用对自旋极化的影响。

papers.title: A "squeezed polaron" variational wavefunction for the spin boson model
papers.abstract: The localization transition of the sub-Ohmic spin-boson model generates boson bath correlations that are, at low frequencies, analytically inaccessible to standard coherent-state-polaron variational ansatzes. In this paper, we introduce a ``squeezed polaron'' wavefunction incorporating generic Gaussian boson-boson correlations induced by the spin impurity. This gives the correct critical power-law scaling of bath observables near the localization transition together with a systematically improved ground state energy and a more accurate determination of the critical coupling. Our wavefunction captures the correct mean-field nature of the transition in the deep sub-Ohmic region. It also displays non-mean-field critical exponents in the shallow sub-Ohmic regime. Using the squeezed polaron as a starting point, we derive scattering phase shifts for bosons, and show how they encode the emergent energy scale that vanishes at the localization transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“变分波函数”“解析方法”“临界指数”等理论物理关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：亚欧姆自旋-玻色子模型中的局域化相变，以及由自旋杂质诱导的玻色子浴关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“压缩极化子”变分波函数，能够正确描述亚欧姆自旋-玻色子模型在局域化相变附近玻色子浴观测量的临界幂律标度，并给出更精确的基态能量和临界耦合强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“压缩极化子”变分波函数，能够正确描述亚欧姆自旋-玻色子模型在局域化相变附近玻色子浴观测量的临界幂律标度，并给出更精确的基态能量和临界耦合强度。；创新点：首次在变分波函数中系统引入由自旋杂质诱导的通用高斯型玻色子-玻色子关联，从而克服了标准相干态极化子变分方法在低频区域解析上的不足，并揭示了非平均场临界指数在浅亚欧姆区域的存在。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含高斯型玻色子-玻色子关联的“压缩极化子”变分波函数，推导散射相移，分析临界指数。

papers.title: Universal spin-squeezing dynamics in spinor condensates
papers.abstract: The production of large-scale entangled states is one of the main goals of next-generation quantum technologies, with an immediate potential for applications in the context of entanglement-assisted quantum sensing. A very promising platform to achieve this goal is offered by ultracold spinor gases, made of atoms with a large internal spin sensitive to magnetic fields. Here we show that the native spin-changing collisions in a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate, combined with an arbitrary quadratic Zeeman shift, can generate scalable spin squeezing in the collective spin of the ensemble, following the universal paradigm of the celebrated one-axis-twisting model. Squeezing dynamics is driven by the quadratic Zeeman shift when this shift is small; and by the spin-changing collisions for large shifts, in the form of stroboscopic squeezing. Turning off the Zeeman shift freezes out the collective-spin dynamics, so that the ensuing collective spin dynamics can be uniquely governed by an external field to be sensed. Our theoretical results pave the way for the use of spinor Bose gases with a large spin in fundamental studies of entanglement, as well as in advanced metrological applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show that”、“Our theoretical results”等表述，未提及任何实验数据或计算模拟，核心是理论推导和模型分析。；研究对象：自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（spinor Bose-Einstein condensate）中的集体自旋压缩动力学。具体体系为由具有大内禀自旋的原子组成的超冷自旋气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的自旋改变碰撞与任意二次塞曼位移相结合，可以产生可扩展的自旋压缩，其动力学遵循单轴扭曲模型的普适范式。通过关闭塞曼位移可以冻结集体自旋动力学，从而使其唯一地受待测外场调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的自旋改变碰撞与任意二次塞曼位移相结合，可以产生可扩展的自旋压缩，其动力学遵循单轴扭曲模型的普适范式。通过关闭塞曼位移可以冻结集体自旋动力学，从而使其唯一地受待测外场调控。；创新点：揭示了自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的自旋压缩动力学在不同二次塞曼位移强度下（小位移时由位移驱动，大位移时由碰撞驱动）的普适性行为，并提出了通过开关塞曼位移来冻结集体自旋态以用于量子传感的方案。摘要未突出说明与已有具体实验或理论工作的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架为：基于自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的本征自旋改变碰撞，结合二次塞曼位移，利用单轴扭曲模型（one-axis-twisting model）的普适范式来解析和描述集体自旋的压缩动力学。

papers.title: Hydrogen-Bond Donor-Acceptor Imbalance in Low-Frequency Terahertz Water Spectra
papers.abstract: The low-frequency dielectric response of liquid water is commonly described by a dominant Debye relaxation together with additional faster contributions whose microscopic origin remains debated. Here we show that the dielectric function of water between 0.14 and 1.21 THz can be represented by a collective Debye relaxation plus a Drude-Smith term constrained to the zero-dc-conductivity limit. The Drude-Smith spectral weight increases upon heating pure H2O from 20 C to 50 C and decreases upon isotopic substitution (D2O at 20 C vs. H2O at 20 C). Molecular dynamics simulations including nuclear quantum effects show correlated changes in the population of water molecules with unequal numbers of donated and accepted hydrogen-bonds. Ab-initio-based spectra calculations further indicate that the ~0.1-1 THz response contains both nuclear-motion and explicit electronic-polarisation/charge-redistribution contributions. We therefore interpret the excess low-frequency THz response as a localised, mixed nuclear-electronic dielectric response correlated with transient donor-acceptor imbalance in the hydrogen-bond network.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：实验测量（dielectric function of water between 0.14 and 1.21 THz）、分子动力学模拟（Molecular dynamics simulations）、基于第一性原理的光谱计算（Ab-initio-based spectra calculations）。；研究对象：液态水在低频太赫兹（0.14–1.21 THz）范围内的介电响应，特别是氢键供体-受体不平衡对光谱的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 水的低频太赫兹介电响应可表示为集体德拜弛豫加上一个受限于零直流电导极限的Drude-Smith项；该额外响应的光谱权重随温度升高而增加、随同位素取代（D₂O vs H₂O）而减小，并与氢键网络中供体-受体不平衡的瞬态变化相关，被解释为局域的核-电子混合介电响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：水的低频太赫兹介电响应可表示为集体德拜弛豫加上一个受限于零直流电导极限的Drude-Smith项；该额外响应的光谱权重随温度升高而增加、随同位素取代（D₂O vs H₂O）而减小，并与氢键网络中供体-受体不平衡的瞬态变化相关，被解释为局域的核-电子混合介电响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹介电谱测量（0.14–1.21 THz）、分子动力学模拟（包含核量子效应）、基于第一性原理的光谱计算。

papers.title: Universal purification dynamics of monitored Clifford circuits
papers.abstract: Quantum circuits under sufficiently weak monitoring purify on a timescale $T_P$ exponentially long in the system size. This slowness underlies a universal purification dynamics, whose quantitative description has so far required the replica trick, with a delicate analytic continuation. We show that monitored Clifford circuits on $L$ qudits of prime dimension $q$ bypass this construction entirely: in the scaling limit at fixed $x = t/T_P(L)$, purification reduces to the Markovian decay of the density-matrix rank, an exactly solvable death process descending from infinity. We compute the full scaling functions in compact form: all Rényi entropies collapse onto a universal curve $\langle S(x) \rangle$. Exact stabilizer simulations at $q=2,3,5$ confirm the predictions, with no fitting parameter for the global model and $T_P$ as the only fitted scale for local brick-wall circuits. Also, the replica problem amounts to a tilted version of the same Markov process, in agreement with exact computations from the Clifford commutant. Finally, the quantization of the rank leaves two hallmarks that distinguish Clifford dynamics from generic monitored circuits: the entropy fluctuations saturate at short scaled times $x\to0$ to an $O(1)$ variance, instead of vanishing, and observables develop a temporal modulation periodic in $\log_q x$, which cannot be captured by the replica approach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“bypass this construction entirely”“exactly solvable death process”“exact stabilizer simulations”，核心是解析推导与数值验证，无实验数据。；研究对象：受监测的Clifford量子电路（monitored Clifford circuits），具体为作用在素数维度qudit上的随机Clifford电路，研究其纯化动力学（purification dynamics）的普适行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在标度极限下，受监测Clifford电路的纯化过程可简化为密度矩阵秩的马尔可夫衰变（死亡过程），所有Rényi熵塌缩到一条普适曲线⟨S(x)⟩上；同时，秩的量子化导致熵涨落在短时间饱和为O(1)方差，并出现周期为log_q x的时间调制，这些特征无法被复制技巧（replica trick）捕捉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在标度极限下，受监测Clifford电路的纯化过程可简化为密度矩阵秩的马尔可夫衰变（死亡过程），所有Rényi熵塌缩到一条普适曲线⟨S(x)⟩上；同时，秩的量子化导致熵涨落在短时间饱和为O(1)方差，并出现周期为log_q x的时间调制，这些特征无法被复制技巧（replica trick）捕捉。；创新点：首次绕过复制技巧（replica trick）的解析延拓困难，直接给出受监测Clifford电路纯化动力学的精确可解描述，并揭示其与一般受监测电路在熵涨落和时间调制上的本质区别。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导：利用Clifford电路的代数结构，将纯化动力学映射为从无穷大开始的死亡过程（death process），并计算标度函数；数值模拟：对q=2,3,5的qudit进行精确稳定子模拟（exact stabilizer simulations），验证全局模型（无拟合参数）和局域砖墙电路（仅拟合T_P）的预测。

papers.title: Spin singlets are useful
papers.abstract: We evaluate the utility of the spin-zero manifold of an exchange-coupled array of $N$ spins for tasks in quantum computation and quantum simulation. Since pairs of electrons can be readily initialized into a product state of singlets in semiconducting quantum dot arrays, the full spin-zero manifold is available with exchange-only control, providing a Hilbert space of approximate dimension $2^N/(N/2)^{3/2}$, asymptotically close to the $2^N$ dimension of the full spin Hilbert space. Leveraging the spin-zero manifold enables larger computational space in a given array compared to traditional exchange-only control, in which spin arrays are organized into modular units of $n$ spins comprising $N/n$ encoded qubits, limiting to the exponentially smaller Hilbert dimension $2^{N/n}$. Here we focus on benchmarking metrics for this resource utilization by generalizing cross-entropy benchmarking, mirror benchmarking, and out-of-time-ordered correlators to this system. We show that operating in the spin-zero manifold can accelerate the realization of computational quantum advantage applications in semiconductor-based spin qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“evaluate the utility”“generalizing cross-entropy benchmarking”等理论分析术语，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：交换耦合自旋阵列中的自旋零流形（spin-zero manifold），具体应用于半导体量子点阵列中的量子计算与量子模拟任务。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用自旋零流形（单重态子空间）进行量子控制，可在给定自旋阵列中提供接近全自旋希尔伯特空间维度的计算空间（渐近维度约 \(2^N/(N/2)^{3/2}\)），相比传统仅使用编码量子比特的交换控制方案（维度仅 \(2^{N/n}\)），能显著加速在半导体自旋量子比特中实现计算量子优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用自旋零流形（单重态子空间）进行量子控制，可在给定自旋阵列中提供接近全自旋希尔伯特空间维度的计算空间（渐近维度约 \(2^N/(N/2)^{3/2}\)），相比传统仅使用编码量子比特的交换控制方案（维度仅 \(2^{N/n}\)），能显著加速在半导体自旋量子比特中实现计算量子优势。；创新点：提出并量化了自旋零流形在交换控制下的计算空间优势，并为此类系统引入了新的基准测试指标。摘要未突出说明与传统方案的具体实验对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 通过推广交叉熵基准测试（cross-entropy benchmarking）、镜像基准测试（mirror benchmarking）以及时序外关联函数（out-of-time-ordered correlators）来评估自旋零流形的资源利用效率。

papers.title: Localized Thermometry via Dayem Bridges Integrated on Superconducting Qubit Chips
papers.abstract: Accurate knowledge of the on-chip temperature is essential for understanding and optimizing the performance of superconducting qubits, yet direct thermometry at millikelvin temperatures remains challenging. While qubits themselves are sensitive to the temperature of their environment, other factors may affect the qubits` effective temperature, and using them as thermometers with any accuracy requires specialized measurement protocols and qubit designs, limiting their practicality for routine diagnostics and adding complex infrastructure to any hardware testing apparatus. Here we demonstrate a complementary on-chip thermometry method based on superconducting Dayem bridges that are integrated on the same chip as transmon qubits. By extracting the critical current of the Dayem bridge from I-V measurements, we obtain a local, quantitative measure of the chip temperature without the need for microwave calibration or qubit-specific control sequences. To demonstrate the utility of the Dayem bridges as thermometers, we fabricate them in-situ with qubits on the same chip, calibrate the Dayem bridge critical current as a function of temperature, and characterize its resolution and stability at cryogenic temperatures. We additionally perform simultaneous measurements of the Dayem bridge thermometer and qubit excited-state population, and show agreement over the relevant temperature range, validating the method against established qubit thermometry. Furthermore, we correlate the independently measured chip temperature with qubit energy relaxation and dephasing times, demonstrating the utility of this approach for diagnosing temperature-dependent decoherence mechanisms. These results establish integrated Dayem bridges as a simple, non-invasive, and scalable tool for cryogenic hardware development, and on chip thermometry in superconducting quantum circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、fabricate、measurements、I-V measurements、calibrate。；研究对象：集成在超导量子比特芯片上的Dayem桥（Dayem bridges），用于片上局域测温。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量Dayem桥的临界电流，可以在无需微波校准或量子比特专用控制序列的情况下，获得芯片的局域定量温度，并与量子比特激发态布居数测量结果一致，验证了该方法可用于诊断温度依赖的退相干机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量Dayem桥的临界电流，可以在无需微波校准或量子比特专用控制序列的情况下，获得芯片的局域定量温度，并与量子比特激发态布居数测量结果一致，验证了该方法可用于诊断温度依赖的退相干机制。；创新点：提出并验证了一种基于Dayem桥的片上局域测温方法，该方法无需微波校准或量子比特专用控制序列，具有非侵入性、可扩展性，适用于常规诊断和低温硬件测试。
papers.method_zh: 实验上在transmon量子比特芯片上原位制备Dayem桥，通过I-V特性曲线提取临界电流，标定其随温度的变化关系，并与量子比特激发态布居数进行同步测量对比，同时关联芯片温度与量子比特能量弛豫时间、退相位时间。

papers.title: Monodromy defects in Chern-Simons theory and Holography
papers.abstract: Wilson loop operators in Chern-Simons theory have revealed profound links between quantum field theory, the fractional quantum Hall effect, topology, conformal field theory, and string theory. In Chern-Simons theories with charge conjugation symmetry, we construct a new class of observables: codimension-two monodromy defects around which fields return to themselves up to charge conjugation. Whereas Wilson loops are labeled by integrable representations of an untwisted affine Lie algebra, monodromy defects are labeled by those of the corresponding twisted affine algebra. The modular and fusion data of these two algebras determine the exact correlation functions of Wilson lines and monodromy defects, which together furnish a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-crossed braided tensor category. The spectrum of line defects in Chern-Simons theory thus gives a physical realization of every algebra in Kac's classification of affine Lie algebras: untwisted for Wilson loops, twisted for monodromy defects. We also determine the exact 't Hooft expansion of monodromy defects in $SU(N)_k$ Chern-Simons theory and identify their holographic duals in topological string theory. The insertion of the lightest monodromy defect has a striking effect: it replaces the resolved conifold background of the Gopakumar-Vafa duality by a specific orientifold of the resolved conifold, transmuting the dual theory of oriented strings into one of unoriented strings. Each excited monodromy defect is then realized as a collection of branes in the orientifold background, with the brane content determined by the representation of the twisted affine algebra that labels the defect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Chern-Simons theory, holography, topological string theory, 代数分类。；研究对象：Chern-Simons理论中的新型可观测对象——单值性缺陷（monodromy defects），及其与全息对偶、拓扑弦理论的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有电荷共轭对称性的Chern-Simons理论中，构造了一类新的余维二单值性缺陷，其由扭仿射李代数的可积表示标记，与Wilson环（由未扭仿射李代数标记）共同构成Z₂-交叉辫子张量范畴；最轻单值性缺陷的插入将Gopakumar-Vafa对偶中的解链锥背景替换为其特定定向化，使对偶理论从定向弦转变为非定向弦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有电荷共轭对称性的Chern-Simons理论中，构造了一类新的余维二单值性缺陷，其由扭仿射李代数的可积表示标记，与Wilson环（由未扭仿射李代数标记）共同构成Z₂-交叉辫子张量范畴；最轻单值性缺陷的插入将Gopakumar-Vafa对偶中的解链锥背景替换为其特定定向化，使对偶理论从定向弦转变为非定向弦。；创新点：首次在Chern-Simons理论中系统构造并分类了基于电荷共轭对称性的单值性缺陷，将其与Kac分类中所有仿射李代数（未扭与扭）的物理实现联系起来，并揭示了其在全息对偶中导致背景几何从解链锥到其定向化的转变。
papers.method_zh: 利用共形场论中的模与融合数据计算Wilson线和单值性缺陷的精确关联函数；通过SU(N)_k Chern-Simons理论中的't Hooft展开确定单值性缺陷的精确展开；结合拓扑弦理论识别其全息对偶。

papers.title: Effective Field Theories for Material Media
papers.abstract: We review recent progress in understanding certain aspects of condensed matter systems from a high energy theory perspective. We discuss effective field theories that describe collective bulk and localized excitations in a variety of solid and fluid systems. Particular emphasis is placed on the role played by spacetime symmetries and their spontaneous breaking. The resulting Goldstone dynamics can be seen as underlying a wide variety of phenomena. We attempt to bridge the language gap between subfields while underscoring the numerous conceptual similarities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：review、effective field theories、high energy theory perspective、spacetime symmetries、Goldstone dynamics。；研究对象：凝聚态物质系统，包括固体和流体中的集体体激发和局域激发，以及相关的有效场论描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时空对称性及其自发破缺在凝聚态系统的有效场论中起核心作用，由此产生的戈德斯通动力学可解释多种物理现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时空对称性及其自发破缺在凝聚态系统的有效场论中起核心作用，由此产生的戈德斯通动力学可解释多种物理现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作试图弥合凝聚态物理与高能物理子领域之间的语言鸿沟，并强调两者在概念上的诸多相似性。
papers.method_zh: 采用高能理论视角，构建并分析描述固体和流体系统的有效场论，重点讨论时空对称性及其自发破缺机制。

papers.title: Fingerprint, Not Blueprint: How Positional Schemes Set the Default Spectral Algebra of Attention
papers.abstract: The pre-softmax score of an attention head is a bilinear form $score(i,j) = x_i^T M x_j$ in a learned operator $M = W_q^T W_k$. Because M is generally non-symmetric, hence non-normal, it has a complex eigenspectrum and non-orthogonal eigenvectors, the regime where non-Hermitian and random-matrix tools apply. We ask what this spectrum encodes, at three levels for previous-token and induction circuits. Statically, across seven pretrained models spanning three positional schemes, the strongest previous-token heads are spectrally rotational under RoPE and non-rotational, or content-like, where position enters outside QK (learned-absolute and ALiBi); the model-level separation is perfect at every top-k examined (exact permutation $p=0.029$), and zeroing the per-frequency RoPE phase $Im(M_t)$ eliminates induction on a pre-identified previous-token head in all three RoPE models. Dynamically, over public Pythia checkpoints every head originates at the random-matrix (Ginibre) null; the rotational signature emerges with the behavior, not before it, and the population-median suppression that yields the final profile follows circuit formation, so the profile is a consolidated fingerprint, not a precursor. Causally, and at toy scale, no spectral channel is necessary: constrained two-layer training reroutes around every ban with capability intact, albeit at a significant formation delay (four pre-registered contrasts, $q_BH <= 0.016$). The cost structure exposes each scheme's default: imposing symmetry slows learned-absolute models by a factor of 2.9, whereas a RoPE head with a fully symmetric static M still routes directionally via the phase channel, impossible under absolute positions. Within the settings examined, the positional scheme sets the default spectral algebra of an attention head's solution: a fingerprint sculpted after function, not a hard constraint upon it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“随机矩阵工具”、“非厄米”、“谱分析”、“约束训练”等理论分析框架和计算模拟方法，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的是Transformer注意力机制中，不同位置编码方案（RoPE、可学习绝对位置编码、ALiBi）如何影响注意力头（attention head）的“谱代数”（spectral algebra），具体聚焦于前序词头（previous-token heads）和归纳电路（induction circuits）的谱特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 位置编码方案设定了注意力头解（solution）的默认谱代数，但该谱特征（如旋转性）是功能形成后留下的“指纹”（fingerprint），而非预先设定的“蓝图”（blueprint）。没有任何谱通道是因果上必需的，模型可以通过重新路由绕过对特定谱通道的约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：位置编码方案设定了注意力头解（solution）的默认谱代数，但该谱特征（如旋转性）是功能形成后留下的“指纹”（fingerprint），而非预先设定的“蓝图”（blueprint）。没有任何谱通道是因果上必需的，模型可以通过重新路由绕过对特定谱通道的约束。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于：1）将非厄米矩阵和随机矩阵理论系统性地应用于分析注意力机制的谱特性；2）通过因果实验证明谱特征是功能涌现后的结果而非原因，挑战了谱结构直接决定功能的直觉；3）揭示了不同位置编码方案在谱代数层面施加的“默认约束”及其成本结构。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **静态谱分析**：对七个预训练模型（涵盖三种位置编码方案）的前序词头，计算其QK算子M = W_q^T W_k的谱，分析其旋转性（RoPE下）与非旋转性（可学习绝对位置和ALiBi下）。

papers.title: Polyconvexity does not imply true-stress-true-strain monotonicity in the incompressible three-dimensional case
papers.abstract: We study constitutive conditions of hyperelastic potentials for incompressible material behavior in three dimensions. By means of a counterexample, we show that polyconvexity does not imply true-stress-true-strain monotonicity. Thus, polyconvexity alone is not strong enough to guarantee a physically reasonable response for idealized elasticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“constitutive conditions”、“counterexample”、“polyconvexity”、“true-stress-true-strain monotonicity”。；研究对象：不可压缩材料在三维情况下的超弹性本构关系，具体研究多凸性（polyconvexity）与真实应力-真实应变单调性之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过反例证明，在三维不可压缩情况下，超弹性势的多凸性并不蕴含真实应力-真实应变的单调性。因此，仅凭多凸性不足以保证理想弹性体的物理合理性响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过反例证明，在三维不可压缩情况下，超弹性势的多凸性并不蕴含真实应力-真实应变的单调性。因此，仅凭多凸性不足以保证理想弹性体的物理合理性响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于首次指出多凸性在三维不可压缩情形下不能保证真实应力-真实应变单调性，从而修正了此前可能存在的隐含假设。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，通过构造反例（counterexample）进行逻辑论证，未涉及具体实验或数值模拟手段。

papers.title: 2D Transport in an in-plane magnetic field
papers.abstract: A parallel in-plane magnetic field could, in principle, distinguish between two competing physical scenarios for the experimentally observed density-tuned 2D metal-insulator transition (where decreasing the carrier density leads to a crossover from an effective metal to an effective insulator): Wigner crystallization or Anderson localization. Since the main scattering mechanism in 2D doped semiconductors arises from screened random charged impurities and screening in turn depends on the electronic density of states, the in-plane magnetic field could distinguish between the two by decreasing screening through spin polarization and this enhances the effective critical density for Anderson localization compared with Wigner crystallization. We give the general theory and provide results for the quantitative magnitudes of the spin polarization effect on the transition density by focusing on two recent experiments [Z. Ge, et al, arXiv:2510.12009, T. Han, et al, arXiv:2604.00113], noting that the critical density may actually decrease if the dominant scattering is by short-ranged defects instead of long-ranged charged impurities. The difference between the two cases arises from whether spin polarization dominates screening (enhanced critical density) or the Fermi surface (suppressed critical density).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“general theory”、“provide results for the quantitative magnitudes”，且未提及具体实验操作或计算模拟，主要基于理论推导和模型分析。；研究对象：二维掺杂半导体中的金属-绝缘体转变（MIT），特别是通过载流子密度调控的二维金属-绝缘体转变现象，以及区分其物理机制（Wigner结晶或Anderson局域化）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 面内平行磁场可通过自旋极化降低屏蔽效应，从而增强Anderson局域化的临界密度，这与Wigner结晶的临界密度变化趋势不同，因此可用于区分两种物理机制。但若主导散射机制为短程缺陷而非长程带电杂质，临界密度可能反而降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：面内平行磁场可通过自旋极化降低屏蔽效应，从而增强Anderson局域化的临界密度，这与Wigner结晶的临界密度变化趋势不同，因此可用于区分两种物理机制。但若主导散射机制为短程缺陷而非长程带电杂质，临界密度可能反而降低。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于屏蔽随机带电杂质散射机制，结合自旋极化对电子态密度和屏蔽效应的影响，定量计算自旋极化对转变密度的修正，并针对两个具体实验（Z. Ge等人和T. Han等人的arXiv预印本）给出数值结果。

papers.title: Half state at $ν_{tot}$ = -1/2 and its transition in Decoupled Twisted Double Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: The origin of the fractional state at $ν$ = 1/2 observed in double-layer quantum Hall systems has been under debate for decades. Because of the variation of bilayer charge distribution and interlayer tunneling strength, the half-filling state can be attributed to a two-component(2C) or a one-component(1C) origin, which corresponds to Halperin state and Pffafian state, respectively. Here we report the magnetotransport measurement in decoupled twisted double bilayer graphene(TDBG), which has been proved to be a promising platform for double quantum Hall system. Fractional quantum hall states in both odd and even denominator fillings are observed. We also found that the half-filling state occurs at zero displacement field at $ν_{tot}$ = -1/2, which is theoretically consistent with two-component Halperin-Laughlin (Ψ331) state. Moreover, we report the transition from two-component state at zero D field to one-component non-Abelian state by tunning displacement field. Our observation of the half filling state and its transition from 2C to 1C state provides the tunability of decoupled twisted double bilayer graphene and shed light on the understanding of the ground states at half-filling factor in the double quantum Hall system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“magnetotransport measurement”（磁输运测量）、“observed”（观测到）、“report”（报告）。；研究对象：解耦扭曲双层石墨烯（decoupled twisted double bilayer graphene, TDBG）中的分数量子霍尔态，特别是总填充因子ν_tot = -1/2处的半填充态及其相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零位移场下，ν_tot = -1/2处的半填充态为双组分Halperin-Laughlin (Ψ331)态；通过调节位移场，可将其转变为单组分的非阿贝尔态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零位移场下，ν_tot = -1/2处的半填充态为双组分Halperin-Laughlin (Ψ331)态；通过调节位移场，可将其转变为单组分的非阿贝尔态。；创新点：在解耦扭曲双层石墨烯这一双量子霍尔系统平台中，首次实验观测到半填充态从双组分态到单组分非阿贝尔态的电场可调相变，为理解双层量子霍尔系统中半填充因子的基态性质提供了新的调控手段。
papers.method_zh: 磁输运测量（magnetotransport measurement），通过调节位移场（displacement field）研究不同填充因子下的分数量子霍尔态。

papers.title: Multi-Knob Switchable Chiral Superconductivity Quartet in Rhombohedral Graphene
papers.abstract: Chiral superconductors break orbital time-reversal symmetry and may host topological quasiparticles with non-Abelian statistics. In rhombohedral graphene, superconductivity develops from a spin-valley-polarized quarter-metal (QM) parent state and features unique magnetic hysteresis of resistance that indicates orbital time-reversal-symmetry-breaking. Exploring and controlling the full spin-valley flavors of such superconductivity could enable novel superconducting and topological devices, but have remained unexplored. Here we report transport measurements on rhombohedral hexalayer graphene (R6G), which reveal a new superconducting state (SCH) that is induced by an out-of-plane magnetic field, in addition to chiral superconductivity (CSC) similar to those observed in thinner layers. This SCH state emerges above 0.8 T, persists up to 1.6 T and can be switched on/off by magnetic field $H_\perp$, carrier density $n$, and gate displacement field $D$. Quantum oscillations and anomalous Hall measurements show that SCH stems from a field-induced quarter-metal (QM$'$) parent phase, which carries orbital magnetization opposite to that of the zero-field QM. Across the full $(n, D, H_\perp)$ parameter space, superconductivity can be realized from all four spin-valley isospin flavors, establishing a switchable chiral-superconductor quartet in R6G. We interpret the parent-state switching as arising from competition between a Kane-Mele-like spin-valley splitting and magnetic-field coupling to spin-valley-dependent magnetic moments. Our work establishes rhombohedral graphene as a multi-knob platform for different isospin-polarized superconductivities, which enables programmable superconducting networks with possible Majorana modes along domain walls.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here we report transport measurements”（输运测量）、“Quantum oscillations and anomalous Hall measurements”（量子振荡和反常霍尔测量）等实验手段。；研究对象：菱方六层石墨烯（R6G）中的超导电性，特别是其可调控的手性超导态以及由不同自旋-谷同位旋（isospin）极化驱动的超导“四重态”。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在菱方六层石墨烯中，除了零场下的手性超导态（CSC），还发现了一个由垂直磁场诱导的新超导态（SCH）。通过调节磁场、载流子密度和位移场，可以实现所有四种自旋-谷同位旋极化超导态之间的切换，构成了一个可开关的手性超导四重态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在菱方六层石墨烯中，除了零场下的手性超导态（CSC），还发现了一个由垂直磁场诱导的新超导态（SCH）。通过调节磁场、载流子密度和位移场，可以实现所有四种自旋-谷同位旋极化超导态之间的切换，构成了一个可开关的手性超导四重态。；创新点：首次在菱方石墨烯中实现了对所有四种自旋-谷同位旋极化超导态（即超导“四重态”）的独立控制和切换，将菱方石墨烯确立为一个多调控旋钮（multi-knob）的可编程超导平台，为构建可能包含马约拉纳零能模的超导网络提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 输运测量（transport measurements），具体包括：通过测量电阻随磁场、载流子密度和位移场的变化来表征超导态；利用量子振荡（quantum oscillations）和反常霍尔测量（anomalous Hall measurements）来探测母态（parent state）的轨道磁化性质。

papers.title: Static vacancies as parametrized conformal defects in the critical $J_1$--$J_2$ transverse-field Ising chain
papers.abstract: We revisit the problem of two static nonmagnetic vacancies in the transverse-field Ising chain with first- and second-neighbor couplings $J_1$ and $J_2$, now on the critical line, using density-matrix renormalization-group (DMRG) calculations in open chains of up to $N=300$ sites. In contrast to the gapped regime studied previously, where the vacancy-vacancy interaction decays exponentially, along the entire quantum critical line the interaction becomes algebraic, $|Δ_b(r)|\sim r^{-α}$, with $α$ close to the universal Casimir value of unity and a weak but systematic dependence on the second-neighbor coupling, $α_\infty \simeq 1.070 + 0.091\, J_2/J_1)$ across $J_2/J_1\in[0.1,1.0]$. The transmission ratio of the spin correlator across a vacancy approaches a $J_2$-dependent plateau $T_\infty(J_2)$ that grows from $0.11$ to $0.33$ over the same range, and the Affleck-Ludwig boundary entropy is small and approximately constant, $\log g_\infty \approx -0.073$, well above the Ising fixed-BC value $-\ln\sqrt{2}$ and close to the free-boundary value. The three observables vary smoothly and monotonically with $J_2$, consistent with a one-parameter family of partially transmissive conformal defects controlled by $J_2$. Throughout, the critical line is located using the bulk spin-correlator exponent $η=1/4$, the order-parameter exponent of the Ising universality class, which provides a robust criterion in this open geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-matrix renormalization-group (DMRG) calculations、open chains。；研究对象：具有第一近邻（\(J_1\)）和第二近邻（\(J_2\)）耦合的横场伊辛链中的两个静态非磁性空位，且体系处于量子临界线上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 沿整个量子临界线，两个空位之间的相互作用变为代数衰减 \(|\Delta_b(r)|\sim r^{-\alpha}\)，指数 \(\alpha\) 接近普适卡西米尔值1，但随 \(J_2\) 有弱系统依赖（\(\alpha_\infty \simeq 1.070 + 0.091\, J_2/J_1\)）。自旋关联函数穿过空位的透射比 \(T_\infty(J_2)\) 随 \(J_2\) 从0.11增长至0.33，而Affleck-Ludwig边界熵 \(\log g_\infty \approx -0.073\) 接近自由边界值，远高于伊辛固定边界值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：沿整个量子临界线，两个空位之间的相互作用变为代数衰减 \(|\Delta_b(r)|\sim r^{-\alpha}\)，指数 \(\alpha\) 接近普适卡西米尔值1，但随 \(J_2\) 有弱系统依赖（\(\alpha_\infty \simeq 1.070 + 0.091\, J_2/J_1\)）。自旋关联函数穿过空位的透射比 \(T_\infty(J_2)\) 随 \(J_2\) 从0.11增长至0.33，而Affleck-Ludwig边界熵 \(\log g_\infty \approx -0.073\) 接近自由边界值，远高于伊辛固定边界值。；创新点：将之前仅在能隙相中研究的静态空位问题拓展到量子临界线上，发现空位相互作用从指数衰减变为代数衰减，并揭示了 \(J_2\) 作为参数调控部分透射共形缺陷的一族连续行为。摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）方法，对最多 \(N=300\) 个格点的开链进行计算。

papers.title: Sedimentation equilibrium and gravity dependent stiffness coefficients of colloidal hard-spheres
papers.abstract: Spherical colloids with harsh repulsive forces have long been used as experimental analogs of the hard sphere model, with demonstrated good agreement with computer simulations for bulk and structural properties of the fluid, glass and crystal phases. However, an enigmatic discrepancy remains for the crystal-melt stiffness coefficient. Here we perform computer simulations of colloidal hard spheres under tunable buoyant mass and show that the long-standing discrepancy can be traced to a hitherto unrecognized gravity dependent contribution of the stiffness coefficient. This effect is one practical realization of a more general result for the external field dependence of stiffness coefficients of arbitrary interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“computer simulations”（计算机模拟）。；研究对象：胶体硬球体系，具体研究其沉降平衡和依赖于重力的刚度系数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长期以来胶体硬球晶体-熔体界面刚度系数与计算机模拟之间的差异，可归因于一个此前未被认识到的、依赖于重力的刚度系数贡献。这一效应是任意界面刚度系数依赖于外场这一更普遍结果的一个具体实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长期以来胶体硬球晶体-熔体界面刚度系数与计算机模拟之间的差异，可归因于一个此前未被认识到的、依赖于重力的刚度系数贡献。这一效应是任意界面刚度系数依赖于外场这一更普遍结果的一个具体实现。；创新点：揭示了重力（外场）对界面刚度系数的依赖关系，并以此解释了胶体硬球晶体-熔体刚度系数长期存在的理论与实验差异。
papers.method_zh: 对可调浮力质量下的胶体硬球进行计算机模拟。

papers.title: Correlated Insulating States in Twisted Double Bilayer Graphene Enhanced by Interfacial Effect on CrOCl
papers.abstract: Interaction between different two dimensional materials can give rise to many exotic physical phenomena which are rarely observed in intrinsic materials. Recently, several theoretical and experimental works have revealed that magnetic proximity effect between pristine graphene and magnetic substrates can lead to the emergence of quantum anomalous Hall states and quantum spin Hall states. However, interplay between correlated states in graphene-based systems and magnetic materials has seldom been studied. Here we perform the transport measurement at ultrahigh magnetic field of twisted double bilayer graphene (TDBG) on CrOCl (COC) substrate, which is an antiferromagnetic material. Instead of a magnetic-exchange effect on graphene, we observe an enhanced correlated insulating state at half-filling factor of TDBG as a result of the charge-transfer process between TDBG and COC. The temperature and magnetic field dependence of this enhanced state are further studied. Our results demonstrate the influence of charge-related effect at the interface, and shed a light on a new route for manipulating the correlated states in graphene-based moiré systems using interfacial engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：transport measurement（输运测量）、ultrahigh magnetic field（超高磁场）。；研究对象：以CrOCl（COC）为衬底的扭转双层石墨烯（twisted double bilayer graphene, TDBG）异质结，具体研究其关联绝缘态及界面效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在TDBG/COC异质结中，观察到TDBG半填充因子处的关联绝缘态因TDBG与COC之间的电荷转移过程而增强，而非通常预期的磁交换效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在TDBG/COC异质结中，观察到TDBG半填充因子处的关联绝缘态因TDBG与COC之间的电荷转移过程而增强，而非通常预期的磁交换效应。；创新点：首次在石墨烯基莫尔体系中，通过界面工程（利用反铁磁衬底CrOCl的电荷转移效应而非磁交换效应）来调控关联绝缘态，为操控关联态提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 超高磁场下的输运测量（transport measurement），并研究了该增强态的温度和磁场依赖性。

papers.title: Phonon-Mediated Thermal Transport in Nanocrystalline Silicon Using Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract: Understanding phonon-mediated heat transport in structurally complex materials remains a central challenge for next-generation electronic and nanomechanical devices, where grain boundaries and interfacial disorder strongly limit thermal dissipation. Although classical interatomic potentials enable large-scale simulations, their limited transferability can lead to inaccuracies in vibrational properties and interfacial phonon scattering. In this work, we develop a machine-learning based framework for modeling thermal transport in bulk and nanocrystalline silicon by combining Gaussian approximation potential (GAP) and multi-atomic cluster expansion (MACE) models with lattice-dynamical calculations and non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD). Harmonic and anharmonic force constants derived from machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are used within a unified Phonopy/Phono3py workflow to compute phonon dispersions, lifetimes, and lattice thermal conductivity, providing an internally consistent description of vibrational properties. In nanocrystalline silicon, NEMD simulations directly quantify the thermal boundary resistance associated with grain boundaries and reveal its sensitivity to interfacial roughness and the underlying interatomic description. Compared with the Stillinger-Weber and Tersoff potentials, the MLIPs provide a more accurate and internally consistent description of bulk and interfacial phonon transport, enabling more predictive modeling of nanoscale thermal transport in low-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、lattice-dynamical calculations、non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD)。；研究对象：体相和纳米晶硅中的声子介导热输运，重点关注晶界和界面无序对热耗散的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的框架能够比传统经典势（Stillinger-Weber和Tersoff）更准确且自洽地描述体相和纳米晶硅中的声子输运，并揭示了晶界热边界电阻对界面粗糙度和原子间势描述的敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的框架能够比传统经典势（Stillinger-Weber和Tersoff）更准确且自洽地描述体相和纳米晶硅中的声子输运，并揭示了晶界热边界电阻对界面粗糙度和原子间势描述的敏感性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合高斯近似势（GAP）和多原子团簇展开（MACE）模型，通过统一的Phonopy/Phono3py工作流计算谐波和非谐波力常数，得到声子色散、寿命和晶格热导率；同时使用非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）直接模拟纳米晶硅中的热边界电阻。

papers.title: Eclipsing Kitaev: off-diagonal exchange governs the correlated high-field phases of $β$-Li$_2$IrO$_3$
papers.abstract: We report a high-field thermodynamic study of the hyperhoneycomb Kitaev material $β$-Li$_2$IrO$_3$, using magnetotropic susceptibility to resolve its low-temperature field-angle phase diagram across the principal crystallographic planes in magnetic fields up to $60$ T. Rather than evolving directly from the low-field incommensurate state into a polarized regime, the system exhibits a strongly direction-dependent sequence of correlated phases. Most notably, for fields in the $ac$-plane, we identify an additional high-field phase that is absent in the other principal planes and exists only within a restricted region of field-angle space. This phase structure is naturally explained by the competition between magnetic field and bond-directional exchange interactions. Using a symmetry-based description supported by microscopic calculations within the $J$-$K$-$Γ$ model, we show that off-diagonal $Γ$ exchange couples the ferromagnetic and staggered magnetic orders and thereby stabilizes the observed correlated high-field phases. The measured angular dependence of the critical fields is quantitatively captured by this theory, identifying $Γ$ exchange as the key interaction controlling the high-field response. These results clarify why the promise of a field-induced spin liquid -- the notion that suppressing magnetic order might reveal the underlying Kitaev physics -- remains unfulfilled in candidate materials: even when the Kitaev interaction is large, off-diagonal exchange stabilizes symmetry-constrained correlated phases that instead preempt the polarized state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：thermodynamic study, magnetotropic susceptibility, field-angle phase diagram）；研究对象：β-Li₂IrO₃ 超蜂窝 Kitaev 材料在高磁场下的低温相图与磁有序行为
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高达60 T的磁场中，β-Li₂IrO₃并未直接从低场非公度态进入极化态，而是出现一系列强方向依赖的关联相；其中在ac面内存在一个其他晶面缺失的高场相，该相结构由非对角Γ交换相互作用稳定，并解释了为何场致自旋液体在候选材料中未能实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高达60 T的磁场中，β-Li₂IrO₃并未直接从低场非公度态进入极化态，而是出现一系列强方向依赖的关联相；其中在ac面内存在一个其他晶面缺失的高场相，该相结构由非对角Γ交换相互作用稳定，并解释了为何场致自旋液体在候选材料中未能实现。；创新点：首次通过高场热力学实验揭示β-Li₂IrO₃中非对角Γ交换对高场关联相的关键稳定作用，并定量解释了临界场的角度依赖，指出Γ交换是控制高场响应的主导相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 磁致磁化率（magnetotropic susceptibility）测量，结合基于J-K-Γ模型的对称性分析与微观计算。

papers.title: Charge-transfer gap size and oxygen hole content as two mechanisms controlling $T_c$ in the Emery model
papers.abstract: Investigating the drivers of superconducting critical temperature trends in cuprates is crucial for uncovering the mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity. Here we study this problem in the canonical model of the copper-oxygen plane, the Emery model, with cellular dynamical mean-field theory. Using the Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen diagram as a guiding framework, we systematically quantify how the maximum superconducting critical temperature $T_c^{\rm max}$ depends on the copper-oxygen energy distance and on the local repulsion on the copper orbital. Unexpectedly, $T_c^{\rm max}$ is optimized not only near the charge-transfer insulator to metal boundary, consistent with previous findings, but also deep in the charge-transfer regime, revealing an unexplored mechanism. Then we link model parameters to physical observables, identifying the charge-transfer gap size and the oxygen hole content as two mechanisms controlling $T_c^{\rm max}$. $T_c^{\rm max}$ increases monotonically as the oxygen hole content increases and the charge gap size decreases. The oxygen hole content is the dominant variable in varying $T_c^{\rm max}$. Our work provides predictions for proposed realizations of the Emery model with ultracold atoms and a theoretical framework for understanding key experimental trends in hole-doped cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“cellular dynamical mean-field theory”（细胞动力学平均场理论）、“systematically quantify”（系统量化）、“provides predictions”（提供预测）。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体的Emery模型（铜氧平面规范模型），具体研究超导临界温度（\(T_c\)）的驱动机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: \(T_c^{\rm max}\)不仅如以往研究所知在电荷转移绝缘体-金属边界附近被优化，而且在电荷转移区深处也存在优化，揭示了一个未被探索的机制。\(T_c^{\rm max}\)随氧空穴含量增加和电荷转移能隙减小而单调增加，其中氧空穴含量是主导变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：\(T_c^{\rm max}\)不仅如以往研究所知在电荷转移绝缘体-金属边界附近被优化，而且在电荷转移区深处也存在优化，揭示了一个未被探索的机制。\(T_c^{\rm max}\)随氧空穴含量增加和电荷转移能隙减小而单调增加，其中氧空穴含量是主导变量。；创新点：发现\(T_c^{\rm max}\)在电荷转移区深处也存在优化峰，并明确将电荷转移能隙大小和氧空穴含量识别为控制\(T_c^{\rm max}\)的两种独立机制，且指出氧空穴含量是更主导的变量。摘要未突出说明与以往理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用细胞动力学平均场理论（cellular dynamical mean-field theory, CDMFT）对Emery模型进行数值计算，并利用Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen（ZSA）图作为指导框架，系统量化铜-氧能量距离和铜轨道局域排斥对\(T_c^{\rm max}\)的影响。

papers.title: Correlation of maximum superconducting critical temperature with copper-oxygen energy distance and oxygen hole content in the Emery model
papers.abstract: Identifying microscopic parameters that optimize the maximum superconducting critical temperature $T_c^{\rm max}$ in the canonical model of the copper-oxygen plane of cuprates, the Emery model, remains challenging. Using cellular dynamical mean-field theory at finite temperature, we find that for a fixed charge gap size in the parent charge-transfer insulating state, $T_c^{\rm max}$ unexpectedly increases with increasing the copper-oxygen energy distance, as this favors the transfer of electrons from oxygen to copper orbitals. We show that these findings emerge naturally in the Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen scheme and capture observed trends in hole-doped cuprates. Overall, our study uncovers that $T_c^{\rm max}$ is optimized in the Emery model under three conditions: upon doping a charge-transfer insulator, close to the charge-transfer insulator to metal boundary, and deep into the charge-transfer regime. This finding indicates new paths for optimizing $T_c^{\rm max}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了“cellular dynamical mean-field theory”（细胞动力学平均场理论）进行数值计算。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体的Emery模型（铜氧平面三带模型）。具体研究该模型中，最大超导临界温度（$T_c^{\rm max}$）与铜-氧能量距离以及氧空穴含量的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持母体电荷转移绝缘体带隙固定的情况下，增大铜-氧能量距离会意外地提高$T_c^{\rm max}$，因为这促进了电子从氧轨道向铜轨道的转移。$T_c^{\rm max}$在满足以下三个条件时达到最优：掺杂电荷转移绝缘体、靠近电荷转移绝缘体-金属相边界、以及处于深电荷转移区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保持母体电荷转移绝缘体带隙固定的情况下，增大铜-氧能量距离会意外地提高$T_c^{\rm max}$，因为这促进了电子从氧轨道向铜轨道的转移。$T_c^{\rm max}$在满足以下三个条件时达到最优：掺杂电荷转移绝缘体、靠近电荷转移绝缘体-金属相边界、以及处于深电荷转移区。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作首次在Emery模型中系统揭示了$T_c^{\rm max}$与铜-氧能量距离的正相关关系，并明确提出了优化$T_c^{\rm max}$的三个具体条件，为理解铜氧化物超导机理和寻找更高$T_c$材料提供了新的微观视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限温度下的细胞动力学平均场理论（cellular dynamical mean-field theory, CDMFT）对Emery模型进行数值求解。

papers.title: Dimensional Crossover of Thermal Transport in Nanoconfined Liquids Driven by the Interplay of Quasi-One-Dimensional Structure and Wall Dissipation
papers.abstract: Heat transport in nanoconfined liquids can deviate from ordinary Fourier behavior because confinement alters liquid structure and interfacial dissipation. Although such changes may lead to quasi-one-dimensional transport or overdamped sound relaxation, the conditions under which length-dependent transport persists remain unclear. Here we use molecular dynamics simulations of monatomic liquid argon confined in carbon nanotubes with systematically varied radii and lengths. We find a radius-controlled crossover: length-dependent axial thermal conductivity persists over long tube lengths in single-file and single-shell states, but is strongly truncated or nearly saturated once mixed-shell or multilayer packing develops. This crossover is accompanied by the loss of clear acoustic-like axial modes and enhanced wall--liquid friction. Thus, tube radius controls whether length-dependent heat transport persists or is truncated by coupling confined-liquid structure to wall-induced dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：molecular dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：纳米受限液体（碳纳米管中单原子液态氩）的热输运现象，具体研究准一维结构与壁面耗散对热传导维度交叉行为的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米管半径控制热传导的维度交叉：在单列和单壳层状态下，轴向热导率随管长增加而持续变化（长度依赖）；一旦出现混合壳层或多层堆积，长度依赖的热传导被强烈抑制或接近饱和。该交叉伴随声学型轴向模式的消失和壁-液摩擦增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米管半径控制热传导的维度交叉：在单列和单壳层状态下，轴向热导率随管长增加而持续变化（长度依赖）；一旦出现混合壳层或多层堆积，长度依赖的热传导被强烈抑制或接近饱和。该交叉伴随声学型轴向模式的消失和壁-液摩擦增强。；创新点：揭示了纳米管半径通过调控受限液体结构（单列/单壳层 vs. 混合壳层/多层堆积）与壁面耗散的耦合，决定了长度依赖热传导是否持续存在。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（Molecular Dynamics simulations），系统改变碳纳米管的半径和长度，模拟单原子液态氩的受限体系。

papers.title: Instabilities of Fermi Liquids with Arbitrary Forward Scattering: Exact Approach
papers.abstract: In this work, we consider $N$-fold degenerate $D$-dimensional electron gas with spherical Fermi surface and arbitrary forward-scattering density-density interaction transferring small momentum compared to the Fermi momentum $k_{\mathrm{F}}$. The dimensional reduction that is mathematically equivalent to the Haldane patch construction and similar multidimensional bosonization techniques, provides a natural map of two-point $D$-dimensional correlation functions (fermion Green function, susceptibilities etc.) onto effective one-dimensional (1D) correlators with the same diagrammatic structure, which can be evaluated exactly within a 1D bosonizable (Gaussian) theory. We then apply this formalism to evaluate the fermion Green function, pair and charge/flavor susceptibilities, as well as the composite correlation functions for the case of a finite-range interaction, where the interaction range $R_{\mathrm{s}} \gg 1/k_{\mathrm{F}}$ is large compared to the Fermi wavelength. First, we find that the single-particle spectral function remains Fermi-liquid-like which is fully consistent with the previous research. In contrast to the single-particle sector, the many-body channels are efficiently dressed by finite-range interactions, and this dressing is fully equivalent to the one-loop renormalization group (RG), which is also in line with previous multidimensional bosonization results. Within the forward-scattering model, stable long-range order is not possible, and relevant susceptibilities demonstrate singular power-law scaling with temperature $T$ at $T \to 0$. The rest of the abstract is in the PDF.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact approach、dimensional reduction、bosonization、renormalization group。；研究对象：具有球形费米面的N重简并D维电子气，以及任意前向散射密度-密度相互作用（相互作用范围远大于费米波长）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单粒子谱函数保持费米液体行为，而多体通道被有限程相互作用有效重整化，其效果等价于单圈重整化群；在前向散射模型下，系统无法形成稳定的长程有序，相关磁化率在温度趋近零时呈现奇异幂律标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单粒子谱函数保持费米液体行为，而多体通道被有限程相互作用有效重整化，其效果等价于单圈重整化群；在前向散射模型下，系统无法形成稳定的长程有序，相关磁化率在温度趋近零时呈现奇异幂律标度行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用维度约化方法（数学上等价于Haldane patch构造和多维玻色化技术），将D维两点关联函数映射到具有相同图结构的有效一维关联函数，并在可玻色化（高斯）理论中精确求解。

papers.title: Skyrmion Phase Control by Magnetic Dipole-Dipole Interaction and Electric Field in Centrosymmetric Materials
papers.abstract: Establishing precise control over the helicity and spatial configuration of magnetic skyrmions will be essential to realize their promise in classical, analog and quantum computation applications. In this work, we explore the role of magnetic dipole-dipole interactions, external electric fields, and magnetic fields in controlling these parameters within a triangular lattice centrosymmetric skyrmion host. We demonstrate that dipole-dipole interactions strongly favor Bloch helicity. Notably, a zero magnetic field skyrmion phase appears upon raising the dipole-dipole coupling strength, with substantial potential for cost-effective quantum device applications. We also report the emergence of a meron/antimeron lattice phase, in the absence of any Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. In contrast, applied electric fields stabilize high density Néel skyrmion crystals. The interplay between dipole-dipole interactions and external electric fields creates a continuous transition between the two skyrmion types, rather than an abrupt switch. Applied electric fields can therefore be used as a continuous tuning mechanism for skyrmion helicity, and hence a control handle for tuning two-level systems in skyrmion qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：explore、demonstrate、report（理论建模与数值计算分析）。；研究对象：中心对称三角晶格材料中磁斯格明子的手性（helicity）与空间构型控制，具体涉及磁偶极-偶极相互作用、外电场和外磁场对斯格明子相的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁偶极-偶极相互作用强烈倾向于布洛赫（Bloch）手性，且增强该相互作用可在零磁场下诱导出斯格明子相；外加电场则稳定高密度的奈尔（Néel）型斯格明子晶格，并实现两种斯格明子类型之间的连续调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁偶极-偶极相互作用强烈倾向于布洛赫（Bloch）手性，且增强该相互作用可在零磁场下诱导出斯格明子相；外加电场则稳定高密度的奈尔（Néel）型斯格明子晶格，并实现两种斯格明子类型之间的连续调控。；创新点：首次在中心对称材料中系统揭示磁偶极-偶极相互作用与电场对斯格明子手性的连续调控机制，并发现零磁场斯格明子相以及无DMI条件下的meron/antimeron晶格相。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟，具体包括：考虑磁偶极-偶极相互作用、外电场和外磁场的三角晶格中心对称斯格明子体系模型，未使用Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（摘要中明确说明在无DMI条件下出现meron/antimeron相）。

papers.title: Spontaneous emission of light by non-equilibrium phonons
papers.abstract: When a system is brought out of equilibrium by an external excitation, its relaxation to thermodynamic equilibrium generates phonons. These non-equilibrium phonons degrade via cascaded anharmonic decay processes, progressively leading to a thermal population of phonons following a Bose-Einstein distribution at the system temperature. Preceding heat dissipation by convection, conduction and incandescence, this early phase of the relaxation dynamics is commonly assumed to be exclusively non-radiative. Here, we demonstrate that the radiative emission by phonons can be an efficient relaxation pathway competing with the intrinsic anharmonic decay. Optical spectroscopy under femtosecond two-photon excitation in boron nitride unveils a photoluminescence signal in the mid-infrared spectral range, stemming from the spontaneous emission of light by non-equilibrium phonons. This observation of non-thermal radiation from phonons introduces a new paradigm for out-of-equilibrium physics, mid-infrared optics, and thermal management.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：optical spectroscopy、unveils、observation。；研究对象：非平衡声子的自发辐射现象，具体材料为氮化硼（boron nitride）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在飞秒双光子激发下，氮化硼中非平衡声子可通过自发辐射光的方式释放能量，该辐射过程可与固有的非谐衰减过程竞争，成为一种有效的弛豫通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在飞秒双光子激发下，氮化硼中非平衡声子可通过自发辐射光的方式释放能量，该辐射过程可与固有的非谐衰减过程竞争，成为一种有效的弛豫通道。；创新点：首次实验观察到非平衡声子产生的非热辐射，打破了此前认为该弛豫阶段完全非辐射的普遍假设，为非平衡物理、中红外光学和热管理提供了新范式。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒双光子激发（femtosecond two-photon excitation）结合中红外光谱学（mid-infrared optical spectroscopy），测量光致发光信号。

papers.title: Effect of charge-imbalance potential relaxation on the high-frequency vortex dynamics and kinetic inductance of superconducting circuits
papers.abstract: We show that relaxation of the charge-imbalance potential plays a key role in the retarded dynamics of Abrikosov vortices in a type-II superconducting sample carrying a microwave current. Starting from the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations we derive the vortex equation of motion accounting both the dissipation and retardation effects. The retardation is governed by the dynamics of the charge-imbalance potential and reveals itself at characteristic timescales diverging near the superconducting critical temperature $T_{c}$. These retardation effects in vortex dynamics strongly affect the kinetic inductance of superconducting circuits being, thus, responsible for the magnetic field dependence of characteristics of different superconducting devices in the high frequency range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“Starting from the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations we derive the vortex equation of motion”，属于理论推导。；研究对象：II类超导体中携带微波电流时，Abrikosov涡旋的高频动力学行为，以及电荷不平衡势弛豫对涡旋动力学和超导电路动能电感的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷不平衡势的弛豫在涡旋延迟动力学中起关键作用，这种延迟效应在接近超导临界温度Tc时特征时间尺度发散，并显著影响超导电路的动能电感，从而决定高频范围内超导器件的磁场依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷不平衡势的弛豫在涡旋延迟动力学中起关键作用，这种延迟效应在接近超导临界温度Tc时特征时间尺度发散，并显著影响超导电路的动能电感，从而决定高频范围内超导器件的磁场依赖性。；创新点：揭示了电荷不平衡势弛豫是导致涡旋动力学延迟效应的关键机制，并指出该延迟效应在接近Tc时发散，进而影响高频超导电路的动能电感。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时金兹堡-朗道方程（time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations），推导了同时包含耗散和延迟效应的涡旋运动方程。

papers.title: Dynamical Simulation of Membrane Bending by Flexible Protein Assemblies
papers.abstract: Membrane-deforming protein lattices play a key role in essential and pathogenic biological processes, including endocytosis and viral budding. Attaining the necessary length- and time-scales in simulation can be difficult for such large-scale membrane remodeling events. We present a model of a flexible protein lattice coupled to a Helfrich membrane propagated in Fourier space in the over-damped regime. We focus primarily on membrane-bound clathrin lattices, an essential part of the endocytic machinery. We quantify the material properties of our clathrin model lattices using buckling methods to measure the flexural rigidity as it varies with force constants of the coarse-grained potential energy function. By comparing this flexural rigidity to the effective rigidity observed when modeling the bending energy of a spherical clathrin coat using a Helfrich-like bending energy term, we show how the interpretation of the bending rigidity changes with the structure of the protein coat, resulting in an effective stiffening as the coat grows. This relatively common approximation thus must be applied with care, as it can over-estimate the stiffness of assembled lattices depending on the interpretation assumed. We validate our model by verifying that the tension of our simulated membrane results in changes to the geometry of the clathrin coat consistent with theoretical expectations. We conclude by demonstrating our newly available code for transferring structures assembled via rigid-body reaction-diffusion (using the NERDSS simulation package) into our flexible membrane-coupled dynamical framework, applying it to the membrane-bound HIV-1 immature Gag lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：simulation、model、Fourier space、coarse-grained potential energy function。；研究对象：柔性蛋白质晶格（特别是网格蛋白晶格）与Helfrich膜耦合的动力学系统，涉及膜弯曲变形过程（如内吞作用、病毒出芽）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过比较网格蛋白晶格模型的弯曲刚度与球形网格蛋白外壳的Helfrich类弯曲能模型的有效刚度，发现随着蛋白质外壳生长，弯曲刚度的解释会发生变化，导致有效硬化；若使用不当，常见的Helfrich近似会高估组装晶格的刚度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过比较网格蛋白晶格模型的弯曲刚度与球形网格蛋白外壳的Helfrich类弯曲能模型的有效刚度，发现随着蛋白质外壳生长，弯曲刚度的解释会发生变化，导致有效硬化；若使用不当，常见的Helfrich近似会高估组装晶格的刚度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用过阻尼体系下傅里叶空间传播的Helfrich膜模型，耦合柔性蛋白质晶格模型；使用屈曲方法测量粗粒化势能函数力常数变化下的弯曲刚度；通过刚性体反应-扩散（NERDSS模拟包）组装结构，并将其转移至柔性膜耦合动力学框架中。

papers.title: Radio frequency readout and control of Ge/SiGe hole spin qubits with a global accumulation gate
papers.abstract: Hole spin qubits in undoped Ge/SiGe quantum well structures have advanced rapidly in performance and scalability. However, stringent multi-layer patterning and overlay requirements of conventional overlapping-gate devices create a bottleneck for academic proof-of-concept experiments involving few-qubit devices. Here we present fabrication and measurements of Ge/SiGe spin qubit devices with a global accumulation gate and single-layer depletion fine gates, which substantially reduce fabrication complexity. With careful design of the gate-2DHG capacitance, we demonstrate RF-based single-shot spin readout and coherent control of two single-spin qubits. We also characterize the spin coherence times and exchange tunability, which are similar to those reported in recent overlapping-gate Ge/SiGe spin qubit devices. By simplifying fabrication without sacrificing performance, our approach offers a more accessible device design for spin-based quantum technology research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：fabrication and measurements、RF-based single-shot spin readout、coherent control。；研究对象：Ge/SiGe量子阱中的空穴自旋量子比特，具体为采用全局积累栅和单层耗尽精细栅的器件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过简化器件制造工艺（使用全局积累栅和单层耗尽精细栅），实现了与复杂重叠栅器件性能相当的射频单次自旋读出和相干控制，且自旋相干时间和交换可调性相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过简化器件制造工艺（使用全局积累栅和单层耗尽精细栅），实现了与复杂重叠栅器件性能相当的射频单次自旋读出和相干控制，且自旋相干时间和交换可调性相似。；创新点：大幅降低了Ge/SiGe自旋量子比特器件的制造复杂度（无需多层图形化与套刻），同时保持了与先进重叠栅器件相当的性能，为自旋量子技术研究提供了更易实现的器件设计方案。
papers.method_zh: 器件制备（全局积累栅+单层耗尽精细栅）、射频反射测量（RF readout）、相干控制脉冲序列（coherent control）、自旋相干时间表征（spin coherence times）和交换耦合调谐（exchange tunability）。

papers.title: Anomalously high quasiparticle thermal conductivity in the underdoped cuprate superconductor HgBa$_{2}$CuO$_{4+δ}$
papers.abstract: The single-layer cuprate superconductor HgBa$_{2}$CuO$_{4+δ}$ (Hg1201) is an ideal candidate for investigating many properties of cuprates with minimal disorder and without the complication of multiple CuO$_2$ layers. Here we measure the in-plane longitudinal thermal conductivity $κ$ of underdoped Hg1201 ($T_c$ = 76 K, $p$ = 0.11) at dilution refrigerator temperatures to extract the nodal quasiparticle velocity ratio $v_F/v_Δ$. Assuming contributions from only a single line node per quadrant on the Fermi surface leads to a value of $v_F/v_Δ$ = $23 \pm 3$, anomalously large compared to other cuprates at similar dopings. In conjunction with the anomalously high quasiparticle specific heat of Hg1201 in the normal state reported previously at a similar doping, this points to more than one Fermi surface sheet crossing the nodal line, suggesting the presence of more than the single small electron pocket detected by quantum oscillations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“测量”热导率（measure the thermal conductivity）并“提取”准粒子速度比，属于实验测量与数据分析。；研究对象：欠掺杂的单层铜氧化物超导体 HgBa₂CuO₄₊δ (Hg1201)，具体研究其准粒子热导率及费米面结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在欠掺杂 Hg1201 中，提取的节点准粒子速度比 v_F/v_Δ = 23 ± 3，该值异常高于其他类似掺杂水平的铜氧化物。结合此前报道的异常高的正常态准粒子比热，暗示存在多于一个费米面片穿过节点线，即存在除量子振荡探测到的小电子口袋之外的费米面结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在欠掺杂 Hg1201 中，提取的节点准粒子速度比 v_F/v_Δ = 23 ± 3，该值异常高于其他类似掺杂水平的铜氧化物。结合此前报道的异常高的正常态准粒子比热，暗示存在多于一个费米面片穿过节点线，即存在除量子振荡探测到的小电子口袋之外的费米面结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 在稀释制冷机温度下测量面内纵向热导率 κ，通过分析节点准粒子对热输运的贡献，提取费米速度与超导能隙速度之比 v_F/v_Δ。

papers.title: Robust q-negative Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient
papers.abstract: The multifractal detrended cross-correlation coefficient $ρ_q(n)$ is widely used to investigate scale-dependent interactions, but its application to negative fluctuation orders is affected by numerical instabilities, unbounded values, and interpretational difficulties. We propose a Signed Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient, $ρ_{\mathrm{SMFDCCA}}(n,q)$, an amplitude-conditioned correlation observable for multifractal detrended analysis, based on locally normalized detrended correlations and regularized fluctuation amplitudes. The proposed coefficient preserves the sign of local interactions, remains strictly bounded within $[-1,1]$ for both positive and negative values of $q$, and eliminates the corrective procedures required by previous approaches. Validation using independent fractional Gaussian noise confirms the absence of spurious cross-correlations and the numerical stability of the method. Applications demonstrate that the proposed observable resolves how cross-correlations evolve jointly with temporal scale and fluctuation amplitude, revealing scale- and amplitude-dependent correlation structures, including stronger synchronization during large fluctuations in stock-market indices and heterogeneous coupling patterns in temperature records.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。关键词：提出、验证、应用（一种新的系数）。；研究对象：论文研究的是时间序列或信号之间的交叉相关性，具体关注的是多重分形去趋势交叉相关分析中的负波动阶数（negative fluctuation orders）问题。物理现象为尺度依赖的相互作用和波动幅度依赖的相关结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“有符号多重分形去趋势交叉相关系数”的新观测指标，该指标在正负波动阶数下均严格有界于[-1,1]，消除了数值不稳定性，并能揭示交叉相关随时间和波动幅度的联合演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“有符号多重分形去趋势交叉相关系数”的新观测指标，该指标在正负波动阶数下均严格有界于[-1,1]，消除了数值不稳定性，并能揭示交叉相关随时间和波动幅度的联合演化。；创新点：解决了传统多重分形去趋势交叉相关系数在负波动阶数（q<0）时存在的数值不稳定、无界值和解释困难的问题。新系数保留了局部相互作用的符号，无需先前方法所需的修正程序，并且能同时解析交叉相关在时间尺度和波动幅度两个维度上的演化。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个基于局部归一化去趋势相关性和正则化波动幅度的新统计量：Signed Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient (ρ_SMFDCCA(n,q))。通过独立分数高斯噪声进行数值验证，并应用于股票市场指数和温度记录等实际数据。

papers.title: Decoupling Josephson Coupling and Supercurrent Nonreciprocity in Twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 van der Waals Junctions
papers.abstract: The microscopic origin of supercurrent nonreciprocity in van der Waals Josephson junctions remains under active debate, particularly regarding the role of twist-angle engineering in layered superconductors. Here, we investigate superconducting transport in twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 vertical Josephson junctions fabricated by dry transfer with controlled crystallographic alignment and chemically clean interfaces. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy is employed to directly determine the twist angle and assess interface quality. While the Josephson coupling strength exhibits a pronounced dependence on twist angle, with characteristic voltages maximized near crystallographically equivalent orientations and suppressed at intermediate angles, the supercurrent diode efficiency remains negligibly small and shows no systematic twist-angle dependence. In contrast, enhanced diode-like responses emerge only in weakly coupled junctions exhibiting interfacial disorder and reduced transparency. Deliberate interface degradation further amplifies the apparent nonreciprocity, yielding diode efficiencies approaching 30% together with an irregular magnetic-field-strength dependence. These results establish a clear decoupling between Josephson coupling and supercurrent nonreciprocity in twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 junctions. Our findings identify interface disorder, rather than twist-angle-controlled momentum matching, as the dominant origin of the observed diode response and provide a critical benchmark for interpreting nonreciprocal superconducting transport in van der Waals Josephson devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：fabricated、High-resolution transmission electron microscopy、investigate superconducting transport。；研究对象：扭曲双层二硒化铌（NbSe₂/NbSe₂）范德华垂直约瑟夫森结中的超导输运现象，特别是超流非互易性（超导二极管效应）的微观起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂约瑟夫森结中，约瑟夫森耦合强度与超流非互易性（二极管效率）被明确解耦：耦合强度显著依赖于扭转角，但二极管效率极小且无系统扭转角依赖；相反，二极管效应仅在界面无序、透射率低的弱耦合结中出现，且通过人为退化界面可放大至约30%的效率。这表明界面无序而非扭转角控制的动量匹配是二极管响应的主导起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂约瑟夫森结中，约瑟夫森耦合强度与超流非互易性（二极管效率）被明确解耦：耦合强度显著依赖于扭转角，但二极管效率极小且无系统扭转角依赖；相反，二极管效应仅在界面无序、透射率低的弱耦合结中出现，且通过人为退化界面可放大至约30%的效率。这表明界面无序而非扭转角控制的动量匹配是二极管响应的主导起源。；创新点：通过系统对比扭转角与界面无序对超流非互易性的影响，首次实验证明在扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂结中，约瑟夫森耦合与超流非互易性可以完全解耦，并明确指出界面无序（而非扭转角）是二极管效应的主要成因，为解释范德华约瑟夫森器件中的非互易超导输运提供了关键基准。
papers.method_zh: 干法转移制备具有可控晶向对准和化学洁净界面的扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂垂直约瑟夫森结；使用高分辨率透射电子显微镜（HRTEM）直接测定扭转角和评估界面质量；通过输运测量表征约瑟夫森耦合强度（特征电压）和超流二极管效率。

papers.title: From Valley Filtering to Superconducting Diode Effect in Spin-Orbit Coupled Graphene Junctions
papers.abstract: We study the transport properties of proximitized graphene, which can acquire a spin-orbit coupling by the proximity effect with a substrate. We focus on the ballistic and zero temperature limits, making use of a tight-binding procedure based on the KWANT Python package. We first find key results on valley-filtering properties and asymmetric edge transport in spin-orbit coupled graphene single junctions, and then move to the analysis of the superconducting transport in a graphene Josephson junction, in the short junction limit. We study the relative contribution of edge modes for different edge terminations and some degree of edge disorder, and also analyze the magnetic interference pattern that arises when threading the junction with a perpendicular magnetic field. We find residual supercurrent at high magnetic fluxes, due to the localized nature of transport in the junction, and a strong non-reciprocal transport that leads to a significant Josephson diode effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“利用基于KWANT Python包的紧束缚方法”，且研究在弹道输运和零温极限下进行。；研究对象：近邻化石墨烯（proximitized graphene），具体研究其通过衬底近邻效应获得自旋-轨道耦合后的输运现象，包括单结中的谷过滤和边缘输运，以及石墨烯约瑟夫森结中的超导输运和约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋-轨道耦合石墨烯约瑟夫森结中，由于边缘模式的局域化输运，在高磁通下仍存在剩余超电流，并观测到显著的非互易输运，即约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋-轨道耦合石墨烯约瑟夫森结中，由于边缘模式的局域化输运，在高磁通下仍存在剩余超电流，并观测到显著的非互易输运，即约瑟夫森二极管效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于KWANT Python包的紧束缚方法（tight-binding procedure），在弹道输运和零温极限下进行计算。研究了不同边缘终止和一定边缘无序对边缘模式贡献的影响，以及垂直磁场下的磁干涉图案。

papers.title: Composite-Fermion Study of Cavity-Modified Fractional Quantum Hall Excitation Gaps
papers.abstract: We investigate how cavity-mediated attractive electron-electron interactions modify the excitation gaps of fractional quantum Hall states within the composite-fermion framework. We compute both the neutral magnetoroton excitation spectrum and the charged excitation gap relevant to transport experiments for the Laughlin $ν=1/3$ and $ν=1/5$ states. We consider a spin-polarized lowest-Landau-level model in which the interaction is mediated by a cavity mode with a spatially uniform vacuum-field gradient and a finite interaction range controlled by a long-distance cutoff. Finite-size scaling reveals that the transport gap is consistently enhanced by the cavity-induced interaction, with the gap enhancement scaling quadratically with the electron number and with the fourth power of the vacuum-field gradient. By contrast, the magnetoroton spectrum exhibits a richer dependence on the interaction range. The high-$k$ magnetoroton gap is enhanced for all interaction ranges considered, consistent with its close connection to the charged excitation gap, even with the long-range character of the interaction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：composite-fermion framework（复合费米子框架）、finite-size scaling（有限尺寸标度）、计算 excitation gaps（激发能隙）。；研究对象：腔修饰的分数量子霍尔态，具体为Laughlin ν=1/3和ν=1/5态，研究腔模诱导的吸引性电子-电子相互作用对其激发能隙的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 腔诱导的相互作用一致性地增强了输运能隙，增强幅度与电子数的平方及真空场梯度的四次方成正比；而磁激子谱对相互作用范围表现出更丰富的依赖性，高k磁激子能隙在所有考虑的作用范围内均被增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔诱导的相互作用一致性地增强了输运能隙，增强幅度与电子数的平方及真空场梯度的四次方成正比；而磁激子谱对相互作用范围表现出更丰富的依赖性，高k磁激子能隙在所有考虑的作用范围内均被增强。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 在自旋极化的最低朗道能级模型中，采用复合费米子理论框架，计算中性磁激子激发谱和带电激发能隙（与输运实验相关）。相互作用由腔模介导，具有空间均匀的真空场梯度和由长程截断控制的有限相互作用范围，并通过有限尺寸标度分析结果。

papers.title: Bockstein Braiding Statistics Versus Three-Loop Braiding
papers.abstract: Braiding statistics of $p$- and $q$-dimensional topological excitations is conventionally defined in $p+q+2$ spatial dimensions. We find a novel statistical process $W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N$ for two order-$N$ excitations in $p+q+1$ dimensions, detecting the Bockstein response $A\smile β(B)$. This new statistics and fermionic loop statistics exhaust all loop statistics in three dimensions whose fusion rules form an Abelian group $G$, classified by $H^5(B^2G,U(1))$. Surprisingly, conventional three-loop braiding goes beyond this classification, so it must have non-Abelian fusion rules. We suggest viewing three-loop braiding as particle-loop braiding together with exotic fusion rules between loops and point-like defects. We also try to clarify the relationship between statistics and symmetry anomaly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：braiding statistics、topological excitations、classification、symmetry anomaly。；研究对象：拓扑激发（p维和q维激发）的编织统计，特别是三维空间中环状激发（loop excitations）的编织行为，以及Bockstein响应与三环编织的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在p+q+1维空间中，发现了一种针对阶数为N的激发的新型统计过程W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N，该过程可探测Bockstein响应A∪β(B)。此外，传统三环编织（three-loop braiding）的融合规则必然是非阿贝尔的，因为它超出了由H^5(B^2G,U(1))分类的阿贝尔群编织统计范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在p+q+1维空间中，发现了一种针对阶数为N的激发的新型统计过程W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N，该过程可探测Bockstein响应A∪β(B)。此外，传统三环编织（three-loop braiding）的融合规则必然是非阿贝尔的，因为它超出了由H^5(B^2G,U(1))分类的阿贝尔群编织统计范围。；创新点：发现了在p+q+1维空间中由Bockstein响应驱动的全新编织统计过程，并指出传统三环编织必须具有非阿贝尔融合规则，从而将其与阿贝尔群分类的编织统计区分开来。摘要未突出说明该工作是否首次提出将三环编织视为粒子-环编织与环-点缺陷奇异融合规则的组合。
papers.method_zh: 采用拓扑量子场论与代数拓扑方法，通过分析Bockstein同态与上同调群H^5(B^2G,U(1))对编织统计进行分类，并对比传统三环编织与粒子-环编织的统计行为。

papers.title: Chiral Graviton Modes in Non-Abelian lattice Fractional Quantum Hall states
papers.abstract: Synthetic quantum matter provides a highly tunable route to fractional quantum Hall physics beyond the constraints of conventional electronic materials. However, previous theoretical studies have mostly focused on their ground state properties. It remains unclear to what extent such platforms could reveal key excitation properties of fractional quantum Hall states. Here, we study charge-neutral collective excitations in a non-abelian lattice fractional quantum Hall state realized in the bosonic Harper-Hofstadter model at unity filling factior, realizing a Moore-Read ground state. Combining full exact diagonalization, band-projected exact diagonalization, and matrix-product-state simulations, we demonstrate the existence of a long-lived chiral graviton mode, probed by chiral 3-body correlators, for the first time on lattice non-Abelian states. The graviton signal is topological sector-independent and could be observed via geometric quenches in small open droplets directly relevant to current cold-atom experiments, while other neutral modes, such as the magnetoroton and neutral fermion, are less resolved at presently achievable volumes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：full exact diagonalization, band-projected exact diagonalization, matrix-product-state simulations。；研究对象：非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态中的手性引力子模式，具体为玻色Harper-Hofstadter模型在填充因子为1时实现的Moore-Read基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态中证明了长寿命手性引力子模式的存在，该模式可通过手性三体关联函数探测，且与拓扑扇区无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态中证明了长寿命手性引力子模式的存在，该模式可通过手性三体关联函数探测，且与拓扑扇区无关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合全精确对角化、能带投影精确对角化以及矩阵乘积态模拟，通过手性三体关联函数表征引力子信号，并考虑几何淬火在小型开放液滴中的可观测性。

papers.title: Uncovering Collective Modes Underlying the Giant Dielectric Response of Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystals
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals (FNLCs) are polar fluids in which spontaneous polarization coexists with nematic orientational order, giving rise to unusual dielectric and electromechanical responses. However, the collective modes underlying their giant dielectric response remain unclear. Here, we show that this response originates from the superposition of two distinct relaxation modes rather than a single process. Dielectric spectroscopy reveals that the low-frequency mode exhibits soft-mode-like behavior associated with short-axis molecular rotation, whereas the high-frequency mode corresponds to a Goldstone-like phase displacement of an effective transverse polarization component rotating around the director. These assignments are supported by systematic analyses of temperature, electric-field, cell-thickness, and alignment-layer dependences. Our results demonstrate that the giant dielectric response of ferroelectric nematics reflects multiple collective polarization dynamics with different symmetries and restoring forces, providing a framework for interpreting dielectric spectra in polar nematic fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“Dielectric spectroscopy”（介电谱）以及“systematic analyses of temperature, electric-field, cell-thickness, and alignment-layer dependences”（对温度、电场、电池厚度和取向层的系统分析），表明主要采用实验测量手段。；研究对象：铁电向列液晶（Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystals, FNLCs）中的集体极化动力学模式，特别是其巨介电响应的微观起源。
