papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁电向列液晶的巨介电响应并非源于单一弛豫过程，而是由两种不同弛豫模式的叠加产生：低频模式表现为与短轴分子旋转相关的软模行为，高频模式对应于有效横向极化分量绕指向矢旋转的类Goldstone相位位移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁电向列液晶的巨介电响应并非源于单一弛豫过程，而是由两种不同弛豫模式的叠加产生：低频模式表现为与短轴分子旋转相关的软模行为，高频模式对应于有效横向极化分量绕指向矢旋转的类Goldstone相位位移。；创新点：首次揭示了铁电向列液晶巨介电响应由两种具有不同对称性和恢复力的集体极化动力学模式（软模与类Goldstone模）共同贡献，为解释极性向列流体的介电谱提供了新框架。
papers.method_zh: 介电谱（Dielectric spectroscopy）测量，并结合对温度、外加电场、样品厚度以及取向层材料的系统依赖性分析。

papers.title: Local spin magnetization in itinerant non-collinear magnets: The local spin Berry curvature
papers.abstract: Conventionally, the local spin magnetization in itinerant magnets is determined from the equilibrium local spin density. Here, we propose a thermodynamic approach in which the local spin magnetization is defined from the response of the system to an infinitesimal external magnetic field. The predictions of the two theories are identical for collinear magnets, but differ qualitatively and quantitatively for non-collinear magnets. In the present thermodynamic approach, the spin coherences determine an alternative distribution of local spin magnetization due to the field-induced deformation of the energy eigenstates. This effect is captured by a Berry-curvature-like contribution reminiscent of orbital magnetization and has several distinct observable consequences. We explore the differences between the conventional and thermodynamic approaches in several test cases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“thermodynamic approach”（热力学方法），并基于“Berry-curvature-like contribution”（类似贝里曲率的贡献）进行理论推导，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：巡游非共线磁体中的局域自旋磁化。具体物理现象为：在非共线磁体中，局域自旋磁化的定义方式及其与常规自旋密度方法的差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于非共线磁体，基于热力学响应定义的局域自旋磁化与常规的平衡局域自旋密度结果存在定性和定量差异；这种差异源于外场诱导的能态形变，可由类似贝里曲率的贡献描述，并具有可观测的物理后果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于非共线磁体，基于热力学响应定义的局域自旋磁化与常规的平衡局域自旋密度结果存在定性和定量差异；这种差异源于外场诱导的能态形变，可由类似贝里曲率的贡献描述，并具有可观测的物理后果。；创新点：提出了一种不同于传统平衡自旋密度的热力学定义局域自旋磁化的方法，揭示了非共线磁体中自旋相干性对磁化分布的新贡献，并指出该贡献与轨道磁化中的贝里曲率效应类似。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：热力学方法，通过系统对无穷小外磁场的响应来定义局域自旋磁化；引入类似轨道磁化中贝里曲率的贡献（local spin Berry curvature）来捕捉自旋相干性导致的效应。

papers.title: Classical Reversible Computation by Quantum Coherence
papers.abstract: Rising energy demand from data-centre and AI applications has renewed interest in reversible computation, where logic need not dissipate heat at every step if information is uncomputed. Implementations have so far been classical: adiabatic CMOS reduces dissipation by slowing charge motion but is still limited by the threshold physics of transistors. Here we propose classical reversible logic implemented by coherent spin dynamics in a spin quantum-dot array, with inputs and outputs in classical basis states and no algorithmic use of superposition. The same spin stores, transports, and computes, with unitary rotation replacing irreversible switching. The universal building block is an iToffoli gate driven by DC voltage pulses and anisotropic exchange in Ge/Si hole spins. Simulations with experimental parameters reproduce the Toffoli truth table and yield a testable error landscape. Because shuttling transports the bit without measurement, logic and data movement remain reversible until readout. Millivolt pulses on femtofarad gates yield a gate energy below the 4~K Landauer scale, about five (eight) orders of magnitude below a room-temperature CMOS Toffoli with (without) 4 K cooling overhead. The same semiconductor hardware is therefore dual-use, supporting quantum algorithms when superposition is used and classical reversible logic otherwise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose、simulations、theoretical framework）；研究对象：基于自旋量子点阵列的经典可逆逻辑门，具体为Ge/Si空穴自旋体系中的iToffoli门。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用相干自旋动力学（而非传统晶体管开关）实现经典可逆计算，其单门能耗低于4K温度下的Landauer极限，比室温CMOS Toffoli门低约5-8个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用相干自旋动力学（而非传统晶体管开关）实现经典可逆计算，其单门能耗低于4K温度下的Landauer极限，比室温CMOS Toffoli门低约5-8个数量级。；创新点：提出同一半导体硬件可双重使用：利用叠加态时支持量子算法，否则执行经典可逆逻辑，且自旋同时承担存储、传输和计算功能，无需测量即可实现比特的往返传输。
papers.method_zh: 通过DC电压脉冲和Ge/Si空穴自旋的各向异性交换作用驱动iToffoli门，结合实验参数进行数值模拟，复现Toffoli真值表并生成可检验的误差图景。

papers.title: Piezoaxial coupling for strain-selected ferroaxial domain control
papers.abstract: We formulate a symmetry-based hierarchy of strain-derived conjugate fields for ferroaxial order, and demonstrate strain-selected ferroaxial domain control using first-principles calculations. Since ferroaxial order is even under both spatial inversion and time reversal, ordinary electric and magnetic fields cannot serve as universal linear conjugate fields. Homogeneous strain, however, can generate symmetry-allowed piezoaxial fields whose leading order is determined by the parent point group and by the chosen ferroaxial-axis component. For basal-plane strain, the leading field is linear in orthorhombic systems, quadratic in tetragonal systems, and cubic in trigonal and hexagonal systems. Cubic parent groups further split into two classes: cubic-I groups, $23$ and $m\bar{3}$, allow linear full-strain fields for selected axes, whereas cubic-II groups, $432$, $\bar{4}3m$, and $m\bar{3}m$, forbid linear fields and require quadratic or cubic strain combinations depending on the selected axis. In trigonal systems, the basal-plane deviatoric strain with signed amplitude $\varepsilon_{\rm u}$ and principal-axis angle $θ$ gives the single-axis field $h\propto\varepsilon_{\rm u}^3\sin6θ$. First-principles calculations for the trigonal ferroaxial compound Na$_2$BaMg(PO$_4$)$_2$ verify both the predicted angular dependence and cubic strain scaling of the ferroaxial domain splitting, and fixed-strain atomic relaxations show strain-selected evolution from the para-axial structure. These results establish static homogeneous strain as a symmetry-allowed conjugate field for ferroaxial order and suggest a route to ferroaxial domain control through strain-field cooling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章+计算文章。关键词：symmetry-based hierarchy、first-principles calculations、formulate、demonstrate。；研究对象：铁轴向序（ferroaxial order）及其在应变下的畴控制，具体材料为三角晶系铁轴向化合物 Na₂BaMg(PO₄)₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 均匀静态应变可作为铁轴向序的对称性允许共轭场，通过应变场冷却实现铁轴向畴的选择性控制；在三角晶系中，畴分裂与应变的三次方及角度六倍正弦关系成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：均匀静态应变可作为铁轴向序的对称性允许共轭场，通过应变场冷却实现铁轴向畴的选择性控制；在三角晶系中，畴分裂与应变的三次方及角度六倍正弦关系成立。；创新点：首次系统建立了应变作为铁轴向序共轭场的对称性框架，并揭示了不同母点群下应变场的主导阶次（线性、二次、三次），为通过静态应变而非电场/磁场控制铁轴向畴提供了理论依据和计算验证。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析构建应变衍生共轭场的层级关系；采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）验证预测的角依赖性和应变三次方标度关系，并进行固定应变下的原子弛豫模拟。

papers.title: Thermodynamic phase transitions in lattice spin systems with severe kinetic constraints: Numerical simulation results
papers.abstract: The Fredrickson-Andersen model with hyperparameter $K=1$ is a severely constrained kinetic lattice spin system, such that any site is temporarily blocked from changing its packing state (empty or occupied) if there is one or more occupied nearest neighbors. Starting from a completely random initial configuration with a fraction $ρ$ of sites being occupied, some of the sites may be permanently frozen to their initial state under this severe kinetic constraint. The remaining sites can switch states at least occasionally, and they form the unfrozen subsystem associated with the given initial configuration. In the present work we investigate thermodynamic phase transitions in such unfrozen subsystems of the two-dimensional square lattice and the three-dimensional cubic lattice by extensive numerical simulations. We demonstrate that the giant connected component of the unfrozen subsystem collapses at certain critical value $ρ_{c}$ of initial packing density, with $ρ_c = 0.2475$ for the square lattice and $ρ_c = 0.2809$ for the cubic lattice. This phase transition belongs to the same universality class of the conventional site percolation. We also observe that the ground states (densest packing configurations) experience a continuous crystal-to-glass phase transition at the critical value $ρ^* = 0.1423$ of initial packing density for the cubic lattice. For the two-dimensional square lattice we argue that long-range crystalline order is destroyed in the ground states as long as the initial packing density $ρ$ is positive.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。判断依据：关键词“extensive numerical simulations”、“numerical simulation results”。；研究对象：具有严重动力学约束的晶格自旋系统，具体为Fredrickson-Andersen模型（超参数K=1）在二维正方晶格和三维立方晶格中的“未冻结子系统”的热力学相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 未冻结子系统的巨连通分量在初始填充密度ρ达到临界值ρ_c时发生坍塌（二维ρ_c=0.2475，三维ρ_c=0.2809），该相变属于常规格点逾渗的普适类。此外，三维立方晶格的基态（最密堆积构型）在初始填充密度ρ*=0.1423处经历连续晶体-玻璃相变；二维正方晶格的基态中，只要初始填充密度ρ>0，长程晶序即被破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：未冻结子系统的巨连通分量在初始填充密度ρ达到临界值ρ_c时发生坍塌（二维ρ_c=0.2475，三维ρ_c=0.2809），该相变属于常规格点逾渗的普适类。此外，三维立方晶格的基态（最密堆积构型）在初始填充密度ρ*=0.1423处经历连续晶体-玻璃相变；二维正方晶格的基态中，只要初始填充密度ρ>0，长程晶序即被破坏。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过大规模数值模拟，分析未冻结子系统的连通性及基态构型，确定临界密度并标度相变普适类。

papers.title: Robust Topologically Protected Edge Transport in Doubly Chiral Active Particles
papers.abstract: Using theory, simulation, and experiment, we introduce a new class of active particle which we term doubly chiral active Brownian particles (dcABPs), which show robust topologically protected transport along boundaries without backscattering at corners. Their double chirality stems from the coexistence of an intrinsic angular velocity, which can cause rotation independently of translation, and a translation-rotation coupling inducing cross-alignment to the instantaneous velocity, which causes rotation only concomitantly with translation. A mechanically detailed model shows that the latter effect can arise from an asymmetric friction distribution in the direction perpendicular to the self-propulsion direction. We show that topologically protected modes emerge when the two sources of chirality have opposite sign and the intrinsic rotation is weaker than the translation-rotation coupling. In the deterministic limit, we characterize the emergence of these modes not only along straight boundaries, but also along curved boundaries and during interparticle interactions. We provide a proof-of-principle experimental realization by building a doubly chiral vibrobot. While setting the work into context, we moreover show that the topologically protected boundary-induced transport of dcABPs stands in contrast to the edge currents observed for simple chiral ABPs, which we demonstrate are not associated with boundary-induced transport, as well as to those observed for chiral active rods or self-aligning chiral ABPs, which we show to be associated with boundary-induced transport but to backscatter at corners, implying lack of topological protection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论、模拟与实验结合）。判断依据：摘要明确提及“theory, simulation, and experiment”。；研究对象：双旋手性活性布朗粒子（doubly chiral active Brownian particles, dcABPs）及其边界拓扑保护输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两种手性来源符号相反且内禀旋转弱于平移-旋转耦合时，dcABPs沿边界出现拓扑保护模式，该模式在直边界、弯曲边界及粒子间相互作用中均稳定存在，且无角向背散射，区别于普通手性活性粒子的边缘流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两种手性来源符号相反且内禀旋转弱于平移-旋转耦合时，dcABPs沿边界出现拓扑保护模式，该模式在直边界、弯曲边界及粒子间相互作用中均稳定存在，且无角向背散射，区别于普通手性活性粒子的边缘流。；创新点：首次提出并实现“双旋手性”活性粒子概念，证明其边界输运具有拓扑保护特性（无角向背散射），并明确区分了该现象与普通手性活性粒子（无边界输运）及手性活性棒/自对准手性活性粒子（有边界输运但存在角向背散射）的本质差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模（含机械细节模型，指出不对称摩擦分布可产生平移-旋转耦合）、数值模拟、实验构建双旋手性振动机器人（vibrobot）进行原理验证。

papers.title: Uncertainty relations for arbitrary currents in coherent transport
papers.abstract: We derive thermodynamic and kinetic uncertainty relations valid for arbitrary currents in coherent, strongly coupled, linear systems out of equilibrium. Exploiting properties of the transport statistics, in particular fluctuation theorems, we identify the relevant entropy production and activity that determine the cost of precision at the level of individual scattering events. The resulting bounds include higher-order fluctuations and remain valid far from equilibrium. We illustrate our results in normal and superconducting hybrid structures, and show that their predictiveness and validity range exceeds existing formulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“derive”（推导）、“exploiting properties of the transport statistics”（利用输运统计性质）、“identify”（识别）等理论推导与概念分析关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：相干输运中任意电流的涨落与精度限制，具体应用于正常导体和超导混合结构中的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相干、强耦合、线性非平衡系统中，推导出适用于任意电流的热力学和动力学不确定关系，指出在单次散射事件层面，熵产生和活性（activity）决定了精度的代价，且这些界限在远离平衡态时仍成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相干、强耦合、线性非平衡系统中，推导出适用于任意电流的热力学和动力学不确定关系，指出在单次散射事件层面，熵产生和活性（activity）决定了精度的代价，且这些界限在远离平衡态时仍成立。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但指出所得界限包含高阶涨落，且其预测能力和适用范围超越了现有公式。
papers.method_zh: 利用输运统计性质（特别是涨落定理）进行理论推导，识别相关的熵产生和活性，并通过正常导体和超导混合结构中的实例进行验证。

papers.title: On the capacitance gradient description in Heterodyne Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
papers.abstract: Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) probes local surface-potential variations through the electrostatic force between a conductive tip and a surface, which depends on the potential difference and the tip-surface capacitance gradient (CG). In heterodyne KPFM, the oscillating tip is usually treated by combining a bias-modulated electric field with a first-order truncated Taylor-series expansion of the CG. Although convenient, this treatment is limited to a poorly defined small-amplitude regime and leaves the convergence of the series unresolved. Here, we establish a rigorous spectral description of the CG dynamics and of the resulting electrostatic force beyond this approximation. We formulate a non-truncated Taylor-series description of the CG and prove its convergence for a realistic Hudlet-based capacitance model in both monomodal and bimodal motion. In the monomodal case, we show the equivalence between Fourier-series and Taylor-series descriptions, derive explicit expressions for the dominant Fourier coefficients, and introduce order-truncation criteria that replace the usual qualitative notion of a small-amplitude regime. We then extend the formalism to bimodal motion and derive the effective CG coefficients governing the static, first-eigenmode, and second-eigenmode components of the electrostatic interaction. Numerical simulations confirm the convergence of the Taylor-based coefficients toward the Fourier coefficients and support the truncation-regime hierarchy in both configurations. This work establishes the formal basis for describing electrostatic force components and AFM observables in open-loop heterodyne experiments and provides a general framework for CG dynamics in multimode force microscopy involving nonlinear electromechanical coupling and frequency conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：建立描述、推导表达式、数值模拟、形式化框架。；研究对象：异质外差开尔文探针力显微镜（Heterodyne KPFM）中，导电针尖与样品表面之间的电容梯度（CG）动力学行为，以及由此产生的静电力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了超越传统一阶泰勒展开近似的电容梯度严格谱描述，证明了基于Hudlet电容模型的泰勒级数在单模态和双模态运动下的收敛性，并给出了替代“小振幅”定性概念的截断判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了超越传统一阶泰勒展开近似的电容梯度严格谱描述，证明了基于Hudlet电容模型的泰勒级数在单模态和双模态运动下的收敛性，并给出了替代“小振幅”定性概念的截断判据。；创新点：首次严格处理了异质外差KPFM中电容梯度的高阶项，解决了传统一阶近似中“小振幅”条件定义模糊且级数收敛性未解决的问题，并将形式化描述推广至双模态运动。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：非截断泰勒级数展开与傅里叶级数展开的等价性证明；数值模拟：验证泰勒系数向傅里叶系数的收敛性及截断层次。

papers.title: Layer-selective chirality switch in bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers
papers.abstract: We predict that intercalating bilayer graphene with nonmagnetic WSSe or magnetic MnSSe Janus monolayers induces a layer-selective switch of the in-plane Rashba spin texture, resulting in opposite spin current directions in the top and bottom graphene layers. First-principles calculations reveal that both Janus monolayers decouple the two graphene layers while simultaneously inducing opposite signs of the proximity-induced Rashba spin-orbit coupling in each. Tight-binding modeling of the proximitized layers, combined with Rashba-Edelstein charge-to-spin conversion calculations, confirms that the spin current direction can be independently controlled by gating the top or bottom graphene layer. Bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers thus represents a promising platform for gate-tunable, layer-selective spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。判断依据：关键词“predict”、“First-principles calculations”、“Tight-binding modeling”。；研究对象：双层石墨烯中插入非磁性WSSe或磁性MnSSe Janus单层的异质结构，以及其中由近邻效应诱导的层选择性Rashba自旋织构和自旋电流方向。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 插入Janus单层后，上下两层石墨烯被解耦，并分别被诱导出符号相反的近邻Rashba自旋-轨道耦合，导致两层中面内Rashba自旋织构方向相反，从而产生方向相反的自旋电流；通过分别对顶层或底层石墨烯施加栅压，可独立控制自旋电流方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：插入Janus单层后，上下两层石墨烯被解耦，并分别被诱导出符号相反的近邻Rashba自旋-轨道耦合，导致两层中面内Rashba自旋织构方向相反，从而产生方向相反的自旋电流；通过分别对顶层或底层石墨烯施加栅压，可独立控制自旋电流方向。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）和紧束缚模型（Tight-binding modeling），并结合Rashba-Edelstein电荷-自旋转换计算。

papers.title: Quantum Density of States and Integer Partitions: A Semiclassical Approach
papers.abstract: In this review we discuss semi-classical methods that are traditionally used to describe many-body systems in physics, but may also be used to describe partitions of integers in analytic number theory. Specifically, we explore the connection between the methods of statistical mechanics and number partitions. Though the two fields appear very different, their fundamental issues bear a close resemblance. In the former case it is the distribution of a given amount of energy among the particles in an ensemble at a given temperature with well defined properties, while in the latter case it is the way an integer is partitioned into other integers, with or without restrictions. We begin with a discussion of the single-particle quantum density of states, also called the level density, in which we illustrate the connection between the density of states and the classical periodic orbits through the semiclassical trace formula. This is then extended to many particle systems. We show that the asymptotic number partition is reproduced by the average (smooth) part of the level density at discrete integer values of the argument. In the especially interesting case of distinct square partitions, pronounced oscillations are well reproduced by the periodic orbit theory in terms of a few orbits characterised by Pythagorean number triples. We speculate on the connection to Fermat's theorem as to why such regular oscillations (though vanishing asymptotically) exist only in this special case. Finally, we discuss some new results for integer partitions of primes, both unrestricted and distinct.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：semi-classical methods、review、analytic number theory、trace formula、periodic orbit theory）；研究对象：整数分划（integer partitions）与多体系统态密度之间的半经典联系，特别关注无限制分划、不同平方数分划以及素数分划。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 整数分划的渐近行为可由单粒子能级密度的平滑部分在离散整数自变量下重现；不同平方数分划中的显著振荡可通过毕达哥拉斯三元数刻画的少数周期轨道精确再现，并推测这种振荡与费马定理有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：整数分划的渐近行为可由单粒子能级密度的平滑部分在离散整数自变量下重现；不同平方数分划中的显著振荡可通过毕达哥拉斯三元数刻画的少数周期轨道精确再现，并推测这种振荡与费马定理有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 半经典迹公式（semiclassical trace formula）、周期轨道理论（periodic orbit theory）、统计力学方法（用于描述多体系统能级分布）。

papers.title: Inverse heterodyne effect in bimodal Kelvin probe force microscopy
papers.abstract: Heterodyne Kelvin probe force microscopy (He-KPFM) enables high-sensitivity electrostatic measurements by converting a bias-modulated interaction into a resonant response at a higher cantilever eigenmode. While the "direct" heterodyne actuation of the second eigenmode is well established, the dynamical back-action of this heterodyne-driven motion on the fundamental eigenmode has remained largely unexplored, particularly in open-loop operation where the second mode is excited to a finite amplitude. Here, we demonstrate an inverse heterodyne effect: a force component generated by heterodyne frequency conversion acts back on the first eigenmode and produces measurable inter-mode energy exchange. The analysis combines a bimodal virial and power-balance framework with a non-truncated description of the tip-surface capacitance-gradient dynamics developed and validated in a companion manuscript submitted concurrently to the same journal. On this basis, we derive closed-form expressions linking inverse heterodyne coupling to the experimentally accessible observables of non-contact AFM open-loop amplitude-modulated He-KPFM. The theory predicts that inverse heterodyne coupling appears predominantly in the dissipation channel, with a sharply resonant dependence on the demodulation frequency near the second-eigenmode resonance, while its conservative contribution to the frequency shift remains comparatively weaker under typical conditions. Ultrahigh-vacuum experiments validate these predictions and isolate the inverse heterodyne signature through frequency- and voltage-dependent measurements. Beyond KPFM, this work connects heterodyne force microscopy to a broader class of driven multimode systems in which nonlinear coupling and frequency conversion produce inter-mode energy transfer, back-action, and dissipation-based observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analysis combines a bimodal virial and power-balance framework with a non-truncated description... developed and validated in a companion manuscript”，以及“Ultrahigh-vacuum experiments validate these predictions”。；研究对象：双模态开尔文探针力显微镜（bimodal Kelvin probe force microscopy）中的逆外差效应（inverse heterodyne effect），具体为悬臂梁第一本征模与第二本征模之间的动力学反作用及模间能量交换。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在开环操作的双模态开尔文探针力显微镜中，存在一种逆外差效应：由外差频率转换产生的力分量会反作用于第一本征模，导致可测量的模间能量交换。该效应主要出现在耗散通道中，并在解调频率接近第二本征模共振时呈现尖锐的共振依赖，而其保守贡献（频率移动）在典型条件下相对较弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在开环操作的双模态开尔文探针力显微镜中，存在一种逆外差效应：由外差频率转换产生的力分量会反作用于第一本征模，导致可测量的模间能量交换。该效应主要出现在耗散通道中，并在解调频率接近第二本征模共振时呈现尖锐的共振依赖，而其保守贡献（频率移动）在典型条件下相对较弱。；创新点：首次揭示并定量描述了双模态KPFM中由外差驱动运动对第一本征模产生的动力学反作用（逆外差效应），并建立了该效应与实验可观测量的闭合解析表达式。摘要未突出说明与已有He-KPFM研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：双模态维里（virial）与功率平衡（power-balance）框架，结合对针尖-表面电容梯度动力学的非截断描述。实验手段：超高真空环境下的非接触原子力显微镜开环振幅调制外差开尔文探针力显微镜（open-loop amplitude-modulated He-KPFM），通过频率和电压依赖测量分离逆外差信号。

papers.title: Hidden Entropy Production at Mechanical Stall: Exact Reconstruction in a Reciprocal Brownian Motor
papers.abstract: We show that in a reciprocal Brownian motor the entropy production hidden behind a mechanically stalled coordinate can be reconstructed exactly from measurements of that coordinate alone. We introduce a minimal, analytically solvable Langevin motor in which an observed translational coordinate is coupled reciprocally to a hidden internal rotor: a single periodic potential $V(x-\ellθ)$ generates both the force on the observed coordinate and the reaction torque on the hidden one, so that $τ_{\rm int}=-\ell F_x$ holds identically. Force--torque reciprocity together with translational symmetry produces a local current identity that closes the hidden thermodynamic bookkeeping. From it we prove that the Harada--Sasa heat measured through the observed coordinate equals the positive current-square dissipation of that coordinate, with the information-flow correction vanishing identically. eciprocal class. ries in that it requires no separation of time scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically solvable Langevin motor、reciprocal Brownian motor、local current identity。；研究对象：一种互易布朗马达（reciprocal Brownian motor），其中可观测的平动坐标与隐藏的内部转子通过单一周期势耦合，形成机械失速（mechanical stall）条件下的隐藏熵产生。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在机械失速条件下，隐藏的熵产生可以通过仅观测平动坐标精确重构，且Harada-Sasa热测量等于该坐标的正电流平方耗散，信息流修正项恒为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在机械失速条件下，隐藏的熵产生可以通过仅观测平动坐标精确重构，且Harada-Sasa热测量等于该坐标的正电流平方耗散，信息流修正项恒为零。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 引入一个最小化、可解析求解的朗之万马达模型，利用力-扭矩互易性（force–torque reciprocity）和平移对称性推导出局部电流恒等式，从而闭合隐藏的热力学记账。

papers.title: Self-Bound Droplets of Ultracold Dipolar Molecules under Tunable Double Microwave Shielding
papers.abstract: We use the Ground-State Path Integral Monte Carlo method to study a Bose-Einstein condensate of strongly interacting NaCs polar molecules under the action of a fully anisotropic double microwave shielding potential characterized by a linear and an elliptical polarization field. In particular, we analyze the ground state of the system and its structure as a function of the ellipticity angle $ξ$. While for the circularly polarized case ($ξ=0$) a gas phase is realized, one or more self-bound droplets are observed for small $|ξ|$'s above a threshold value near $3^\circ$. With increasing $ξ$, the observed droplets rapidly become tightly bound and are estimated to form a superfluid array. Our results compare favorably to the experimental observations in [Zhang et al., Nature \textbf{651}, 601 (2026)] for positive $ξ$, while moderate differences show up for $ξ<0$ where our simulations conform to the expected symmetries of the intermolecular potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Ground-State Path Integral Monte Carlo method（基态路径积分蒙特卡洛方法）、simulations（模拟）。；研究对象：超冷NaCs极性分子在双微波屏蔽势作用下的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，具体研究其自束缚液滴的形成与结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双微波屏蔽势中，当椭圆偏振角ξ从零（圆偏振）增大到约3°以上时，体系从气相转变为自束缚液滴，且液滴随ξ增大迅速变得紧密束缚，可能形成超流阵列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双微波屏蔽势中，当椭圆偏振角ξ从零（圆偏振）增大到约3°以上时，体系从气相转变为自束缚液滴，且液滴随ξ增大迅速变得紧密束缚，可能形成超流阵列。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基态路径积分蒙特卡洛方法（Ground-State Path Integral Monte Carlo method），用于模拟全各向异性双微波屏蔽势下强相互作用的NaCs极性分子BEC的基态。

papers.title: Multiscale modelling of diffusion and retention of hydrogen in multi-occupancy traps in irradiated bcc metals
papers.abstract: We use molecular dynamics simulations to directly compute the effective diffusivity of hydrogen gas atoms in homogeneous distributions of monovacancies in tungsten and vanadium, and voids in tungsten. Rather than fitting the results to an Arrhenius law, we compare to an analytic approximation for the effective diffusivity recently derived for multi-occupancy traps [Kaur et al (2025), Phys. Rev. Mater. 9:125404]. We find good agreement between full atomistic simulation and our theory, validating the analytic model for diffusivity for materials containing nanoscale defects characteristic of radiation damage. There are no parameters fitted, only physically motivated quantities that can be computed with static density functional or atomistic potential calculations. In this study we prove rapid convergence of hydrogen trap occupation to the steady state using lattice kinetic Monte Carlo, the spontaneous emergence of voids in tungsten using atomistic simulation with empirical potentials, and molecular hydrogen formation in voids using molecular dynamics. We conclude with a prediction for diffusion and retention of hydrogen in voids in tungsten starting from first principles. This work shows that not only is the analytic form for diffusivity and retention in multi-occupancy traps a practical scheme for making predictive simulations of hydrogen isotope diffusion and retention in irradiated microstructures, derived and parameterized from first principles, it is superior to existing single-occupancy trap formalisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：molecular dynamics simulations、lattice kinetic Monte Carlo、atomistic simulation、first principles）；研究对象：氢原子在辐照体心立方金属（钨和钒）中的扩散与滞留行为，具体涉及单空位和空洞中的多占据陷阱效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于多占据陷阱模型推导的有效扩散率解析近似公式，与全原子分子动力学模拟结果吻合良好，验证了该解析模型在描述含纳米级辐照缺陷材料中氢扩散行为的有效性，且无需拟合参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于多占据陷阱模型推导的有效扩散率解析近似公式，与全原子分子动力学模拟结果吻合良好，验证了该解析模型在描述含纳米级辐照缺陷材料中氢扩散行为的有效性，且无需拟合参数。；创新点：首次将多占据陷阱解析模型直接与全原子模拟对比验证，证明该模型优于传统单占据陷阱形式，且所有参数均可通过第一性原理或原子势计算获得，无需经验拟合。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（直接计算有效扩散率）、晶格动力学蒙特卡洛（验证陷阱占据稳态收敛）、经验势原子模拟（自发形成空洞）、密度泛函理论或原子势静态计算（提供物理量）。与Kaur等人(2025)推导的多占据陷阱有效扩散率解析近似进行对比。

papers.title: Conditional Residence Times and Sequential Transition Dynamics of an Overdamped Dimer
papers.abstract: We investigate the completion dynamics of an overdamped dimer moving in a bistable potential under thermal fluctuations and a weak periodic force. Both monomers start in one of the two wells separated by a barrier. The transition is initiated when the monomer closer to the barrier makes a jump across it. The completion dynamics refers to the next part of the dynamics where the second monomer has to wait for some time before it can follow up. We use the Conditional Residence Time (CRT) to study the delay between the successive barrier crossing of the two monomers. The CRT distributions highlight qualitatively different regimes formed by the competition between the escape times of the lagging monomer and the time period of the external drive. The effect is strongest in the weak coupling regime where the delayed completion is spread across multiple forcing cycles. By partitioning this process into three windows, i.e. the immediate, first cycle and later cycles, we show that the probability that the lagging monomer will make a transition in the said cycle is redistributed among these pathways as we change the frequency of the drive. This leads to a non-monotonic dependence of the mean CRT on the frequency of the drive. Our results demonstrate that transition initiation and completion in a coupled system are two separate processes and establish CRT as a useful measure to quantify the sequential barrier crossing dynamics in coupled stochastic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、distributions、demonstrate、quantify，基于随机动力学模型的理论分析）；研究对象：过阻尼二聚体（overdamped dimer）在双稳态势阱中的顺序跨越动力学，具体关注两个单体先后跨越势垒的完成过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耦合系统中跃迁的起始与完成是两个分离的过程；条件停留时间（CRT）分布揭示了由滞后单体的逃逸时间与外驱动周期竞争形成的不同动力学区间，且平均CRT随驱动频率呈非单调变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耦合系统中跃迁的起始与完成是两个分离的过程；条件停留时间（CRT）分布揭示了由滞后单体的逃逸时间与外驱动周期竞争形成的不同动力学区间，且平均CRT随驱动频率呈非单调变化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于过阻尼朗之万动力学模型，引入条件停留时间（CRT）作为量化工具，通过分析CRT分布及将完成过程划分为即时、第一周期、后续周期三个窗口，研究弱周期力与热涨落下二聚体的顺序跨越动力学。

papers.title: Weak-coupling altermagnetism and chiral magnetic excitations in a checkerboard lattice
papers.abstract: Altermagnets, characterized by spin-split electronic bands with compensated magnetic moments, have emerged as a new class of magnetic materials garnering attention in recent years. Here, using a minimal one-band Hubbard model, we show that the checkerboard lattice serves as a natural platform for altermagnetism for electrons. The instability towards altermagnetic order is denoted by diverging altermagnetic susceptibility at weak-coupling. Carrying out mean-field treatment of the Hubbard repulsion, we show phase transitions from the nonmagnetic to altermagnetic semimetal and then to altermagnetic insulating phase, allowing clear identification of spin-split states. We then examine magnetic excitations in the altermagnetic phases using a random-phase approximation treatment of the dynamical spin susceptibility. The altermagnetic order is found to be stable against spin-fluctuations with the excitation spectra showing well-defined magnon excitations, which decay into single-particle excitations with decreasing interaction strength. Remarkably, the magnetic excitations exhibit strong dependence on both chirality and direction, showing an alternating chirality splitting, similar to the alternating spin splitting of the electronic bands, which serves as a salient feature of altermagnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用 Hubbard 模型、平均场处理、随机相位近似等理论方法。；研究对象：棋盘晶格（checkerboard lattice）中的弱耦合交变磁性（weak-coupling altermagnetism）及其手性磁激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 棋盘晶格是交变磁性的天然平台，其交变磁序中的磁激发表现出与电子能带类似的手性交替劈裂（alternating chirality splitting），这是交变磁性的一个显著特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：棋盘晶格是交变磁性的天然平台，其交变磁序中的磁激发表现出与电子能带类似的手性交替劈裂（alternating chirality splitting），这是交变磁性的一个显著特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用最小单带 Hubbard 模型，通过计算交变磁化率（altermagnetic susceptibility）的发散来判定弱耦合不稳定性；采用平均场（mean-field）方法处理 Hubbard 排斥项以研究相变；利用随机相位近似（random-phase approximation, RPA）处理动力学自旋磁化率，以研究磁激发。

papers.title: Universal self-similar evolution of two-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensates in the acoustic regime
papers.abstract: When driven out of equilibrium, a Bose-Einstein condensate develops nonlinearly interacting density waves that trigger a turbulent cascade, transferring energy toward small scales. In this article, we investigate the nonstationary evolution of solutions to the two-dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii equation. Through numerical simulations of both the GPE and the corresponding Wave Kinetic Equation, we identify self-similar solutions relevant to atomic and polariton Bose-Einstein Condensates. These solutions exhibit characteristics of both first and second kind self-similarity. In particular, we show that the dynamics of the propagating front is universal, governed by a dimensionless universal constant $β$, which we determine numerically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：numerical simulations、Wave Kinetic Equation、self-similar solutions。；研究对象：二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensates）在声学区（acoustic regime）的非平衡演化，具体涉及原子和极化激元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的湍流级联现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在声学区的非平稳演化表现出自相似解，兼具第一类和第二类自相似性特征；传播前沿的动力学是普适的，由一个无量纲普适常数β决定，该常数通过数值计算确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在声学区的非平稳演化表现出自相似解，兼具第一类和第二类自相似性特征；传播前沿的动力学是普适的，由一个无量纲普适常数β决定，该常数通过数值计算确定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解二维Gross-Pitaevskii方程（GPE）以及对应的波动力学方程（Wave Kinetic Equation），通过对比两者结果识别自相似解。

papers.title: Stabilization of Stone-Wales Defects in Metal-supported Graphene
papers.abstract: The characteristics of graphene-metal interfaces play a decisive role in their electronic, optoelectronic, and mechanical applications. Properties such as charge transfer across the interface become particularly significant in the presence of topological defects. The stability of Stone Wales (SW) defects in graphene is governed by the balance between three energy descriptors, the activation energy, formation energy, and restoration energy. By comparing the energy parameters obtained from first-principles density functional theory calculations, we show that SW defect formation is energetically more favorable on metal-supported graphene. Our calculations for SW defects in graphene/Cu(111) and graphene/Al(111) systems indicate only a little dependence of energy profile on the type of metal. The presence of the metal substrate leads to a $\sim$ 12\% increase in the formation energy and a $\sim$ 20\% reduction in the activation energy, which together favor the formation of Stone Wales defects. Although the restoration energy decreases by about $\sim$ 35\% in metal-supported graphene, it remains significantly higher to prevent self-healing. As a result, once formed, the Stone Wales defects are likely to remain stable, suggesting the possibility of terminal SW defect formation in metal-supported graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles density functional theory calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：金属支撑石墨烯中的Stone-Wales（SW）拓扑缺陷的稳定性，具体体系为石墨烯/Cu(111)和石墨烯/Al(111)界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金属衬底的存在使SW缺陷的形成能增加约12%，激活能降低约20%，从而在能量上更有利于SW缺陷的形成；尽管恢复能降低约35%，但仍显著高于自愈合阈值，因此一旦形成，SW缺陷在金属支撑石墨烯中可保持稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金属衬底的存在使SW缺陷的形成能增加约12%，激活能降低约20%，从而在能量上更有利于SW缺陷的形成；尽管恢复能降低约35%，但仍显著高于自愈合阈值，因此一旦形成，SW缺陷在金属支撑石墨烯中可保持稳定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，比较了激活能、形成能和恢复能三个能量参数。

papers.title: Deep-learning Hamiltonian reveals twist-tunable flat bands and nonlinear photocurrents in SrTiO3 moire bilayers
papers.abstract: The extension of moire physics to complex oxides offers new ways to manipulate electronic states, but the large oxide moire supercells make systematic first-principles calculations demanding. Here, we combine density functional theory with the E(3)-equivariant deep-learning Hamiltonian framework DeepH-E3 to investigate the twist-angle-dependent electronic structure and optical responses of twisted bilayer SrTiO3. The model is trained on untwisted bilayers with different interlayer-sliding configurations and then applied to commensurate twisted bilayers with twist angles from 8.80 degrees to 53.13 degrees. Compared with the untwisted bilayer, decreasing twist angle systematically flattens the valence bands and leads to nearly dispersionless bands at the smallest angles studied. Based on the predicted Hamiltonians, we evaluate the dielectric response, second-harmonic generation (SHG), shift current, and spin Hall conductivity. The dielectric response and spin Hall conductivity remain close to those of the untwisted bilayer, whereas the nonlinear optical responses are more strongly affected by twisting. SHG is strongly enhanced relative to the weak untwisted response, and the shift current shows a clear twist-angle dependence within the response-calculation range (53.13 degrees-22.62 degrees). These results show that twist engineering can control electronic and optoelectronic responses in oxide moire systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“结合密度泛函理论（DFT）与E(3)-等变深度学习哈密顿框架DeepH-E3”，并基于预测的哈密顿量计算光学响应，属于第一性原理与机器学习相结合的计算研究。；研究对象：扭曲双层钛酸锶（SrTiO₃）莫尔超晶格。具体研究其转角依赖的电子结构（平带）和非线性光学响应（二次谐波产生、位移电流、自旋霍尔电导率）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 减小扭曲角度会系统性地使价带变平，在最小角度下形成近乎无色散的平带；扭曲工程可显著增强非线性光学响应（如二次谐波产生），而介电响应和自旋霍尔电导率则与未扭曲双层接近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：减小扭曲角度会系统性地使价带变平，在最小角度下形成近乎无色散的平带；扭曲工程可显著增强非线性光学响应（如二次谐波产生），而介电响应和自旋霍尔电导率则与未扭曲双层接近。；创新点：将深度学习哈密顿方法（DeepH-E3）应用于氧化物莫尔体系，实现了对大型莫尔超胞（传统DFT难以处理）的转角依赖电子结构和光学响应的高效计算，揭示了扭曲工程在氧化物莫尔体系中调控非线性光电响应的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 采用E(3)-等变深度学习哈密顿框架DeepH-E3，结合密度泛函理论（DFT）训练模型。训练数据来自不同层间滑动构型的未扭曲双层，然后应用于转角为8.80°至53.13°的共格扭曲双层。基于预测的哈密顿量，计算介电响应、二次谐波产生（SHG）、位移电流和自旋霍尔电导率。

papers.title: From Active to Odd to Smart Matter
papers.abstract: The study of active matter has reshaped our understanding of collective states of matter far from equilibrium by proving that energy pumped into the microscopic scale leads to order on the macroscopic scale, collective motion, and anomalous mechanical responses. More recently, the discovery of odd elasticity and nonreciprocal mechanical couplings has extended these ideas to solid-like active systems, revealing materials with nonconservative elastic response. Simultaneously, innovative developments in swarm robotics , programmable metamaterials , and learning algorithms have led to the emergence of a new frontier in which collective behavior and mechanical response are no longer fixed by design, but adapted, optimized, and learned toward functional goals. This Perspective proposes a unifying trajectory, from active to odd to smart matter, organized along two intertwined axes: the traditional gas--liquid--solid progression of condensed matter, and the more recentparadigm shift from spontaneous collective dynamics to task-driven functionality. We try to highlight emerging principles, conceptual shifts, and open challenges that come along this trajectory, and argue that learning may play the role of a specific form of emergence, which could advantageously replace the more traditional view of control, at least in the realm of physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章/观点文章（Perspective）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“This Perspective proposes...”，且内容是对领域发展轨迹的梳理、概念总结和未来展望，而非具体的实验或计算研究。；研究对象：论文研究的是一类广义的“活性物质”体系，具体包括：传统的流体状活性物质（Active matter）、具有非互易弹性响应的固体状活性物质（Odd matter），以及通过学习和编程实现任务驱动功能的智能物质（Smart matter）。物理现象涵盖集体运动、非保守力学响应、自适应和功能优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出了一条从“活性物质”到“奇弹性物质”再到“智能物质”的统一发展轨迹，认为学习机制可以作为一种特殊的涌现形式，取代传统的控制范式，从而在凝聚态物理框架内实现从自发集体动力学到任务驱动功能性的范式转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出了一条从“活性物质”到“奇弹性物质”再到“智能物质”的统一发展轨迹，认为学习机制可以作为一种特殊的涌现形式，取代传统的控制范式，从而在凝聚态物理框架内实现从自发集体动力学到任务驱动功能性的范式转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体的单一创新点，但本文的核心新意在于：首次将活性物质、奇弹性物质和智能物质（如群体机器人、可编程超材料）置于一个统一的物理视角下进行讨论，并明确提出“学习”可以作为一种物理意义上的涌现机制，从而为设计具有目标导向功能的物质提供了新的理论路径。
papers.method_zh: 本文未采用具体的实验或计算手段，而是采用理论综合与概念分析的方法。作者通过梳理凝聚态物质中“气-液-固”的传统分类，并将其与“自发集体动力学到任务驱动功能性”的新范式相结合，构建了一个统一的分析框架。

papers.title: Identifying Non-Ideal Reaction-Diffusion Systems Unable to Maintain Diffusion Out-of-Equilibrium
papers.abstract: We develop a general method, based on the construction of a kinetic potential acting as a Lyapunov function, to establish when diffusion necessarily equilibrates in non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems, under arbitrary driving by autonomous homogeneous chemostats. Using this method, we generalize the results of J. Chem. Phys. 161, 174108 (2024) by relaxing some of the underlying assumptions. Specifically, we show that diffusion equilibrates in reaction-diffusion systems whose chemical reaction network is either pseudo-detailed balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled by the stoichiometry of reactants and products, or complex balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled only by the stoichiometry of the reactants. The different constraints on the reaction fluxes are shown to originate from the distinct stoichiometric properties of the two classes of networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Lyapunov function（李雅普诺夫函数）、kinetic potential（动力学势）、general method（一般性方法）。；研究对象：非理想反应-扩散系统（non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems），具体研究在自主均匀化学恒化器驱动下，扩散过程是否必然导致系统达到平衡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于化学反应网络满足“伪细致平衡”（pseudo-detailed balanced）或“复平衡”（complex balanced）的非理想反应-扩散系统，扩散过程必然导致系统平衡化，无法维持非平衡扩散态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于化学反应网络满足“伪细致平衡”（pseudo-detailed balanced）或“复平衡”（complex balanced）的非理想反应-扩散系统，扩散过程必然导致系统平衡化，无法维持非平衡扩散态。；创新点：推广了已有工作中关于反应-扩散系统扩散平衡化的结论，明确区分了伪细致平衡网络（反应通量受反应物和产物化学计量共同控制）与复平衡网络（反应通量仅受反应物化学计量控制）在维持非平衡扩散能力上的本质差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于构造一个作为李雅普诺夫函数的动力学势（kinetic potential），建立了一般性判据，并放宽了J. Chem. Phys. 161, 174108 (2024)中的部分假设。通过分析两类网络（伪细致平衡与复平衡）中反应通量受化学计量约束的不同方式，推导出扩散平衡化的条件。

papers.title: Bose Einstein Condensation of Magnons in BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$: An experimental perspective
papers.abstract: Han Purple, a pigment first obtained in ancient China, is one of the earliest known synthetic pigments. Also naturally occurring, as a mineral, it is known as colinowensite (Cwn). Its chemical formula is BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$, and its structure is a layered cyclosilicate in which magnetic Cu$^{2+}$ ions (S = 1/2) form dimers arranged on a square lattice, making it also the first known synthetic metal dimer compound. Most interesting magnetic properties arise from a strong intradimer spin coupling, accompanied by weaker interdimer interactions within and between Cu-dimer layers. In zero or small magnetic fields, BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$ remains a quantum paramagnet. However, under high magnetic fields between 23 and 49 Tesla -- about a million times stronger than Earth's magnetic field -- it undergoes magnetic ordering at subliquid Helium temperatures into an almost ideal easy-plane (XY) antiferromagnetic state regarded as a realization of a Bose-Einstein condensate of magnons. Within this experimentally accessible field range, BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$ serves as an extraordinary playground for testing predictions of quantum many-body physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要标题明确标注“An experimental perspective”，且内容聚焦于实验观测到的磁有序和相变行为。；研究对象：BaCuSi₂O₆（硅酸铜钡，即“汉紫”颜料），一种层状环硅酸盐化合物，其中Cu²⁺离子（S=1/2）形成二聚体并排列在四方晶格上，在强磁场下实现磁振子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在23至49特斯拉的高磁场和亚液氦温度下，BaCuSi₂O₆从量子顺磁态转变为近乎理想的易平面（XY型）反铁磁有序态，该态被认为是磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的实验实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在23至49特斯拉的高磁场和亚液氦温度下，BaCuSi₂O₆从量子顺磁态转变为近乎理想的易平面（XY型）反铁磁有序态，该态被认为是磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的实验实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：将一种古代合成颜料（BaCuSi₂O₆）作为强磁场下磁振子BEC的模型体系，提供了在实验可及的磁场范围内检验量子多体物理预言的理想平台。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如中子散射、磁化率测量、比热测量等），仅提及在特定磁场和温度范围内观测到磁有序行为。

papers.title: High temperature ferromagnetism in epitaxial monolayers of Co-doped Fe5GeTe2
papers.abstract: Magnetic van der Waals materials have mainly been investigated in their bulk form or as few-layers flakes. Due to the challenges in producing atomically thin films, only a few have been isolated as monolayers, which typically exhibit long-range magnetic order below 150 K. In this work, we use molecular beam epitaxy to synthesize Co-doped Fe5GeTe2, achieving precise control over both thickness and composition. We demonstrate ferromagnetism well above room temperature in multilayer samples and present clear evidence of ferromagnetic ordering in monolayers up to $\sim$200 K. The changes in Curie temperature and magnetic anisotropy with composition exhibit similar trends in both monolayers and thicker films, indicating that the magnetic properties are primarily governed by intralayer magnetic interactions. Through element-specific X-ray magnetic circular dichroism and density functional theory, we identify the substitution site of Co dopants and reveal the mechanism behind the Curie temperature enhancement induced by Co doping. Our findings suggest that, despite their weak magnetic moment, Co dopants strengthen the magnetic moments on neighboring Fe atoms and enhance the intralayer ferromagnetic exchange interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：分子束外延（MBE）合成、X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）实验，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：Co掺杂的Fe₅GeTe₂单层及多层外延薄膜的室温以上铁磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子束外延精确控制厚度与组分，实现了Co掺杂Fe₅GeTe₂单层薄膜中高达约200 K的铁磁有序，并在多层样品中观察到远高于室温的铁磁性；Co掺杂通过增强邻近Fe原子的磁矩及层内铁磁交换作用来提高居里温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子束外延精确控制厚度与组分，实现了Co掺杂Fe₅GeTe₂单层薄膜中高达约200 K的铁磁有序，并在多层样品中观察到远高于室温的铁磁性；Co掺杂通过增强邻近Fe原子的磁矩及层内铁磁交换作用来提高居里温度。；创新点：首次在单层极限下实现Co掺杂Fe₅GeTe₂的高温铁磁性（~200 K），并系统揭示了Co掺杂对层内磁相互作用的主导调控机制，突破了此前单层范德华磁体通常低于150 K的磁有序温度限制。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长薄膜；X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）进行元素特异性磁性表征；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算分析Co掺杂位点及磁性增强机制。

papers.title: The Ramsey community number as a renormalization-group crossing
papers.abstract: The Ramsey community number $r_k$ is the smallest size at which a network is better described by communities than by none, under a Bayesian detection rule. On the diamond hierarchical lattice we show that $r_k$ is an exact renormalization-group crossing: the block-model sufficient statistics obey a linear map with eigenvalues $\{bs,b\}$, the degree-corrected evidence density flows to $\ln K$ at a community fixed point, and $r_k$ is the generation at which the running evidence clears the detection threshold. Degree correction advances detection by two generations. We derive $r_k(b,s;q)$ in closed form for the whole family. Finally, placing on the lattice the Reichardt--Bornholdt community Hamiltonian -- whose ground state is the partition itself -- we find an exact community-ordered phase: below the ferromagnetic critical temperature the two hubs lock into opposite communities for any resolution $γ>0$, a staggered order that persists as $n\to\infty$. Allowing each nested sub-community its own label, the optimal partition is a hierarchy of $q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}$ communities, so the number of Potts states that best describes the network grows with the network. This hierarchy orders thermally level by level, through a cascade of first-order transitions whose temperatures fall as $1/\ln q$, so every stable level persists as $n\to\infty$: the emergent partition is detectable, optimal, and thermodynamically ordered.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization-group crossing（重整化群交叉）、Bayesian detection rule（贝叶斯检测规则）、exact community-ordered phase（精确社区有序相）。；研究对象：网络中的社区检测问题，具体在分形晶格（diamond hierarchical lattice）上研究Ramsey社区数（Ramsey community number）作为重整化群交叉点的行为，以及Reichardt–Bornholdt社区哈密顿量在该晶格上的精确社区有序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ramsey社区数在分形晶格上表现为精确的重整化群交叉点，其闭式解可对整个晶格族导出；在Reichardt–Bornholdt哈密顿量下，系统存在精确的社区有序相，且最优分区中的社区数随网络规模增长（\(q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}\)），该有序相通过一系列一级相变逐层建立，每个稳定层在热力学极限下持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ramsey社区数在分形晶格上表现为精确的重整化群交叉点，其闭式解可对整个晶格族导出；在Reichardt–Bornholdt哈密顿量下，系统存在精确的社区有序相，且最优分区中的社区数随网络规模增长（\(q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}\)），该有序相通过一系列一级相变逐层建立，每个稳定层在热力学极限下持续存在。；创新点：首次将Ramsey社区数解释为重整化群交叉点，并给出其在分形晶格上的精确闭式解；发现度修正可将社区检测提前两个世代；揭示了在Reichardt–Bornholdt哈密顿量下，社区有序相中最佳社区数随系统规模增长（\(q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}\)）且通过温度随\(1/\ln q\)下降的一级相变级联实现热力学有序。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用重整化群方法分析块模型充分统计量的线性映射（特征值为\(\{bs,b\}\)），计算度修正证据密度流，并推导Ramsey社区数\(r_k(b,s;q)\)的闭式解；同时通过精确求解Reichardt–Bornholdt哈密顿量的基态和热力学性质，分析社区有序相及其相变级联。

papers.title: Electron-Phonon Dephasing in Ultrathin Disordered Films: From Power Laws to Diagnostic Maps
papers.abstract: Electron-phonon dephasing in ultrathin disordered metallic films is often summarized by a power law, $τ_{e-ph}^{-1}=AT^p$. However, thin metals, alloys, and superconducting films exhibit effective exponents close to 2, 3, and 4, as well as intermediate nonuniversal values. We argue that in ultrathin supported films, the exponent should be treated not as a universal material constant, but as a crossover observable. Its interpretation requires several coordinates: the clean-to-dirty parameter $q_T l$, phonon confinement and film-substrate acoustic coupling, and the microscopic character of disorder. The diagnostic picture is illustrated using Ar-ion-irradiated Au films as a controlled-disorder series. In these films, the fitted electron-phonon exponent remains near $p\simeq 2$ for low values of the pure-dirty crossover temperature $T_{tr}\simeq \hbar s/(k_B l)$ and increases toward $p\simeq 2.8$ as disorder increases. At the same time, the prefactor trend indicates suppression of electron-phonon scattering with decreasing mean free path, consistent with dirty-limit weakening rather than static-disorder enhancement. The persistence of $p<4$ points to the role of thin-film or film-substrate phonon effects. The resulting diagnostic map provides a compact framework for comparing electron-phonon dephasing data in ultrathin disordered films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：argue, treat as crossover observable, diagnostic picture, framework）；研究对象：超薄无序金属薄膜中的电子-声子退相过程，具体以Ar离子辐照Au薄膜为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超薄无序薄膜中电子-声子退相指数p并非普适材料常数，而是随无序程度变化的交叉行为；随着无序增强，p从约2增至约2.8，且平均自由程减小会抑制电子-声子散射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超薄无序薄膜中电子-声子退相指数p并非普适材料常数，而是随无序程度变化的交叉行为；随着无序增强，p从约2增至约2.8，且平均自由程减小会抑制电子-声子散射。；创新点：提出将电子-声子退相指数p视为交叉可观测量（crossover observable），而非固定指数，并建立多坐标诊断框架以统一解释不同薄膜中p≈2、3、4及中间非普适值的现象。
papers.method_zh: 基于理论分析构建诊断图（diagnostic map），结合清洁-脏乱参数q_T l、声子受限与薄膜-衬底声学耦合、无序微观特征等多坐标解释；实验数据来自Ar离子辐照Au薄膜的可控无序系列。

papers.title: CE-antiferromagnetic electronic structure in LaSr$_2$Mn$_2$O$_7$ revealed by micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and tight-binding models
papers.abstract: We have investigated the electronic structure of LaSr$_2$Mn$_2$O$_7$ in the CE-type antiferromagnetic (CE-AFM) state below the Néel temperature using micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy ($μ$-ARPES) and tight-binding models. In agreement with the tight-binding calculations, we found a dispersive intensity around the X point in the $μ$-ARPES spectra, where the A-type antiferromagnetic (A-AFM) phase has no bands experimentally and theoretically, demonstrating that we have successfully captured the signatures of the CE-AFM band structure for the first time. Many observed features can be explained by the CE-AFM tight-binding bands, although some of them and the overall near-Fermi level intensity mapping can be explained by the A-AFM band structure. This indicates that the CE-AFM domain size would be no larger than the beam footprint size of a $\sim\!20$~{\textmu}m scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (μ-ARPES) 实验测量，并结合 tight-binding models 计算对比。；研究对象：LaSr₂Mn₂O₇ 在 CE 型反铁磁（CE-AFM）态下的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次成功捕捉到 CE-AFM 相能带结构的特征信号，在 X 点附近观测到色散强度，而 A 型反铁磁（A-AFM）相在该处无能带；同时发现部分特征及近费米能级强度分布可由 A-AFM 能带解释，表明 CE-AFM 畴尺寸不超过约 20 μm 的光斑尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次成功捕捉到 CE-AFM 相能带结构的特征信号，在 X 点附近观测到色散强度，而 A 型反铁磁（A-AFM）相在该处无能带；同时发现部分特征及近费米能级强度分布可由 A-AFM 能带解释，表明 CE-AFM 畴尺寸不超过约 20 μm 的光斑尺度。；创新点：首次通过 μ-ARPES 实验直接观测到 CE-AFM 态的能带结构特征，并利用紧束缚模型成功解释观测到的色散行为，同时通过对比 A-AFM 相能带揭示了畴尺寸的尺度信息。
papers.method_zh: 微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱（μ-ARPES）实验测量，结合紧束缚模型（tight-binding models）能带计算进行对比分析。

papers.title: Modelling the mean inner potential of alloyed and strained materials
papers.abstract: In this publication, we study the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential (MIP) using density functional theory (DFT) within an augmented plane waves plus local orbitals basis set. Two major effects have been identified allowing to model the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential with a reasonable accuracy. First, alloying for constant volume results in a linear relationship between the MIP and the concentration. Second, the MIP scales with changes in volume as we already pointed out in an earlier publication (M. Schowalter, D. Lamoen, A. Rosenauer, P. Kruse, and D. Gerthsen, Appl. Phys. Lett. 85, 4938-4940 (2004)). Specifically, a linear relationship between MIP and concentration x was found for AlGaAs (nearly no change in lattice parameter), whereas InGaP and GeSi (volume changes with concentration x) exhibits a clear bowing. The bowing can be modeled by taking the rescaling of the MIP with the varying volume additionally into account. The rescaling could be also used to model the dependence of the MIP on strained binary cells and the density dependence of e.g. amorphous materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、modelling、augmented plane waves plus local orbitals basis set。；研究对象：合金化与应变对材料平均内势（MIP）的影响。具体体系包括AlGaAs、InGaP、GeSi以及应变二元晶胞和非晶材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在恒体积下，合金化导致MIP与浓度呈线性关系；MIP随体积变化而缩放，这一缩放效应可解释InGaP和GeSi中MIP随浓度的弯曲行为，并可用于建模应变二元晶胞及非晶材料的密度依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在恒体积下，合金化导致MIP与浓度呈线性关系；MIP随体积变化而缩放，这一缩放效应可解释InGaP和GeSi中MIP随浓度的弯曲行为，并可用于建模应变二元晶胞及非晶材料的密度依赖性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于增强平面波加局域轨道基组的密度泛函理论（DFT）进行计算。

papers.title: Orientation-resolved ultrafast spin reorientation dynamics in ferrimagnetic DyCo$_5$
papers.abstract: Under quasi-static conditions, ferrimagnetic DyCo$_5$ thin films exhibit a thermally induced spin-reorientation transition, in which the equilibrium magnetization changes from an out-of-plane to an in-plane orientation, mostly as a result of the competing magnetic anisotropy contributions of the Dy $4f$ rare-earth and Co $3d$ transition-metal sublattices. While this equilibrium transition has been studied, it remains an open question whether such a reorientation can be triggered on ultrafast timescales using femtosecond laser excitation. In this work, we investigate the ultrafast spin-reorientation dynamics in DyCo$_5$. The time-dependent orientation of the magnetization vector following femtosecond laser excitation is quantified by combining polar with transverse magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements in the extreme ultraviolet spectral range, which are sensitive to the out-of-plane and in-plane magnetization component, respectively. Both techniques are implemented at the Co M$_{3,2}$ resonance and are complemented by visible-light MOKE measurements. This combined approach allows us to resolve the canting of the magnetization from an out-of-plane toward an in-plane orientation and to determine the characteristic timescales of the transient spin-reorientation process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用极紫外波段磁光克尔效应（MOKE）和可见光MOKE进行测量，属于实验手段。；研究对象：铁磁性亚铁磁薄膜DyCo₅中的超快自旋重取向动力学。具体涉及在飞秒激光激发下，磁化矢量从面外取向向面内取向的瞬态倾斜过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合极紫外波段的面外与面内磁光克尔效应测量，成功解析了飞秒激光激发后磁化矢量从面外向面内的倾斜过程，并确定了瞬态自旋重取向的特征时间尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合极紫外波段的面外与面内磁光克尔效应测量，成功解析了飞秒激光激发后磁化矢量从面外向面内的倾斜过程，并确定了瞬态自旋重取向的特征时间尺度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：首次在超快时间尺度上（飞秒激光激发）定量解析了DyCo₅中自旋重取向的瞬态过程，并给出了特征时间尺度，而此前仅研究了准静态条件下的热致自旋重取向转变。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：极紫外波段的面外（极向）与面内（横向）磁光克尔效应（MOKE）测量，两者均在Co M₃₂共振吸收边处实施；同时辅以可见光MOKE测量。通过联合分析实现对磁化矢量取向的时间分辨。

papers.title: Interfacial Noncollinear Filtering of Spin Hall Currents
papers.abstract: Spin Hall currents generated in nonmagnetic materials are conventionally regarded as bulk responses whose polarization is fixed by crystal symmetry. This view has motivated the search for intrinsically low-symmetry spin sources when unconventional spin polarizations are required. Here we point out that, in realistic heterostructures, the device-relevant quantity is not the fully symmetry-averaged bulk spin Hall current, but the emitted spin current transmitted across the interface. We therefore establish emitted spin currents as bulk-interface hybrid responses and propose interfacial noncollinear filtering as a mechanism to bypass the bulk-symmetry constraint. A low-symmetry interfacial spin-orbit field, generally noncollinear with the momentum-resolved spin polarization of the incident spin Hall current, imposes spin-dependent transmission and converts hidden momentum-resolved spin-polarization components into an observable unconventional emitted spin current. Using both a rotationally symmetric minimal model and a realistic high-symmetry Dirac-semimetal model, we show that conventional spin Hall sources can emit sizable out-of-plane spin currents when their hidden bulk spin Hall textures are selectively transmitted by the interfacial spin-orbit field. Our results reveal that spin-current polarization emerges from the cooperative action of bulk and interfacial responses, providing a strategy for reprogramming spin-current polarization in high-efficiency, CMOS-compatible spin Hall materials without relying on intrinsically low-symmetry bulk crystals or external symmetry-breaking schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“point out”、“establish”、“propose”、“show”等理论推导和模型构建的表述，并提及“minimal model”和“realistic model”。；研究对象：自旋霍尔电流在非磁材料/铁磁体异质结界面处的输运行为，具体研究界面非共线滤波效应对自旋电流极化的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 器件中实际可观测的自旋电流极化并非仅由体材料对称性决定，而是体材料自旋霍尔电流与界面自旋轨道场协同作用的结果。通过界面非共线滤波，即使在高对称性的传统自旋霍尔材料中，也能产生可观的面外自旋电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：器件中实际可观测的自旋电流极化并非仅由体材料对称性决定，而是体材料自旋霍尔电流与界面自旋轨道场协同作用的结果。通过界面非共线滤波，即使在高对称性的传统自旋霍尔材料中，也能产生可观的面外自旋电流。；创新点：提出“界面非共线滤波”这一新机制，指出自旋电流极化是体-界面混合响应，从而突破了传统认为自旋电流极化必须依赖低对称性体材料的限制，为在CMOS兼容的高效自旋霍尔材料中重新编程自旋电流极化提供了新策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用旋转对称的最小模型和真实的高对称狄拉克半金属模型进行理论计算与分析，通过对比体材料自旋霍尔纹理与界面自旋轨道场的非共线关系，揭示自旋电流的发射与过滤机制。

papers.title: Machine learning prediction of the convergence criterion for a topological invariant of finite non-Hermitian chains
papers.abstract: A topological invariant based on polar-decomposition of matrices correctly captures the topology of finite non-Hermitian chains exhibiting the non-Hermitian skin effect, provided that an appropriate crop-length parameter is chosen. This parameter, which sets the cutoff used in the calculation of the invariant, is usually chosen empirically and becomes especially important near topological phase transitions, where finite-size effects are strongest. Here we show that the required crop-length is controlled by physical decay (localization) lengths. For nearest-neighbor and pure longer-range hopping Hatano-Nelson-type chains, the crop-length is set mainly by a single localization length and is well approximated by a scalar multiple of that length. For more general longer-range hopping models, it is governed instead by a multichannel root structure of the characteristic polynomial. Random-forest regression captures finite-size and near-boundary corrections while preserving this decay-length interpretation. Trained on one set of Hamiltonians, the predictor accurately generalizes to unseen Hamiltonians and complex base energies, reproducing crop-lengths across full phase diagrams. We further show that the predictions learned from clean nearest-neighbor hopping chains remain stable under moderate hopping disorder. These results provide a practical and physically interpretable way to choose the crop-length, which in turn determines when the real-space invariant can reliably capture the topology of finite non-Hermitian chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：machine learning prediction、random-forest regression、theoretical analysis。；研究对象：有限非厄米链（finite non-Hermitian chains）中基于极分解的拓扑不变量（topological invariant）的收敛判据（convergence criterion），特别关注非厄米趋肤效应（non-Hermitian skin effect）和拓扑相变附近的有限尺寸效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 用于计算拓扑不变量的裁剪长度（crop-length）主要由物理衰减长度（localization lengths）控制：对于最近邻和纯长程跳跃的Hatano-Nelson型链，裁剪长度近似为单一局域长度的标量倍数；对于更一般的模型，则由特征多项式的多通道根结构决定。随机森林回归可准确预测裁剪长度，并推广到未见过的哈密顿量和复杂基能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：用于计算拓扑不变量的裁剪长度（crop-length）主要由物理衰减长度（localization lengths）控制：对于最近邻和纯长程跳跃的Hatano-Nelson型链，裁剪长度近似为单一局域长度的标量倍数；对于更一般的模型，则由特征多项式的多通道根结构决定。随机森林回归可准确预测裁剪长度，并推广到未见过的哈密顿量和复杂基能量。；创新点：首次将机器学习（随机森林回归）与基于极分解的拓扑不变量计算相结合，为有限非厄米链中裁剪长度的选择提供了物理可解释的定量方法，并验证了其在无序下的稳定性。摘要未突出说明与纯解析方法相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机森林回归（random-forest regression）机器学习方法，基于特征多项式的根结构（多通道根结构）和物理衰减长度进行预测。训练集为清洁最近邻跳跃链，测试集包括未见过哈密顿量、复杂基能量以及存在跳跃无序（hopping disorder）的情况。

papers.title: Microscopic theory of the lower critical field in superconducting thin-film strips
papers.abstract: The lower critical field \(B_{c1}\) of a narrow superconducting thin-film strip sets the thermodynamic scale for vortex-free operation in a perpendicular magnetic field. The standard Pearl--London estimate requires a phenomenological vortex-core cutoff, because the London theory does not resolve the core. We formulate a microscopic theory for a dirty strip by solving the two-dimensional Usadel equations in the film plane, with the applied field included directly in the gauge-invariant momentum. Self-consistent vortex and Meissner solutions are computed at fixed field, and \(B_{c1}\) is obtained from their Gibbs-energy difference. The calculation resolves the vortex core and its finite-width deformation without introducing a cutoff. The resulting vortex self-energy is larger than the naive Pearl--London estimate and cannot, in general, be represented by a London logarithm with a single width-independent cutoff. The formulation applies at any \(T<T_c\) and provides a microscopic basis for predicting \(B_{c1}\) in superconducting nanostrips and related thin-film devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“formulate a microscopic theory”、“solving the two-dimensional Usadel equations”、“computed at fixed field”等关键词，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：窄超导薄膜条带（narrow superconducting thin-film strip）在垂直磁场中的下临界场 \(B_{c1}\)，以及涡旋（vortex）与迈斯纳态（Meissner state）的热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微观理论自洽求解Usadel方程，无需引入唯象涡旋核心截断，即可计算 \(B_{c1}\)，并发现涡旋自能大于Pearl-London估计值，且不能用一个与宽度无关的单一London对数形式描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微观理论自洽求解Usadel方程，无需引入唯象涡旋核心截断，即可计算 \(B_{c1}\)，并发现涡旋自能大于Pearl-London估计值，且不能用一个与宽度无关的单一London对数形式描述。；创新点：首次在微观层面（无需涡旋核心截断）自洽计算窄超导薄膜条带的下临界场，揭示了Pearl-London唯象估计的偏差，并建立了适用于任意温度 \(T<T_c\) 的微观预测框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于二维Usadel方程（dirty limit）的微观理论求解，在薄膜平面内直接包含规范不变动量中的外加磁场，自洽计算固定磁场下的涡旋解和迈斯纳解，并通过吉布斯自由能差得到 \(B_{c1}\)。

papers.title: Chiral-Structured Superconductors TrX4 (Tr = Rh, Ir; X = Ge, Si): A Platform for Mixed-Parity Pairing and Topological States
papers.abstract: Chiral-structured superconductors, with simultaneous broken mirror and inversion symmetries, promote unconventional superconductivity through parity-mixing mechanisms. Yet a few bulk chiral-structured superconductors are known, partly due to the difficulty in directly determining their atomic-scale chirality. Here we report three chiral-structured superconductors, , RhGe4, IrGe4, and IrSi4, synthesized under high pressure, with Tc values of about 1.6 K, 1.1 K, and 2.5 K, respectively.Using atomic resolution Cs-corrected scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) combined with X-ray diffraction characterizations, we directly confirm their chiral structure (space group P3121). This real space imaging approach overcomes ambiguities in traditional diffraction based methods. These materials exhibit type-II superconductivity, and the enhancement of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) leads to the emergence of mixed parity pairing. Calculations also reveal symmetry protected Weyl points near the Fermi level, which is robust against the SOC. Our work not only expands the family of chiral-structured superconductors but also demonstrates the indispensable role of STEM in directly determining chiral crystal structures. These materials thus offer a clean platform to explore the interplay among structural chirality, SOC, mixed parity superconductivity, and topological quantum phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：synthesized under high pressure, scanning transmission electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, calculations）；研究对象：三种手性结构超导体：RhGe₄、IrGe₄ 和 IrSi₄，以及它们中混合宇称配对与拓扑态的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高压下合成的三种手性结构超导体（空间群P3₁21）具有第二类超导特性，自旋-轨道耦合增强导致混合宇称配对出现，且费米能级附近存在受对称性保护的Weyl点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高压下合成的三种手性结构超导体（空间群P3₁21）具有第二类超导特性，自旋-轨道耦合增强导致混合宇称配对出现，且费米能级附近存在受对称性保护的Weyl点。；创新点：首次通过实空间成像（STEM）直接确认了RhGe₄、IrGe₄和IrSi₄的手性晶体结构，克服了传统衍射方法在确定原子尺度手性时的模糊性，并扩展了手性结构超导体的家族。
papers.method_zh: 高压合成、原子分辨率的球差校正扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）、X射线衍射表征、第一性原理计算（用于揭示Weyl点与能带结构）。

papers.title: Spatially heterogeneous noise restructures flocking into geometry-locked and vortex states
papers.abstract: Spatially heterogeneous environments continually challenge the ability of active matter to sustain coherent collective motion. Understanding how collective motion remains robust under changing environments is central to both the functioning of biological systems and the design of smart active matter. Here, we extend the Vicsek model to include a circular non-noisy region surrounded by a noisy environment - a configuration in which the noise difference sets up a contrast in local directional order between the two regions. We find that, as the surrounding noise is increased, the system passes through three distinct dynamical regimes: (i) conventional global flocking at low noise; (ii) geometry-locked motion, aligned with simulation boundaries, at intermediate noise; and (iii) vortical motion within the non-noisy region at high noise. Extending the environment to multiple non-noisy regions, we find that the geometry-locked regime can develop a directional coupling, while the vortex mode leads to antiferromagnetic order between the regions. Taken together, our results demonstrate that the spatial modulation of order and disorder offers a powerful and generic strategy for steering active matter, aligning with recent experimental observations of active particles in patterned landscapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“extend the Vicsek model”（扩展Vicsek模型）并进行数值模拟，属于计算与理论建模研究。；研究对象：活性物质（active matter）在空间异质性噪声环境中的集体运动行为，具体为包含圆形无噪声区域和周围高噪声区域的二维系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着周围噪声增加，系统依次经历三种动力学状态：低噪声下的全局群集、中等噪声下的几何锁定运动（与模拟边界对齐）、高噪声下无噪声区域内的涡旋运动。多区域系统中，几何锁定态可产生方向耦合，涡旋态则导致区域间反铁磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着周围噪声增加，系统依次经历三种动力学状态：低噪声下的全局群集、中等噪声下的几何锁定运动（与模拟边界对齐）、高噪声下无噪声区域内的涡旋运动。多区域系统中，几何锁定态可产生方向耦合，涡旋态则导致区域间反铁磁序。；创新点：揭示了通过空间调制有序/无序区域（即噪声对比）来引导活性物质运动的通用策略，与近期图案化景观中活性粒子的实验观测一致。摘要未突出说明与已有理论模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 扩展Vicsek模型，引入空间异质性噪声：一个圆形无噪声区域被高噪声环境包围。通过改变周围噪声强度，模拟并分析系统的集体运动模式。

papers.title: Autoencoder-Based Unsupervised Identification of Nonequilibrium Phases in Sheared Binary Colloids
papers.abstract: Identifying nonequilibrium phases in particle systems remains a major challenge because they often exhibit complex and spatially heterogeneous structures without long-range order. Here, we develop an unsupervised machine-learning framework for classifying such nonequilibrium phases by integrating Fourier-based preprocessing, an autoencoder, and a Gaussian mixture model (GMM). Specifically, we transform global spatial configurations into Fourier space and use the amplitudes of Fourier coefficients as inputs to the autoencoder. This preprocessing suppresses spatial noise while preserving phase-specific structural features and physical interpretability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this framework using a binary charged colloidal system under steady shear flow, where the competition between Coulomb interactions and shear gives rise to three nonequilibrium phases characterized by distinct local structures. The encoded latent space reveals well-separated clusters that are robustly identified by the GMM, enabling the construction of a nonequilibrium phase diagram based on cluster membership probabilities. The resulting phase boundaries are consistent with those independently obtained from radial distribution function analysis and unsupervised anomaly detection. These results demonstrate that autoencoder-based unsupervised learning provides an effective framework for identifying nonequilibrium phases in complex particle systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：unsupervised machine-learning framework、autoencoder、Gaussian mixture model (GMM)、Fourier-based preprocessing。；研究对象：二元带电胶体体系在稳态剪切流下的非平衡相。具体物理现象为库仑相互作用与剪切流竞争导致的三种非平衡相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于自编码器的无监督学习框架能够有效识别剪切二元胶体中的非平衡相，并构建出与径向分布函数分析和无监督异常检测结果一致的非平衡相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于自编码器的无监督学习框架能够有效识别剪切二元胶体中的非平衡相，并构建出与径向分布函数分析和无监督异常检测结果一致的非平衡相图。；创新点：通过傅里叶空间预处理抑制空间噪声，同时保留相特有的结构特征和物理可解释性，使得自编码器能够从全局构型中无监督地识别出非平衡相，并自动构建相图。
papers.method_zh: 结合傅里叶预处理（将全局空间构型变换至傅里叶空间，使用傅里叶系数振幅作为输入）、自编码器（autoencoder）进行降维与特征提取，以及高斯混合模型（GMM）对隐空间中的聚类进行无监督识别。

papers.title: Local moment magnon spectrum in conduction electron tunnelling
papers.abstract: The surface tunnelling spectrum of a dual system consisting of localised moments with antiferromagnetic order coupled to conduction electrons by on-site exchange interaction is investigated. In the static approximation of the local moment order it is known that magnetic band reconstruction leads to an anomalous tunnelling spectrum at the magnetic ordering vector of local moments although the latter cannot contribute directly. In this work we consider dynamic effects by including the scattering of conduction electrons from the local moment magnon excitations. They lead to self energies and renormalisation of conduction states which in turn appreciably modify the tunnelling spectrum beyond the influence of static order, interpreted as the appearance of magnon sidebands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigated、consider、lead to、interpreted。；研究对象：由局域磁矩（具有反铁磁序）与传导电子通过局域交换耦合构成的双系统，具体研究其表面隧穿谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 考虑局域磁矩的磁振子激发对传导电子的散射后，隧穿谱中会出现磁振子边带，从而显著改变仅由静态磁序导致的异常隧穿谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：考虑局域磁矩的磁振子激发对传导电子的散射后，隧穿谱中会出现磁振子边带，从而显著改变仅由静态磁序导致的异常隧穿谱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用理论分析框架，在局域磁矩序的静态近似基础上，引入动态效应，即传导电子与局域磁矩磁振子激发的散射，计算由此产生的自能和传导态重整化，进而分析隧穿谱的修正。

papers.title: Floquet polaritons in optically driven materials
papers.abstract: Polaritons are coupled collective modes of light and matter in quantum materials. In modern pump-probe experiments, a pump light pulse may dramatically alter the properties of the polaritons, rendering them Floquet polaritons that can be detected by a probe pulse. We present a practical framework to describe Floquet polaritons in terms of the linear and nonlinear optical properties of the material. The central quantity that yields the spectra of Floquet polaritons is an effective linear optical susceptibility contributed by the pump through nonlinear optical susceptibilities. We apply this method to graphene and show that via its third-order optical nonlinearity, infrared pump leads to Floquet plasmon bands. Notably, near plasmonic band crossings, parametric instability leads to flat bands with unstable modes and exceptional points that closely resemble those of non-Hermitian systems. As a second example, we show that in hexagonal boron nitride pumped by mid-infrared laser, the pump induces Floquet phonon polariton bands via phononic nonlinearity, which can be detected with either far-field or near-field optical technique. Finally, in layered superconductors pumped by THz light polarized along the out-of-plane direction, the Josephson-type optical nonlinearity leads to Floquet Josephson plasmons, which manifest as new peaks in the THz reflectivity of a probe pulse.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中描述“提出一个实用框架”（present a practical framework）、“应用此方法”（apply this method）等，属于理论建模与计算分析，未提及实验数据或具体实验操作。；研究对象：光驱动材料中的Floquet极化激元（Floquet polaritons），具体包括石墨烯中的Floquet等离激元、六方氮化硼中的Floquet声子极化激元、以及层状超导体中的Floquet约瑟夫森等离激元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过泵浦光诱导的非线性光学效应，可以产生Floquet极化激元能带；在石墨烯中，等离激元能带交叉处出现参数不稳定性导致的平带、不稳定模和非厄米系统特有的奇异点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过泵浦光诱导的非线性光学效应，可以产生Floquet极化激元能带；在石墨烯中，等离激元能带交叉处出现参数不稳定性导致的平带、不稳定模和非厄米系统特有的奇异点。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于材料的线性和非线性光学性质，构建描述Floquet极化激元的理论框架；核心是定义一个由泵浦光通过非线性光学极化率贡献的有效线性光学磁化率，用于计算Floquet极化激元谱。

papers.title: Anomalous Piezoelectricity from Polarization-Dependent Electrostriction in Wurtzites
papers.abstract: The piezoelectric coefficient is a third-rank tensor connecting the strain or stress with the electric field or polarization, whereas the electrostriction coefficient is a fourth-rank tensor relating the strain to the square of electric polarization. The electrostriction tensor components in the current literature are often treated as constants independent of polarization, resulting in piezoelectric tensor components that are linearly proportional to polarization and the dielectric susceptibility tensor. Here, we study the electrostriction and piezoelectricity in strongly polar wurtzites, including AlN, Al$_{1-x}$Sc$_x$N, Al$_{1-x}$B$_x$N, GaN, and ZnO. We discover that electrostriction and the elastic modulus in wurtzites are both strongly polarization-dependent, and the piezoelectric coefficient is highly nonlinear with respect to polarization, including the anomalous possibility that decreasing polarization increases the electromechanical strain response. These unusual dependencies of electrostriction and piezoelectric effects on polarization arise from the evolution of a layered reference nonpolar structure toward a tetrahedrally coordinated wurtzite network structure as the polarization increases. The findings have important implications in understanding the thermodynamics of the general class of wurtzite ferroelectrics and in manipulating their piezoelectric and ferroelectric behaviors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“研究”“发现”“演化”等理论分析词汇，未提及具体实验手段，主要基于第一性原理或理论建模分析电致伸缩和压电效应。；研究对象：强极性纤锌矿材料，包括 AlN、Al₁₋ₓScₓN、Al₁₋ₓBₓN、GaN 和 ZnO，以及其中与极化相关的电致伸缩和压电行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现纤锌矿材料的电致伸缩系数和弹性模量均强烈依赖于极化强度，压电系数与极化呈高度非线性关系，甚至存在“减小极化反而增强电致应变响应”的反常可能性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现纤锌矿材料的电致伸缩系数和弹性模量均强烈依赖于极化强度，压电系数与极化呈高度非线性关系，甚至存在“减小极化反而增强电致应变响应”的反常可能性。；创新点：揭示了纤锌矿中电致伸缩和压电效应强烈依赖于极化的非线性行为，特别是发现了“降低极化可增强电致应变”的反常现象，并指出该现象源于极化增大过程中参考非极性层状结构向纤锌矿网络结构的演化。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与计算研究，具体方法摘要未明确说明（如是否采用DFT等），但基于对极化依赖的电致伸缩和弹性模量的系统分析，以及从参考非极性层状结构向四面体配位纤锌矿网络结构演化的物理图像。

papers.title: Efficient Bethe-Salpeter Equation Calculations Based on Numerical Atomic Orbitals and Norm-Conserving Pseudopotentials: Dual-${\boldsymbol k}$-Mesh Strategy
papers.abstract: We present an efficient implementation of the Bethe--Salpeter equation (BSE) based on numerical atomic orbitals (NAOs) and norm-conserving pseudopotentials within the ABACUS+LibRPA framework. By exploiting the localized resolution-of-identity (LRI) technique, the screened Coulomb interaction is cast into a real-space, unit-cell-indexed form $W_{μν}(\boldsymbol R)$ that is inherently short-ranged and well localized. This spatial locality enables an efficient Fourier interpolation of the BSE kernel from the coarse $\boldsymbol k$-mesh used in the preceding $GW$ calculation to an arbitrarily dense $\boldsymbol k$-mesh on which the BSE Hamiltonian is assembled and diagonalized, thereby giving rise naturally to a dual-$\boldsymbol k$-mesh workflow. Building on this scheme, we systematically examine the convergence of the absorption spectra with respect to the NAO basis set, the auxiliary basis set, and the $\boldsymbol k$-point sampling. Benchmark calculations for both molecular and periodic systems collectively validate the accuracy of the present implementation and establish the dual-$\boldsymbol k$-mesh strategy as a practical and reliable approach for $GW$+BSE calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) implementation、numerical atomic orbitals、norm-conserving pseudopotentials、dual-𝒌-mesh strategy。；研究对象：分子和周期性体系（具体材料摘要未明确说明），研究其吸收光谱的GW+BSE计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于数值原子轨道和模守恒赝势，利用局域化分辨率恒等（LRI）技术，实现了BSE核从粗𝒌网格到任意密𝒌网格的傅里叶插值，从而自然形成双𝒌网格工作流，并验证了该策略在GW+BSE计算中的准确性和实用性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于数值原子轨道和模守恒赝势，利用局域化分辨率恒等（LRI）技术，实现了BSE核从粗𝒌网格到任意密𝒌网格的傅里叶插值，从而自然形成双𝒌网格工作流，并验证了该策略在GW+BSE计算中的准确性和实用性。；创新点：提出并实现了双𝒌网格策略，利用LRI技术将屏蔽库仑相互作用局域化，从而允许BSE核从粗𝒌网格高效插值到密𝒌网格，避免了在密𝒌网格上重复进行GW计算，显著提升了计算效率。
papers.method_zh: 基于ABACUS+LibRPA框架，采用数值原子轨道（NAO）基组和模守恒赝势，结合局域化分辨率恒等（LRI）技术，将屏蔽库仑相互作用表示为实空间短程形式，并利用双𝒌网格策略进行BSE哈密顿量的组装与对角化。

papers.title: Dynamical crossover from motor-dominated to drag-dominated transport in a minimal active transport network
papers.abstract: Motor-driven intracellular transport is often described in terms of motor activity, but macroscopic transport also depends on how effectively motor-generated force is converted into coherent motion. Motivated by cytoplasmic streaming, a minimal active transport network is examined in which motor-driven transport competes with an effective slip-related dissipative resistance. The model is not intended as a quantitative reconstruction of Nitella cytoplasmic streaming, but as a minimal system for isolating the relation between motor activity, resistance, and transport output. A controlled scan over $γ_{\mathrm{Slip}}$ and $α_m$, with three independent seeds per condition, shows that increasing $γ_{\mathrm{Slip}}$ strongly suppresses mean transport speed while leaving the motor-bound fraction nearly unchanged. The mean load and motor force remain finite in the high-$γ_{\mathrm{Slip}}$ regime, indicating that motors remain mechanically active even when transport is suppressed. The dependence of transport speed on $α_m$ progressively disappears with increasing $γ_{\mathrm{Slip}}$: the motor dominance ratio decreases from $R\approx1.69$ to $R\approx1.01$, and the corresponding velocity difference decreases from $\sim1.9~μ\mathrm{m/s}$ to $\sim0.003~μ\mathrm{m/s}$. These results indicate a dynamical crossover from motor-dominated to drag-dominated transport. The minimal model provides a compact physical scenario in which active force generation persists while its contribution to net transport is suppressed by increased effective dissipative resistance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：minimal model、controlled scan、dynamical crossover）；研究对象：最小活性输运网络中的马达驱动胞内输运现象，具体以Nitella细胞质环流为背景，研究马达活动与滑移相关耗散阻力之间的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着有效滑移阻力系数γ_Slip增大，系统从马达主导的输运转变为阻力主导的输运：平均输运速度被强烈抑制，但马达仍保持机械活性（平均负载和马达力有限），且输运速度对马达活性的依赖性逐渐消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着有效滑移阻力系数γ_Slip增大，系统从马达主导的输运转变为阻力主导的输运：平均输运速度被强烈抑制，但马达仍保持机械活性（平均负载和马达力有限），且输运速度对马达活性的依赖性逐渐消失。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建最小活性输运网络模型，通过控制扫描滑移阻力系数γ_Slip和马达活性参数α_m，对每个条件进行三次独立种子模拟，分析平均输运速度、马达结合分数、平均负载和马达力等物理量。

papers.title: Engineering nonlinear magnon scattering in artificial spin ice via vertex dipolar control
papers.abstract: Artificial spin ice (ASI), composed of geometrically frustrated arrays of interacting nanoislands, provides a versatile platform for reprogrammable magnonic functionality. However, the commonly used geometric control parameters such as island length, width, and aspect ratio simultaneously modify the island footprint, inter island dipolar spacing, and shape anisotropy, making it difficult to tune the nonlinear response independently of the linear spectrum and lattice density. Using micromagnetic simulations of kagome ASI under strong microwave drive, we identify edge curvature as a geometric degree of freedom that separates nonlinear magnon scattering from the island footprint. Sharp tipped islands predominantly generate integer harmonics, whereas dumbbell shaped tips produce a transition toward subharmonic rich spectra by concentrating demagnetizing and exchange fields near the island ends without changing the overall island volume or lattice spacing. By mapping the curvature and drive parameter space, we identify a continuous threshold for subharmonic onset controlled by tip curvature. We further show that the angular dependence of the second harmonic amplitude reverses between sharp and dumbbell geometries, providing an experimentally accessible signature of curvature localized nonlinearity. Width and leg length asymmetry can also modify harmonic amplitudes, but they do not remove the intrinsic trade off between footprint and coupling. These results establish tip curvature as a footprint preserving design parameter for engineering nonlinear magnon scattering in ASI, with implications for reconfigurable magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：micromagnetic simulations、mapping the curvature and drive parameter space）；研究对象：人工自旋冰（ASI）中由几何阻挫纳米岛阵列构成的非线性磁振子散射，具体为kagome型人工自旋冰。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控纳米岛端部曲率（sharp tips vs. dumbbell shaped tips），可在不改变岛体积或晶格间距的前提下，独立控制非线性磁振子散射行为：尖锐端部主要产生整数谐波，而哑铃形端部通过集中退磁和交换场产生亚谐波谱。
